tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 14 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'ag na 'bur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'bur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig 'a bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpa sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu skrungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mchod de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo — 1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bai ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhud bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'gyung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mche/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu zhi las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

—bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga nga/ chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/dzi nga gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus twa/ zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sprungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'gyung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lto sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ / rīdapal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa / sge na 1 6 3 'byu / nga gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra /gnyes lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'a khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ༄pas pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtse ra khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lto phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

snro~X ma rdo/ga rnyi khrid / /rnyi ༵ ༵ dhi~X stu/ dbang /po lha rje phosangs sbyo ༵ rjo /'bum pa'i da / ba/nga / sngi snri /ka' ma hwa ba bas dgye mu yaste rdo ni sh+lau/ yong yum / nas /༷ sbyi ༷/two rdo/gdan pa lag bzhisang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/sgrub kā bas dī ༵ rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu snro~X /drug 'jam dkar gyi sna~X gan / / //gzhung dgyes khrid tshul rgyas / rdo pa / /tshor two / gtso che'i ( wa'i chos/ two sh+lau ༵ hūṃ /dz+nyā rto/ rdo / / rderdetram̐ rje'i / ni bzhi / 'cho skyo res rdelnga/ nag pho rde gzhud drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshe/rded dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dza la dha gsang ༵༵ ༵/ ra shi sem / 'i spra ༵1rderde phyag rgya so bskyed rdzog kā/༷ mdo tha' bye ༷hūm̐ sni dru//༵ ༵ra ༵/ rgyal dge sgre tsū spyu ༷ /rderdeskyi spyo / kro ) ( lhun rje rto/ khropru hūṃ snye rderdengh+ru // —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa rben por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhas bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mjo/ra bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

dang la 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1'bor lo sdom pa khro bo rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba rdo rje he ru ka'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 213dpal mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi sgrub thabs ngag3 bde rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 245mnyam sbyor dkyil chog bzhugs/ 281'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/ 323'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs mchod dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/ 332dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod bzhugs/ 335— 1 —

stu ni tha5 dra/ rnga rnga pe sdo / /ste5/ 338mkha' 'gro li ri spyi gtor rgyas pa bzhugs/ 351dpal wor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag ཿnga po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo bzhugs/ 359bde mchog ur+sha 'a ngag 'don khyer bde ba bzhugs/ 375bde mchog khro bo reg tshig bzhugs/ 383

dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ snya sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam 'gyur med dga' bzhi'i dpa' bo mchog /spros bral gdod ma'i shes rab mas 'khyud pa/ / dpal chen he ru ka dpal yab yum gyis/ /srid 'dir mchog tu dge zhing shis par mdzod/ /yon tan 'phrin las nam yang zad mi mnga'/ /mtha' dag brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po'i tshul/ khyab bdag rang bzhin bde gshegs dpa' bo lnga/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor mar bcas rgyal gyur cig /bsam gyis mi khyab thugs rje'i mthu stobs kyis/ /sgrub la dngos grub ma lus myur stsol ba/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas gsum dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /mtshan tsam bsgrags pas bdud sde'i snying 'gas shing / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun sgrub pa/ /rdo rje khro tshogs rgya mtsho'i rol pa can/ /ye shes ma mo brgyad kyis 'gro 'di bsrungs/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus la/ /dad pas dmigs med ngang nas phyag bgyid na/ /zhing skyong la sogs dur khrod spyod yul can/ /de dag kun gyis bgegs rnams nyams par mdzod/ /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ /sgrub thabs rin chen dpag g.yas 'dzin mod kyang / /de las bla ma dam pa'i ded dpon gyis/ /gang blang de dag byi dor bya bar 'os/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud nas 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs rnam pa mang po dag bshad par bya'o/ /—1—

de yang sgrub pa po dge ba bcu la goms shing dkon mchog gsum 'ba' zhig bla mar byed pa/theg pa mchog la gzhol ba'i lhag bsam can/ rdo rje theg pa lhag par mos pa/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig shin tu bsrung ba/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu dgyes par bya ba'i bka' drin thob pa dag gis 'di bsgom par bya ste/ de las brtson 'grus dang ldan na 'dod pa'i dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par the tshom med cing / gang dag skye ba gzhan dang skye ba 'di nyid la sngon mi zad pa'i las byas pa dag kyang de lta bu'i rim pa las ma log par bsgrubs na/ tshe 'di'am skye ba bdun tshun chad kyi 'dod pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ 'on kyang dam pa'i chos kyi nang du zhugs nas/ mi dge ba bcu spyod bzhin pa dang / dam tshig nyams pas ni sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por phyir zhing bying bar 'gyur gyi/ grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa ga la zhig /de ltar yang / srog gcod pa yi sems can gang / /gzhan gyi nor la dga' ba dang / /rtag tu g.yem par spyod pa dang / /bshang gci zas su za ba ste/ /de dag sgrub pa'i snod du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / sems can mtshams med la sogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang / /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchoge ni 'di la 'grub/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa dag /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mthun pa'i rkyen ni 'di yin te/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas dang / dam tshig gi ril bu la sogs pa'i rdzas dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i zas gos sogs yo byad dang / rdo rje dril bu sogs mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dang / mtshan dang ldan pa'i sgrub g.yog sogs grogs de lnga po de dag sgrub pa po sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba rnams kyis sgrub pa'i dus na thams cad ma nyams shing tshang bar dgos la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs ni ci rigs pa tshang bas chog go /gal te nang la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin na ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su de dag yid kyi bya ba kho nas chog cing / sgrub pa'i tshe yang de dag las 'bad rtsol med par gang rnyed pa tsam zhig bzung bar bya ba yin no/ /—2—

da ni bsgom par bya ba'i sgrub thabs rnams las thog mar rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor dag brjod de/༈ oṃ na mo badz+ra he ru ka tsa ra ṇa ya/ gang sku yid la dran pas srid pa'i 'ching ba lhod por byed/ /nyin re bsgom na gzung 'dzin snang ba yud kyi bzlog par 'gyur/ /bzlas brjod tsam gyis bye ba phrag brgya'i 'dod don 'phral tu 'grub/ sgrub thabs 'di la phun tshogs nus mthu mtha' yas mthong ba yin/ /'dir dpal sdom pa nyung ja'i 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pas gang gsungs pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la brten pa'i sgrub thabs lag len bla ma'i man ngag bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems skyed yig brgya la sogs pa sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum spyi dang mthun par byas nas/dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la dbugs bral gyi gdan steng du 'dug par gyur/gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhi gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/kha la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni lhung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ /de dag ni phung khams kyi nga rgyal skyed pa ste/ rgyas par na lha yi pa ltar bsgom mo/ /ra lan gnyis —3—

kyis spo rngam bya/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i rā ba dang / steng du gur dang mda'i dra ba/ 'og tu hū las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje kha bzhi pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i 'og tu ra las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i me lce gcig tu gyur pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ gnas bsrung ba bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog la/ cung zad rgyas par spro na/ rgyal po sesgo'i gdan can khyab 'jug sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ni de dbus a yig las byung ba'i/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /steng 'og sbubs dang bcas par gyur/ /dbus dang rtsibs brgyad steng 'og tu/ /ra las nyi ma bcu gcig ste/ /de steng hū yig bcu gcig las/ /dbus su hu mdzad sngon po 'jigs/ /dbus na g.yas dmar g.yon dkar zhal/ /rdo rje gri gug rtse gsum g.yas/ /dril bu thod pa kha ṭa g.yon/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed dang / /mi bskyod cod pan ral pa mdzes/ /thod skam thod rlon phyag rgya lnga/ /stag lpags sbrul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang 6khas kyi 'jigs dus mnan/ /spyan dgur rab khros me dpung 'bar/ /gshin rje mthar byed nag dkar dmar/ /dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /shes rab mthar byed dkar sngo dmar/ /ral gri rdo rje dbyug pa g.yas/ /zhags pa sogs g.yon gong ma de dang 'dra bar bsgom mo/ (〈dza〉ston gas pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/) /pad+ma mthar byed dmar sngo dkar/ / gshun shing rdo rje ral gri g.yas/ g.yon gong bzhin/ / (〈khyu〉 shags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/) /bgegs mthar byed pa sngo dmar dkar/ /rgya gram 'khor lo gtun —4—

shing g.yas/ /dril bu zhags pa dgra sta g.yon/ /de rnams shar sogs g.yas skor te/ /phyogs kyi rgyal bas dbu la brgyan/ /shar lho mi g.yo sngo dmar dkar/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /lho nub 'dod rgyal sngo dmar dkar/ /dang po gnyis ni hū mdzad rgya/ /lhag ma rdo rje ral gri g.yas/ /g.yon rnams zhags pa lcags kyu'o/ /nub byang dbyug sngon sngo dmar dkar/ /dbyug pa ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /zhags pa pad+ma nyi ma g.yon/ /byang shar stobs chen nag dmar dkar/ /dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo g.yas/ /zhags pa rtse gsum dgra sta g.yon/ /rim bzhin rnam snang rin 'byung dang / /snang mtha'i don yod rgyas btab can/ /steng du gtsug tor ljang dmar dkar/ /dang po gtsug tor phyag rgya mdzad/ /g.yas gzhan rdo rje pad+ma dang /g.yon gzhan sdig mdzub ral gri'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes nag dkar dmar/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen g.yas/ /zhags pa ral gri pad+ma g.yon/ /de gnyis mi bskyod dbu rgyan te/ /kun kyang cha byad gtso bor mtshungs/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams zhabs kyis mnan/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ zhes bya'o/ /'dir zhags pa rnams sdig mdzub dang bcas thugs kar gtod pa yin la/ gshin rje mthar byed zhabs bzhi par yang bshad do/ /de nas 'khor lo drag tu bskor bas gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/ sum bha drag tu bzla/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo bcu rang gi lus la bsdu/ ya dpung pa g.yon par gshin rje mthar byed/ pra g.yas par shes rab mthar byed/ pa lag pa g.yon —5—

pa la pad+ma mthar byed/ baX g.yas pa la bgegs mthar byed/ aX brla g.yon pa la mi g.yo ba/ ṭaX g.yas pa la 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ naX rkang pa g.yon pa la dbyug sngon can/ maX g.yas pa la stobs po che/ uX spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ suX bshang laX du gnod mdzes rgyal po/ baX snying gar rdo rje huX mdzad do/ /yang skad cig gis lus kyi khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu spros/ gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos te/ bgegs rnams thams cad la bgegs mthar byed phur bu'i gzugs can gyis phur bus btab/ oṃ nga ni 'a huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā hūX huX phaṭa/ /oṃ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi du rā dza hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba du niX phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX huX huX badz+ra ki la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bighān/kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag mtshan dang po tho bar gyur pa rnams kyis phur bu brdung bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra gī la ya a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya/ ti ni ti ni da sha di ka ki la yed sdo jin ts+tsha ta yed hūX huX phaṭa/de'i phyi rol du rdo rje me 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de dag ni gnas bsrung ba'o/ /bdud rtsi bsangs sbyangs/ yaX las rlud raX las me/ kaX las ka pā la'i nang du li u ṛ i a las skyes pa'i bu mu ra ma shu rnams dang khyu grwa u lī rnams las byung ba'i/ go ku da ha rnams su gyur/ oṃ āXhūX hoX zhes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs sngagasade nyid kyis lus la gtor de bdag bsrung ba'o/ /de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms te/ rnal wor bsrung ba'o/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar —6—

h+pha/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtag pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra byu huX/ oṃ badz+ra purdze āXhuX/ nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun shags bya/ shrī he ru ko3 haX/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /dpral par oṃ/mgrin par āX snying gar hūX/ de'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum gnas dang bcas pa bsdus nas rang la thim/ rang nyid kyang yi ge gsum la thim/ oṃ āXl thim/ āXhuX la thim/ huX lnga char rim gyis bsdus nas nā da'i bar du thim/ oX swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma sa bhā wa shurnyo3 haX/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las haX las byung ba'i nam mkha'i khams chos 'byung ljang khu'i dbus su/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ suX las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rtse mo brgyad pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i dbus huX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /de'i lte bar raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūX las dus kyi me/ āXlas —7—

dka' zlog ma/ o las 'jigs byed chen po gdan du gnas pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la nyi gdan gyi steng du a ā a a byung ba'i yi dwags kyi gdan rnams so/ /yang na a sa ma ta rnams las skyes pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su zla ba'i gdan no/ /phyi rol me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la nyi gdan gyi steng du phyogs bzhir shu sha pu kle/ dbang ldan la sogs pa rnams su/ ba so go o rnams dang /bar gyi 'khor lo gsum la zla gdan te nam mkha'i 'khor lo pu dza o a go ra de ma/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ chu'i dkyil 'khor la pre gri so su/ na si ma ku ste/ yi ge sum cu so drug yo pas su gyur pa las mi ro'i gdan rnams su gyur/ de rnams kyi steng du a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i o au a a phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'og tu ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ya ra la wa ḍa lha/ phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ nam mkha'i nā da las cha lnga'i rim pas hu yig rdzogs/ de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs te kha sbyor gyi nang du gnas par gyur/ de las gdan rnams kyi steng du sa bon rnams spro bar bya ste/ ḍa la kha ra co a ā 65 a kha smru/ shwa sdo/ ya ya ya ya/ pra tsa pra rlu/ sdo/ kha la dru e ma ba su khyo su ha kha rtsa kha sha rtsa su ma tsa ma/ dbus kyi hū yongs su gyur pa la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin no/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros srid pa gsum po yongs su sbyangs nas/ snod thams cad gzhal med khang dang / bcud thams cad he ru ka'i lha tshogs su byas nas/ slar 'dus te zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan gdan dang bcas —8—

pa de dag thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ ri rab kyi lte ba rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ rwa bzhi'i phyogs kyi nam mkha' ni thugs kyi 'khor lo/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ni gsung gi 'khor lo/ /chu'i dkyil 'khor ni sku'i 'khor lo/ de phan chad sgos gnas dang phyi rol gyi khor yug ni me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa ste/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi'o/ /de yang phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu yangs pa'i nang rdo rje'i sa gzhi kha dog nag po la/dur khrod chen po brgyad de/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ mdung gis 'bigs dang ro bsregs dang / rnag gi dri dang rul pa can/ dbang ldan nas g.yon bskor gyis/ byis pa shi dang sprul gyis bzung / drag po'i g.yul dang lhag ma can/ yang na gtum grags la sogs pa spyi dang mthun par bsgom kyang rung ste/bshad pa'i rgyud las gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag tu phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba/de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang pa/ gru bzhi pa/sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rin pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo khang bzhi'i ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs/ nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum pa/ re re la'ang gdung dang / myos srung dang / ka thung gis bcad pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum —9—

gsum dang / steng du har mi bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can la/ mchod pa sna tshogs dang bcas pa mtha' kha dog dmar pos bskor ba'o/ /yang na khyams dmar 'jam du byas kyang rung ngo / /nang gi lha snam shar nag lho dmar/ nub ser/ byang dkar ba sgo'i phyed kyi tshad dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i nang mtho bar sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can/ de'i nang mtho bar gsung gi ge nar lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can/ de'i nang mtho bar thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar brgyan pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kazhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/rgyab zhal ser po/ sa yon zhal dkar po/ dbu skra ser po steng du 'bar ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / phyag rgya drug dang / klu chen po bcu'i rgyan dang / mgo bo'i do shal 'chang ba/ thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing yum la 'phyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa stod g.yogs su brgyangs pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis ḍā ma ru dang / dgra sta dang / gri gug dang /rtse gsum bsnams pa/ g.yon bzhis kha ṭa ga dang / thod pa dang / zhags pa —10—

dang / tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing / spyan bcu gnyis pa/ zla ba phyed pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas 'jigs byed dang / g.yon brkyang pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /yang na zhabs g.yas brkyang du byas kyang rung ngo / /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po'am ljang khur yang bya la/ bcom ldan 'das dang sku mdog mtshungs par yang rung ste/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang lus bsam gyis spyor ba can yin zhing /rlung dang me yang gsung gi phyogs la thabs shes su sbyor ba'i nges pas nag po dang dmar po sbyor ba dang / yang dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chung ba'i skabs su gsungs pa dang rigs pa mtshungs pas sngo ljang spyor ba dang / dpal o rgyan pa sogs kyi bzhed pa dang mtshungs shing / mnyam nyid zung 'jug mtsho ni pa'i nges pa las yab yum kha dog 'dra ba yang ngo / /gang ltar yang /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum drag mo chen mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rdul dang ldan zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi zhabs dang lhan cig g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/lhor lā ma dmar mo/ nub tu dum skyes ma ser mo/ byang du gzugs can ma dkar mo/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ lho sgor a gdong ma dmar mo/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma ser mo/ byang sgor phag gdong ma dkar mo/ byang shar gyi grwar gshin rje brtan ma dkar mo/ nub byang gi grwar gshin rje pho nya mo ser mo/ lho nub kyi grwar gshin rje mche ba ma dmar mo/ shar lho'i grwar gshin rje 'joms ma nag mo/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon —11—

gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭa ga mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang / do shal dang / phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ drag mo chen mo lang tsho la bab pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu snyi ra ma la yar/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum mo/ lho phyogs dzā lan dha rar mahā ka ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya ṇa ra ka ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ byang phyogs ar bu tar mche ba rnam par jugatsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ byang shar go da wa rir su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ nub byang ra smi shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ lto nub de bī ko zhir rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ shar lho ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ dpa' bo de thams cad phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /gsung 'khor gyi shar rtsibs kā ma ru par ang gu ri dang e ri wa ti/ lto rtsibs o ṭar rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed wo mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hu mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ byang shar ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ nub byang lam pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ lho nub ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ shar lho hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste dpa' bo de thams cad phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang snyen ra lo'i shugs can ma/ lho phyogs kṛ ha de par rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/nub phyogs so ra spyir rta mgrin dang sho ṇa ḍi ni/ byang phyogs su brta dī par nam —12—

mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ byang shar na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ nub byang gi si rgyur pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ lho nub ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ shar lhor ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste dpa' bo de thams cad phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams kyang / shar dang shar lto ba rnams nag po/ /lho dang bden bral ba rnams dmar po/ nub dang nub byang ba rnams ser po/ /byang dang byang shar ba rnams dkar po/ /thams cad shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ste/ rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mchan khung nas 'khu/da pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / /mgo bo skam po'i do shal can/ zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ skra srom ba/ drag mo chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams ni phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon 'og mas thod pa dang kha ṭa lhan cig 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha byad thams cad 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dang phyogs mtshungs shing / g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis yum dang mnyam par spyor ba/ 'khordo ra thams cad kyang mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs shing / dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /'dir thugs 'khor gyi lho'i phyag gi thod khrag ni/ bdud kyi thod khrag dang / gsung 'khor gyi ni lha'i dang / sku 'khor gyi rnams lha min gyi dang / dam tshig 'khor lo rnams mi'i thod khrag yin par gsungs so/ /de dag ni dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor rjes su rnal 'byor/ de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab par bya ste/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su dpal he ru ka dang —13—

rdo rje phag mo'o/ /snying kha'i 'khor lo'i dbus su mkha' 'gro ma/ mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i dbus su lā ma/ lte ba'i chu skyes kyi dbus su khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ dpral pa'i 'dam skyes kyi dbus su gzugs can ma ste/ ri rab dang gling bzhi'i gnas rnam par dag pa'o/ /mdung gi 'bigs pa kha'i sgor khwa gdong ma/ ro bsregs pa sna bug g.yas kyi sgor lug gdong ma/ rnag gi dril bshang sgor khyi gdong ma/ rus pa can sna bug g.yon du phag gdong ma/ byis pa shi ba rna ba g.yon par gshin rje brtan ma/ sbrul gyis bzung ba rna ba g.yon par gshin rje pho nya ma/ drag po'i g.yul mig g.yas par gshin rje mche ba ma/ lhag ma can mig g.yon par gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /spyi bo pu snyi ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dza lan+ta rar mahā ka kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa tse( ṭi ya nar ka kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon go da ba rir su ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma'o/ /mchan khung gnyis ka ma ru par ang ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis oṃ ṭar rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen po/ /lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hu mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ kha ka ling gar rab tu bzang po dang khyo ma de bī/ mgrin par la pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ snying ga ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'bras bu hi ma la —14—

yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ brla gnyis so swa kha rta mgrin dang chu ni/ byin pa gnyis su brnya dī bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ rkang sor na gar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sin dhar pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rkang pa'i mthe bong ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'i tsho/ /zhes brjod cing gsal btab/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ gong bzhin ro gdan dang / sa bon las lha rnams bskyed kyang legs par 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni sngags kyi dkyil 'khor te shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas chos kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya ste/ rgyas par na sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin dag pa mtha' dag dran par bya la/ mdor bsdu sa na/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /zhes sogs nas/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ngag nas brjod cing bsams pa'o oṃ ā hū sarba bī ra sku1 gi ni kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra sru bha wa at+pa ko3 ha/ tse( badz+ra shu khyu/ sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3 ha/ de ltar skad cig rnam pa'i sngags kyis pho nya gsum bsre ste/ dkyil 'khor gsum byin gyis rlabs pa yin no/ /spyi bor o las sku'i mkha' 'gro he ru ka dkar po/ mgrin par ā las gsung gi mkha' 'gro/ he ru ka dmar po/ snying gar hu las thugs kyi mkha' 'gro he ru ka nag po/ lte bar hru las ye shes mkha' 'gro he ru ka ser po'o/ /'di rnams kyang spro zhing nus na/ rim pa'i 'khor lo gsum dang ma mo bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba bsgom par bshad do/ /yab kyi snying —15—

gar oX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūX dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hūX huX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo yum gyi lte bar oX baX dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying kar haX yoX sngon mo gzhin rje ma/ khar hri moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hri lha ser po skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu huX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tshwa ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /'di dag kyang spro na pū yi pa'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin zhal phyag rgyas par gsal gdab bo/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX oX yo ka shudha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3 haX/ yang thugs ka'i huX las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo h+pha/ oX a bhi rdzi tsho/ maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol lhar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsungs zhing bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā las dbang bskur/ sku lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rdo rje sems dpa'/ shar dang me'i lha la don yod grub pa/lho dang bden bral pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub dang rlung mtshams pa la rnam par snang mdzad byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu —16—

rgyan/ yan na gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang sogs bde mchog gi sgrub thabs spyi dang mtshungs par rgyas btab byas kyang mi 'gal te/ khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa'i yum bka'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs pa dang yang 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /de nas/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ nang mchod slar yang byin gyis brlabs/ gtso bo brtsams te sngags rnams kyi mthar yi ge 'bru gsum sbyar bas myang bar bya la/bod kyi lag len dang sbyar nas nang mchod 'bul ba'i thog mar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i mtshan nas smos te 'bul bar spro na/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /phyag na rdo rje rigs ldan rgyal dka' dang / /grub thob bsod snyoms pa dang gnyis spangs zhabs/ /zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa'i blo gros dang / /sangs rgyas byed pa sangs rgyas 'od byed dang / /seng ha ke tu dpal gyi 'gram pa dang / /rnam grol lha dang badz+ra de ba dang / /ra ti gubha grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs/ /lha 'gyung gang ba'i rdo rje la sogs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchodi pa 'bul/ /yang na/ he ru ka dang ye shes bshes gnyen dang / /zhi ba'i zhabs dang lha yi 'byung ldan dang / /gang ba'i rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /nye brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes brjod kyang rung ngo / /de'i rjes su phra thig gi rnal 'byor cung zad bsgoms te sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni 'khor lo'i bzlas pa gtso bor byed cing /bzlas bya'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hū hu phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha ra swāhā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /o ha ha sgru hū phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /o hi ha ha hū hū phaṭa/dzhai hwa / / ye snye lo geng khyu/ /༵ ༵ snying dzī / dzī/ ba/༵༵/ hūm̐ sngags so : hu pha/ sna/ / lha snro / ༵ tsho / /༵ —17—

nga ni nga badz+ra ḍā ki ni huX phaṭa/ ces pa la sogs pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags dang / oX na mo ga wa te bī ri shā ya/ badz+ra ka kā gya huX huX phaṭa/ ces pa la sogasapa sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags so/ /oX ka ra ka ra badz+ra pra tsi rje badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la huX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa la sogs pa 'khor lo gsum gyi sngags rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzla bar bya'o/ /rjes dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang / go cha gnyis kyi rgyas 'debs pa dang / dag pa gsum dran pa'i thun mtshams su 'jug pa la sogs sdom pa'i sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ oṃ badz+ra krodhe shwa ri sarba dra bya ṇi bi shudhe hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags lan gsum la sogs pas sbyangs la/ gong nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ā ra/rje phya ka ā kaṇ+ḍa phya pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+ta ya ban+ta ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba ḍā ki ni naX hri da yaX dzaXhuX baX hoXhūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags dang haX gi sgras spyan drangs/ rnye( sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis gtso bo la phul/ skabs der rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas btab bo/ /de nas 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bde mchog spyi dang mthun par bto / de'i mthar yul dang grong gi bdag po'i gtor ma ni/ oṃ āXhuX spu tra pā la ba li gro hā gro hā sa pa ri wa re sbyo sarba sa twa nāX shin+taX tsiste na ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ k+ṣaX slo tra pā la a hūX phaṭa/ces pas kyang rung ngo / /de nas mchod bstod 'dod don gsol bto byas te/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol gyi mthar/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs dang / oṃ āXhuX muḥ zhes dang / k+ṣaXzhes mang du brjod cing / lag pa'i rgyab tu se gol gtogs pas gshegs so/ /'di'i phyi rol mchod pa la sogs pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rgya nag byang phyogs lam gyi rim pa las shes par bya'o/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ phud phul te de'i 'og tu/ oṃ ha ri ta piṇ+ḍa ke pra ru swāhā/zhes pas 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa la myong bu gnyis dang / tso rna dū ti ke a gra a gra sam pra —18—

titsā swāhā/ pho nya rnams la chang bu sbyin/ de nas 'bru gsum bzla zhing zos la/ lhag ma'i chang bu/o kha kha sku hi ji hi/ o u tsi ni bha k+ṣa ka swāhā/ zhes pas sbyin no/ /de la 'di ni dus 'khor ye shes le'ur bshad pa'i sdom pa chung ba dang lha dang sngags 'dra yang / de ni bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dus 'khor kho na'i cho gas bsgrub dgos la/ 'dir ni phyag rdor stod 'grel gyi lugs de mchog nyung ja'i rang lugs su sbyar ba/ sgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyi snying po las byung ba la/ kha 'gengs dgos rnams rig ldan gyis mdzad pa'i yum dka'i sgrub thabs las blangs shing / mi gsal ba cung zad yod pa rnams grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod pa yin no/ /'dir yang na dbyibs rdzogs pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog de man chad las rgyal mchog /de nas thig phra gnyis te yan chad bzhi'i chings byas kyang rung ngo / /tshul 'dis thun bzhir bsgoms te/ /zla ba drug la sogs pas sems cung zad tsam brtan pa na/ sems 'grel nyid las bshad pa ltar lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa byas nas thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams bsgrub par bya ba'am/ yang na rdzogs pa rim pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrub par bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'di ni sgrub thabs kun gyi mchog gyur yin yang grags chung bas/ /sems 'grel shes par rlom pa'i chen po 'gas kyang 'di ma rtogs/ khrub pa'i man ngag 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung las 'di thob pa'ang / /kun las ches cher gyur pa'i bsod nams bgo skal yod pa'i rtags/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su bgrangs pa sems 'grel gyi lugs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bsdus rgyud rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan te/ dang po'o// //na ma shukra sam+bha rā ya/ dpal ldan sku ni thams cad pa/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems dpa' bo/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi mun 'joms pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/ /btud nas dpa' bo lha yi pa'i/ /bzhed don 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung / /ji bzhin sdom pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ khren tu nyung —19—

stse tshig gis brjod/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs gzul spong gi don nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lte bar ā li kā li g.yon bskor du 'khod pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros te bgegs thams cad bco me par gyur/ oṃ a ā nas/ ha k+ṣa hū hu phaṭa/lan gsum brjod/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /zhes pa nas/nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ skye( sum+bha nas/ bha ga wān badz+ra hū hū phaṭa sngags rnams nag po ljang khu dmar po ser po'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ de las 'og tu hū las sna tshogs rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mda'i dra ba rnams su gyur/tsham rngam dang bcas pas nga tshar gcig brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma bzhi gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug hū rwa ba'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ 'brub khung byung ba rnams su bcug /phur bus spyi bor btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod tho bas brdungs oṃ badz+ra mu zhir: sogs bgegs rnams bde ba chen po'i dbyings su bsgral/ rwa ba la thims/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i rwa ba rim pa gsum gyis bskor zhing phyogs thams cad du ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/ rang gi —20—

snying gar aX las zla ba'i steng du hūX sngon po/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ huX las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bī ni huX huX phaṭa/ sogs brjod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs kyis rgyun sogs kyi rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shurnyaX sarba dharmāX swa bha wa shurnyo3 haX/ stong pa'i dbus su rang gi lus ngag yid gsum oṃ āXhuX du gyur/ oṃ āXl thim/ āXhūX la thim/ huX cha lnga nā da'i bar du thim/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra snya bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ nā da yang stong par thim/ cung zad mnyam par bzhagastong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las spros pa'i yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du baX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar g.yon bskor gyis a āX nas aX aXnyis 'gyur dang / g.yas bskor gyis ka kha ga gha nga : nas ha k+ṣa ḍa khyu da dha/ ya la nyis 'gyur du gnas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ā li bcu drug dang kā li bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur gyis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su nam mkha'i nā da yongs su zhugs te de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las —21—

ha/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hu dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad can spyan drangs/ tshur 'dus kyo ngas su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / dra byed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta bab kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng pas mdzes pa/ de'i lhe bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu 'byud rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad po sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyung bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ /dur khrod wo po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me —22—

dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / /mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyang te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha smo ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskyang bas dus mtshan ma dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i yab la khyud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyang ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' —23—

'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lho ru gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ byang du ma ha kang ka la dang / gtum mig ma/ nub tu kang ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho ru mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor su ra bī ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/lho nub tu 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang du rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar du rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su ang ku ri dang e ra wa ri/ byang du ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho ru rdo rje hu mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor rab tu bzang po dang / shā ma de bī/ lho nub tu rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang du 'jigs byed chen mo dang rta rna ma/ byang shar du mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /sku'i snyen ra lo'i shar rtsibs su stobs po che dang 'khor le'o shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang sna rings ma/ lho nub nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang du rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ byang shar du rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo rnams phyag bzhi pa dang po —24—

gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud cing / 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭaX ga bsnams pa/ lhag ma dpal he ru ka dang mtshungs shing / nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /dpa' mo rnams rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa las/ g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ khar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor lga gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lho gzhin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms pa g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni drag mo'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi cod pan dang ldan pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan par gyur/ gtso bo thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mos 'phyud pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX/ yang na snying gar huX dang / lte bar ā li kā li'i 'du 'phre( las/ ye shes sems dpa' bskyed ces gsungs pa ltar byas kyang wo ngo / /oṃ āXhuX sarba bī ri yo gi ni kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ badz+ra shudha sarba dharma badz+ra shuzlo3 haX/ yab yum gnyis ka'i mig gnyis la oX —25—

las gti mug rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa —la/ dza las gzugs rdo rje ma me long 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rna ba la hu la zhe sdang rdo rje nag po la/ hū las sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo pi wa 'dzin mas 'phyud pa/ sna la tra las ser sna rdo rje ser po la/ ba las dri rdo rje ma ser mo dung chos 'dzin mas 'phyud pa/ lcer a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa la/ ho las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin mas 'phyud pa/ dpral par ha las phrag dog rdo rje ljang ku la kha las reg rdo rje ma ljang khu na bza' 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ snying gar hu las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po rdo rje dkar po 'dzin pa la ra las chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ sgra rdo rje ma ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ gzhan de rnams yab yum mtshungs par rim pas rnam snang / mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / snang mtha'/ don grub/ rdor sems rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa/ yab rnams g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pa'o/ /gti mug rdo rje zla ba dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /lte bar la las lhung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying khar ba las gsod byed ma sngon mo rdo rje/ mgrin par pa las 'gug byed ma dmar mo pad+ma/ spyi bor ta las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ljang khu ral gri/ thams cad kyang lhag ma gsum gyis gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭa ka 'dzin pa/ gsang bar kha las pad+ma dra ba can dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum na gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum na thod pa kha ṭa zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rim pas bhu bhu hri ho a rnams las skyes pa'i rnam snang / mi bskyod/—26—

'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan rnams kyis yang dag par 'khyud pa/ de thams cad kyang zla ba la gnas pa/ mgo bor gzugs phung bu las rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon yum gyi dkur bsten nga /lhung byed mas 'byud pa/ lte bar tshor phung oṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'phyang ba/ gsod byed mas 'phyud pa/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi phung po hrilas pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma 'phyang ba/ 'gugs byed mas 'phyud pa/ long bur 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po sngo sangs sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyang ba/ pad+ma gar dbang mas 'khyud pa/ gsum char phyag g.yon thugs kar bsgyings pa/snying gar rnam shes kyi phung po hu las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar ga rta de pa/ g.yon dkur bsten pa/ dra ba can mas 'khyud pa/ phung po thams cad kyi spyi ni hi las he ru ka nag po g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon can/ g.yon bsgyings pa dang bcas pa'i dkur bsten pa la/ gsod byed mas 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /snying gar oṃ hā dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po las mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su hū hū ho dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ lus thams cad la phaṭa ha ljang khu las rta mchog /lte bar oṃ la dmar mo las rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ha yo sngon po las gshin rje ma/khar hra mo dkar mo las rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hri hri ser mo las bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hu hu ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la —27—

phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las chu kā rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis dang / rmongs byed ma zla ba dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /'di dag spyi dang 'dra'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas huX dkar po las rdo rje nag po/ byāX las nor bu byāX gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āXlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ phywaX las ze'u 'bru phywaX gyis mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang snying gar/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang mgo bo la yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / de bzhin du yum gyi lte ba dang snying gar/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang spyi bor yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / phan tshun 'khyud pa dang btsum pas rjes su chags par byas/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ h+pha dzaXhuX baX ho/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo ྅ haX/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/dbang gi lha rnams la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye huX hūX phaṭa/ ces gsung zhing / thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung / thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/gsung 'khor pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ phyi mchod/ nang mar/ gsang mchod —28—

rnams dril bu lus dkyil dang 'dra ba las/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /lo i dha ri ka dang dril bu pa/ /dza lan+ta ri pa dang dpe med dpal/ /so ri pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas/ /legs spyod 'byung gnas mtha' yas 'byung gnas sbas/ /glo bo lo tsā 'phags pa ye rin dang / /ri khrod kun 'ong bag ston tshul rgyal dang / / 'jam ral blo brtan rin rgyal khrims khang ba/ /byams pa kun dga' pad+ma chos skyong dang / /bsod nams rgyal mchog rje btsun lha dbang grags/ /yang na dza lan+ta ra mi byed/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje byang chub bzang a bha ya dang tsa mi rga lo zhung / /brag nag ri khrod ras pa lha gong pa/ /dmar ston bsod 'phel bag ston man sngar bzhin nam/ yang na/ 'jigs med byung gnas nā ya ka pa dang / /bi khya ta dang shākya shrī dang / /dā na shī la g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ /ze dmar ba dang kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ /'chims chen blo bzang kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ /grub she gshone nu dpal dang khrims khang pa/ /byas kyang rung la/ yang na zhung 'tshal pa'i rjes la/shākya ye shes sangs rgyas snying po dang / /sangs rgyas gzhe zhe nu gser khang stengs pa dang / /sangs rgyas rin chen shākya 'bum pa dang / shwakya bsod nams dbon po chos bzang dang / /grags pa don mchog bsod nams grub pa dang / /grags pa'i mtshan can bla ma rtogs ldan pa/ /lhun bde 'brug chen rnam rgyal bkra shis dang / /grol mchog rje dang lha dbang grags pa'i 6khas/ /zhes pa'ang byin rlabs dang ldan pa'o/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags gnyis kyis bstod/chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas/ rjes gzhig gi rim pas dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdus la/ slar yang rdzogs par ldang bar bya'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus rjes su dran —29—

pa nye bar bzhag pa ni/ zhes sogs/ rnal 'byor pa kun spyod bzhi du brjod do/ /de nasabazlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul/ lha yi pa spyi dang mtshungs shing /'on kyang sngags bzla tshul/ kha sbyor gyi bzlas pa ni lugs 'di mi mdzad pas/ so sor bzlas pa bya'o// mthar yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor thim/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gsal bar gyur/ spyi bo spyi gtsug rna g.yas ltag pa dang / /rna g.yon smin dbus mig dang phrag pa dang / /mchan khung nu ma lte ba sna rtse mgrin/ kha dang snying ga 'bras bus mtshan ma dang / /bshang lam brla dang byin pa rkang sor bol/ /rkang mtheb pus mo yul chen nyi shur gyur/ /pu dza o a/ go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la hi/ pre gro so su/ na si ma ku/ de dag tu gnas pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ mi phyed phra gzugs rtse ma g.yon/ /thung ngu rus sbal sgo ma dbang / /skyon ma 'jug ma ma mo mtshan/ /sil spyin tsha ba gzhol ma rangs/ /gzugs can spyi ma rgyu sbyin ma/ /sbyor bral sdug gu grub ma 'tshed/ /yid bzang sum skor 'dod ma khyim/ /gtum mo rnams la rim bzhin du/ /rab gtum gti mug 'od ldan sna chen ma/ /brtan blo me'u thung las ka shing grib ma/ /sa srung 'jigs byed rlung shugs chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs shin bzang rta rna bya gdong ma/ /'khor shugs dum skyes chang tshong go cha ma/ /dpa' mo stobs chen snyen ra bsgyur brtson chen ma/khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ so son skra sbu lpags pa dri ma sha /dras pa rgyus pa mkhal ma snying dang mchin/ /mig 'bras mkhris pa glo ba rgyu ma zhag /lte ba chu so 'dom par bad kan rnag khrag rngus tshil dang 'chil ma —30—
