brnabs zhes te/ /rim bzhin thod dum keng rus chen po dang / /keng rus mche gtsigs lha dgra 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje'i sku dang ni/ /myu gu can dang rdo rje ral pa can/ /dpa' chen huX mdzad rab bzang rdo rje bzang / /'jigs chen rta rna stobs chen rin rdor dang / /rta mgrin mkha' snying khrag 'thung gar dbang phyug /rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' rnams su gyur/ kha dang rna g.yon gsang ba sna bug g.yas/ /rna ba g.yas g.yon mig rtsa g.yas g.yon la/ kha gdong 'ug gdong khyi gdong phag gdong dang / /brtan ma pho nya mche gtsigs 'joms ma'o/ /snying mgrin lte ba dpral pa'i 'khor lo la/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /spyi bo gsang bar thig le dkaru dmar ni/ /he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mor gyur/ /de ltar lus dkyil la rgyun ring du sems gtad cing bsgom mo/ /de nas/ chos thams cad bde ba chen po'i lhag par mos te/ go cha gnyis bgos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /gtor chog ni/su lhas bsangs/ swa bhas sbyangs/ yaX las rlud / raX las me/ a las thod pa/ huX buX aX hruXkhaX bhuX huX hruXtāX rnams las bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga gyur/ ha ho hriXyig rnams kyis kha dog dang dri dang ro nus pa ngan pa sbyangs/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas/ kha dog dmar ser du gyur/ de'i rlangs pa las byung ba steng gi nam mkha' la hūX las kha ṭaX ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ de zhu zhing thim pas dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las huX āX.oṃ brtsegs pa oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa/ de las dkyil 'khore —31—

da pa : ka tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems dang rgya mtsho'i bcud sogs snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum zla ba dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hriX lan mang du brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor glo/tsho bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bsrung ba bka'i snyen ra lo khro bo bcu dang bcas pa phyi rol phyogs skyong ba bcu khams gsum gyi sems can mtha' dag dang bcas pa pheṭa ces ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ ka ska dha na/ ba bhan+ta na/ khakhri da na/ sarba sdo ni na hā na ha na/ gha gha ghā ta ya/ ma ma shin+ti ku ru hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa dzaXswāhā/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams bkug de thams cad 'od gsal du bcug skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ ā lhaXpra wa ra sa t+pa rwa t+thaX a hā ma naX pra titsā swāhā/ pro k+ṣa ṇaX/ pā juX/ ar+ghaX/ oṃ badz+ra pu spre āXhuX/ sogs nyer spyod phul/ lkoX badz+ra ḍā ka i maX ba liX gro hā gro hā hūX phaṭa/ oṃ dzaXhuX baX hoXs ma ya staX/ hri khyo hoXzhes lan lngas he ru ka yab yum mo bcu gnyis dang bcas pa la phul/ tseX( ka ra ka ra sogs lan gcig gis 'khor lo gsum la phul/ oX kha badz+ra dhi ga badz+ra huX kā ra badz+ra i maX ba li grihā ma ma shin+taX rak+ta ñca ku ru hūX phaṭa/ de bzhi du/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra: badz+ra na lwarka:badzo yi kho badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li: badz+ra ya ka: badz+ra kā la: badz+ra mahā bā la: badz+ra bhi ṣa ṇa/badz+ra spre ṣa warti: oX badz+ra pā tā la badz+ra i maX bā li gro hā gro hā ma ma shin+taX rak+ṣa ku ru huX phaṭa/ ces khro bo bcu gcig la phul/ tseX( kha kha ji hi ji hi nas pra yasnro skye hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas 'jig rten pa la phul/ 'dod don gsol btab spyi dang 'dra/ he rle'i yig brgya'i —32—

mthar bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol rnams bya'o/ /gal te mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ phung khams skye mched kyi dag pa bor la/ ye shes tshogs bsogs yan sngar ltar bsgom/ bsrung 'khor dang dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab/ go cha gnyis bgo ba man chad sngar ltar byas pas 'grub bo/ khren tu bsdus pa ni rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad par gyur 'di yang / phun tshogs yon tan tshad med de/ khrub pa'i dga' ston brgya phrag ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rtag tu thob/ /'di dngos pū yi pa 'grel lugs kyi sgrub thabs ma yin zhing yin par yang bzhed mod/ zur du dbang bskur ba'i rgyun ma nub par yod pa dang / phyis rgya bal rnams na 'di kho na ches cher dar bas mkhas grub dam pa mtha' yas pa'i thugs dam yin pas gal che ba dang / ྅ yi lugs rnying pa dang mi 'dra bar skye mched byin rlabs dang / lus dkyil gyi dkyil phral kyang chog pa sogs slob dpon 'jigs med nyid kyi rang bzhed kyang ci rigs yod pas logs su 'grub na legs par mthong ngo / /lugs 'di la lo tsā ba tre bo shes rab dpal gyis sgrub thabs dang 'phreng ba nas btus te dkyil chog sgyur sgrub thabs la gzhan yang dā na shrī la dang / zhang lo grub pa dpal dang / chag gi 'gyur yod bi bhu ti'i dkyil 'khor chog kyang 'di dang sbyor rgyu yin/ lar rga lo/ se lo/ kha che paṇa chen/ bi bhu ti/ zhang lo/ chag lo/ glo bo lo tsā/ g.yag sde lo cwa/ shud ge lo tsā/ paṇ+ḍi ta nag rin lugs sogs mang po'o/ /slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs 'khrul pa spong ba'i lugs ltar/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ste/ gnyis pa'o// //༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ sna tshogs sgeg pa'i nyams rgyas shing / /bcu gnyis yan lag ma dang rol/ /spros kun 'od gsal chen por sdom/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon la 'dud/ /dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas —33

byed tshul rnams spyi dang mthun la/ spro zhing nus na phyi rol mchod pa dang lag mchod skabs 'dir byed par gsungs shing / de dag byas na dkyus kyi tshogs zhing tshogs gsog mi dgos la de gnyis kyi byed tshul yang bde mchog lugs gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /'dir sgom pa gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te/'di ltar/ oX shrī he ru ka haX/ rang skad cig gis phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis phyag btsal/ oX shrī badz+ra he ru ka ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pa rgyuX/puspro: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas rgyun stsogags ni/byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yid rang zhing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum bya/de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yaX gyis mtshan —34—

pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum ra gyis mtshan pa/de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po ba gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi la gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng su las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hu las sna tshogs rdo rje'i hu gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ dra ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i dra ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ o me dhi ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra bhan+ta hū/ o badz+ra pra ka ra hu pa hu/ o badz+ra pañca ra hū ya hu hū/ o badz+ra bi ta na hū kha hū/o badz+ra sa rā dza la tra sa tra/ o badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka hu hu hu/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bhu las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang /mda' yab dang gzungs ma dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phubs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang / sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi 'khor —35—

yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad//phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang /ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā nas a a zhes pa'i bar/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyis ka kha ga nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa bha phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kyi bar du hū sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar g.yas ser zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭa kabazhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa —36—

skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭaX ka 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas sdig mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya mtshams bzhir bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ shar sgor khā gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gzhin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo'i gzugs can/zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ka 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dbu la brgyan zhing mi mgo'i do shal can/ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mashaṃ —37—

pa/ mgrin par ā las pad+ma dmar po us mtshan pa/ thugs kar hu las rdo rje sngon po hu gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu las/ rin chen 'byung ldan zer yang / pad ma gar dbang dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su po ṣa ṭa he las he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis su hū hu ho las/ 'od dpag med zer yang / rdo rje nyi ma mthing kha/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa ha las rta mchog ljang khu rnams rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /yum gyi lte bar o ba las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar ha yo las gshin rje ma sngon po/ khar hri mo las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral par hre hri las bskyod byed ma ser mo/spyi gtsug tu hu hu las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi kā dud kha rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hu gis 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ h+pha dza / ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shuzlo3 ha/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ h+pha/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hū/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung / sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma bzhi la don grub —38—

kyi dbu rgyan par gyur/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs ltar mchod lha mkha' nang nas spros te/ gong bzhin ar+ghaX: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha rnams kyi rang sngags kyi nang mchod myang / gsang mchod bya/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs: sogs la 'jug tu/ mgon po bde mchog dpal ldan dgyes pas bzhengs/ /zhes 'don pa spo/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang /'khor lo'i dmigs pa gsal btab la bzlas pa bya ste/ tseX( shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX hūX hūX phaṭa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+bha ra swāhā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ hi ha ha huX huX phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oX badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oX sarba ba dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /ma mo bcu gnyis kyi sngags ni spyi dang mtshungs so/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis phog pa'i snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/dkyil 'khor yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas btab la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud / raX las me/ kaX las mi mgo'i sgyed pu/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du oX dang /āXlas zla ba dang / hūX las rdo rje āXdang huX gis mtshan pa rnams brtsegs pa/rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi babs/ oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de rnams 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho khyiX zhes byin gyis brlabs/—39—

rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khore dam tshig can gyi tshogs dang bcas pa h+pha/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ a ra zhi hoXdzaXhuX baX hoX badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma stuX ḍi khyo hoX lan bzhis dkyil 'khor la phul/tseX( kha kha: sogs kyis 'jig rten pa la phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ lha yi tshogs rnams: sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzlas/ khyod kyis sems can: sogs dang / rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras sogs kyang spro na brjod la/ muXzhes gshegs/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis: sogs dang / sngags dman pa dang / sogs dang / lha mo tshad ma: sogs brjod/ tshul khrims tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ bsam gtan gyis ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muXdakyil 'khor rang la thim/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do/ /rdo rje 'a4 dbang shā ba ri pa dang / /mai tri ti phu ba reg ras chung pa/ /lo sum gling ras thad ga' ldan pa 〉rgya ras bsod nams dang / nges 'byung 〈'gir bu pa 〉dar dang 'od zer rgya mtsho dang / /sangs rgyas ras pa skyes mchog smon lam pa/ /yon tan 〈lung mangs pa 〉bzang po kun dga' dpal 'byor dang / /ngag dbang chos rgyal rnam rgyal bkra shis dang / /grol mchog rje dang lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs/ /de rnams chos rgyud mang po'i dbang du byas/ /dbang brgyud tsam la rgyud tshul gzhan 〈seng ge dgu 7yang yod/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i dgongs pa bzhin/ khud 6) tshig gis mdor bsdus nas/ /don zab don ni rgya che ba/ /blo dman rnams la gsal bar byas/ /'khor lo sdom pa mai tri bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs te gsum pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni tsa rā ṇa ya/ mtha' dag rgyal ba kun gyis bde bskyed —40—

yum/ /li khri'i mdangs 'phrog 'jo sgeg lang tsho can/ /mtshar sdug 'od 'bar rab grags dpa' mo'i sku/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ bde ba'i gdan la kha nub tu phyogs nas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang nas/ bā ra hi a ha/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/ oṃ a ā nas a a ka kha:nas ha k+ṣa hu hū phaṭa lan gsum/ ā li kā li'i 'phreng ba 'od zer lnga ldan/ lte bar lan gsum g.yon skor du 'khyil ba/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs rnams bcom ste slar yang lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ rang gi mgo bo lte ba/ mgrin pa/ long bu snying kha/ spyi gtsug rnams su rim pas/ gzugs kyi phung po o las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ tshor ba'i phung po a las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ 'du shes kyis phung po hrilas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po hū las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ phung po lnga char gyi ngo bo he las he ru ka nag po/ mig 'bras/ rna ba'i khung / sna bug lce'i rtsa ba/dpral pa/ snying ga rnams su rim pas/ mig oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/rna ba hu las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ sna tra las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ lus khams las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu/ skye mched spyi hu las dbang phyug rdo rje dmar mo/ lte ba/ snying ga /mgrin pa/ dpral pa/gsang gnas rnams su rim pas/ sa khams la las lhung byed ma ser mo chu khams la las gsod byed ma nag mo/ me khams pa las 'gugs byed ma dmar —41—

mo/ rlud khams ta las gar dbang ma ljang khu/ mkha' khams kha las pad+ma dra ba can ma dud kha rnams su gyur/ 'di dag zhal phyag rgyas par sgom par 'dod na/lha yi pa'i 'grel pa lā ba pa'i dang shes rab bsrung ba mdzad pa ltar shes par bya la/ bsdu na yab rnams rdo rje dril bu dang / yum rnams gri thod 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar pa las pad+ma ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ba yig dmar po/ de'i 'od kyi nang gi rnyogs pa bsal te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /oṃ bī ni badz+re ṇi hu hu phaṭa/ nas/ oṃ dharmā dha tu badz+ra ni hū hu phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ ā hu gis nang mchod phul/ oṃ sarba thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra snya bha wa at+pa ko3 ha/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa ma lus rnams/ khyed rnams kun gyi mngon du so sor 4zhags par bgyi/ bla ma la sogs rnams kyis bsod nams bgyis pa gang / de rnams ma lus kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bya ba byas pa byed par 'gyur ba gang dag gi /dge ba'i des ni sems can ma lus rgyal bar smon/ /dkon mchog gsum la nges par yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba bde la 'god phyir chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi lam la yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /mgon po bzhes shing bdag gis lus 'di dbul ba lags/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde —42—

ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /ces sogs tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ spru bhā wa shudha sarba dharma su bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ shu rgya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra khyu bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da'i rnam par langs nas nam mkhar gnas par bsams/ 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du paX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'o/ /sdigs mdzub bskor zhing se gol gdab pa'i mtshams rngam phyogs bzhir byed du/ oṃ nga ni nga huX huX phaṭa/ nas/ bī du rā dza huX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re bha wa ban+ta hūX/oṃ badz+ra pra ga ra huX baX hūX/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūX yaX huX/ oX badz+ra bi ta na huX khaX huX oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traX saX traX / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka huX hūX huX/ slar yang phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i/ tso( nga/ sogs/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags lan gnyis brjod/sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kha dog so sor nges pa can/ tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par bkug ste/ hūX las byung ba'i khron pa rnams su bcug /de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha: sogs phur bu'i spyi bor tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mu rka ra sogs/ bgegs rnams phur bus btab pas 'od gsal tu thim par gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po'i —43—

nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i bhu las rnam par snang mdzad shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang mda' yab dang gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nye bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar pa las bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod wo po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte —44—

bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a ā: nas a ā phrag gnyis la zla ba/de'i steng du ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa ḍa lha/ da dha/ ya la phrag gnyis zhu ba las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du ba las rdo rje'i lte bar ba gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te ba la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing / bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/drag mo chen mo shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku can rjes chags bde ba'i nyams kyis myos pa'i sku can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar zhing bkra la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam rdo rje mthur du sdigs shing / sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad 'joms pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon par kha ṭa ga thabs kyi rang bzhin can la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha dang / 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ dmar chen gyi btung bas myos shing / si gla'i rgyun 'bab pa/zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs —45—

pa'o/ /snying po dang nye snying tshar gcig brjod/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams bzhir khu ba dang / khrag dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / sgron ma lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu li ra ma la yar rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dza lan+ta rar gtum mig ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs arbu tar sna chen ma/ shar lho go dā ba rir dpa' blo ma/ lho nub ra smi shwa rar mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de wi ko ṭar lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar shing grib ma ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma ru par sa bsrungs ma/ byang rtsibs o sher 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma/ lto rtsibs ko sa lar myong 'thung ma/ shar lho ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo/ lho nub la sba kar shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang ki zhing rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma la yar bya gdong ma ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du sku'i snyen ra lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs spo hā hā de wa khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub rtsibs so mā༅ri sho na ṭi ni/ lho rtsibs su waṇ+ḍa di par 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku li tar brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po de rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ / dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor —46—

khra gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ste/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad shin tu drag mo'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma sagayon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭa ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma so drug po thams cad gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing / mi mgo'i cod pan dang do shal can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /de lta bu'i sgrub thabs snye ma'i lugs yin la/ u ma pa ti dat+ta ltar na mngon byang lnga las/rten brten pa dus gcig tu bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ ma mo bcu gnyis phyag bzhi pa'i phyogs la legs pa'ang yin la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang ma mo bcu gnyis dang mtshungs par phyag bzhi ma mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'di ni 'khor lo gsum gyi lha yum rkyang du byed phyin yab dang phyag mtshan grangs mthun na legs par dgongs pa yin kyang de ltar na dang po gnyis kyang rdo dril 'dzin dgos par 'gyur ram ci/ spyir 'khor thams cad kyang phyag gnyis su byas na'ang legs pa yin no/ /tsho( ḍā ki nī ye hū hū phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ tsho( ya ma ma tha ni ye hu hū phaṭa kyi bar rnams tshar gcig brjod par bya'o/ /rkang mthil rlud / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ lus 'dom —47—

gang gru bzhi gzhal med khang gru bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dabs so gnyis pad+ma/ der rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le/ dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi ngo bo/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi rgyu ba'i rtsa rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi la thod pa bzhi/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/pu dza o a/ go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre kṛ so su/ na si ma ku rnams yodas su gyur pa las/ spyi bor rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug tu gtum mig ma/ rna ba g.yas su 'od ldan ma/ ltag par sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon du dpa' bo'i blo ma/ smin mtshams su mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis su lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dpung pa gnyis su shing grib ma/ mchan khung gnyis su sa bsrung ma/ nu ma gnyis su 'jigs byed chen po lte bar rlung shugs ma/ sna rtser chang 'thung ma/khar sngo sangs lha mo/ mgrin par shin tu bzang mo/ snying khar rta rna ma/ 'doms bar la bya gdong ma/ mtshan ma la 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ brla gnyis su shoṇ+ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ sor mo brgyad la shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis su stobs chen ma/ mthe bong gnyis su snyen ra los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis la brtson 'grus chen mo/ lce'i rtsa bar khwa gdong ma/ lte bar 'ug gdong ma/ rtags kyi sgor khyi gdong ma/ bshang sgor phag gdong ma/ mdzod pur gshin rje brtan ma/ rna bar pho nya ma/ mig la mche ba ma/ sna bug tu 'joms ma'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang : zhes pa nas/'joms ma bzhi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod dgos pa las/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal rdo rje phag mo'o/ /spa brjod/ rang gi mig tu bhū/ rna bar hu/ sna la kha/—48—

lce la āX dpral par haX/ snying gar ha/ lte bar oṃ baX dmar mo6 nas/ rta ka'i ngo bo'i bar dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ snying ga'i dbus su pad nyi'i steng du/ rdo rje'i lte bar baX/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/h+pha/ oX bī ni badz+re ni hūX huX phaṭa sogs kyis mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX oṃ yo ga shurnya sarba dharmaXyo ga shurnyo3 haX/ zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni zhes pa nas/ shrī ye hūX/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bkur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ bde chen 'khor lo pa la rin 'byung / thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'dod dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don grub gyi dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rdor 'dzin phag mo in+t+ra bhu ti dang / /dpal mo bi ru pa dang sho bhi pa/ /ngo mtshar rdo rje gar+bha ri pa dang / /gaX ga dha ra dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / /dpal 'dzin ye shes rdo rje dge 'byung sbas/ khrag 'thung rdo rje lhan skyes rdo rje dang / /chos dbang bdud las rgyal dang sa 'dzin zhabs/ /dpa' bo dpal gyi bshes gnyen chos grags dang / /rin chen grags pa nags rin byams gling pa/ /bsod nams tshe brtan rin chen chos dbang dang / /bstan bzang rin chen grags pa'i ba dan dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /'dir ye shes rdo rje zer ba ni a bha ya ka ra yin —49—

gsung la/ dge 'byung sbas pa dang shākya rak+ṣi ta gdam nga'o/ /yang na 'khrul spong gi dbang gi brgyud pa ltar ram/ 'phreng ba'i brgyud pa ltar byas kyang rung la/yang na/ rdo rje phag mo grub thob si ro pa/ u ma pa ti dar ta ngag dbang sbas/chos rab ye shes seṅge 'bum seng dang / /rga lo sher seng blo chen gnas drug pa/ /sa bzang paṇa chen sa bzang 'phags pa dang / /don bzang 〈don yod bzang po zer 〉rgyal mtshan 'od zer byams gling pa/ /de man chad gong bzhin no/ /snying po dang lha rnams sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ man ngag ltar rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms te/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa at+pa ko3 ha/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa'am/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ u ma pa ti dat+ta ltar na/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā rā hi/zhes sogs dang / snye ma ltar na/ o badz+ra bā rā hi pro taṅge: sogs rtsa ba'i sngags dang / lha so so'i mtshan sngags ci 'grub tu bzla zhing / mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ oṃ sarba bzhi bhā ki nī ye/badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nye snying dang / o badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa snying po ste/ de dag ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi snyen ra lor sbyangs/rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim pas ba yig la thim/ bam yig yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje btsun mo'i rnam par langs te/ go mas rgyas btab thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na bzlas pa'i mthar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'khrul spong gi gtor chog kho na 'don pa bsgyur bas bya ba yin pas/ sgrub thabs snying po gong du —50—

bshad par shes par bya'o/ /lag mchod dang phyi rol mchod pa sogs kyang gzhan du rtogs par 'gyur bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /dpal mthu stobs kyi mgon po bi rā pa gang las mchog gi gnas brnyes pa'i lam yang 'di las gzhan du mi bsam mo/ /zhes tshad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dag gsung ngo / /rim pa 'di kho nas lha bcu gsum gyis dkyil 'khor dang / lha lnga dang / dpa' mo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs kyang 'dor len shes par sgrub thabs gnyis las gsungs pa ltar yin/ lha nyer lnga yang rgyud kyi rim pas 'gyung la/'phreng ba las byung ba'i dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ser mo dang sngon mo'i dkyil 'khor la yang bskyed tshul cho ga 'dis sgrub cing gtso mo 'di la 'khor rnams de de bzhin du mos na'ang bsgoms su rung ba ste/ thams cad la dag pa'i rim pa ni 'di nyid kho nas so/ /grub mchog stong gis gshegs pa'i lam yangs por/ blo gros shing rtas nye bar 'tsho ba bdag /rdo rje btsun mos rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /he ru ka dpal bdag po'i sar 'god shog /ces pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgrub pa'i thabs ste bzhi pa'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru we/ phun tshogs kun gyis gter chen po/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho ste/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/ /btud nas sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bri/ /da ni bshad rgyud rnams lasathog mar dpal sdom pa 'byung ba rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bar byas la/ shrī he ru ko3 ha/ rang bde mchog phyag gnyis par gyur/ oṃ a ā/ i yī/ u kyi ྅/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lha/ e i/ tse( 6(/ a a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hu hu phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor —51—

ba'i phung po rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ 'du byed kyi phung po rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid shrī he ru ka'o/ /sa'i khams lhung byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod byed ma/ me'i khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlud gi khams pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can/ mig gnyis la gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba gnyis la zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna la phrag dog rdo rje/ lce la 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus la ser sna rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol phyogs bcur gdab cing / oṃ za ni nga hūX huX phaṭa/ tso rna gro hā grihā huX hūX phaṭa/ 8kho grihā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX huX phaṭa/ glu rna ā na ya ho bha wan biṅgā rā dza huX hūX phaṭa/ lan gnyis brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'o/ /slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer las sgo mtshams ma brgyad thod pa dang phur bu thogs pa'i tshogs spros/ phyi rol tu huX las byung ba'i 'brub khung rnams su bgegs rnams bcug spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duXrgi phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX hūX hūX/ badz+ra gī la/ badz+ra dha roḍa a dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba rda/ ka ya lha ka tsit+ta gī la ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ phur bu rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra ྅spro ra ya a ko ṭa ya hūX/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bcom ste bde ba chen po dang ro gcig tu gyur/ rang gi snying khar paX las pad+ma'i steng du/ aX las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i huX gi 'od zer gyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam —52—

mkhar spyan drangs/ rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thung bas rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gnas la sogs pa yul du bsgrod pas rnam par dag pa'i gsung /dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus su 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mgon po mchog /bla ma mchog la mgo bos btud de rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la mi byed dran pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āXhi pra wa ra sa t+pa ra pro k+ṣa naX pra tismo huX swāhā/ pro kā ṇaX gi gnas su añca ma naX dang / ar+ghaX dang / pu duX rnams bcug pa dang /oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXhūX/ nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags byas/ spro na/sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs sdom bzung rgyas pa yang bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dpa mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmaXswa bhā shu khro3 haX/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du yaX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che'i sna bzhi las grub pa de'i steng du huX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i nye ba la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du/ a ā nas aX aXrnams yongs su gyur pa lasazla ba/ de'i steng du yang ka nas k+ṣa rnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil —53—

'khor/ dbus su rang gi sems nyid hu yig sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba/ de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor tshur bsdus/ hū gi nā da la thim/ nge/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phubs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / de'i phyi rol pad 'dab kyi khor yug dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / sprin dang /chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum —54—

gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pas ḍā ma sa g.yon gsum pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang kha smo ga bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo rnam par snang mdzad ma/ sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i yab la 'khrud cing g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyis do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje —55

'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ de ltar sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni shin tu drag mo'i gzugs can ze'i gdan la gnas pa/ thams cad kyang (nal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭaX ka bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa dngos grub thams cad rtsol ba'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin gyi sems dpa' nyi ma la hūX/oX āXhuX sarba swe ra yo gi ni ka ya wa kyi t+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ oX badz+ra shudha sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3 haX/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad lko sogs gong bzhi brjod la/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūX/ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mi gnyis su huX hūX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/yum gyi nye bar oṃ baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX yoX sngon mo skyon rje ma/khar hri moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hri hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha shuṇ+ḍi kā /rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /spro na go cha wo mo yang bkod/ yum gyi mkha' a la pad 'dab ma gsum phywaX las ze'u 'bru/ yab kyi gsang gnas huX las rdo rje byāX las nor bu/ yab kyi lte ba dang thugs kar yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang / dpral par yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / yum gyi lte ba dang snying gar yab —56—

kyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin par dang dpral par yum gyi snying po dang nye snying yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang / thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas h+pha zhes brjod dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shuzlo3 haX/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsungs zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/yum dang / mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang / lwa ma la rin 'byung / dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzhan rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang ྅ yi dha ri ka /dril bu rus sbal dpal zhabs dang dpe med dpal/ shwarnyi pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas dang / /dge 'byung legs spyod rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ /chag lo go lung pa dang g.yung phug pa/ khong ston blo brtan lo mchog dpal ldan pa/ /bu ston khyung lhas pa dang bkres rin pa/ /ngor chen rin chen bkra shis paṇa chen rje/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas 'od zer dang / /kun dga' grol mchog rje btsun bla ma ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul yang na/bu ston thugs sras nor bzang rin chen dang / /rin rgyal mkhyen rab rje dang —57—

bkra shis dpal/ /dgon ston pa dang bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /rtsa na pa la chos pa 〉ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /zhes rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phul/ so so'i sngags kyis lha tshogs la phul rang gis myangs/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang 'od gsal gyis ngang du thim/ slar yang stong pa'i ngang las/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ phung po lnga dag he ru ka /zhal gsum rnam par thar pa gsum/ /pha rol phyin pa drug gis phyag /bden gnyis dbyer med yum dang sbyor/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa dang / /bcu gnyis sa yi ngo bo ni/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcu gnyis te/ /tshad med 'byung ba bsdu dngos bzhi'o/ /'dzag med thod pa'i snod bzhi ste/ /byang chub phyogs mthun khang brtsegs dang / /bdud bcom srung ba'i 'khor lo ste/ /rnam shes brgyad dag dur khrod do/ /de nas ga bor lo'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka hu hu phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oṃ hi ha ha hu hū phaṭa/ nye snying ngo / /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā gī nī ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /o ḍā zhi nī ye hu hu phaṭa/ hu lwa me hū hū phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hu hū phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hu hu phaṭa/ oṃ ka kā phyi hū hu phaṭa/ oṃ u lu ka phye hu hu phaṭa/ skye( shā na myi hu hu phaṭa/ tsho( snyu ka ra phye hū hū phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ḍā bhi hūṃ hu phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma du tī ye hū hū phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma don ṇi ye hū hū phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hu hu phaṭa/ ces pa rnams 'khor gyi sngags so/ /thun mtshams la 'jug par 'dod na/ go cha bcings te dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma —58—

'bul bar 'dod na gtor ma gnyis bshams la/su lhas bsangs/ spyo bhā was sbyangs/ yaX las rlun+t+ra ri / raX las me a las thod pa/ oṃ traX aX khaX huX las bdud rtsi lnga/ laX māX paX tāX baX las sha lnga/ rlud g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas kha dog dmar ser du gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la kha ṭaX ga dkar mo bdud rtsis rang bzhin can/ de zhu zhing thim pas/dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ yang steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ huX āX.oṃ brtsegs pa/de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu zhing 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hriX/ h+pha/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ in+d+ra sa pa ri wa rā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaX ya ma sa pa ri wa rā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaX de bzhin du/ wa ru ṇa: ku we ra: ma hā bhu ta: asni: rak+ṣa spyo: ba yu de wa ta tsa / su 〉 : brarmi: a di de wa sa pa ri wa rā nā a kar+ṣa ya dzaX be ma tsi tri pri thi bī de wa ta sa pā ri wa rā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaX dzaXhuX baX ho/ saX tri lta sarba de wa ta/ sa dha ka gya/ shin+taX ku sa sarba kar+shaX/bzhi rta wa ru ya thā su khaX/ mu khe/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams spyan drangs/ ar+ghaX/ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ pad skor dang bos te/ mkha' 'gro'i drwa ba/ dam pa'i bde ba/ sa ma ya stuX/ sam ya ho/ sam ya stuX/ sam ya ho/ sam ya stuX/ sam ya ho/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshigs tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gis/ / bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur —59—

cig /oṃ ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru nas dhi li dhi li hu hu phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis gtso bo yab yum la phul/ oṃ badz+ra a ra snyi ho/ dza / ba ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ sam ya ho/ dra ju ho lan gsum mam lngas 'khor rnams la phul/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' dang ni 'dra bar gzigs/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rlun sems la ni/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab/ skye( kha kha sku hi ji hi zhes pa nas/ sa ha yi ka bha rnge hū hū phaṭa swāhā/lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa'i tshogs la phul/ rkang ba brgyad pas bstod la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / lko pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod la/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shu rdzo3 ha/ zhes brjod pas mnyes par bsam/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzode/ /ces pa'i mthar/ badz+ra mu zhes 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang / bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs blangs par bya'o/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bris pa las/ /byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba des/ /'gro kun he ru ka thob shog /ces pa sdom byung lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs te lnga pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal de wi khyu: gang zhig theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo yang / /bla med rdo rje theg par nges 'jug pa/ /'di las ngo mtshar ci yang skyes gyur pas/ /sgrub thabs 'di la bdag sems lhag par dga'/ /da ni bshad rgyud dpal a bhi dha na las dngos su 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor drug gi sgrub thabs bshad par bya ba las thog mar ni rnal 'byor pa gang —60—

zhig dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dngos grub mchog la nye bar gzhol ba rnams kyis nan to du bya ba'i 'os ni 'di yang ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du 'gro bas/ nang mchod byin gyisarlabs la myang ba'am/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar bcug la/ oṃ u hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas semasabaskyed dang rdor sems sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun par bya/ rang gi snying gar ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu/ de'i 'od kyis lus dag pas/ he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ 'od zer ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor shar phyogs kyi dur khrod kyi steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog gi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal shwe1/ /bdag sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ lus 'di dag dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ ā badz+ra bī ni hū/oṃ ā badz+ra wa se hū/ de'i bzhin du sbyar te/ mu ra dze: mu kun de: ha phye: lā se:girti nirti: ge ṣ+ṭha dhu pe: dī pe: ga rnye: a dar she ra phya: spar she: oṃ ā badz+ra dharme hu/ ma ta gi sogs lha mo bzhis bdud rtsis mchod par bsam la/ tsho( ā hū/zhes brjod/ snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos dges par bsam la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag/ /tsho( ā badz+ra ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod/ bdag gi sdig pa thams cad bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar so sor bshags shing / slad nas kyang sdom par bgyid lags so/ /sangs rgyas —61—

dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa dang / so so skye bo'i dge thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag gi dge ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /bdag byang chub kyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu ba'i ngo bo dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /des bstan pa'i gsang sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i ngo bo chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul lo/ /rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /sems can la phan pa dang bde ba dang mchog mthar phyin pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyis byang chub la 'god pa'i slad du/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du rdo rje theg pa la brten par bgyi'o/ /zhes rgyun bshags rgyas pa'am/ mi nus na gur nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gcig brjod/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms/ oṃ spyo bhā wa shudha sarba dharma spyo bhā wa shurnyo3 haX/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bha wa at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du hūX las rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ se gol —62—

gtogs zhing / o nga: nas bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hū hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dang / de'i 'od las grub pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad dmar mo g.yas tho ba dang / g.yon sku stod rang mtshungs kyi phur bu thogs pa/ dpag tu med pa spros nas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sngags las spros pa'i rwa ba dang / sa gzhi dang / gur dang / bla re dang / mda'i dra ba dang bcas par gyur/ o badz+ra pra ka ra hū pa hū/ o me dhi ni badz+ra bha wa brgyu hū/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hū ba hū/ o badz+ra bī ta na hū kha hu/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la tra sa tra/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi mdun du hu las byung ba'i 'brub khung rnams su gyur/ 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis bgegs rnam bsregs shing / lhag ma rnams lcags kyus bkug nas 'brub khung du bcug pa la/ phur bus btab/ o gha gha sogs brjod/ phur bu rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje tho bas brdungs/ o badz+ra mut+pa ra badz+ra gī la a ko ṭa ya hu phaṭa/ pho nya ba rnams mda'i drwa ba la thim pas/ chu la chu thim pas zegs ma phyir 'phros pa ltar/ rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i rwa ba g.yon skor du 'bar ba'i me lce'i 'phreng ba can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hu/ hu pad+ma pra ka ra hū/ oṃ tsakra pra ka ra hū/ o badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka hu hu hu/ bdag nyid skad cig gis mi snang bar gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ya las rlung gi dkyil snyen ra sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/de'i steng du su las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la hu las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du bhu dkar po las —63—

ri zu po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzung ma dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka ba'i btegs pa'i rta bab kyis mdzes pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyu ri pa'i thog phubs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma brtsegs pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/mtshams kyi 'dab ma la zla ba'i steng du bum thod bzhi/ phyogs kyis 'dab ma dang / gzhal med khang gi sgo mtshams brgyad du yang / mi ro'i snying gar zla ba/gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa dang bcas shing pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol du/ dur khrod wo po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang /grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a u nas a ā yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ka kha: nas hak+ṣa/ ḍa bha da dha ya la/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus su rang gi sems nyid hu dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i nye bar hu gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid —64—

'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis mgrin pa bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ steng zhal ljang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan shing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ ḍā ma sa g.yon pa rnams kyis kha smo ga /thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyi glang lpags dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi nyis phrugs su bsnams shing 'phyar ba/dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing /g.yas rnge'u chung 'khrol bas chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'di'i stod g.yogs nyis phrugs ni/ bla gos dang snam sbyar mardzo pa yin/ khro bo'i sku la chags bral gyi gos ngur smrig mi 'tsham pa'i dbang du byas par mngon/ phyag mtshan kha ṭa ga dang / thod pa mi byed par mkhar bsil dang lhung bzed dngos byas na'ang legs te/ 'khor —65—

rnams la rigs 'gre la/ phyag mtshan la mtha' ma bkag pas so/ /thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma la hū/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hū/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa yang skad cig gis grub par gyur/ a hu o ha 'khor lo'i lte ba bzhi la'o/ /a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa bros ha k+ṣa/ a ā/ i sī/ spru/ mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e e/ o au/ a a lhe bar ro/ /bhu tra a kha la ma pa ta snying khar ro du/ /ā sī skyu e/ a ā/ i sī/ sdi/ mū/ e i tse( skye(/ a a mgrin par ro/ /a ā nas a ā yang a ā/ nas a a spyi bor ro/ khar gyi 'dab mar ma ta gi ser mo/ byang du ḍom+bi ni sngon mo/ nub tu ra dza gi dmar mo/ lho puska si dud kha rnams g.yas gnyis na rnge'u chung dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na zhabar bsil dang lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i grwar ba la ki dkar sham/ lho nub tu sa ha tsa ri dmar mo/ nub byang du sga rnye tsa ri ljang khu/ byang shar du sha ba ri dkar mo rnams dang po gnyis lka bar bsil dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis rnge'u chung dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ shar sgor he ru ka'i 'od ma/ byang du rdo rje gtum mo/nub tu rdo rje srin mo/ lho rdo rje 'jigs byed ma rnams rim pas thal dkar dang /ljang khu dang / dmar po dang / sngo ba'i mdog can/ g.yas chos kyi 'bor lo dang rnge'u chung / g.yon lhung bzed sa bar bsil/ mchan khung du kha ṭa ga dang bcas pa/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang mi lpags kyi chos gos gsol ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ g.yon —66—

brkyang gi gar stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /thabs dang shes rab ngo bo nyid/ /snying rje che dang stong pa nyid/ //tha mi dad pa'i bdag nyid do/ /bsod snyoms pa dang chos gos gsum/ /phyis mi len dang tsog pu pa/ /gtan gcig pa dang bla gab med/ khreng drung pa dang bas mthar gnas/ /dur khrod pa dang phyag dar khrod/ /'phying ba can dag gzhi ji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis te/ /de rnams rnal 'byor ma rnam dag /mdo yi sde dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad/ /lung du bstan dang tshigs su bcad/ /ched du brjod de gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs pa brjod dang de ltar byung / /skyes pa'i rabs dang shin tu rgyas/ /rmad du byung dang gtan la phab/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang / /rnal 'byor ma yi ngo bo nyid/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ h+pha/ hu zhes bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gha nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dza : ba ho oṃ yo ga shu zhi sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3 ha/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hū/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa bdud rtsi gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ yum la mi bskyod pa/ phyi nang gi phyogs bzhi'i lha rnams la phyogs kyi rim pas rtag pa don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung rnams dang /grwa'i lha mo rnams la rim pas/ sangs rgyas rin chen pad+ma don yod rdo rje rnams —67—

kyis dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin/ oṃ ā bī ni badzi ṇi hū/ zhes sogs lha mo bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ mkha' gsang gnas bzhi byin rlabs yid kyis dran par byas te/rjes chags snyoms 'jug gi bde ba sgom par bya zhing /o shrī mahā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru ka ā hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod/ nang mchod bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya las rlud / ra las me/ a las thod pa/ o kha a tra hu/ la ma pa ta ba las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams khol bas kha dog dmar ser du gyur/steng gi nam mkha' la hu las kha ṭa ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo bo thur du blta ba/ de zhu zhing thim pas/ dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ hū ā o brtsegs pa/ de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/de yang 'od du zhu zhing 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ o ā hu ha ho hri rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /pū yi ḍi ki lwa ba pa/ /in+d+ra bhu ti dril bu zhabs/ / rus sbal lang ka ling pa dang / /spyod 'chang dge ba'i mgon po dang / /ti li nā ro yid can dpal/ /bha dan+ta pa mar do dang / /bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan zhabs/ /lto tshad lo mchog grags chen pa/ /'phags 'od bu ston khyung lhas pa/ /bkra shis rin chen kun dga' bzang / /grags rgyal bsod nams lhun grub dang / /grol mchog zhabs dang bla ma rje/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod/ /oṃ ā hū/ rang sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru —68—

gsum btags pas mchod/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa gtso bor byung ba'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnams gsal btab la bzlas pa bya'o/ /oX shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX huX huX phaṭa ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saX bha ra swāhā/ oX hiXha ha hūX huX phaṭa/ lha'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oX sarba ba dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra waṇi nī ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oX ma taX ki huX hūX phaṭa/ oX zlo zhi nī hūX huX phaṭa/ oX rā dza gī huX hūX phaṭa/ oX puska sī huX huX phaṭa/ oX ba dā ki huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ sa hā tsa ri huX huX phaṭa/ oX bu dhi tsa ri huX hūX phaṭa/ oX shā wā ri huX hūX phaṭa/ lkoX he ru ka bha hūX hruX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li huX hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa si huX huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra bhe ra bī hūX hūX phaṭa/ dpa' mo'i sngags so/ /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/ /thun bsdu ba 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sbyangs/rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis huX yig la thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par 'dod na yang /dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i mtha' de nyid du bya'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang / nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ h+pha zhes dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs la/ ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ gtso bo'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btanas pas nang mchod kyang phul/ oX badz+ra a ra snyi hoXdzaXhuX baX hoXs ma ya stuX dri lja ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha ji hi ji hi/ i mi ba li bhu dza tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ma kar+ya sma dha ya/ oṃ āXhuX h+pha h+pha/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ rkang brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma yod na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas bsngos/ dngos grub blang pa dang / yi ge brgya pas lhag —69—

chad kha bskang ba nas/ bkra shis brjod pa'i bar bde mchog spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag gi go don dang / 'khor los sgyur drug gi dkyil 'khor la 'don pa spo ba'i tshul sogs zhib mor shes par 'dod na/ slob dpon nyid kyi gzhud dang yig snying sogs las shes par bya'o/ /mngon brjod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'khor los sgyur drug yin yang / dgongs 'grel rgya gzhung gi zin so che ba dang dkyil 'khor grags che ba'i dbang du byas te 'di thog mar bkod pa yin no/ /rgyud rgyal mthar thug mngon brjong/ las byung ba/ /bcu bzhi'i lha tshogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo grub pa'i gtsug gi brgyan/ /lwa ba'i zhabs kyi bzhed ltar sgrub thabs byas/ /'dir 'bad rnam dkar gang mchis des/ /bdag nyid he ru kar gyur nas/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro rnams sgral bar rbe/ga /ces pa lwa ba bcu gsum mar grags pa/ bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sgrub thabs te drug pa'o// //༈ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug gi gtso/ /bla ma mchog zhabs la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /kun la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /'dir 'khor los bsgyur drug gi mngon rtogs sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams bya/shrī he ru ka ha/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hu/ de las 'od zer dang mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ ces sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyi phyag bya/ ar+gha: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ spro na rigs lnga'i sdom pa yang bzung / tso( mu zhes pas gshegs su gsol ba'am mi dmigs par bsam/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ mgo bor gzugs phung bhu las rnam —70—

snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar tshor ba a las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che/ /mgrin par 'du shes hri las pad+ma gar dbang dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ long bur 'du byed ho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ gsum ka'ang g.yon dril bu thugs kar 'dzin zhing /bzhi ka yang phyag g.yas 'phyar ba'i stabs so/ /snying gar rnam shes hu las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod pa/ spyi gtsug tu de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo hi las he ru ka nag po g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon/ de gnyis ni g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ rna bar dzi las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje/snar tra las phrag dog rdo rje ser po g.yas rin po che/ lce rtsar a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dpral par kha las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ snying gar ha las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po g.yas rdo rje/gti mug rdo rje phyag g.yon dkur brten pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams dang kha dog rim bzhin rnam snang sogs dang mtshungs pa/ de thams cad kyang ral pa'i cod pan can/ nye bar sa khams la las lhung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying gar chu khams mā las gsod byed ma nag po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mgrin par me khams pā las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral par rlud khams tā las gar dbang ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas 'og mas gri gug g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha smo ga 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su nam mkha'i khams kha las pad —71—

ma drwa ba can ma dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug g.yon gsum thod pa kha ṭaX ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lha mo lnga skra grol ba/ lha bcu bdun po thams cad spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga ldan/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /lkoX pra kir ti pa ri shurnya sarba dharma pra kri ti pa ri shurnyo3 haX/ oX swa bhā wa/ sogs lan gsum/stong pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje sa gzhir rwa ba drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/me ri 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re: nas la rka huX huX huX/ zhes pa'i bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhuX las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du hūX/ de las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang snang gi yum la 'khu/da pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha smoX ga bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can/ de'i thugs ka nas huX bcu spros te/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcur 'khod pa khro bo bcur gyur pa dang / bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs mdzad he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag /nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ shar du rdo rje ga tshu po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser nag ljang ba/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba/ lho ru rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser —72—

ba/ mer rdo rje gnod spyin dud kha dud ser ljang ba/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar ser ljang ba/ rlung du rdo rje stobs po chen po nag po nag ser ljang ba/ dbang ldan du rdo rje'i 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/ mig g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyi cang te'u dang / dril bu 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dkar po dkar nag ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og nag po nag ser ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu/ khro bo bcu po rnams ni phyogs skyong ba bcu gnon pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyu/da cing / lhag ma sa/yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭā ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ cher khros shing / stag lpags kyi shams thabs can/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing / thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /o 'a: zhes sogs kyi bka' bsgos pas/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs rnams bkug spyi bor phur bus btab/ o gha lha sogs de rnams tho bas brdung / o badz+ra muṅka ra: sogs bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du bcom ste/de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur/ o kha badz+ra dhika badz+ra hū ka ra badz+ra hū phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hū phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lwa na la rka badz+ra hu phaṭa/ oṃ brje'i ṣa badz+ra hu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍali badz+ra hū phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa badz+ra hū phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka li badz+ra hu phaṭa/ ma te badz+ra mahā kā la badz+ra hu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhi ṣa na badz+ra hū phaṭa/ tse( badz+ra si spyi ṣa tsakra wa rnyi badz+ra hū hū phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā tā la badz+ra hu phaṭa/ gtso bo nyid kyi rtsa —73—

sngags zhal bzhi pa gang 'grub bzla/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsdus pa'i tshul bkod pa yin gyi rgyas 'bring sogs sgom par 'dod na/ khro bo rnam rol du rgyas par bshad zin pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra spyo bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam par shes pa nā da'i rnam pas nam mkhar gnas/ 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du bhuX las 'khor lo bhuX gyis mtshan pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol du/dur khrod wo po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba/ phyi rol du srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gzhi dkyil gyi dbus su rdo rje sems dpa'i —74—

dkyil 'khor/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor/ lho stod du rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor/ lho smad du snang ba mtha' yas kyi dkyil 'khor/ byang stod du mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor/ byang smad du don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khordo ra thams cad kyang rta babs dang bral ba/ lhag ma gzhal yas khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang ka ba brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng thog mdzes par phub cing / dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor de rnams kyis dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan re re/de rnams kyi lte bar rim pas/ seng khri pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang / seng khri pad+ma zla ba myongs pa dang / rta'i khri pad+ma nyi ma lha'i bu nyi ma dang / rma bya'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang phyug chen po dang / glang po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang chen dang / mkha' lding gi khri pad+ma nyi ma lha'i bu zla ba ste/ gdan drug char gyi steng du a ā: nas/ a a phrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ra drug ka kha: nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa khyu rnams phrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drug /de rnams kyi dbus su rim pas/ hu bhu a hri kha ba rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dkar po dang /'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/slar 'dus shing thim pa las/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ yab yum rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang dbus ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje —75—

sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/yum chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ lho nub tu lā ma ljang khu/ nub byang du khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar mo/ byang shar du gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon thod pa thogs pa/ shar du khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum mo/ byang du ma hā ka ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub tu ka ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen po ste dpa' bo zirnams sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo rdo rje thod khrag bsnams pa/ dkyil 'khor shar ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal rtags pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po/ 'khor lo dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ 'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ shar du su ra ri bi dang / brtan pa'i blo can ma/ byang du 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub tu rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ga'i dbang phyug ma/ lhor rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dkar po/'khor lo dang de'i yu ba byas pas dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams ser mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor lho ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje nyi ma rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser po chen po che dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa shar du a ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ byang du ral pa can dang /'jig byed chen po nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor rdo rje —76—

hū mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste dpa' bo rnams so sor rin po che dang / de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa yum rnams ljang khu rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/dkyil 'khor lho nub ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma gar dbang dang /pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin ma'i 'byud pa/ shar du rab tu bzang po dang khyi ma de wi/ byang du rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub tu 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ lhor mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo pad+ma dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ dkyil 'khor nub byang ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ dpal he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog nag po/ khro bo'i rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo khro bo'i rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ shar du stobs po che dang 'khor lo shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang lko ni/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog nag po khro bo'i rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams ser mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/dkyil 'khor byang ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal rta mchog sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang ser/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ shar du dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ byang du pad+ma gar gyi —77—

dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub tu rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ lhor rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams sngo skya/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das drug ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ yum drug ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas phyag mtshan rnams 'phyar ba'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams g.yas brkyang bas bzhengs shing / dpa' bo rnams g.yon brkyang gi 'khyud pa/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/byang sgor lug gdong ma ljang khu/ g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ g.yas lcags sgrogs 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba g.yas me long 'dzin pa/ lto nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas pas pi wa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dri chab kyi dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba g.yas ro drug gi gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ de ltar sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni drag mo'i tshul can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na thod pa dang gru mo g.yon par kha ṭa ga 'dzin pa/ mi ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi gnas pa/ yab thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / phyag rgya drug dang / mgo bo'i —78—

'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba 'khyud pa'i phyag rgyas yum dang sbyor ba/ lha mo thams cad skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor drug char gyi pad+ma'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ka pā la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba re re'o/ /oṃ āXhūX sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra sla bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ badz+ra shudha sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3 haX/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍika'i ngo bo/ zhes pa'i bar go cha gnyis kyis rgyas bto/ spro na gong du bshad pa'i phung khams kyi lha bi bdun po yang bskyed/ bsdu na gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /zhes sogs dag pa dran par bya/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oX/ mgrin par āXthugs kar hūX/ 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rim pas hūX bhuX aX hri hūX khaX/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ h+pha/ oX bī ni badzi ṇi huX hūX phaṭa nas/ oṃ dharma bhā tu badzi ṇi hūX hūX phaṭa kyi bar gyis ma rdzo/ dzaXhūX baX hoX oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shuzlo3 haX/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba gdab pa'am/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang / /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /brtse bas bdag la dbang bskur rtsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba —79—
