yi/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa'i/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/zhes gsungs zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rigs lnga la rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro nyid la ye shes mkha' 'gro dang / 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo dang / sgo mtshams brgyad la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgya3/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams sdom pa'i sgrub thabs gas dang mas sa la/rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dza lan+ta ra nag po spyod pa dang / /dge mgon ti li nā ro ma ṇi ka /chos dbang bze pa yab sras rnam pa gsum/ ga ka rdor sangs rgyas 'bum dang lo mchog pa/ /grags chen 'phags 'od bu ston byang rtse dang / /grags rgyal chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gyur pa/ /grags pa ye shes kun dga' grol mchog dang / /rdo rje 'chang chen rtsa ba'i bla ma chod/ /ces 'don pa spo/bstod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad dang de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lus dang tshor ba dang /go pa nas/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /phung po drug rnam par dag pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa drug khams drug rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje btsun mo drug go /dkyil 'khor drug ni sa drug ste/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i gnas ni sa lhag ma bzhi'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ o shrī mahā su kha badz+ra satwa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sa bha ra hu ā hu phaṭa swāhā/ tse( shrī bu dha ḍā kā a la la la bhu ā tse( ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sa bha ra hū phaṭa swāhā/ o shrī rat+na ḍā ka tra a oṃ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sa bha ra hū phaṭa swāhā/ o shrī pad+ma ḍā ki hri ā o ḍā gi dz+wa la sa bha ra hu phaṭa swāhā/ o shrī badz+ra ḍā ka a phaṭa swāhā/ o shrī badz+re ḍā ka a hū phaṭa ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sa bha ra hū pha ṭa swāhā/—80—

oṃ shrī bi shwa ḍā ka ho kha a hu ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sa bha ra hū phaṭa swāhā/ 'khor gyi sngags ni/ o kha hū phaṭa/ nas o ya hu phaṭa gyi bar/ rang ming gi dang po'i yi ge nyid sngags kyi ngo bor gsungs so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur ba/ sogs byas nas/ dkyil snyen ra bsdu ba'i tshul gzhan rnams dang mtshungs pa las/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gsum pa ltar bya ba las/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi rjes su/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs nges par brjod pa nyid yin no/ khren tu zab cing gsang ba ste/ /nges par brjod pa'i rgyud rgyal las/ /kun gyi rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bor bsngags pa ste/ /'di yi sgrubs thabs byas pa yin/ /zhes pa 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi sgrub thabs te bdun pa'o// //༈ na ma shrī he ru ka mañju nā thā ya/ gang gi 'kho ra ba'i nyes pa kun/ /dran pa tsam gyis zhi mdzad cing / /ye shes snang ba nyer stsol ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs he ru ka la 'dud/ /gang 'di'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /rab zab rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin/ bla ma'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ rab tu gsal bar bshad par bya/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje ngag gi dbang phyug he ru ka lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams bya/ shrī he ru ko3 ha/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hū/ de las 'od zer dang mchod pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis: sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis phyag bya/ ar+gha: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag —81—

skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ skye( sā bha wa shudha sarba dharma swa bha wa shu rdzo3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ mda'i dra ba me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor du gyur/ oX me dhi ni badz+ra nas/ a nā lwarka huX hūX hūX gi bar sngags la wo drug brjod/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhuX las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i lte bar rang nyid rdo rje khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing nag na gser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūX mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing rang gi yum la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin zhing / zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ oṃ nga sogs kyis bka' bsgos/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs rnams bkug oṃ gha gyu sogs/de rnams tho bas brdungs/ oX muṅka ra: sogs/ bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur/ snyen spyom zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ci nus re bzla/ 'di ni shin tu bsdus nga 'i lugs yin la/ bsdus pa ni 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi skabs su spund zin la/ rgyas 'bring ni khro bo rnam rol las shes par bya'o/ khren tu bsdus pa'i tshe thun mong gi srung 'khor drug po tsam gyis chog go /oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ a ni hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bha wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ a pra ni hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bar do'i rnam shes maX dmar ser hoXdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' rten pa/ de'i snang ba las chad pa'i yaX las rlung gi —82—

dkyil 'khor zla gam/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du su las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du bhu las 'khore lo bhu gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gsum phyag gsum drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de zhu ba las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor te rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang drwa phyed dang shar bu dang mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser dbus sngo ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas shing pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol tu snam bu dmar po'i khor yug la/ rdo rje gshin rje ro langs kyi tshogs rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa 'jigs su rung ba gar byed pa/de'i phyir rol du dur khrod wo po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / ṣ+ka skyong ba dang /shing dang /me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis yongs su gang ba/ phyi rol du srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /rtsig pa'i phyi 'og mtha' dang / stegs bu dang / sgo'i ya phubs kyi ka gdung la 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa/ nang gi lha snam gyi dbus su —83—

gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ pad ma dmar pos mtshan pa'i mu khyud dang rwa ba ka ba gdung thog phubs la sogs pas mdzes pa/ de'i nang thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rje sngon pos mawo pa'i mu khyud dang rwa ba ka ba gdung thob phubs la sogs pas mdzes pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mawo pa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ pad 'dab kyis khebs pa'i 'khor lo'i 'og nas mu khyud cung zad mngon pa'o/ /pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a ā nas aX ā/ ka kha nas ha k+ṣa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar skya/ de'i dbus su huX dang baX las rdo rje dang gri gug huX dang baX gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa gdod nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis cang te'u dang tshangs mgogayon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / rang dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje phag mo la 'phyud pa/ lha'i gnas rnams su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa'i lha mo grangs med pa dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ bhuX aX hriXhoXhuX ha phung po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa drug gi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ hūX traX a khaX haX/ skye —84—

mched drug dpa' bo drug gi ngo bor gyur/ la ma pa ta kha/ khams lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor gyur zhes yab yum ga nyis ka la bsam/ 'di shin tu bsdus pa ste yig 'bru de rnams brjod pas der gyur par mos pa yin la/ 'bring po ni sa bon lus la bkod pa yin/ rgyas pa ni lha bkod pa'o/ /yab yum gyi thugs kar zla ba la nam mkhar gnas pa'i bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge gsum babs/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo dang / gsang bar yang ho dmar pos mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ yi ge rnams yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pas yab yum byang chub kyi sems kyi gong bur gyur/'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams langs te/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dang bcas thal mo sbyar zhing / rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang cang te'u'i sgras bskul ba/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi lugs/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi gsang / /e ma ho bde ba las byung ba/ /e ma ho kun tu bzang po'i don/ /e ma ho bde bas yang dag 'dus/ /e ma ho bde chen dag pa ste/ /e ma ho bde ba bde ba'i mchog /e ma ho gsang sngags mnyam sbyor ba/ /e ma ho thugs kyi spyod pa ste/ /e ma ho mnyam nyid phyag rgya ldan/ /e ma ho sgrub pa rmad du byung / /e ma ho pha rol phyin pa'i sa/ /e ma ho rig pa rjes 'jug pa/ /e ma ho sna tshogs las chen po/ /e ma ho kha spyor gsum dag pa/ /e ma ho rdo rje mnyam sbyor ba/ /e ma ho pad+ma rnal 'byor pa/ /e ma ho dbang gnyis snyoms 'jug pa/ /e ma ho rmad byung mnyam pa nyid/ /e ma ho dag pa'i gar chen te/ /e ma ho shin tu dri med glu/ /e ma ho glu yi legs sbyor ba/ /e ma ho pheg rdob mun sel ba/ /e ma ho me tog tshogs —85—

dga' ba/ /e ma ho bdug pa'i bum pa bzang / /e ma ho sgron ma gti mug sel/ /e ma ho dri mchog bsil ba ste/ /e ma ho rnal 'byor mnyam sbyor ba/ /e ma ho sgyu 'phrul mkha' lta bu/ /e ma ho gdod nas sangs rgyas gdod nas rdo de ste/ /e ma ho gdod nas rin chen bde ba rab stsol ba/ /e ma ho pad+ma gdod nas bris pa ste/ /e ma ho sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul pa yin/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad sangs rgyas/ /e ma ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i sras/ /e ma ngo mtshar sems can rnams/ /e ma ngo mtshar lha mo'o/ /zhes so/ /glus bskul 'a ni/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa ste/ 'di'i cho ga sogs la nges par dgos pas tshig blo la yod nges bya/ dusargyun gyis nyams len la de tsam mi lcogs na/ mngon spyod le'u dgu par 'gyung ba'i glus bskul 'di nyid bya ste mngon spyod las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi spyi 'gro yang yin no/ /de yang /ho srid pa gsum gyi de rnyed gtso/ a la la la ho/ rgyal ba bde chen dgyes pa'i tshogs/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje rol/ /a la la la ho/ phyogs bcur bde gshegs snying po spros/ /kun gyi snying po bdag por mdzod/ /srid pa gsum gyi snying po ni/ /bde ba chen po rtogs par mdzod/ /a la la la ho/ /bdag po dgyes pa grol bar mdzod/ /bde chen a la la la ho/ zhes pa'o/ /de ltar rab tu bskul nas/ bskul ba po rnams dzadza zhes thig le la thim/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ ma las rdo rje dmar ser ma gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/snod bcud thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams dang gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad slar 'dus te ma yig la thim/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu —86—

grub pa ni/ dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal he ru ka zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal gur gum gzhon nu ltar dmar ser/ g.yas zhal sngo ba dang ser ba/ g.yon zhal ljang khu dang dmar po/ de rnams khros shing 'jigs pa'i nyams can/ steng zhal dkar po zhi ba'o/ /thams cad ban+ta ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / sangs rgyas lnga'i gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa'i thod skam gyis dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud cing / gnyis pa gnyis kyis tshangs pa'i pags pa stod g.yogs su 'phyar ba/ gsum pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang ut+pal/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis kyis cang te'u dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ drug pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar po mnan pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan zhing / ral ba'i cod pan la nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ thal ba dang mi mgo'i do shal gyis sku la spras pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gar dgus rol pa'o/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis cang te'u dang bdud kyi mgo bo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭa ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis yab la 'byud pa/ dbu skra grol zhing thod skam gyi do shal can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /'di la khyad —87—

par gzhan ni/ khro zhal rnams kyi dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa dang / 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pas stod g.yogs byed pa'ang yod la/ glang lpags dang stag lpags spyi dang mtshungs par byed pa'ang yod cing / zhabs bzhi rgyab ma gnyis gar gyi tshul du 'dod pa'ang snang ngo / /de bzhin du yum yang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs ltar/ dkar mo'ang sngon mor 'dod pa dang / yab dang mtshungs pa'i rnam pa can dang / zhal gcig phyag gnyis par yang 'dod cing / rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar por 'dod pa'ang yod do/ /de dag kyang rgyud tshig 'don tshul dang man ngag gi khyad par so so las byung ba yin pa'i phyir thams cad kyang mi 'gal lo/ /rgyud las yum byin pa gnyis 'khyud du bshad pa la/ mnyam 'khrud dang gang rung gis ci bder 'byud pa gang byas kyang chog la/ mngon brjod 'grel pa las/rtsig pa la yi dwags phreng ba dang / stegs bu la lha mo'i 'khor du bshad na'ang mi legs so/ /thugs 'khor ra gyi shar phyogs pū li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dag rab gtum ma/dkar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang phyogs dzā lan+ta rar ma hā kaX ka la dang gtum mig ma/ ser sngo ljang ba'i: nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar kaX ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ dmar sngo ljang ja lho phyogs a rlu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ ljang ser rdzo shar lho go dwa wa rir su ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ dmar ser ljang ba'i: lho nub ra sma shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dkar ser ljang : nub byang de lī ko ṭar rdo rje dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ sngo skya ser ljang je byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ ljang ser sngo: de ltar thugs 'khor ba rnams phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma rū par ang ku ri dang e ra wa ti/ dkar sngo ljang ba/ byang phyogs o ṭar rdo rje ral pa can dang —88—

'jigs byed chen mo/ ljang ser sngo ba nub phyogs tri sha ku nir dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sngo ser ljang ba/ lto phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje o mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ dmar ser ljang ba/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang khyo ma de swe/ ljang ser sngo ba lho nub la sba kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ ser sngo ljang ba nub byang ka ltung 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dud ser ljang ba/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma/ sngo skya ser ljang ba/ de ltar gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar sgo pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ sngo ser ljang ba/ byang sgo gri ha de war rin wo rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ ser sngo ljang ba/ nub sgo so ra shi rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ dmar ser ljang ba/ lho sgor su waṇ+ḍa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo go cha ma/ dkar sngo ljang ba/ shar lho'i grwa na ga ra dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ sngo skya ser ljang ba/ lho nub kyi grwa si rgyur/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ ser ljang ba/ nub byang gi grwa ma rur/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ dkar sngo ljang ba/ byang shar gyi grwa ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ dkar nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ de ltar sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang / de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyu da cing / lhag ma g.yas kyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang cang tes g.yon gnyis kyis thod khrag dang kha ṭa ga bsnams pa'o/ /yab rnams —89—

stag lpags kyi shams thabs can g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/yum rnams gcer bu g.yon brkyang gi stabs can/ thams cad kyang gtso bo yab yum gyi rigs las byung ba'o/ /bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i thugs dam la gtso bor 'khor thams cad khro nyams che zhing cung zad sbom pa'i sku can du bris 'dug go /oX āXhūX sarba lī ra yo gi ni kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ oX badz+ra shudha sarba dharmā badz+ra shuzlo3 haX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ h+pha dzaXhuX baX hoX oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3haX/ ar+ghaX/nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ bar 'dir lus dkyil sgom par 'dod na/ lte bar gtso bo yab yum dang / spyi bo la sogs par 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams bkod pa'i lha lnga bcu pa bsgom par bya'o/ /ci ste ma mo bcu gnyis 'god par 'dod na yang / mngon brjod le'u dgu par gsungs pa ltar phyag bcu gnyis la 'god dgos shing / de ltar na thod pa bzhi zhal bzhi la'o/ /'on kyang de dag dkyil 'khor 'di'i lha ma yin pa'i phyir 'god mi dgos so/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi phung khams skye mched byin gyis slobs pa ni/ rgyu rdo rje'i 'dzin pa'i skabs bzhin no/ spyod pa bzhi byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ lte bar hoX rang gi snying gar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar ser gyi lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maX gyis mtshan pa'o/ /yang thugs ka'i huX las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo h+pha/ oṃ a bhi ṣañca tu maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa: nas shrī ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā las dbang bskur/ sku lus —90—

gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / sngon po rnams la mi bskyod pa/ dkar po rnams la rnam snang ljang khu rnams dang dud kha la don grub/ dmar po rnams la snang mtha'/ ser po rnams la rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan/ de nas go cha bgo bar bya ste/dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i snying gar oṃ ha dkar po: nas/ rta mchog gi ngo bo/ dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i nye bar oṃ ba: nas/ tshwa ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang /rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /de nas 'dir yang spro na mchod bstod bya zhing / khyad par bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ sdom 'byung gi gtor mchog rnams su bshad pa ltar nang mchod byin gyis rlobs te/ oṃ sa ma ya shudha sarba dharma sa ma ya shu khre/྅ ha/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hu/ ṭha ṭha stu a kha hu/ zhes/ bdud rtsi myang ngo / /bla ma la 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jam dpal ngag dbang grags pa blo gros bzang / /bde chen rdo rje lha yi 'byung gnas dang / /mi 'jigs 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /bkas gnang bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bu/la/ /zhes so/ /bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa sogs bsgom par bya zhing / dkyil 'bor gyi 'khor lo sgyu mar shes par byas te/ de la mnyam par bzhag go/byang chub phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa ni/ byang phyogs dang po brgyad dang / tha lhag bzhi bor ba ste/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum ma/ nas yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /zhes so/ /gas yang / dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dang / /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid lha/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam par spyor/ /de nyid nyi shu lnga bdag —91—

nyid/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal med khang bzang ste/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad dag pa/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad du sprul/ /sdang dang sred pa rab 'joms pas/ /lha mo rnams dang yi dwags 'phreng / /sna tshogs rdo rje dud gzhom ste/ /ye shes me 'od rnam par spro/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dag pas/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du shes par bya/ /dam pa'i don du dpa' bo'i gzugs/ /ye shes kyis ni 'jam dpal nyid/ /skyon drug dag pas rigs drug nyid/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag pa yis/ /zhal dang phyag ni rnam dag pa/ /ma rig 'du byed zhabs kyis mnan/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam mo/ /de nas 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang / ngag bzlas yid bzlas rnams rim gyis bya ste/ skye( ā hū/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /tsho( shrī mañju badz+ra stu ka oṃ hū/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha ra hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra wa ra hi hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ 'phreng ba'i sngags ni bde mchog spyi dang mthun pa yin na'ang / de gtso bor bzla bar ma gsungs so/ /'khor gyis sngags ni/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍaka pā la hū hu phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsasne hu hū phaṭa/ ces sogs sbyar te bzla'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/bdag bskyed kyi gtor bsngo byas te thun bsdu ba'am/ min yang rung ste/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyang bdag nyid la thim/ de yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i bar du bsdus/ de yang 'od gsal bar bsdus te stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag go/slar yang rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur/ spyod pa bzhi dang go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab ste thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma byin rlabs —92—

'khrul spong gi sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bya zhing / h+pha zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ oṃ a ra snyi ho dza / ba ho badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya stu khru khyi ho/zhes lan gsum gyis spyir phul/ yab yum gyi snying po'i hu hu phaṭa kyi sngon du i ma ba li gro hā gro hā ma ma sarba ka rla ku ru ku rba9 zhes bcug pa lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ tsho( ka ra ka ra nas/ dhi li dhi li hū hu phaṭa/ lan gcig gis 'khor lo gsum la phul/ hu bcu gcig gi mthar a kā ro btanas pas srung ba'i 'khor lo pa la phul/ yang ar+gha: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis sam gong gi zhu ba glus bskul gyis bstod/ oṃ kha kha ji hi ji hi nas sa ha yi ka bha skyi hu hu phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis phyi rol 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams nas kun 'grub shog gis bstod cing gsol ba btab/ oṃ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ /zhes sogs dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blang / sems can thams cad nad med cing / /zhes sogs smon lam btab/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod/ yig brgya bzod gsol gtor mgron gshegs gsol rnams byas la/ yo ga shu khri spu'i sngags kyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ slar yang bdag zung dang / smon lam bkra shis gang 'os re bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs tshes mang yang / khyud sde kun gyi rtse mor gyur pa dang / /las tshogs tsam min mchog sgrub gtsor ston dang / /dag bya dag byed rab rgyas dkyil 'khor dang / khyud las shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /sgrub thabs 'di nyid kho na ches mchog ste/ /gsang ldan la sogs rgyu sde 'og mar mtshungs/ /gur las gsungs sogs las tshogs lha tsam yin/ / mtshan brjod sgrub thabs bla med lugs byas pa/ /phal cher dag bya dag byed —93—

shin tu bsdus/ /'dug pa'i 'jam rdor man ngag gtso che ste/ khri rdod las ha cang gsal ba gsung pa'ang med/ /ces ched du brjod pa'o/ /de ltar sgrub thabs rab 4gad pas/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i sa thob cing / khyad par lam 'dir 'jug pa rnams/ /tshe 'dir 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs te brgyad pa'o// //༈ rab 'bar ye shes me lce yis/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /rab gsal dkyil 'khor ri mo ni/ /ci yang 'char 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdor sems sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying gar raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du huX/de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ 'od zer ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ skabs 'dir spro na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ gang gi drin gyis: sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: sogs kyi phyag 'tshal/i rna āXbadz+ra bī nī hūṃ/ nas skye( āXbadz+ra dharme/ huX/ tsho( āXhuX/ tsho( āXbadz+ra mahā sda/ khaX/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gcig brjod/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang ma lhun/ tsho( swa bhā wa sko khri sde sarba dharma su bhā wa shu smosa3haX/oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da nam mkhar gnas/ tshams rngam dang bcas pa'i ra lan gnyis brjod/ sngags las spros pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / rwa ba dang / gur dang / bla re dang / mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re: sogs sngags 'a drug brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po —94—

zla gam/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser ngo/ gru bzhi rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i nye ba la/ hu las sna tshogs rdo rje de'i steng du bhu dkar po las/rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyis snam bu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mchan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po/ rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar pa las bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus su phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang /—95—

shing dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil ga bor gyi steng du a ā: nas/ a a phrag gnyis las zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha: nas ha k+ṣa/ ḍa bha/ da dha ya la phrag gnyis zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hu las rdo rje'i lte bar hū gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ se mas can thams cad kyi don byas/slar 'dus te hū la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su 'khor lo bde mchog che/ drag po chen po he ru ka /sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag /mi bzad sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhal dang phyag dang zhabs rnams ni/ /thams cad 'bum gyi grangs su bya/ /zhal ni ji snyed thams cad kyang / /mdun nag g.yon ljang rgyab dmar ba/ /g.yas pa ser po shes par bya/ /dang po rdo rje dril bus khyud/ /de 'og lha mo'i nu ma mtshir/ /de 'og thod pa kha ṭa bsnams/ /gnyis kyis glang lpags 'dzin pa'o/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dgra sta dang / /mdung rtse gsum pa ngo bo nyid/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug dang / mda' dang gzhu yang de bzhin te/ /thod dbyug dang ni mdung thung dang / /sdig mdzub dang ni gtso/ shing dang / /'khor lo ral gri rin chen dang / /pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /rdo rje mtshon pa'i dbyug tho dang / /ga da mdung ring mdung kha leb/ /dza ma be con chu gri dang / /dung dang rwa dung pa ṭa ha/ /pi wa gling bu rdza rnga che/ /rdza rnga rnga zlum gru gsum 'khyog /sa chu me dang rlung dkyil 'khor/ /sgra can ke rus 'jigs byed che/ /lus lag rkang pa —96—

pags pa dang / /lcags sgrogs g.yas pa'i lhag na ste/ /g.yon pa'i lhag ma'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltar phyag ni brgya phrag rnams/ /re re dang mtshung5 stong phrag re'o/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /dus mtshan tshangs ma dbang mo dang / /dpal mo ga ga dbyangs can ma/ /ga the ne nu ma dang drug lda myo ma/ /re ba tī dang dga' byed ma/ /tsa mun ṭi dang klu mo dang / /gnod spyin lnga/tshe dang zla ba mo/ /nyi ma mo dang dga' ma dang / /tshogs bdag mo yi snying gar mnan/ /g.yon rnams 'jigs byed chen mo dang / /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag khyab 'jug kun 'gyed gzhon nu dang / /nag chen dga' byed dbang phyug dang / /gshin rje chu lha lus ngan dang / /zla ba nyi ma lus med dang / /tshogs bdag 9spru sogs kha bub tu/ /bsgyel ba'i steng du rnam par gnon/ /lhag ma'i zhabs 5mas thams cad kyis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad mnan te bzhugs/ /zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ drag po chen po mche ba rnam par gtsigs pas 'jigs su ra snga5 ba/ bzhad pa mi sdug pa rab tu 'jigs pa/ dpa' ba/ sgeg pa/ dam pa/smin ma rnam par g.yo ba/ bsnyems pa/ zhi ba/ g.yo ba/ mi g.yo rnga// zhal rnam skyu per gdangs pa/ rnam par rol ba/ ljags rnam par bskyod pa la 1sgogs pa sna tshogs pa'i nyams ltar bar mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bo'i gtsug tu rgyan byas pa/ zhal thams cad rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /zhabs rnams g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang shing / ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo'i 'phreng ba —97—

can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'byud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis 'di la zhal gdong gi rnam pa la sogs pa mi 'dra ba gzhan yod pa ni yi ge gzhan du gsal lo/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ba glang gi gdong pa can/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu rta'i gdong pa can/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can/ thams cad rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnams so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum mo: nas byang shar ku lu ta rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar lnga'o/ /zhes pa'i bar spyir dang 'dra/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed chen po rnams rnam par gnon pa/yab rnams bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ zhal phyag sna tshogs pa/ yum rnams rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ khar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor wa gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma —98—

dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ma he'i gdong ma can/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba bong bu'i gdong pa can/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba rnga mong gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po rnams ni/rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭāX ga dang bcas pa/ dbu dang phyag dang zhabs mtha' yas pa/ ro'i ga dbye/ la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub stsol ba'o/ /bdag nyid kyi lus la rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ skye⑥ dharma dha tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po: nas skyu4ṭa phaṭa dud kha tsa r+bhe ka'i ngo bo gnyis ka'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/rang gi thugs ka'i hūX gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spya zu drangs/ h+pha/dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shu rdzo3 haX/slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ h+pha/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur nga ni rdo rje che/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a ngu/ ṣañca huX/ su ra ta stuX a haX/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas nga bang bskur/dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/nang mchod byin gyis mas la/ rdo rje 'cha dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ka ha na ti zhi na —99—

ro tsa tra pa/ /bsod nams 'byung gnas rin chen 'byung gnas sbas/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas da sha ba la dang / / 'dren pa'i dpal dang shrī gup+ta dang / /blo gros 'gyung gnas dkar min sprin gyi zhabs/ /dz+nyā na mi tra bde chen rdo rje dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul/ tse( ā badz+ra ma hā su kha/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa phul la/ yab yum gyis rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ nag po pa ltar dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gal te drag po'i las la mos na/ 'khor thams cad kha dog mthing khar bsgom zhing / gtso bo'i zhal yang rtsa zhal khro bo'i zhal la/ zhal lhag ma rnams gdong brnyan du bsgyur te/ kha dang chu skyar bzhad dang ni/ ce spyang skye gnyis sngags chen po/ khrung khrung ri rkeg ka dam pa/ /zhes pa srog chags brgyad dang / bong bu dang / mi dang / rus sbal dang / khyi dang / rnga mong dang / rta la sogs pa'i phyugs sna tshogs pa'i gdong brnyan du bsgyur zhing / gzhan yang rtsa ba'i phyag rgya phrag gcig dang / stong la sogs ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /bzlas ba'i dmigs pa ni spyi dang mtshungs shing / bzlas bya ni/ oṃ shrī he he ru ru ka ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru nas dhi li dhi li hū hu phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha ra hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bī ra hi/ta bya thā/ pro ta gi ha na ha na: nas yo gi sho ri phaṭa hū hu phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar yum gyi sngags so/ /yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyang bzla bar bya'o/ /cher khros pas/ ha ha hi hi hu hū phaṭa/ ces kyang bzlas so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ oṃ ā hū zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod par bsams/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum bha lan gnyis su bzla/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ yang sum bha tshar gcig bzlas pas bka' bsgos/ de rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs rnams bkug /bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol du 'brub —100—

khung du bcug pa la/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i phur bu rnams kyis btab/o gha gha:sogs lan gsum brjod/ o badz+ra mud ga ra/ sogs/ tho bas brdung bas bgegs rnams ming yang med par byas par bsams/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ lha thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis phur bu dang tho ba 'dzin par bsgyur te/ o gha gha: sogs kyi bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste/ rang gi sna bug gnyis nas zhugs/ snying ga'i hū la thim/ rang nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ phaṭa ces brjod/slar yang stong pa'i ngang las lha skur gyur/ swāhā o zhes brjod/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab nas thun mtshams kyis bya ba la 'jug go /'di'i kha zas kyi rnal 'o byor la/ kha zas thams cad ling gar byas te bsgral nas bza'o/ / gtor ma'i cho ga ni sdom 'byung gi mngon rtogs su shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon gang ba'i rdo rje las thob pa'o/ /bdud dpung phye mar brlag byed cing / khrub pa brgyad sogs mngag gzhug dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po sogs/ /tshul 'di sgom pa'i bran du 'gyur/ /mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa'i sgrub thabs te dgu pa'o// //༈ na mo ga rba ba mu kha he ru kā ya/ rdo rje'i mthon ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdud dpung lan brgyar bcom byas nas/ /sgrub la bde chen dngos grub stsol/ /rab 'jigs he ru ka la 'dud/ /'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi khyad par rab 'byams zhig sgrub par 'dod pas/ sdom pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar rdo rje khrag 'thung bong bu'i zhal can bsgom par bya'o/ /de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ shrī he ru —101—

ko3 haX/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX sngon po de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaXn mo gu ru khyoX na maXtra / tsakra sa sba ra maṇ+ḍal khyeX oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mar/ byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub mchog tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /ra med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo ྅ haX/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swabha wa at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du paX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ huX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ mda'i drwa ba/phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badzi bha wa badz+ra ban+ta huX/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūX baX huX/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūX yaX hūX/—102—

oṃ badz+ra bi ta na huX khaX huX/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la traX saX traX/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka hū ཾ ༷ huX huX/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bhuX las gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug srung ba'i 'khor lo dang cas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod r+ṣa po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang /zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon bskor gyi a ā zhes pa nas/ aX aX—103—

zhes pa'i bar/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyi ka kha nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa lha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de gnyis kyi bar du hu dkar po'o/ /nam mkha'i nā da yang hū yig de nyid la thim/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yong su gyur pa las/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag drag po chen po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ka bong bu'i gdong pa can/ khrag chen gyis byugs shing shin tu 'jigs pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba dang g.yon zhal dmar ba dag ni lha zhal khro chags kyi nyams can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mi lpags rlon pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pa na rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pa na thod pa dang kha ṭā ga lhan cig par 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang /g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang /sna tshogs rdo rje dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po/zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i yab la —104—

'khyud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir zhal gsum phyag drug sdom 'byung dang 'dra rung mdzad pa ni slob dpon skal ldan bzang po'i man ngag yin yang / phyag gnyis par bsgom na'ang legs so/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ de bzhi dang rdo rje phag mo yang bong bu'i zhal can/ zhal gyi grwa nas ma hā ru dhi ra'i rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi phyi rol dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lto sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba ma he'i gdong pa can/ lho nub gshin rje pho nya mas g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba ri dwags kriṇ+ḍa'i gdong pa can/nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba stag gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba dom gyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing / skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing mi mgo'i do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis —105—

gnas pa dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la byang phyogs dza ca rar ma hā ka ka la/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nar ka ka la/ lho phyogs ar bu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ shar lho go da wa rir lha'i dgra/ lho nub ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med/ nub byang de lī ko ṭar rdo rje 'od/ byang shar ma la war rdo rje'i sku ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon mo bya khyung gi gdong can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma ru par a gu ri/ byang phyogs o ṭar rdo rje ral pa can/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hū mdzad/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po/ lho nub la spa ka ra rdo rje bzang po/ nub byang ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rma bya'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che/ byang phyogs gri ha de war rin chen rdo rje/ nub phyogs so ra tshing rta myo/krin/ lho phyogs su waṇ+ḍa di par nam mkha'i snying po/ shar lhor na ga rar dpal he ru ka lho nub sin dhu ra pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /nub byang ma rus rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum ma dang kha ṭa ga bsnams pa/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / rang snang gi —106—

shes rab ma dang bcas pa'ang thabs rkyang pa/ khyad par g.yin rnams bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs kar rang 'dra ba'am phyag gnyis pa'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar huX dang baX ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ yab rna myo/sa kyi thugs kar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūX dmar ngo/ pa/bla gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su po kho he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su huX huX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum rnams kyi lte bar oṃ baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX yoX sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar lha moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hri hri ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu huX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rta ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma la zla ba'i gdan dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūX yig gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3 haX/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ h+pha/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol la/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo —107—

la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams la rin 'byung /thugs 'khor pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa rnams la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa 'a/ khyu badz+ra ar+gha ā hū nas sha lta'i bar gyis phyi mar phul/rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ ā hu/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma'i:skal ldan bzang po'i skye dgu'i 'tsho ba bzang po'i: mahā bo dhi'i bla ma bsam gto 'od zer gyi: gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta'i: bsod nams lhun grub kyi: rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi: rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po lha dbang grags pa'i zhal du tse( ā hū/lha thams cad kyi snying pos dkyil 'khor la phul/ a nu ra gas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yang phul la/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bde stong du 'char bar byas te mnyam par bzhug /rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir bsgom/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'am/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gsal btab nas/ bzlas pa bya ste/ sngags 'phreng rgyas par ni/dpa' mo nyer bzhi bor nas gzhan lha yi pa dang mtshungs la/ bzlas pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ hi ha ha hu hu phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bdun pa nyid la nan tan du 'bad par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i gzhi ni/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hū dmar skya las/ dbugs phyi nang du 'gro ba dang bstun nas byed pa man ngag yin no/ /mthar bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ sa bcu dag gi rim pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /phyi —108—

dang nang gi chos rnams kun/ byang chub phyogs kyis rnam par dag /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang / /tshangs pa'i skud pa la sogs rtag /lha yi snying po'i sngags kyi ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyi mdzes/ / yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /gdub 'khor gyis ni rna ba brgyan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin par mgur chus mdzes pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyi/ /ske rags byas pas brgyan pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug po ni/ /phyag rgya las ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa'o/ /rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin/ /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams ni rnam par dag kha ṭāX ga ni lha yi sku/ khres rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa 'a ba ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa yin/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes dag pa dran par byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal du langs te/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la thun mtshams la 'jug go/gtor ma'i cho ga ni/sdom 'byung bcu gsum ma'i sgrubs thabs su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo gsum dang sgo —109—

mtshams ma brgyad la gdong brnyan du mdzad pa 'di ni/ bshad rgyud a bhi dha na las bshad pa'i lugs yin la/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gzhan las ni bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams bong zhal du sgyur ba tsam zhig gsungs so/ /gang zhig sgom par byed pa la/ /phun tshogs bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /'byung 'gyur de yi pha mtha' ni/ /bye ba'i gdong gis brjod nus sam/ /'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs te bcu pa'o// //༈ na mo badz+ra yo gi ni khyo rmad byung mchog tu ngo mtshar ba'i/ /rdo rje btsun mo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnyed pa 'di yang skal bzang ste/ /lha mos rjes su gnang bar mdzod/ /sgrub thabs kyi dmigs pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bsgom zhing / oṃ shrī he ru ko3 ha/ gang gi drin gyis:sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ ar+gha: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ dza / ba ho tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/shā n+ya tas stongs par sbyangs/ hu sum+bha lan gnyis/ oṃ gha gha: sogs/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra: sogs/ oṃ mi dhi: nas/la rka hu hū hu gi bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las e ya ra ba la su rnams las/ chos 'byung 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bhu las gzhal med khang / phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang shar dkar/lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus su pa las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad dang sgo mtshams rnams su nyi ma'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de'i bar du ba las rdo rje ba gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus/—110—

gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje phag mo brgyu dang sin+ta ra'i mdog can nyi ma bcu gnyis kyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/zhal gsum phyag drug pa ltar na/ dmar ljang sngo ba'i zhal lam/ yang na zhal gsum ka yang dmar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas thabs he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la 'phyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon thod pa dang / kha ṭā ga lhan cig 'dzin pa/ thabs he ru ka ni dkar po dang dmar po dang mthing ka gdar/ nga'o/ /yang na rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po dang ljang khu/ g.yon zhal sngon po dang ser po/ steng gi zhal phag gdong dmar po phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang lpags/ g.yas lhag mas ḍā ma sa dgra sta/ gri gug rtse gsum/g.yon lhag mas kha ṭā ga thod pa zhugs pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin par byas kyang rung ngo / /gang ltar yang / zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/dbu skra phyed bcings shing / phyed grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang / rin po che dang me tog la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs drag mo'i tshul can bde ba rgyas ma'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du rdo rje gsang ba mchog ma/ byang du rdo rje dam tshig mchog ma/ nub tu rdo rje gzi brjid mchog ma/ lhor rdo rje rin r+ṣa mchog ma/ mer rdo rje ye shes mchog ma/ bden bral du rdo rje rig mchog ma/ rlung du rdo rje grub mchog ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje thal ba mchog ma thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal gsum ka'ang dmar zhing / phyag —111—

dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang snang gi thabs la 'phyud/ bar pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams gtso mo nyid dang mtshungs pa'o/ khar sgor rdo rje 'bar mchog ma/ byang sgor rdo rje bdud rtsi mchog ma/ nub sgor rdo rje khro bo mchog ma/ lho sgor rdo rje mche ba mchog ma rnams 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams dang 'dra ba snye sa/ rdo rje gsor zhing zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub brkyang ba/g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing cher khros pa'o/ /grwa bzhir lha mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ dkar ser dmar ljang / las kyi pho nya mo'i tshul du gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ba/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ lte bar oṃ baX dmar po sogs go chas rgyas btab/ h+pha dzaXhuX baX hoX oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3 haX/ slar yang dbang gi lha rnams h+pha/ oX badz+ra bha wa a bhi tiñca huX/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang /'khor lo rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas spro bsdus bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor gsal btab ste/ oX shrī badz+ra bā rā hi a baX huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra gu phya ud ta me hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX shrī badz+ra sa mā ya ud ta me hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te dzod ta me huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX shrī badz+ra ra snod ta me huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX shrī badz+ra dz+nyā nod ta me huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bi du ud ta me huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX shrī badz+ra sirnyot+ta me hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bha smod ta me huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rdzu lod ta me huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX shrī badz+ra a mṛ tod ta me huX huX —112—

phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kro khyod ta me hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rda rdzod ta me hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ thun bsdu ba'i sngon du ar+gha la sogs pas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa rnams byas la/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi 'od zer gyis/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying khar bsdu/ go chas rgyas btab la/ dag pa gsum dran bzhin pas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /gtor ma'i cho ga ni sdom 'byung bzhi du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /gsang ba byin dang mchog gyur pa/ /grags pa ye shes grol mchog zhabs/ /bla ma mchog gi zhal las 'ongs/ rgyud sde'i dngos bstan zab mo'i gnad/ /'jigs bral nyid kyi khyad par chos/ /srog 'dzin gdams pa'i smin byed kyi/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni 'di kho na/ /deng dus de yi srog 'dzin du/ /grags shing rlom pa rnams kyis ni/ /gang 'di'i ming yang mi shes te/ kho bos bsod nams skal bas thob/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ bi rū pa/ go len nā thā/ shā ri bu tra/ grub chen kun blo/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/ blo gros dpal 'byor/ zal mo brag pa zhes dbang rgyud ded kyang cho ga 'di la sgrub thabs rgya gzhung gi lung yang yod do/ /zhes pa mngon brjod le'u sum cu rtsa drug pa las byung ba/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gzigs shing / shin tu gsang bar gyur pa 'di ni/ bsod nams mchog gyur pa'i sgrub thabs tshig rgyal rgyas pa las/ snying po mtha' dag bsdus pa ste/ mchog gi rdo rje phag mo'i sgrubs thabs te bcu gcig pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru badz+ra ḍā kā ya/ shes rab gsang ba'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen dngos/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs pa/ /bla ma mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab mo sbas pa gsang ba'i don/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam 'bri byed pa/ /'di ni 'gro ba'i don —113—

phyir te/ /de phyir 'phags rnams dgyes par mdzod/ /da ni bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor he ru ka drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/rnal 'byor pa dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob pas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang gi snying gar ra las nyi ma la hū/ de las khro bo'i rdo rje nag por gyur pa'i lte ba la yang hū gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid he ru kar gyur pa'i thugs kar/ zla ba dang rdo rje dkar po la hu gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor bla ma rje btsun mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen: sogs dang / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs sho lo ka gnyis/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing / /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /de nas/ ar+gha:nas shasta'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ yi ge 'khru gsum lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi lnga dang rjes chags kyis mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang khu rngus gyi mchod pa ni mchod pa chen po ste/ de gnyis yid kyis dran tsam bya/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyi mthar/brgal dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gis bdag nyid skad cig ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes bdag nyid phul/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun par bya/ de bzhin du tshad med bzhi yang spyi dang mthun/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma gar dbang / 'du byed kyi phung po rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin —1/4—

gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sa'i khams lhung byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod byed ma/ me'i khams 'gu/gas byed ma/ rlud gi khams pad ma gar dbang / nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can sgyu ma chen mo'o// /mig gnyis gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba gnyis zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ lce 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharmaXsnya bhā wa shu sgo3 haX/ oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las sgo mtshams ma brgyad dmar mo tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ oṃ nga nas bi du rā dza hūX hūX phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ lha mi lha min dang bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad bkug phyogs mtshams kyi sa gzhir phur bu btab ste tshar bcad/ hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ rdo rje me lce 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/sngags rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yaX las rlung / raX las me baX las chu/laX las sa'i dkyil snyen ra rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du suX las ri rab/ de'i nang du chos 'byung shes rab kyi gsang ba/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha —115—

khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang /nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nye bar gsung gi 'khor lo pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad bcas shing pad 'dab kyi khor yug srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang /shing dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod brten/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /'dir bha ba bha dra'i 'grel pa las/ zhi khro dkyil 'khor tha dad du dgongs pas rgyu rdor 'dzin zhal phyag can logs jupa med/ zla ba rdo rje nyid rgyu rdor sems kyi ngo bor 'dod la/ ka la ka lnga'i sgrub thabs na rgyu rdo rje sems dpa' byed de rdo rje zhu ba'i thig le las rdor sems dkar sngo ser dmar ba'i zhal bzhi pa/phyag bzhi rdo rje/ kha ṭī ga thod pa/ dril bu 'dzin/ gdan thod pa'i nang gi steng du phyed krung gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po 'od dmar po can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan —116—

pa'o/ /de nas 'dod chags chen po'i spyod pa dang sprul pas sems can gyi don rgya cher mdzad nas zhu ba dang glus bskul ba'i mdzad pa nag po pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /tshul 'di yang ches legs par mthong mod/ sngar srol bzhin dkyus su 'grel pa ltar bshad na/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang sems zla ba'i rnam pa can/ oṃ tsit+ta pra te bet+taX ka ro mi/ de la a u nas aX aXs mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs te/ thim pa las zla ba gnyis par gyur/oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ de la ka kha nas ha yis mtshan pa/ci zla ba kha spyor gyi steng du huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ 'od zer gyis bskul nas/sangs rgyas rnams zhugs shing thim pa las/ rdo rje de nyid nyi ma stong gi 'od zer ltar 'bar ba'i thig le'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra at+pa ko3 haX/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs ma lus pa 'dus te/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra/ dzaXhuX baX hoXsu ra ta stuX/ zhes bskul bas/ de rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ka 'jigs pa yang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ drag po chen po zhal bzhi phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin mtshams nas huX bzhi pa'i sngags spro ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'bar ba'i rdo rje dang kha smoX ga 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i gsho/ra thod dang / thod khrag 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /sa 'og bskyod cing lha ma yin 'joms pa'i gar gyi stabs can/ zhabs gnyis —117—

g.yon bskums g.yas brkyang bas bdud bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa mnan pa/ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng nga rbon/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ ba skru'i khung bu nas sprul pa 'gyed pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sku mi 'gyur ba/ gsung ma skyes pa/ thugs nam mkha' rdo rje'i bdag nyid do/ /yum sgyu ma chen mo wa ra hi/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta thā a ha/ 'dir gar gyi stabs shes pa spyir gar gyi rol ba mdzad pa'i don yin gyi skyil krung phyed pas gar stabs kho na la go bar mi bya'o/ /yang 'di la gshor dang thod pa 'dzin pa gnyis bor ba'i phyag bzhi pa yang rung ngo/ /de bzhin du zhabs 'og tu 'jigs dus mnan par byed pa dang dkyil 'khor la bde chen 'khor lo le tshe dgu par byed pa dang / de ltar gyi tshe sgo ma dang mtshams ma go brje ba dang / sngon 'gro cung zad bsdus pa byed pa yang lugs gcig go/de nas 'di ltar/ nga ni 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs pa/ /nga nyid chos kyi sku yi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po yin/ oṃ sum bha: sogs/ oṃ dharma ke tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 ha/ ka la ka lngas skabs 'dir go cha dang gnas gsum byin rlabs byed do/ /bde chen 'khordo ra —118—

lo'i shar du lhung byed ma sngo ser/ g.yas rdo rje dang thod pa/ g.yon kha smo ga dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du gsod byed ma ljang ser/ g.yas rnge'u chung dang ral gri/g.yon thod par bcas pa'i kha smo ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'gugs byed ma dmar ser/ g.yas mda' dang pad+ma/ g.yon gzhu dang thod pa 'dzin pa/lhor gar dbang ma dkar ser g.yas ba dan dang thod pa/ g.yon rtse gsum dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ de dag gi thod pa bzhi ni/ rim pas glang po/ ce spyang / mi ba glang gi gzugs dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang nyi ma'i 'od skor can no/ /'di dag la 'ga' zhig phyed gzugs byed pa ni mi legs shing / sngo ser zhes sogs phal cher 'dod pa ltar rgyud dang 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs 'gos 'gyur gyi dbang du byas te rin chen gyi rigs mtshon par 'dod pas dkyus su bshad pa yin yang / sngo skya/ ljang skya/ dmar skya/ ser skyar byas na'ang legs so/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyis nye bar brgyan pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi 'dab ma la pu li ra ma la yar rab tu gtum mo dang / khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ byang phyogs dza lan dha rar gtum mig ma dang ma hā ka ka la/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya rar 'od ldan ma dang ka ka la/ lho phyogs ar bu tar sna chen ma dang mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ shar lho go da ba rir/ dpa' bo blo gros ma dang lha'i dgra/ lho nub ra smi shwa rar mi'u thung ma dang 'od dpag med/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang rdo rje'i 'od/ byang shar ma la nywar shing grib ma dang rdo rje'i sku rnams mdog sngon po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma ru par e ra ba ti dang myu gu can/—119—

byang phyogs o ṭar 'jigs byed chen mo dang rdo rje ral pa can/ nub phyogs tri sha ku nir rlung gi shugs can ma dang dpa' bo chen po/ lho phyogs go sa lar chang 'thung ma dang rdo rje hū mdzad/ shar s+ho ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo dang rab tu bzang mo/ lho nub la ba kar shin tu bzang mo dang rdo rje bzang po'o/ /nub byang ka zhin rta rna ma dang 'jigs byed chen po/ byang shar hi ma la yar bya gdong ma dang mig mi bzang rnams sku mdog dmar po'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang stobs po che/ byang phyogs grir ha de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang rin po che rdo rje/ nub phyogs so phung shoṇ+ḍi nī dang rta mgrin/ lho phyogs su wadhe dī par 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ khar lho nā ga rar shin tu dpa' mo dang dpal he ru ka lho nub si rgyu stobs chen ma dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nub byang ma rur 'khor los bsgyur ma dang rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku lu tar brtson 'grus chen po dang rdo rje sems dpa' rnams sku mdog dkar po'o/ /de thams cad kyang shes rab ma gtso mor gyur pa ste/dpa' mo thams cad phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug 'phyar bas bsdigs pa/g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas thabs la 'khril bas bde chen sbyor ba la brtson pa/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭā ga 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ral pa'i cod pan can/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba'o/ khar sgor gshin rje brtan —120—

ma/ byang sgor gshin rje pho nya ma/ nub sgor gshin rje mche ba ma/ lho sgor gshin rje 'joms ma/ shar lhor khwa gdong ma/ lho nub tu lug gdong ma/ nub byang du khyi gdong ma/ byang shar du phag gdong ma ste/ de rnams thams cad sku mdog ljang khu/g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa gru mor kha smo ga dang bcas pa/ nyi ma dang ro la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs shing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ thams cad kyang skra mtshams la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang / rkang brgyan la dril bu g.yer khas mdzes pa'o/ /lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang :nas 'joms ma bzhi po'i bar/ dag pa dran par bya'o/ /rkang pa gnyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal med khang gru bzhi/spyi bo pu li ra ma la yar rab gtum ma dang khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ spyi gtsug dza lan dha rar gtum mig ma dang mahā ka ka la/ rna ba g.yas pa o ṭi ya nar 'od ldan ma dang ka ka la/ ltag pa ar bu tar sna chen ma dang mche ba rnams par gtsigs pa/rna ba g.yon pa go da pa rir brtan pa'i blo can ma dang lha'i dgra/ smin mtshams ra smi shwa rar mi'u thung ma dang 'od dpag med/ mig de swe ko ṭar lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang rdo rje'i 'od/ phrag pa ma la bar shing grib ma dang rdo rje'i sku/ mchan khung ka ma rū par er ba ti dang a gu ri/ nu ma o ṭar 'jigs byed chen mo dang rdo rje ral pa can/ lte ba tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma dang dpa' mo —121—

chen po/ sna rtse ko sa lar chang 'thung ma rdo rje huX mdzad/ kha ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo dang rab tu bzang po/ mgrin pa la sba kar shin tu bzang mo dang rdo rje bzang po/ snying gar kañci rta rna ma dang 'jigs byed chen po/ 'dom bar hi ma la yar bya gdong ma dang mig mi bzang / mtshan ma pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang stobs po che/ bshang lam gri ha de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang rin chen rdo rje/brla gnyis so rbi wo ni dang rta mgrin/ byin pa gser gling du 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang nam mkha'i snying po/ sor mo na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo dang he ru kabol gong si rgyur stobs chen ma dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug mthe bong ma rur 'khor los bsgyur ma dang rnam par snang mdzad/ pus mo ku lu tar brtson 'grus chen mo dang rdo rje sems dpa' 'o// oṃ āXhuX sarba bī ra yo gi ni ka ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ badz+ra shudhaXsarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo rdo3 haX/ rang gi snying gar ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā huX dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su huX huX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ snying gar huX thugs rdo rje/mgrin par oṃ hiXha ha hūX huX phaṭa gsung rdo rje/ dpral par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX huX phaṭa ḍā ki dzā la sam+bha ra swāhā/ sku rdo rje/ gsum char yang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /yum gyi lte bar oṃ baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX yoX sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hi moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hri hri ser mo bskyod byedi ma/ spyi gtsug tu huX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ dpral par phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rta —122—

ka'i ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki shī ye badz+ra brta ni ye hūX hūX phaṭa snyu hā/thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ be+e ro he re hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ gsung rdo rje/ snying gar oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye swāhā/ /sku rdo rje'o/ /rang gi snying gar huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa ye shes sems dpa'/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ h+pha/ oṃ bī ni badz+ra ṇi hūX hūX phaṭa nas oṃ dharmā bhā tu badz+re ni huX hūX phaṭa kyis bar gyis mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX.oṃ yo ga shurnyaXsarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3 haX/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pa dang / gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang / /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /brtse ba'i bdag la dbang bskur stsole// /zhes kyang gsol ba btang pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /zhes gsung zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / bde chen 'khor lo pa la rin 'byung /thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'dod dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang / dam dzig 'khor lo pa la don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ de nasabazlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ yi ge nyer gnyis pa dang / bzhi ḍā ki'i sngags spel nas bzla ba'am/oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru : nas ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li/ si li si li/ dhi li dhi li huX hūX phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas/ sngags kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par rgyud 'grel du shes par —123—

bya'o/ /tsho( sum+bha hū hu phaṭa/ las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /bzlas pa'i gong du'am/ skabasa'adir mchod pa bya ste/ ar+gha: nas shasta'i bar gyi mchod pa ni phyi mchod do/ /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis gas nas/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /lha yi ḍi ki dha ri dril bu pa/ /lwa ba dza lan+ta ra nag po pa/ /dge mgon ti li nā ro pham ting mched/ /ma ṇi ka dang byang chub bzang po dang / /chos dbang bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan dang / /don grub ye shes sha kya rdo rje dang / /sangs rgyas 'bum dang lo mchog seng ge rgyal/ /g.yung ston rdor dpal grags tshul byang seng ba/ /gzhon blo kun bzang gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta//mkhan chen grol mchog zhabs dang bla ma rje/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchodi pa 'bu1la/ /oṃ ā hu/ yang na/ rat+na shrī dge legs zhi ba'i blo/ /sa dbang bzang po sa dpal dri med dpal/ 'u༈nga ston blo brtan lo mchog seng ge rgyal/ /g.yung ston man chad gong bzhin no/ /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod myang / oṃ i nu ra ga na/ badz+ra spyo bha wa at+pa ko3 ha/ thabs dang shes rab snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo'o/ /spyo pa gsang ba'i ma sto pa'o//mkha' nang du gnas pa'i khu rjas myang bar mos la/ oṃ ā hu/ zhes brjod pa ni mchod pa chen po'o/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na/rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sbyangs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis hūṃ yig la thim/ hū yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na/ bzlas pa'i sngon —124—

du'am/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i mthar bsgom mo/ khyun gyi gtor ma'i cho ga bsdus pa ni/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum skyed pa bor ba dang / bru a dzi kha hu las rdzas bcu bskyed cing de rnams kyis mtshan pa bskyed pa ni khyad par ro// 'bring po ni ma rgyud spyi'i zhing skyong gi cho ga nyid yin zhing / rgyas par zhing skyong gi gtor ma'i cho ga chen po ni logs shig tu 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /go don rgyas par rgyud 'grel dang ka la ka lnga'i sgrubs thabasadang bla ma snga ma rnams kyi yi ger blta bar bya'o/ /tshul 'di phyi ma'i dus 'dir nub mthong nas/ /blo dman rnams la mchog tu mkho ba'i phyir/ /don rgyas shin tu nyung dza'i tshig tu sdebs/ /gang 'di'i dge ba 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs te bcu gnyis pa'o// //༈ na sdu wa rā ya/ gsang ba mchog gi pho brang du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog‘gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /lha mo de la'ang gus btud nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho 'dir 'jug bya/ /da ni 'dir dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pa la de bshad par bya ste/ de yang rgyud las/ sngon du phag mo'i dkyil 'khor cha ni/ /bri bya de nas he ru ka'i 'o/ /rdo rje bu mo'am de nas gzhan/ /der ni shes rab gzhug par bya/ rgyud gzhan du ni dbang bskur la/ /tshul 'di bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mi g.yo bla med las kyang 'di dang 'dra bar bshad pa la phyis kha cig rang gi dbang ma thob na dbang gzhan thob kyang mi rung ba'i don tsam du 'chad mod dzig don la ma zhugs te/ rang gi dbang ma thob na ta ga la zhig /rang gi dbang thob kyang rgyud gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la 'di mi ston zhes pa'i don du 'dug pas/ mkhas pa rang tsho dang / mi mkhas kyang mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can ske 'brang po rnams tshig 'di lta bu'i don gang yin da dung rtogs shig /skabs 'dir rgyud 'di'i dbang bskur thob pas de la dang por zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma —125—

byin te rang gnas su btang / tso'o huX/ zhes stan byin gyis rlabs/ tsho( khyoXswāhā lan gnyis kyis kha dang lag pa byin gyis brlab/ g.yon pa'i mthil dang mthe'u chung nas brtsams nas/ sor mo rnams kyi rtsa ba la/ oṃ baX haX yoX lcu/ moX/ hre hri/ phaṭa phaṭa/ huX hūX/ sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i 'dzom dang /mthe bong la sogs pa'i sen mo la/ oṃ ha na ma hi/ swāhā hūX/ bo ṣa ṭa he/ huX huX hoX phaṭa haX/ rnams sa 'khod/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i nang mchod/ lag mthil g.yas su ba 'ag ste/ srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung bri/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod la/ yan lag lnga dang / mchod rdzas sogs la bsang gtor bya/oṃ badz+ra bhu mi huX/ oṃ sarba rtse ut+pa/ da ya huX/ oṃ a badz+ra re khe huX/ oX hiXswāhā/ oṃ arka bu ma le swāhā/ tsho( tsan+t+ra bi ma le swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal bya/rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg cing / bhu ra bhu wa swaX zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āXza naX me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ āX.at+pa na me rak+ṣa huX/ oṃ āXyo gaX me rak+ṣa huX/ bar 'dir skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed bya/ rdo rje phyag rgya gnas drug tu reg la/ oṃ hā sogs brjod pas go cha bcings/ spro na dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs sho ka gnyis dang / srid pa'i rgya mtshor yongs bying ba/ /yang dag yongs su sgrol mkhas pa'i/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin gang gis/ /bdag la ye shes 'di bskyed 'dud/ /ces phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'dasa'akhor bcas la gtor ma 'bul bar bya'o/ /mdor bsdu ba'i tshe/ nang mchod dang lag pa byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams bya/ gzhan de rnams ma grub kyang nyes pa med do/ /rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ snying gar paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX nag po/ oṃ a ā: nas ha k+ṣa huX huX phaṭa/ huX gi nā da las yi ge'i 'phreng ba spros/ lus kyi stod —126—

bar smad rnams su/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i 'phreng bas g.yon skor du dkris/ de las khams gsum du gtogs pa thams cad du 'khe7ra lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros te srid pa gsum gyi bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo dang / dpral pa dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams kyi thad ka'i nam mkha' la/rim pas shrī he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi kha dog sngon po'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 ha/rgyas par spro na/ shrī yig 'byung ba kun gyi don/ spa sogs brjod cing don sgom par slob dpon dag gsung mod/ tshig de ma brjod kyang dgos nges pa'i tshig don chad pa med do/ /gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /phung po lnga po thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna dag la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni lhung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ /dag pa gsum dang phung khams byin gyis rlabs pa de dag ni/ rten byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol gdab cing / 'dzi nga ni nga kā yi ka hū hu phaṭa/ glu( spo hā gro hā wā rnyi ka hu hū phaṭa/ glu te gro hā pā ya gro sna pā ya tsa ra pi ma hu hū phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra dz+nyā ni ka hu skyo phaṭa/ sngags rnams nag —127—
