po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ 'og tu raX las nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje rwa ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i rtse lnga pa ljang khu'i mda'i drwa ba rnams su gyur/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum bha tshar gnyis brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba/ khra gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo ma bzhi/ gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba/ gnyen rje brtan ma la sogs pa'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams tho ba dang rang 'dra'i phur bu thogs pa spros/ oX ru a na ya dzaXzhes bskul bas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug hūX rwa ba'i phyi rol du 'brub khung mes gang ba byung ba rnams su bcug phur bus spyi bor gdab/ oX gha gha: sogs brjod/ tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra muta ga ra: sogs brjod/ bgegs rnams stong pa'i dbyings su sbyangs/ pho nya mo rnams ra ba la thim/ 'od zer gyi thig le phyir 'phros pas/ snyen ra lo dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje dang / me'i rwa ba zlum po rnams su gyur/ 'og gi huX zhu bas rdo rje phra mo'i bar mtshams med par gtams/ bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kun nas bgegs dang bral ba'o/ /de dag ni bsrung ba'i 'khor le'o/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu dgod cing /oṃ badz+ra ku ru swāhā/ oX sarba sdo tha/ ri swāhā/ oṃ pri ya ud ta ma swāhā/ oṃ da ma gā tā rā swāhā/ oṃ bi wā sa badz+ra swāhā/ tseX( bzhi 'e1 tsa ne swāhā/ oṃ mā ma gī swāhā/ oṃ paṇ+ḍar wa si swāhā/ oṃ tā rā swāhā/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer —128—

gyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi me tog gi steng du/ lha tshogs rnams rang rang gi rnam pa dang / bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rol pas bzhugs/ shar du kun mdzes ma sngon mo/ byang du dga' mchog ma ljang khu/ nub tu shin tu brtse ma dmar mo/ lho ru rol pa'i rdo rje ma ser mo/ bzhi char yang snyem pa rin po che dang mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bkang nas/ gtso bo la bstod pa/ mer spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo/ bden bral du mā ma gī sngon mo rdo rje/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal/ bzhi char yang g.yas rang rtags dang / g.yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad zhi zhing sgeg pa/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs can no/ /oṃ ā hū/ lan gsum gyis mgron la bsangs gtor bya/ oṃ pra wa ra sa t+pa ra pā phywa pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+gha: bar 'dir lha so so'i sngags kyis me tog 'bul bar bshad kyang / yun ring du thogs pa'i phyir deng sang lag len mi mdzad do/ /oṃ ā badz+ra pukhre hu sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ snying ga'i hū las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ o badz+ra lī ni hu hu phaṭa nas/ oṃ dharma dha tu badzi hū hu phaṭa/ rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i rkang pa re re'i 'go ru oṃ re dang / mjug tu hu hu phaṭa re sbyar bas bstod de/ o na ma shrī badz+ra ḍā ka ma hā bī ra lī re shwa rā ya hu hū phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ skye( gra sta pā ta pra bā ta ma hā ma te hu hū phaṭa ces pa'i bar ro/ /de la skabs 'dir rkang pa zhe brgyad pa/ oṃ dang hū phaṭa spel bas nang mchod 'bul zhing / ma spel bas bstod pa byed pa'i lugs ni mi legs par snang la/ ci ste nang mchod 'bul bar 'dod na/ rang sngags sam 'bru gsum gyi phul na legs so/ /spro na/rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang shā —129—

bā ri pa dang / /mai tri pa dang rgya gar phyag na dang / /pad+ma rdo rje dza ya gya na dang / /sum lo grags rgyal sa paṇa skyob pa dpal/ /rgyal tsha cho se dbang mang 'bar lo tsā dang / /bag ston tshul rgyal ngag dbang byang seng ba sa bzang 'phags pa mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ /byams pa gling pa rdo rje gdan pa dang / /rgya ston byang dbang rje btsun grol mchog dang / /byams pa lhun grub rnams la gus pas mchod/ /ces pa 'di rje btsun grol mchog gis gsan yig ltar bkod pa yin/ yang na srin po ri nas rgyud pa'am/ rgyal tsha chos dbang mang 'bar lo tsā ba/ /glo chen ye shes mgon dang dar ma bzang / /grags chen spang khang pa dang rin rtson pa/ /mkhan chen byang seng theg chen chos rje dang / /brag thog bsod bzang 'jigs med 〈rdo rje gdan pa 〉dpa' bo dang / rgya ston man gong bzhin/ yang na/ sum lo mkhas pa mu dra pa dang / seng ge rgyal mtshan yar klungs lo tsā ba/ rong ba sher sing kyi ston grags rgyal dang / kun mkhyen chen po slob dpon chos grags dpal/byang seng sogs sum lo man chad sna tshogs su gyes pa'o/ /nye rgyud/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ shwa bā ri pa sems kyi mdud 〈rje grol mchog go 〉grol dang / sangs rgyas kun 'dus lha dbang grags pa ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ ces so/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po/ /yid bzhi nor bu 'dir 'byung ba/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs ye shes chen pos g.yogs/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thugs rjes khro ba drag chen po/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun bcom pa yi/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa gzung bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med —130—

rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsngags pa'i dge ba gang / /de dag kun la bdag gis rjes yi rang / /byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyid/ /rgyun bshags 'di dz+nyā dzā ya phya na'i gzhung / sum pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba ltar na/ rkang pa drug las med pa sogs 'gyur mi bde ba bag re snang bas gzhung g.yin 'gyur bde ba ltar bris so/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa gu ru pā de khyuXsarba satwa u pa kā ra ṇa ya swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ tshogs zhing gi dkyil 'khor bcas rang la thim pa'am/ glu( āXbadz+ra muXhūX zhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom ste/ bsod nams tshogs gsog go/oṃ sarba dharmāXtshwa/ n+ya swa bhā wa shurnyo3 haX/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharma snya bhā wa shurnyo3 haX/ oX shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ yo ga shudhaXsarba dharma yo ga shu khre/྅ haX/ 'di'i sngags gnyis pa des thams cad la 'dra min zhig yod pa ni/ rgya dpe'am thog ma'i bod dpe gang rung ma dag par gsal lo/ /de lta bu'i sngags kyi don sgom pa ni ye shes tshogs gsog go /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las thig le/ de las zla phyed/ de las mgo bo/ sde las ha/de las mū yig grub pa'i tshul gyis/ huX ye shes lnge ji ngo bo/ de dang lhan cig grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ phyi rol 'khor lo dang /pad+ma dang / rdo rje dang / me'i rwa bas bskor ba thams cad kyang dbyibs zlum po'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo de'i nang 'og gi char/ yaX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po bzla gam yaX dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor —131—

dmar po gru gsum raX dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baX dang bum pas mtshan pa/ laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laX dang rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ kha dog bzhi dang zur bzhi pa/ rtse mo brgyad pa la sum gyis mtshan pa/ paX las sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i spyoX/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar nag byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba dkar ba/ 'byung ba rnams zhu zhing sla ba'i ngo bor gyur pas/ ri rab 'og gi cha la song la/ 'byung bzhi zhu ba rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/gzhal med khang chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis sa gzhi la gnas shing dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i nang du chud pa kho na phyi nang du rim pa bzhi las/ pho brang nang ma gsum zlum po/ phyi ma gru bzhi'o/ /pho brang dang po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'i 'khor lo ni/ nag po dang sngon po'i rtsig pa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur gsum pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gnyis pa chos kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ nag dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur bzhi pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gsum pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i dkyil 'bor ni/ sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur lnga pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur drug pa'i nang du chud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang po'i dbus su sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo/ pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad —132—

pa ste/ de'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan ma'o/ /de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo sngo nag mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/de'i phyi rol du snying po'i 'khor lo dmar ser rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/de'i phyi rol du yon to gyi 'khor lo dkar dmar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i bskor ba/de'i phyi rol skal ba bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du nam mkha'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar nas g.yon bskor gyis/gtum drag /tshang tshing can/ 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i keng rus/ 'jigs sde/dbang sde/ dbang ldan nas g.yon skor gyis/ ha ha rgod pa/ dpal gyi nags/mun pa drag po/ ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa rnams so/ /de dag na gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shi ri sha a shwat+na ka ka la tsu ta/ n+ya gro dha/ ka ra sgra la ta par+sha bār+sha pa'o/ phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ dbang po/ gnod sbyin/ klu'i dbang po/gzhan rje'i bdag po/ 'byung po'i bdag po/ bsreg za'i bdag po/ srin po'i bdag po/ rlung gi bdag po/ klu chen po brgyad ni/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ hu lu hu lu/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong ngo / /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ sgra sgrogs/ 'ur sgrogs/ drag po 'khyil ba/ 'thug po/ gang ba/ char 'bebs gtum po'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dam skyes sngon po'i mdog can pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du rlung gi 'khor lo sngo ljang ngam sna tshogs pa'i mdog can 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du sa'i 'khor lo ser po ral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du skal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam —133—

bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du me'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ gsod byed/ kun tu skrag byed/ 'jigs chen/ /'jigs byed/ skrod byed/ sdang byed/lkugs byed/ rengs byed do/ tsheng brgyad ni/ gu yo/ star kā nā ri la/ se 'brubil ba/ kyu ru ra/ bi dz+nyā/ rag sha'o/ /phyogs skyong ma brgyad ni/ dbang mo/gnod sgyin mo/ chu lha mo/ gshin rje mo/ 'byung mo/ drang srong mo/ srin mo/ rlung gi chung ma'o/ / dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i dbus su me'i 'jor lo dmar po sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyir rol du chu'i 'khor lo dkar po thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi 'khor lo ljang khu'am khra bo mgo bo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du skal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du chu'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/byis pa shi ba/ lhag ma za ba/ mi bzad pa'i g.yul/ mche ba kun/ du ba mun nag nang gi me/ ha he'i sgra/ sgra chen po'o/ tsheng brgyad ni/ tsan dan/ ga bur/dzā tī/ e la/ nā ga ge sar/ tsam pa ka shun tu sa lha'i shing ngo / /'jigs rten skyong ba brgyad ni/ nyi ma me 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ bsil pa ral gri 'dzin pa/sa'i bu chu gri 'dzin pa/ ri bo can skyes mdung ring 'dzin pa/ bla ma sbu'i gri 'dzin pa/ ngan spong brag ri 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i bu glog 'dzin pa/ lha min mgo bo mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa ste thams cad kyang bzhin shin tu khros pa'o/ /grub pa'i skyes bu brgyad ni/ ral gri mig sman ril bu rkang byug bcud len/ mchil lham/ dngul chu/ sa 'og thob pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po keng rus kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/—134—

de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po zhags pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdog can/ mu khyud la lcags kyu'i 'phreng ba'i yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i phyir rol du skal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu rlung gi khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ tshig pa/ ma tshig pa/ dum bur gyur pa/ ma brtubs pa/'jigs su drang ba/ 'jigs par byed pa/ gsal shing gis phug pa/ steng nas btags pa'o/ khreng brgyad ni/ shal+la li/ mya ngan med pa/ yongs 'du/ u du sba ra/ to sba ri/ za ri/ rgya shug /ba ru ra'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba ni/ dmyal srung chen po brgyad do/ /de la gzhal med khang rim pa re re'i nang du chud pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum gsum ste/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang so sor rtsibs sum cu rtsa drug dang bcas pa/ gzhal med khang rnams kyang pha gu dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang /ri dwags kyi rtse mo brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub ngar/ra/lho ser/ dbus dkar ba/ steng thog rim par phub pas dbus phyur bur gyur pa/rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa/ gzhal med khang phyi ma'i nang gi grwa bzhir/bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dur khrod rim pa bzhi po rnams kyang /re re bzhin zhing skyong ba dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten brgyad brgyad rnams dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ ro dang ro langs —135—

dang / bya dang gcan gzan dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi 'khor gyi yongs su gang ba/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dang grub pa'i rdzas kyi nye bar brgyan pa/phyi rol na rdo rje 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/nang gi lha'i gnas rnams las/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma nyer bzhi dang /'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams dang / dkyil 'khor so so'i sgo mtshams rnams su ro'i gdan/ skal bzang gi snam bu la zla ba'i gdam rnams so/ /'di dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā:nas a a nyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du ka kha: nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa lha nyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkha'i hu yig zhugs/ de las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams spros te/ 'gro ba thams cad de'i bdag nyid du byas nas slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hu gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ yang 'od 'phros thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpal bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad phyogs bcu nas spyan drangs te hu la thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de —136—

yang rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ dkar ljang dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang 'dra'i yum la 'khrud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis cang tes gri gug dgra sta/ rtse gsum/ g.yon bzhis kha ṭaX gathod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/zhabs gnyis g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan mo mnan pa/ lhag ma 'bras bu'i he ru ka dang mtshungs pa thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX yig go / de yan go ni bsnyen pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa byāX las byung ba'i nor bu'i rtse mor byāX dmar ser gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āXlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa sdiX las byung ba'i ze 'bru'i rtse mor byāX dkar ser gyis mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang / yum gyi mgrin par/ oX badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang / yum gyi dpral par/ oX sarba ba dha ḍā ki nī ye/badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar/ oX shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX huX hūX phaṭa/ ḍā gi nī dzā la sa ma wa raX swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang /yum gyi thugs kar/ oX hiXha ha huX huX phaṭa/ oX āXhuX sngags rnams phan tshun reg cing yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul te yab kyi zhal du zhugs lha mo'i pad mar son pa na/ yab yum gnyis ka bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi thig —137—

le'i gong bur zhu bar gyur/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas snying rje dang byams pa dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin thig le las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo drug tshan bzhi/ rang rang gi gnas kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar 'dug nas bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ mnga' bdag nyi ma re rer 'gro ba mgron 'bod na/ khyod ni ci yi phyir na stong pa nyid la bzhugs/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod pa mdzod/ /gson zhig gson zhig g.yin gyi dgongs pa nub/ /'jig rten phyugs gang shi ba bzhin du gyur/ /bdag gi pad+ma rgyas pa la 'dod mdzod/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun bder 'gyur bar byos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la rol zhig rol/ /lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa thob/ /'jig rten sems can gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas/ /ji ltar khyod ni stong pa don med 'gyur/ khyod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed po ste/ /ci'i phyir lhan skyes rang bzhin 'gro med bzhugs/ /bdag la mchog gi don gyi 'dod pa mdzod/ /ji ltar khyod ni 'jig rten rnams mthun bzhu na/ /ces bskul nas/ lha mo rnams thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid huX sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar hūX ljang sngon gyis mtshan par 'gyur/ oṃ āXkā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra hūX phaṭa hoX de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sngags 'di 'don bzhin par bzhengs pa na/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyang skad cig gis rdzogs par blta'o/ /de yang dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ nyi ma dang dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'jigs byed chen po dang —138—

dus mtshan mo'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba'i phyir gzugs la/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyi phung po can/ zhal bcu bdun/ phyag bdun cu rtsa drug pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ rtsa zhal gyi steng gi zhal gsum dang / kun gyi steng gi zhal gcig ste bzhi ni bung ba ltar gnag cing ches khros pa/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ljang khu/ rgyab zhal brtsegs ma bzhi dmar po g.yas zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ser po/ zhal re re zhing dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal thams cad kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ kun gyi mdun ma'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa thams cad kyi tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyi glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su bsnams pa ste rtsa ba'i phyag bzhi'o/ /lhag ma sprul phyag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /dang po g.yas g.yon ral gri phub chen bsnams/ /gnyis pa dag gis mdung ring che ba 'dzin/ /gsum pa mdung rtse gsum dang gshun shing ngo / /bzhi pa dgra sta zhags pa ste/ /lnga pa gri gug thog khrag go /drug pa mda' bo che dang gzhu/ /bdun pa gsal shing kha smo ga /brgyad pa tho ba po ti dang / /dgu pa 'khor lo phub chung dang / /bcu pa cang te'u sdigs mdzub can/ /bcu gcig chu gri g.yer kha'i 'phreng / /bcu gnyis dbyug gu rtse gcig lug gu rgyud//bcu gsum mtshon cha rtse gcig brag ri'o/ /bcu bzhi dung dkar dur khrod rdul/ /bco lnga zangs dung bho ka dang / /bcu drug dbyug rtse gsum dang bha ka ste/ /bcu bdun rma bya'i mjug sgro —139—

pags rlon no/ /bco brgyad bya rog gshog sgro skra thag dang / /bcu dgu skra'i spir ro bsreg bskul ba'i shing / /nyi shu me thab ga da'i dbyug /nyer gcig ri bo phub rings dang / /nyer gnyis dbyug to mi mgo dang / /nyer gsum me long keng rus dang / /nyer bzhi pi wa zor ba'o/ /nyer lnga rkang pa'i mgo dang mig /nyer drug lag mgo mkhal ma ste/ /nyer bdun glo ba snye ma dang / /nyer brgyad rgyu ma spen pa dang / /nyer dgu sgra can phur bu'o/ /sum cu lcags sgrog bi dza pur/ /so gcig gdos dang sog le ste/ /so gnyis du bhu sa dang khab/ /so gsum nya dol pags pa rlud bu bshus/ /so bzhi mgo med ro dang char 'bebs sprin/ /so lnga 'bar ba'i mar nag ljon shing ste/ /so drug 'jigs byed che gzugs lcags kyu bsnams/ /de dag la phub rings ni zur bzhi nar thabs can/ phub chen bse phub lta bu zlum po/ phub chung lag phub thug mo nang na lag 'dzin gdong kag yod pa/ chu gri ni gri thung / lug gu rgyud ni nyag thag kha cig na lug rgyud med par sgrog 'dzin pa yod/ gdos ni/ gru rkya dang / tshong ge dang / srog chags 'dzin pa'i rnyi'i rigs gcig la 'dod pa sogs sna tshogs yod kyang phyi ma 'thad par sems/bho ga ni bla ma rnams mdung thung yin par 'chad pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya mod/ zangs dung gi nang sel yin par yang mi 'gal/ rte ka ni rnga pa ṭa ha/ du bhu sa ni nya skyogs su rlud bu bshus ni kha cig seng ge'i rlud bu bshus su bzhed do/ /skye gnas phyag rgya skabs 'dir yum gyi phyag yin pa yab kyi phyag tu 'khrul bas/ phyag tha ma'i 'jigs byed lcags kyu dang glang lpags lhan cig byed pa dang /dmar nag 'jigs byed lhan cig /ljon shing lcags kyu lhan cig byed pa sogs smra bas 'phongs pa dag byung zhes gzigs pa yangs po dag gsung pa ni shin tu mang ba'o/ /yang dkyus su 'jug ste/—140—

zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan mo dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu steng dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/ smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor cog spyi bor bcings ba'i rtse mor 'khor lo la gnas pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang / ral ba'i mdun ngos su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag brgya'i do shal can/ phyag drug dang dpung rgyan dang / zhabs gdub dang / 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing / sku lus ba sbu'i 'phreng ba can/ sku'i tshigs thams cad la bde bas rlan pa/ sprul pa'i he ru ka sna tshogs pa rnam par 'phro ba dang bcas pa'o/ /de ni sgrub pa'o/ /de la 'phyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis zangs gri sta re ḍā ma rus tri shu la/ g.yon bzhis ka pā la/ 'ching byed mkhar dbyug /tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis spyi bo'i steng du skye gnas kyi phyag rgya yongs su bskor ba/ dmar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa/gcer bu ba sbu langs shing rngus dang ldan pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ yan lag thams cad la lha rdzas kyi dris nye bar byugs shing lha rdzas kyi me tog 'phreng bas klubs/—141—

dbu rgyan la zla phyed rdo rjes mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon skyang ba'i stabs kyis yab dpal he ru ka dang spyor ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de ni sgrub pa chen po/'o/ /'di dag tu rnam grangs kyi nges pa cung zad bshad na/ yab kyi zhabs gnyis su byed pa 'di bsdus pa'i lugs yin/ rgyud kyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis ston pa'i skabs kyi dgongs pa'ang yin par 'dod de/ le'u gnyis pa rdo rje phag mo phyag bcu gnyis pa'i skabs dang /le'u bco lnga pa 'khor lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs 'dir rgyu rdor 'dzin skabs su zhabs kyis 'jigs dus mnan pa tsam gsungs pa zhabs gnyis pa yin phyin 'bras bus rdor 'dzin skabs kyang 'jigs dus mnan par gsungs pas zhabs kyang sngar dang 'dra bar shugs la 'grub par bsams te/ rgyal sdes kyang zhabs gnyis par mdzad gda' ba lar nas 'gal ba ga la yod/ 'on kyang gdan 'jigs dus tsam gyis zhabs gnyis kho nar 'grub dka' zhing / skabs g.yin du byung bas kyang ma nges la 'di lta bu sku 'dra 'jim gzugs bzhengs pa sogs la ni cung zad mi bde yang 'byung ngo / /phag mo chen mo'i skabs su gsung pa ltar zhabs bco brgyad kyis lha chen bco brgyad mnan pa ni 'bring po dang / le'u lnga bcu pa las byung ba ltar/ zhal so bdun/ phyag stong phrag /rtsa ba'i zhabasabaco brgyad kyis lha chen bco brgyad chung mar bcas pa gnon pa ni rgyas pa'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen chen pos/ bstod pa mdzad pa na 'jigs dus mnan pa tsam zhig gsungs/ zhabs kyi grangs gsal ma mdzad/ sgrub thabs nyung ngu dang / thugs dam ri mor bris pa la/ zhabs bco brgyad pa/ 'og tu 'jigs dus che ba re byas de'i steng du lha bco brgyad mnan pa mdzad 'dug pa —142—

ltar na bris 'bur bzhengs pa dang / sgom pa sogs gang la yang bde bas 'dam kha rnams kyi nang nas 'di ngos bzung bar sem mo/ phag gdong chen mo'i skabs na/ lha bco brgyad la rlung lha sa lha chu lha/ gnod sbyin/ bdud/ 'khor sgyur rnams yod/ stong phrag phyag can gyi skabs su drug po de'i dod du thags bzang ris dang / dgra bcom dang / bla ma/ skyob pa/ bla ma gnyis pa log 'dren zhes pa yod la/ phyi ma lnga po de rnams rgyal ba dam pa dang / phur bu dang / mi sbyin dang / pa sangs dang / a sho ka rnams yin no/ /skabs 'dir phag gdong chen mo'i lugs bzhin byas na bde'o/ /yum gtso bo dang zhal phyag mtshungs pa rgyas pa/ dkyus su bkod pa ltar zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa 'bring po ste 'di ni 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyis skabs su gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang / zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsdus pa ste/ rgyas bsdus gnyis le'u lnga bcu par/ phag mo yis ni 'khrud pa ste/ /de gzugs can nam phyag gnyis skyes/ /zhes pas bstan la/ phyag gnyis kyi phyogs la skye gnas kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa dang / gri thod 'dzin pa gnyis spyir gang byas kyang chog mod/ dza ya phya nas 'khrul pa cung zad mdzad pa'i nor ba rjes su 'brang ba'ang mang ngo / /rgyud las/ de yi mdun gnas lha mo che/ /rdo rje phag mo sngar dang mtshungs/ /zhes sngar le'u gnyis par phag mo phyag bcu gnyis pa gsungs pa la zhal 'phangs mdzad pa ste/ der 'jigs dus me lta bu'i 'od zer can/ zhes pas gzi brjid kyi dpe'am/ me dpung 'bar ba bstan par ma zad sku mdog kyang dmar mor bstan par bzhed pa yang legs shing / yab mig sman mdog tu khug da/phag mo gtso bor gyur pa thabs kyis 'phyud pa'i skabs der ni/ phyag tha mas bdud kyi pags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /phag gdong chen mo lta bu'i yum rkyang la ni glang lpags so/ /der skye gnas phyag rgya gnyis kyis/ lhag ma rdo rje phag mo'o/ /gal te he ru ka gtso bo/ de tshe phag mo'i phyag gnyis su'o/ /glang po'i pags pa 'dzin pa po/ /zhes yab gtso bor gyur pa las/ yab kyis glang lpags —143—

dang / yum skye gnas kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa dang / yum gtso bor gyur pa la de go bzlog par bshad pas/ sgrub thabs dza ya gya nas mdzad pa las/ glang po'i pags pa phyag gnyis kyis/ skye gnas phyag rgya de bzhin gzhan/ /zhes rgyud tshig ji lta ba drangs nas/ slar yum phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin par byas pas 'gal ba 'dus te thams cad la 'khrul gzhi byung ba yin gyi/ rgyud tshig rang la 'khrul gzhi de med pas bshad par bla'o/ /de bzhin du mtshon cha bdun cu rtsa gnyis su bshad pa yang / rtsa phyag bzhi ma nga grangs pa'i dbang du mdzad pa kho na'o/ /zhes rig par bya'o/ /de yan chad kyi dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo'i pad ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad las/ bar bar du 'dab ma re re bor ba'i 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ shar nas byang gi bar la/ mkha' 'gro ma dang gzugs can nyid/ /'o byed ma dang gzhan sgyur ma/ /byis bcas ma dang rjes 'jug ma/ /de rnams g.yon nag g.yas ljang khu/ /byang nas nub kyi bar la/ lā ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /bzang mo thod pa can ma dang / /nag mo rgyal pos bskor ma rnams/ /g.yon ljang g.yas dmar rim pas so/ /nub nas lho'i bar la/ dum skyes mi dang dur khrod ma/ /rnam par zhu ma rigs byed ma/ /dur byed ma dang gar ma rnams/ /g.yon dmar g.yas ni ser ba'o/ /lho nas shar gyi bar la/ gzugs can ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gtsug phud ma dang thor tshugs ma/ /ral pa can ma drag mo rnams/ /g.yon ser g.yas ni sngo ba'o/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ sgra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me —144—

ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /zhes dza ya phya na dang bod thams cad 'dod pa ltar rung ba'ang yin la/ 'on kyang rgyud las skabs 'dir gtso bo dang mtshungs par gsungs pas/ rdo rje phag mo yab dang mtshungs na nyer bzhi snying po'i lha mo yang dbu ma phyag mang/ bcom ldan 'das ma phyag bcu gnyis ma ltar na/'di dag kyang de dang 'dra ba/ yum phyag gnyis ma ltar na 'di dag kyang phyag gnyis pa'o zhes don yin kyang da lta'i lag len la dang po mi 'grub pa'i phyi ma gnyis gang bde yin la/ 'on kyang phyag bzhi ma g.yas gri gug ḍā ma sa g.yon thod pa kha ṭā ga byas na'ang legs so/ /de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa nyer bzhi'o/ /de'i phyir rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ mkha' 'gro ma gzhan lwa ma gzhan/ /dum skyes ma gzhan gzugs can gzhan/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan ma dang sna chen ma/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma mi'u thung ma/ la d+ma'i bdag mo shing grib ma/ /sa srung 'jigs byed chen mo dang / /rlung shugs ma dang chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs lha mo rab bzang ma/ /rta rna ma dang bya gdong ma/ /'khor lo'i shugs ma dum skyes ma/ /chang tshong 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ khren tu dpa' mo stobs chen ma/ /'khor los bsgyur ma brtson 'grus chen ma/ /gshin rje'i bu mo gshin rje ma/ /bskyod byed ma dang skrag byed ma/ /gtum mo dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /'dod grub ma dang 'bar chen mo/ /de thams cad kyang sngo nag byed pa'i gzugs can no/ /'di dag gi yab rnams mtshan tha dad pa la mos na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa bzhi dang / khaṇ+ḍa kā pā la sogs pa nyer bzhi dang /—145—

stobs po che/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ blo brtan/ brtan pa thar ba/ ye shes thabs/thugs kyi rdo rje zhes pa rnams su bshad la/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi skabs 'dir/ 'og ma rmams kyis rigs 'gre ba'i phyir mtshan tha dad pa ma smos kyang chog go /snying po'i 'khor 'o/ pa shar nas g.yon skor gyi/ rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod ma/ /rin chen gtsug ma rnam snang ma/ /pad+ma dkar dbang ma dang don yod ma/ /spyan ma bdag ma gos dkar mo sgrol ma/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma dang de bzhin tu/ /sgra dri ro reg chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sa snying mo dang nam mkha'i snying po ma/ /phyag rdor ma dang 'jig rten mgon mo dang / /sgrib kun sel ma kun tu bzang mo nga/nga / /rin chen sgrol ma bdag med khro gnyer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can ma de bzhin du/ /gshin rje mthar med mo dang shes mthar ma/ /pad mthar ma dang bgegs mthar byed ma dang //mi g.yo ma dang dbyug sngon 'dod rgyal ma/ /stobs chen ma dang gtsug tor gnod mdzes ma thams cad kyang dmar ser phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /yon tan 'khor lo la/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs mo/ /dmangs mo gtum mo khyi mchod ma/ /g.yung mo gar ma thod pa can/ /nya pa mo dang smig ma mkhan/ /dung bzod mkhan ma tha ga ma/ /'khur ba mkhan mo shing bzo ma/ /'phreng ba mkhan mo til mar mkhan/ /de bzhin chos mkhan mo dang ni/ /srin bal byed mo pho nya mo/ /bshang 'phyag mo dang brtses mkhan mo/ /chang tshong ldum ra'i gnyer pa mo/ /rgyal pos bkrabs ma gshan pa mo/ /so rtsi tshong par byed ma dang / /gser mgar mo dang lcags mgar mo/ /nor bu mkhan pa nag pa mo/ /kla klo o ṭi tshong pa mo/ /rdo bzo ma dang zhing las mo/ /ko lpags ma —146—

ste rnal 'byor ma'o/ /thams cad kyang dkar dmar byed pa'i gzugs can no/de'i phyi rol skal ba bzang po'i snam bu la/ byams pa nas brtsams te glog gi tog gi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgo khwa gdong ma/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma/lho sgor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gzhin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya ma/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams so/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo la/ mi 'am ci mo dri za mo/ khu ṭu ka ma pa pha ṭa ha/ /pi wa gling bu mu kun+da/ /rdza rnga gaglu ri ma dang / /cha lang shes le tri ka ma/ /klu ma ka raṇ+ḍa ma ta ma ḍa/ /gar ma sgeg ma dha ka ma dang ni/ /tā li sha ra ṇa mo rnga chen mo/ /mo dri rgyud can ma dang mā ru ma/ /na la bā mo khyu ba ka ma dang / /ḍā ma ru dang gu'o ḍū ka ma dang / /zangs dung ma dang rwa dung ma de bzhin/ /bhu ki dril bu ma dang dril chung ma// g.yer kha ma dang ko li ka ma dang / /dung dkar ma dang dbyangs ldan ma de bzhin/ /'khor ma zhes bya sum cu rtsa drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /yang na sna tshogs par bkra ba'o/ /rlung gi 'khor lo la/mkha' lding dang mo bkra ba mo/ /bya rog bya dkar sreg pa mo/ /rma bya zangs kyi gtsug phud ma/ /gu da bu li 'jam pa mo/ /phug ron bya rog chen mo dang / kha ṭi ni dang gong ma sreg /ne tso sngags ma gzhad ma dang / /bya rgod lug pa tsā ṭa ki khreng bye'u ma dang ngur ba ma/ /pri slo ra ni ka ska si/ /so bya mo dang bi lā ṭi/ /lcug ma'i mgrin dang sha ri gī /bye'u khra gur bum lce ma dang / /ba ṭi ri kā rdza ga mo/ /hor pa ka ga mo de bzhin/ /da t+ta ri mo ri dwags dgra/ /thams cad kyang 147—

sngo ljang phyed pa'am sna tshogs pa'i kha dog bkra ba can no/ /sa'i 'khor lo la/seng ge mo dang stag mo dang / /bhi ba mo dang ri bong mo/ /glang chen ri dwags byi la mo/ /ba dang ma he mo rta mo/ /ce spyang mo dang bse mo 'bri/ /byi ba bong mo bhe ḍi ma/ra mo lug mo rim pa bzhin/ khyi mo phag mo dom mo dang / /daṇ+ḍa ri ma mo dz+nyā gī/ /dred mo dang ni sgeg mo dang / /nags ma dang ni khyi chen mo/ /bya rog chen mo sha chu lī/ /sbrul mo khra mo rnga mong dang / /sre mong rtsang mo phug pa mo/ /grong na gnas pa ma rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog ser lnga'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ mchod pa dang dpal sbas nas brtsams te tshangs pa'i tog gi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ khar sgor tshangs ma/ byang sgor dbang phyug ma/ nub sgor gzhon nu ma/ lho sgor khyab 'jug ma/ mer phag mo/bden bral du dbang mo/ /rlung du gtum mo/ dbang ldan du dpal chen mo rnams so/ /me'i 'khor lo la/ lha mo klu mo gnod spyin mo/ 'byung mo ma dang chung ma sring / bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / pha yi sring mo de bzhin du/ zhang po yi ni chung ma dang / /chung ma'i sbun zla dang de'i ma/ /de nyid kyi ni pha yi ma/ /chung ma yi ni phyi mo dang / /ma yi ma dang gnyen mo dang / /ma'i sbun sbun zla'i bu mo dang / /rang gi phyi mo'i skrun zla dang / /skrun zla'i bu mo de'i bu mo/ /pha yi ma dang phyi mo dang / khu bo yi ni chung ma dang / /bu mo'i bu yi chung ma dang / /slar yang chung ma'i sbun zla mo/ /pha yi sring dang de'i bu mo/ /de nyid kyi ni rang rigs skyes/ /sbun zla'i chung ma su tī dang / /bu nyid kyi ni chung ma dang / /bu mo'i khyo yi ma yi ni/ /bu nyid kyi ni rgyug mo dang / /'jo byed mo dang pū tri'o/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar —148—

mo'o/ /chu'i 'khor lo la/ ma ka ra mo ku nyi ka /sral mo kañci chu sram mo/ /sdig nag gaglu rā ma shrī li ma/ /chu yi phug ma srin bu'i gdong ma dang / /cha ga karka ṭa dang su ya mo/ /chu byi mo dang grog mo'i gdong ma dang / /chu yi mi mo dang ni ba ṭa bī/ /glang chen mo dang stag mo ce spyang mo/ /chu sbrul ma dang dud mo 'gron bu ma/ /mu tig ma ṇi mo dang dzi gu rī/ /li sa mo dang dung ngur ma ka rto ṭi/ /pha ṭa ka ma dā wa ka ma kri ma mo/ /dzu ṣi dzu ṣa mo dang sha sbrang ka lā mo/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo la/ thig le mchog ma shin tu bde/ /lha yi bu mo dga' chen mo/ /dga' dang dga' grags pad+ma can/ /dung can sna tshogs glang chen ma/ /gzugs can ma dang gzugs mdzes ma/ /'dod chags rnam sgeg bde ba mo/ /me tog 'dod ma ku mu da/ /ut+pal ma dang mdzes ldan ma/ /'dod chags mo dang 'dod chags che/ /rol grags ma dang rol chen mo/ /myos ma dang ni myos chen ma/ /'dod pa mo dang 'dod chen ma/ /bde 'byung ma dang bde ldan ma/ /mthun mchog ma dang byams pa mo/ /skal bzang ldan ma skal bzang mo/ /dma' mo zhum ma skyes gzugs ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog sna tshogs bkra ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ zla ba'i gdugs nas mthu'i dpal gyi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ /sgo mtshams brgyad la shar du go rī/ byang du tso rī/ nub tu be tā lī/ lho ru lha sma rī/ bsreg par pu ka sī/ srin por ri khrod ma/ rlung mtshams su tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ཿnga por ḍom+bhi nī rnams so/ /thugs kyi snyen ra lo la/ klu mo gnod spyin mo 'byung mo/ /yi dwags dmyal mo mnar med ma/ /lhung ba ma dang bar med ma/ /bum pa mo dang gshin rje —149—

mo/ /thig nag mo dang me mdag ma/ /tsha ba ma dang rab tsha ma/ /ngu 'bod ma dang ngu 'bod che/ /mar nag du mched ri gnyis 'tshor/ /sdang ma rmongs ma phrag dog ma/ /chags ma ser snas myos pa ma/ /skud pa ma dang grang ba mo/ /de bzhin ral ji hūṃ nags ma nyid/ /du ma dang ni mu ge ma/ /nang dgon mtshon dgon chu'i dgon ma/ /ral gri'i so ma rab med ma/ /sbu gri'i so ma 'khor lo can/ khrul bum ma ste so drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo la/ le lo chos sems sgom pa mo/ /mchod sems bza' sems gnyid sems ma/ khyim sems bud med sems ma dang / /don sems ma dang sbyor bral ma/ /bu sems ma dang mya ngan ma/ /bsam gtan ma dang sngags zlos ma/ /ngo mtshar nga rgyal gdung ba mo/ /sems can don gyi rgyur brtson ma/ /rgyal po sems ma g.yin gnod ma/ /ye shes thob ma dka' thub ma/ /rgas ma 'chi ba sems ma dang / /bde ma sdug ma mi dge ma/ /yod ma med ma nyid dang ni/ /bla ma sems ma 'gro ba mo/ /bzod ma mi bzod dal ma dang / /ngal sos ma dang bkres sems ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /'di thams cad kyi mtshan gyi mthar sems pa ma spyo spyor rgyu yin no/ /sku'i 'khor lo la 'khor los bsgyur ma rnams te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs 'khor los bsgyur ma dang / /sum cu rtsa gsum 'thab bral dga' ldan pa/ /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed tshangs ris pa tshangs pa 'dun na 'don dang tshangs r+ṣa po/ /'od chung r+sā med 'od dang 'od gsal ba/ /dge chung tshad med dge dang dge rgyas dang / /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang 'bras bu che/ /mi che mi gdung shin tu mthong ba dang / /gya nom snang ba dang ni —150—

'og min pa/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang / /ci yang med dang 'du shes yod min zhing / /'du shes med min gyi ni skye mched dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang ni mi/ /lha min zla ba nyi ma gzhin rje dang / /da/bang po'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar ba'am/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i khro bo'o/ /'di thams cad kyi mthar 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma zhes sbyor ba yin no/ /de'i phyir rol gyi snam bu la/ 'phags dgyes nas snang mdzad kyi bar gyi sangs rgyas nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ shar sgor chu skyes dkar mo/ byang sgor gan+dha ri/ nub sgor rdo rje gar ma/ lho sgor rta rgod ma'i kha ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'bar zhal ma/ mer rdo rje khro gnyer can ma/bden bral du rdo rje dum bu ma/ rlung du rdo rje gtum mo rnams so/ /de rnams las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ma thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ dang po gnyis shā ma ru dang kha ṭa ga lhag ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ drag mo chen mo mche ba gtsigs shing chags pas bzhad pa/ gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sogs sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams la 'khyud pa'i dpa' bo rnams ni mtshan dang sku'i rnam pa yum dang 'dra ba las/ phyag rgya drug dang ral ba'i cod pan dang / mgo rlon gyi do shal dang / stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhi'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ sgrub thabs dang bod rnams ltar na/ shar dang byang shar ba rnams ni g.yon sngo g.yas ljang ba/ byang dang nub byang ba rnams g.yon ljang —151—

g.yas dmar ba/ nub dang lto nub pa rnams g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba lho dang shar lho ba rnams g.yon ser g.yas sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zha9pre gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mtshungs pa'o/ /'on kyang rgyud kyi le'u so so'i dkyil 'khor la/ mkha' 'gro ma nag mo phyag bzhi mar mdzad/lā ma sogs kha dog ma gtogs de la zhal 'phangs/ gzhan rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i shugs la go bar dgongs pa yin pas 'dir de nas drangs pas phyag bzhi pa'ang legs so/ /skal bzang gis sangs rgyas rnams ni/ shar phyogs pa rnams sngon po/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang khu/ nub phyogs pa rnams dmar po/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser po/thams cad kyang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa chags bral rab 'byung gi cha lugs can bzhugs tshul dang phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /zhes bla ma snga ma rnams gsungs/bdag gi bla ma rje btsun gyi bka' las gzugs phung gi rnam snang sogs dang 'dra ba khro chags nyams can yin yang yin la bla ma gong mas de ltar zhal gzigs pa'ang yin gsungs/ 'dir rgyas par ma bris so/ /rgyud las sprul skur bshad pa ni dkyil 'khor lha sde tshan so sos sku bzhi mtshon pa'i nang tshan nas sprul sku mtshon byed ni skal bzang 'di rnams yin zhes pa'i don yin la/ spyir yang sprul skur bshad pas chags bral gyi rnam par sgrub nus pa ga la yin/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir/pi wa ma la sogs pas rnal 'byor ma rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyi rang ming dang mthun pa'i rol mo 'dzin pa dang / mkha' lding ma la sogs pa'i srog chags kyis mtshan can rnams/ zhal ras srog chags de dag mthun pa'i kha dog dang gdong bas du byed pa'i lugs gdam ngar bshad la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi ni/ sgom par nus na gtso bo ltar phyag mangs sam/ rdo rje phag mo ltar zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par yang rung zhing / sgo mtshams ma rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar —152—

nges so/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la huX ljang sngon/ spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la/ oX dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba dang pad+ma la āXdamar po/ thugs ka'i 'og gi cha la/ zla ba dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i hūX nag po/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma la/ rang rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i huX yig go /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i huX yig gnyis kyi bar du/ raX las byungaX ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ oX ha baX hā bāX/ haX biX hāX bi/ hu buX hu byuX/ he baX hai be+e/ho boX ho bo/ haX baX haXbaX huX hūX hūX skyoX/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā swāhā/ dkar po dang dmar po g.yon skor du sbrul 'khyil ba ltar gnas pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang phag mo'i rang bzhin no/ /go cha'i sngags drug char la 'gor oṃ dang / mjug tu hūX bzhi phaṭa bzhi swāhā gnyis rnams gong bzhin sbyor dgos te/ maXgo bo'i nang du nyi ma la/ na haX nā hāX/ ni hi ni hi/ nu hūX nā skyoX/ ne ho ni lha/ no hoX no ho/ na haX naXhāXser po dang sngon po rnam par snang mdzad dang gshin rje ma'i ngo bo/ spyi gtsug giX nang du nyi ma la/ su hraX snyu hraX/ sri hri sī sbru/ sru hruX snyu spruX/ swe hre swe hṝ/ swo hroX swo hro/su hraX suXhraX hūXhūX skyoX hūX/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ swāhā swāhā/ dmar po dang dkar po pad+ma gar dbang dang rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/ dpung pa gnyis kyi nang du nyi ma la/oX ba hraX ba hāX/ bi hri bī lha/ bu hruX byu khyuX/ be hre be+e lha/ bo hroX rba shīXspe/ ba hraX baXhraX nag po dang ser po he ru ka dang bskyod byed ma'i ngo bo/ mig gnyis kyi dbus su nyi ma la/ ha haX hā hāX/ hi hi hi dh+wa/ hu huX hu huX/ he ho hai lha/ ho hoX ho hoX/ haX haX rnyaXrnyaXdamar ser dang ljang khu rdo rje nyi ma dang skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ mdzod sbu'i thad ka'i nang du/ pha pha/ phu phu/ phi phi/ bī bī/ phu phu/ phyu phyu/ phe phe/ phi phi/ pho pho/ pho pho/—153—

pha pha/ pha pha ljang khu dang dud kha rta mchog dang tshwa ka'i ngo bo/ /'di la'ang pha pha phu phu sogs dgos par mngon yang sngar gyi dpe thams cad la med par mthun pas re zhig bzhag go/ 'di rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad sngags kyi rdul phra rab kyis gang / sku'i phyi rol du snying gar o ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po/ dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su/ hu hū ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa ha ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo yum gyi lte bar/ o ba dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/snying gar ha yo sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar nywa mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hre hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug hu hū ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rta kwa'i ngo bo'o/ /de rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros te lus kyi phyi rol thams cad gang bar gyur/ 'dir yang spro na go tsho lha rnams zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom ste/ ྅ yi pa'i lugs bzhin no/ /snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bskor zhing / h+pha wo brjod/ o badz+ra lī nī/ sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dza : ba ho zhes pas dam ye bsre/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ h+pha/ gong bzhin rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gde/gas rnams khrus gsol ltar/ /de —154—

bzhin bdag la khrus byed 'gyur/ /lha yi chus ni dag par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btang pas/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba sbyor mtshams nas byung nas/ bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rgyun gyis lha thams cad kyi spyi bor nas blugs shing dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag rdo rje bzhi mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs/ spyi bo'i steng du gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la 'od dpag med dam he ru ka rdo rje'i 'khor lo pa dang / nam mkha'i 'khor lo pa dang / thugs 'khor ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/ snying po'i 'khor lo pa dang / me'i 'khor lo pa dang / gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ yon to gyi snyen ra lo pa dang / chu'i 'khor lo pa dang / sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / sa'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/rlung gi 'khor lo pa dang / ye shes kyi 'khor lo pa dang / sgo mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ zhes gsung zhing dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim/ de nas mchod pa dngos su bshams yod na byin rlabs bya/ yid sprul tsam la byin rlabs mi dgos te/ gang ltar yang gong tshogs gsog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ chu gnyis/ nyer spyod lnga/ rig ma bcu drug rnams kyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la —155—

'khyud pa nyid/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa dang / /bde chen sogs dang bzang po dang / /gnyis kun rnam par spangs pa dang / /mchod pa khams gsum bdag nyid ni/ /dngos po kun 'byung rnams kyis mchod/ /de nas bstod pa ni/sngags 'phreng yongs rdzogs kyis byed pa'ang yod mod kyi/ de ltar dgos pa'i shes byed 'thad ldan mi snang bas/ bde mchog spyi dang mthun par yab yum gyi rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas spro na cang te'u sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i mthar/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ rnal 'byor chen po thub chen po/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal 'e1/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mtshan brgyas kyang bstod/ nang mchod 'khru gsum gyis myangs la/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ma lus pa 'dus nas/ myos byed dang sha'i bye brag sna tshogs pa dang / dam tshig gi rdzas thams cad kyis mchod de thams cad kyang rang gi snying gar thim/ dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po sgom par gyis/ rnal 'byor bcu gnyis bsod nams sdig med pa/ /thams cad zag med rang bzhin myong bar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ngan pa de ni bde bar shes par byos/ /dbang po 'khrul pa bde ba chen por myong bar gyis/ /skad cig de la rang dang g.yin gyi ngo bo med/ /gang dang gang gi rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs can gyi/ /sa gsum gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro bar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'ja' tshon lta bu snang stong gnyis su med pa la mnyam par bzhag go /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas 'dod chags chen po'i tshul lam du byed pa/ kun tu spyod pa la 'jug pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes par —156—

mos shing / phag mo mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas su song la/ mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo'i gnas su 'ongs te dga' ba rtsoms pa dang / de lā ma'i gnas su song zhing / /lwa ma gtso mo'i gnas su 'ong ba sogs rnal 'byor ma bzhi lan cig 'kho da pa ni/ longs spyod pa zhes bya/ lan gnyis pa 'khor ba thim pa/gsum pa 'kho ra ba bdag po/ bzhi pa 'khore ba khyab bdag /de bzhin du/ thig le'i 'khro ra lo'i rnal 'bye rnar ma/ lnga tshan bzhi po rnams la'ang sbyar zhing / sgo ma bzhi tshan bzhi dang / mtshams ma bzhi chan bzhi la'ang sbyar ro/ /de nas 'khor lo bcu gnyis la kun tu spyod pa ni/ bdag nyid 'dren pa'i he ru ka nag po phyag bcu gnyis par gyur pa ni/ 'dren pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rang nyid chung waṃ) he ru ka dmar ser du gyur la/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ snying po'i 'khor lo'i gnas su song zhing / snying po'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i gnas su 'ongs pas/ 'khor lo kun gyi nang du gnas par gyur pa na/ chung dza'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du gyur ro/ /rim pa de nyid nas brtsams te/rang nyid sku'i he ru ka sngo dmar dkar ba'i mdog can/ gsung gi 'khor lo sku'i 'khor lo'i gnas su song / 'khor lo thams cad kyi nang du sku 'khor song bas sku'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /tshul de nyid lan bcu gcig tu bskor bas/ rdo rje 'khor lo nang du 'ong gi bar skor nas/ slar yang rang nyid mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nyid du bo sgom par bya'o/ /'dis ni me tog gang la lhung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa yang bstan pa yin zhing / de'i rjes lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi sne la dkyil 'khor lha'i 'khor lo spros pas don gnyis byas te/ slar bsdu ba yang yang sgom pa ni las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas/ snying ga'i sa bon dang phyag mtshan las 'od zer spro bsdu'i rim pas/ thig le'i dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor/ de yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus thig ler zhu ste rdo rje nor bur 'ongs pa phyag mtshan du gyur/ de'i lte bar dkyil 'khor sgoms pa'i gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag —157—

gsal bar bsam/ de la sems brtan pa thob pa'i tshe/ phra mo'i sa bon de'i 'od zer gyis drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' dag sa bon de'i nang du bsdu ba yang yang bsgom pas rtags lnga mthar phyin par 'gyur bar bshad de/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de la las rgyal mchog dang phra thig gi rnal 'byor de dag mngon rtogs kyi ngag 'don la nam du yang mi dgos shing / 'dod pa'i dngos grub mchog sgrub pa la spyir nges par dgos pa'i gal po che yin yang / las dang po pas de dag go yul tsam ma gtogs yongs rdzogs sgom par mi spyod cing yi ge mang par 'gyur ba'i phyir rgyas par ma smos so/ /de dag nang nas gtso bo yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi dga' bzhi'i don sgoms shing /dkyil 'khor spro bsdus mos pa tsam byed pa'i las rgyal mchog de tsam sgom dgos te/ gzhan du na mngon rtogs kyi yan lag chad par 'gyur bas so/ /de nyid la thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor yang tshang bar rgyud kyi mthar thugs 'ga' zhig las gsung shing / gong du smos pa'i phra thig de dag ni gsang 'dus kyi man ngag las blang ba yin pas skabs 'di'i dkyus la ma bsgoms kyang lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyis yan lag chad par ni mi 'gro bar mngon la/ gal te las dang po pas bsgom na/ snying ga dang gsang ba'i thig le tsam la sems gzung zhing / de'i nang gi dkyil gyi 'khor lo ni mos pa tsam gyis chog go /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags bzla bar bya ste/ yab yum gyi snying po dang / nye ba'i snying po ni/ gong du dril bu lus dkyil gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar te/ lha dril sogs dang 'dra la/ yum gyi 'phreng ba'i sngags rtsa sngags su grags pa ni/ ྅ yi pa'i man ngag gi lag len dang mthun te rgyud rgyal 'dir sngags btu yang gsungs so/ /yab kyi 'phreng ba'i sngags rtsa sngags su grags pa ni/ 8de na ma4gle badz+ra ḍā ka mahā bī ra bī re shwa rā ༵nga/ ༵ lja hūṃ ya/shrī rno / ༵ /mā ༵ tsho'i bha ra sni rna ྅ ༵ ༵/ ko rnyi ༵/hūṃ ldi sa ya ha/ phyu ༵ ༵ rnyi/ —158—

ḍa ji ya/ pa ra shu pa sho du ta hūṃ lwa/ ka lha n+ta dhū mru gra wa byu khri ya/ bi ka ṭa mu kha hā hā rā bā ya/ mu ༷ ga ṇa pa ri pū ri ta man+t+ra ya/ sa ha dza sun+da rī bal+la bha ka rā ya/huX hūX kā ro stso ra ṇa mu 'a ya/ mahā shā sha na pri yā ya/ sarba bhū ta saX tru sa na ka rā ya/mahā kanywan+t+ra sni te dzā ya/ dza ṭa ka lā pa mu ku ṭā ya/ kha ṭāX ga ka pā la shu la lhi sno dha ri ṇi/ mahā sa mu dra me kha lwa ya/ byā gh+ra tsi rmāX ba ra dh+wa ri ṇi/ be tā la saX lha ma dhe ṇa ka rā ya/ mahā ca ni bā ri ṇi/ sha tru ni nga na ka rā ya/ tri sa ha sra mahā si ha sre ka ro mā ba myun+ta warti ṇi/ sha ta sa ha sra mu 'a ya/ dz+nyā na sma ga ra pra bhā ya/ mahā bi shi ta ru dhi ra ba swāhā ri ṇi/ sarba mā ra ba la bi dharmi ne/ shi spyi saX hā ra ka ra kā ya/sarba nā gā nāX sho ṣa ṇa zi na bi dra ba ṇa ya/ an+t+ra ma la dh+wa ri ṇi/ su me ru ka spri ta na dā ya/ kro dha bi gra ha dh+wa ra ṇa ya/ mahā sha ti la ka t+pa ne/ bzhi ko ṭi sa ha sra k+ṣa ṇa ni spyi da nā ya/ dz+nyā na mṛ ta kwa r+ṣa pa ṇa ya/ sarba karma pra warta nā ya/ ban+ta ka rā ya/sarba bi kalpa bhañja na ka rā ya/ muṇ+ḍa ba lī lasna sha rī rā ya/ pa ra kri ta yan+t+ra man+t+ra nā sha nā ya/ mahā rak+ṣa ka rā ya/ dus naX bi dā la ne/ dharmo da ya ka rā ya/ kro dha spyi ra khyu ra ṇa ya/ in+t+ra dzā la sarba sa tat+pa ne/ gra sta bā pra bā da mahā ma te/ oX a ka ā kha i ga yī gha u da mū tsa ṛ tsha grwa dza '-i dzha lī nya e ṭa i ṭha o ṭa au lha aX ṇa aXta/ aXtha aX da auX dha oX na/ blo pa e pha ā+oṃ ba lo bho rā ma ṛ ya mūX ra uX la yī wa i sha aX ṣa āX sa aXha āXk+ṣa haX ka kā kha ji ga gā gha ghā nga ngu / tsa tsā tsha tshwa dza dzā dzha dz+nyā nya nywa/ ṭa khyu ṭha khyu ḍa ḍā khyu bhā ṇa ṇa/ ta tā tha thā da dā dha dh+wa na nā/ pa pāX phaX pā ba bā bha bhā ma mā/ ya yā ra rā la lā wa wā/ sha shā ṣa khri sa sā ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣa/ k+ṣa nywar+shahaX hāX saX sāX ṣa khriX shaX shāX waX wāX laX lāX raX rāX yaX yāX/ maX māX bhaX ra baX bāX phaX pāX paX pāX/ naX nāX —159—

dhaX bhāX daX dāX thaX thāX taX tāX/ ṇaX ṇaX bhaX bhāX ḍaX ḍāX ṭhaX khyuX ṭaX ṭāX/ nyaX nywaX dzhai dz+nyā dzaX dzāX tsho tshwaX rtsa tsāX/ ngaX nguX ghaX ghāX gaX gāX khaX jiX kaX kāX/ ka tsa kha tsha ga dza gha dzha nga nya/ ka ṭa kha ṭha ga ḍa gha lha nga ṇa/ ka ta kha ta thaX ga da gha dha nga na/ ka pa kha pha ga ba gha bha nga ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa aX.a/ ka ha ka ha/ ka sa ka sa/ ka ṣa ka lda ka sha ka sha ka wa ka wa/ka la ka la/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ya ka ya/ ka ma ka myo/ ka bha ka bha/ ka ba ka ba/ ka pha ka pha/ ka pa ka pa/ ka na ka na/ ka dha ka dha/ sna ka da ka da/ ka tha ka tha/ ka ta ka ta/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ka bha ka bha/ ka ḍa ka ḍa/ ka ṭha ka ṭha/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka nya ka nya/ka dzha ka dzha/ ka dza ka dza/ ka tsha ka tsha/ ka tsa ka tsa/ ka nga ka nga / ka gha ka gha/ ka ga ka ga ka kha ka kha/ ku hu ku hu/ ku su ku su/ ku khu ku khu ku shu ku shu/ ku wu ku wu/ ku lu ku lu/ ku ru ku sa ku yu ku yu/ ku mu ku mu/ ku bhu ku bhu/ ku bu ku bu/ ku phu ku phu/ ku pu ku pu/ ku nu ku nu/ ku dhu ku dhu/ ku du ku du/ ku thu ku thu/ku tu ku tu/ ku ṇa ku ṇa/ ku khyu ku khyu/ ku ḍū ku khyu/ ku thu ku thu/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ku nyu ku nyu/ ku dz+nya ku dz+nyā/ ku dzu ku dzha ku tshu ku tshu/ ku tsu ku tsu/ ku du ku du/ ku ghu ku khyu/ku gu ku gu/ ku khu ku khu/ bsgyu ya bsgyu ya/ ban+ta pā ya ban+ta pā ya/ ga rdzogasgru/ga rdzo ya ga rdzo ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ spro ṭa ya spro ṭa ya/ bi dh+waX sa ya bi dh+waX sa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ tru sa ya bhā sa ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kaX bā wa ya kaX bā wa ya/ du ra du ra/ khu ra khu ra/ bha ra bha ra/ dza ra dza ra/ bi sha bi sha /hūX huX huX huX/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhañja bhalpa marda ya mdo ya/ hre hre/ tsa la tsa la mā tsa la mā tsa la/ kru ra tse tā ya phaṭa/ sha tu ni bā ra ya hūX/ me gha ni wā ra ya hri/ mo tsa rnga 4 mo tsa ya/ nga ya stam+bha ya/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ du rlas pa ya du rlas pa ya/ lhulhun tra mā —160—

lwa ba la bi ne/ khe tsa rā ya hūX/ bhu tsa rā ya āX pā tā la tsa rā ya oX/ dza la tsa rā ya baX/ s+tha la tsa rā ya laX/ sarba ta ni bā sa ni hūX/ nā gā nāX sa lta pā tā la ga ta gro hā ra dz+nyā gro hā ra dz+nyāX/ dzhai dzhai/ dzhai dzhai/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku sa kha ra kha ra/ khu ru khu sa ga ra ga ra/ gu ru gu sa gha ra gha ra/ ghu ru ghu sa nga ra nga ra / ngu ru ngu sa tsa ra tsa ra/ tsu ru tsu sa tsha ra tsha ra/ tshu ru tshu sa dza ra dza ra/ dzu ru dzu sa dzha ra dzha ra/dz+nyā ru dz+nya sa nya ra nya ra/ nyu ru nyu sa ṭa ra ṭa ra/ ṭu ru ṭu mā ṭha ra ṭha ra/ thu ru shu sa ḍa ra ḍa ra/ khyu ru ḍū sa lha ra bha ra/ lhu ru hu sa ṇa ra ṇa ra/ ṇa ru ṇa sa ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu sa tha ra tha ra/ thu ru thu sa da ra da ra/ du ru du sa dha ra dha ra/dhu dra dh+wa sa na ra na ra/ nu ru nu sa pa ra pa ra/ pu ru pu sa pha ra pha ra/ phu ru phu sa ba ra ba ra/ bu ru bu sa bha ra bha ra/ bhu ru bhu sa ma ra ma ra/ mu ru mu saya ra ya ra/ yu ru yu sa ra ra ra ra/ ru ru ru sa la ra la ra/ lu ru lu sa wa ra wa ra/ wu ru wu sa sha ra sha ra/ shu ru shu sa ṣa ra ṣa ra/ khu ru khu sa sar sa ra/su ru su saX ha ra ha ra/ hu ru hu sa k+ṣa ra k+ṣa ra/ khri ru khri sa haX hāX/ ho nywa/ huX hūX/ho lha/ hoX ho/ lha haX gar+bha karnya/ dzā ti dzā ti/ de wā nāX/ dā ma ya dā ma ya/ sarba sha rī rā ya hūX/ dza ya dza ya huX/ bi dza ya bi dza ya huX/ sa ra sa ra huX/ bi sa ra bi ra sa hūX/ 'a ye skyoX/ ba ru ṇi skyoX/ a na lā ya hūX/ bā ya we hūX/ ā kā shā ya skyoX/ sarba ro go ba ha rā ya huX/ bi ṣabhak+ṣa ṇa ya huX/ yan+t+ra bā ha nā ya hūX/ kā lā gha ye hūX/ de bā ya huX/ ya mā ya huX/ ku be rā ya hūX/ de t+yā ye hūX/ in+da ya huX/ bhū tā ya huX/ sarba sa tā ya skyoX/ brta tsa grwa ya skyoX/ dharma dh+wa ta we skyoX/ mu ji ya skyoX/ ne tru ya hūX/ ka pā la mā li ne huX/ bhu dzā ya huX/ a sta ya huX/ tsa ra ṇa ya huX/ dza ṭā mu ku ṭā ya/ ma sa ma sa ga —161—

sa ga sa/ ra sa ra sa/ bha ra bha ra/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ muñca muñca sto rngan dha kā ra bri yā ya/ phi h+pha/ phu da phu da/ ma ra ma ra/ pa ra mur+sha rū pi ṇi/ shān+ti ka rā ya/ dzag ba ra ḍa nā ya/ lo ka pā la rū pi ṇi/ sarba sha rī ra rā pā ya/ brik+ṣa gu smo la tā ya/ sa spa rū bī ṇi/ sarba bstu ne mā ra ṇa ya/ rū pā ya/ bha nywa ya/ bha k+ṣa ṇa rū pā ya/ ni ro pā mā ya/ ni ro pā ma mu kha be/ ha sa ha sa/ bi lwa sa bi lwa sa/ snu t+yā ba ya sgro t+yā pa ya/ rdisnru ya yo gā ya/ niXsu bhā wa ma hwa t+pa ne/ shwa sta ṅgā ra ṇi wa ra ṇa ya/ nā nā bhi tsa ru da ne/ tsusba tsusba/ hu lu hu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ huX ha huX hā/ hūX hi hūX hi/ hūX hu hūX hu/ hūX he snyiX hai/ huX ho huX ho/ huX haX hūX rnyaX huX hūX/hri lha/rju rdzu/ kroX kro/ phi phri/ phuX phyuX/ phe h+pha/ phoX pho/ phaX phuX/ phaXphaX ku tsa ku tsa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ma ḍa ma ḍa/ ra ṭha ra ṭha/ da ṭha da ṭha/ dza ṭha dza ṭha/ ma da na ma da na/ hūX huX hūX huX/ hūX huX huX huX/ hūX huX huX huX/ huX huX huX phos ṭa swāhā/ zhes pa yab kyi rtsa ba'i sngags 'di nyid dang /yum gyi rtsa ba'i sngags te/ bzlas bya'i gtso bo ni 'di gnyis yin la/ de tsam bzla ba mi lcogs na rtsa sngags gnyis po tshar gcig bton nas/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gang mos pa zhig bzla bar bya'o/ /'khor gyi sngags rnams ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs bzla mi dgos la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu dgos mod kyi g.yin du bri bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad dam mawo brgya gang wo gis bstod/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol gyi me'i rwa ba nas brtsams bdag nyid kyi bar du phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la thim/ rang nyid kyang snying ga'i hūX ljang sngon la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te nā da yang dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las bdag dpal —162—

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ bar 'dir gtor ma gtong bar bshad kyang / da lta lag len du mi bde bas mi mdzad la/ de nas dag pa dran pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa/ /dkyil 'khor pa dang gtso bo'o/ /khrag 'thung gnyis med dngos po sa /'di gsum gyi ni khams gsum mo/ /thams cad thig le'i gzugs bdag nyid/ /bden pa gnyis su gzung ba med/ /yod pa gzugs med bdag nyid de/ /rtog pa tsam du khyab bdag che/ /spyin pa kun rdzob gzugs bdag nyid/ /pha rol yang ni don dam pa'o/ /dang po'i sbyor ba de'i 'grub bo/ /tshul khrims bsnyen pa sogs su 'dod/ /phar phyin rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang / /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /bzod pa tshangs par spyod pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'byin pa yang ni de/ /rgyal po bde ba kun la gnas/ /mchog ni rang gis pha rol phyin/ /brtson 'grus dga' chen thams cad las/ /mdog dang bzhugs tshul bdag nyid kyis/ /pha rol phyin rnams rang bzhin du/ /ye shes rnam par kun tu 'gyur/ /ye shes sems sogs bsam gtan te/ /phar phyin 'od zer spro ba'o/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dang dbang bskur/ /shes rab las kyi rgyal po mchog /rang rang mgo bor rigs kyis ni/ /rgyas btab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /stobs ni snying rje'i dpa' bo ste/ /stong pa nyid ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pha rol phyin ma gnyis med kun/ /g.yon par zhugs skyes gang bde ba/ /thabs ni thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ /pha rol phyin pa theg pa che/ /smon lam sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs/ /phar phyin phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /phag mo dang ni bsres pa las/ /bsdu ba —163—

pha rol phyin pa ste/ /'jig rten khams kyi rnam dag pa'o/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das gzugs bdag /sgyu ma snying rje las byung ba'o/ /thams cad bden min brdzun min pa'o/ /skye min mi skye min spangs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam par dza ya phya nā'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las bshad do/ /thun bzhi'am thun tha ma'i thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong zhing / gzhan yang bza' ba'i rnal 'byor dang / spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang / nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang nan tan du bya dgos te/ de dag gi rim pa ni spyi dang 'dra la/ dag dran gyi rjes su spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ gong du bshad pa bzhin lus kyi phyi'i go cha rnams bkod nas snang ba thams cad lhar mos bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga la/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni dril bu lus dkyil gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ rdzas rnams bskyed pa'i skabs/shar du bi dkar po las dri chen bis mtshan pa/ byang du mu ljang khu las dri chu mus mtshan pa/ nub tu ma dmar po las sha chen mas mtshan pa/ lhor rwa ser po las rang byung ras mtshan pa/ dbus su a dkar po las byang sems as mtshan pa/ mer go dkar po las ba lang gi sha gos mtshan pa/ srin por ku sngon po las khyi sha kus mtshan pa/ rlung du da dmar po las glang po'i sha das mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du ha ljang khu las rta sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su na sngon po las sha chen nas mtshan pa/ zhes 'don pa spo ba ni dza ya gya na'i khyad par gyi 'dod pa yin zhing 'gal ba med la thog ma kha ṭa ga bskyed nas de rjes rdzas bcu bzhu ba dza ya gya na'i gzhung la snang yang / tshad ldan rnams dang ni mthun par go rim 'khrugs pa dang yi ge gsum las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs spro bsdu byed pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs su bsams nas ched kyis bcos —164—

par snang yang / lha thams cad rdo rje gsum du 'du bas 'chos mi dgos shing / de skabs thun mong ma yin pas khyad chos de don la gnas na/ yi ge yang bcu gnyis dgos pa la yi ge gsum las mi snang ba'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /des na gtor ma byin rlabs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par g.yin mi dgos se/ /de nas mgron spyan drangs shing gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam pa thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil ge nar chen po phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bskor zhing / phaṭa/ces brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi chos 'byung gi nang du/ pad+ma'i gdan la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang dag par bzhugs shing / phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa phyi rol tu 'khod par gyur/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs de rnams skad cig gi 'od gsal du bcug nas/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rig ma bcu drug lha mo brgyad rnams kyis mchod/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma dbus su hū/ nyi zla hu dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa rdo rje thal mor gyur/ o a no n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra pri ni sarba dharma a tu dha a nu pra pre ni sarba dharmā hū/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / nas rgyur gyur cig mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ o badz+ra a ra snyi hodza hu ba ho badz+ra ḍā ka ni sa mā ya stu/ dri khyo ho zhes pa lan gsum dang / o bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo gi shwa re hu hru dza khyu hā/ zhes pa lan lngas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams la phul/o badz+ra ta myu lā ya swāhā/ o badz+ra was gya swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi dang na bza' phul/ gong —165—

bzhin zhabs bsil kyang phul/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang / rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa: zhes pa nas/ bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /gyi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ de nas 'jig rten pa rnams la 'bul ba ni/rdo rje thal mo gyen du kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta/pi sha tsa un ma da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki rgyu da ya/ i maX bā li griṇ+ḍa skye sa ma ya rak+ta skye/ ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra ya:tshu/ a thi baX/ ya the niX/ bhañja tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sa phyi khaX/ bi bri dha/ sa ha yi ka bha ka hūX huX phaṭa swāhāX/ lan gsumaX gyis phul/ zhiXng skyong rnams la khyad par gyi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ka skaX khyu naX/ba bān+ta na/ dzi da na/ sarba du ni/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ ma ma ka rla ku ru huX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ ha hoXhi swāhā/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas bsto da cing 'dod don gsol ba bto/ dril bu rgyun dkrol du byed cing / 'gro ba kun ni mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas gyis/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ kham bu sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol bar byos/ /a re gang gi don dam la ni ma bsgoms pas/ /de yi sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin no/ /a re nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par shes par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ de nas yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ mig gi phyag rgya bstan la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba lte bar 'phyud rgya byas pa'i mthar se gol gtogs te/—166—

o badz+ra mu dkyil 'khore pa bdag gi smin mtshams su thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su spru/skegs/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis smon lam gdab par bshad pa ni/ tshogs dang gtor ma lhan cig tu byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba dang ma 'brel bar/ gtor ma rkyang pa la ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med par/ sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yin/ /lam de nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor ra gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par bgyi/ /zhes sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab cing / bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyang blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni rgyun gyi nyams len gyi gtor chog ste/bsdus pa yin zhing / 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma dang / phyogs skyong gi gtor ma chen po dang /zhing skyong gi gtor ma rnams ni/ lha'i bskyed chog shin tu rgyas pas 'dir ma bris te gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ /'di las dge ba gang thob pa/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag kyang de ring phan chad du/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa nyid du shog /de la dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs shin tu mang po rnams phal cher tshig tshogs che ba lhur blangs pas/ phan thogs chung bar mthong zhing / tshigs bcad du sdebs pas sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'ga' zung yang snang mod kyi/ go dka' zhing ngag 'don dang sgom don gyi dbye ba phyed dka' ba dang / yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig la dgos pas don chad pa yang snang bas/ 'dir nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ zhes pa'i tshul du byas pa yin la/ 'di la rgyud 'grel gyi don lag len du sdebs pa'i gzhung ni/ bar skabs su byung ba'i bal po'i nga/khri ta dza ya phya nas mdzad pa 'di rnams las gzhan —167—

med la/ 'di la'ang 'di nyid kyi rgyud chen po'i dgongs par ma song ngam snyams pa dang / bde mchog gi slob dpon tshad ldan rnams kyi bzhed dgongs dang mi mthun pa ci rigs yod par mngon mod/ re zhig dgongs 'grel rten so gzhan med pa'i phyir/ 'dir phal cher dza ya phya na'i/ gzhung nyid gtso bor byas te bshad pa yin no/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs te bcu gsum pa'o// //༈ na mo gu sa na mo badz+ra yo gi ce/ ba yig bde chen rtag 'char ba'i/ /e yig stong chen klong yangs la/ /gus pas bstud de de'i sgrub thabs/ /brtse bas man ngag ji bzhin bshad/ /'dir mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'gyung ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag gdong ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i tshul ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dang spyi ni 'dra'o/ /'on kyang khyad par ni/ rang gi snying gar ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hi ser po/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid phag mo phyag gnyis par gyur nas/ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa/ zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ lha rnams kyi nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / phyi rol bsrung 'khor sna tshogs rdo rje rwa ba dang / me ri'i phyi rol du dur khrod dang / de'i mtha' bskor gri gug dang / mi mgo dang lag pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba dang / bde chen 'khor lo la rin chen phreng ba/ sgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /de'i rjes su bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma zla ba dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a ā: nas zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de gnyis kyi bar du sdi las rdo rje hi yis mtshan pa nas dbus su dpal rdo rje phag mo phag gdong mar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ser la dmar ba'i mdangs/ /cung zad sbom thung cher khros shing / /'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad 'jigs su rung / /mi zad zhal ni sum cu drug /bzhi lhag bdun cu gnyis kyi —168—

phyag /zhabs ni bco brgyad g.yon bskum zhing / g.yas brkyang pa yi tshul gyis bzhugs/ /gcer bu ba sbu'i 'phreng ba can/ /'dod chags chen po'i bde bas myong / /bha ga nu ma mtho zhing rgyas//rtsa ba'i zhal gyis g.yas g.yon du/ /pha 'jigs zhal ni dgu dgu'o/ /de steng bdun dang slar yang bdun/ /de ste rna yang zhal gsum mo/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni phag gdong 'jigs/ khyi dang ce spyang byi la stag /seng ge 'jigs byed tsodi snyug 'dra ba zhig〉glang chen rta/ /bong gdong g.yas la rim pas so/ /g.yon du ba glang ma he dang / /spyang ku rus sbal bu shin dang / /ri bong bse dang g.yag mu lja /steng du sprul dang sre mong dang / /rtsangs pa sram dang byi ba dom/ /dbus su mkha' lding gdong ste bdun/ /de steng bya rgod bya rog dang / /wa pa bya dkar bong khra dang / /srin bya ngur pa'i gdong ste bdun/ /kun gyi steng ma'i dbus rma bya/ /g.yas g.yon phug ron khyim bya'i gdong / /thams cad spyan gsum ldan pa la/ /rang rang kha dog 'jigs pa che/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang / /dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin/ /mi snang rang gi thabs dang sbyor/ /g.yas pa'i lhag ma rim pa bzhin/ /ral gri mdung ring tri shu la/ /dgra sta gri gug mda' gsal shing / /tho ba 'khor lo cang te'u dang / /chu gri dbyug gu mtshon rtse gcig /dung dang zangs dung dbyug gu gsum/ /rma bya'i mjug ma bya rog sgro/ /ro skra'i pir dang me thab ri/ /dbyug to me long pi waX dang / /rkang lag glo ba rgyu ma dang / /sgra gcan lcags sgrog gdos dang skogs/ /nya rgya dang ni mgo med lus/ /'bar ba'i mar nag 'jigs byed gzugs/ /g.yon pa'i lhag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /phub —169—

zlum mche ba gtun shing zhags pa dang / /thod pa gzhu dang kha ṭāX ga /po ti phub chung yu ba can/ /sdigs mdzub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang / /lug rgyud brag dang dur khrod rdul/ /mdung thung rnga dang pags rlon dang / /lan bu bsregs shing gang da'i dbyug /phub reng mgo bo keng rus dang / /zor ba mig dang mkhal ma bzhag /spen pa phur bu bi dza pur/ /sog le khab dang rlud bu bshus/ /myong sprin shing sdong lcags kyu bsnams/ /tha ma glang chen pags rlone rgyangs/ /zhabs rnams brkyang bskum dor stabs kyis/ /g.yas pas khyab 'jug drag po dang / /tshangs pa nyi ma me dang ni/ /dbang po rlung dang bden bral dang / gnod sbyin ji ltar rim pas so/ /g.yon pas gzhin rje 'dod lha dang / /zla ba chu lha nor rgyas dang / /sa dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /smin drug bu dang 'khor bsgyur rnams/ /gnon zhing 'jigs par mdzad pa yin/ /zhal kun thod pa'i cod pan can/ /mgo bo'i 'phreng ba'i do shal byas/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rnam par brgyan/ /rkang gdub rdo rje 'phreng bas mdzes/ /dbu skra grol zhing me dpung 'bar/ /gar gyi nyams ldan sdang ba dang / /gdug pa thams cad 'joms mdzad ma'o/ /skabs 'dir rgyud gsum pa'i 'gyur gyi dpe na/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dri shul chad/ /g.yon gyi phyag mtshan la spen pa yi ni phur bu dang zhes gcig tu byas pa shin tu nor/ ga da'i tsha ba brag ri dang / /ga dzin shing dod du tho ba dang / /lcags kyu'i gnas su ral gri byung ba rnams zlos pa ste rgya dpe ma dag pa'am/ 'gyur skyon no/ /yang 'di phyag bdun cu rtsa bzhin byed na tha ma gnyis spangs pa yin yang zhal gyi 'god tshul rim pa gsum du bsdu ba'ang cung zad mi legs yang glang lpags bor ba kho nas phyag don gnyis yin na/ g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan sum cu so bdun yod don —170—

med pas phyag don gnyis dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs 'dra bar rig go /'dab ma rnams la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu sogs spyi dang mthun pa'am/ yang na/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma/ g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba/ byang du lwa ma g.yon ljang g.yas dmar ba/ nub tu dum skyes ma g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba/ lhor gzugs can ma g.yon ser g.yas nag pa/mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum mo/ /byang phyogs dza lan+ta rar ma hā kaX ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /dpa' po thams cad phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/dpa' mo thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gtso mo dang mtshungs shing g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa ste shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /shar sgor kha gdong ma sngon mo: nas byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba'i bar spyi dang mtshungs ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang / phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug po thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs shing / ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po:nas bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud —171—

pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid gyis dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ zhes pa nas dag pa dran pa rdzogs kyi bar du 'dra ba las/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rdo rje phag mo'o/ /zhes 'don pa sgyur brgyud rim ni bde mchog drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa dang 'dra'o/ /skabs 'dir rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ci nus su sgoms la/bzlas pa la mos na/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags nyid gtso bor bzla zhing / snying po dang nye ba'i snying po nyid kyang ngo / /mdun du srin po dang bcas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bsgom ste/ skye( phaṭa che ge bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa k+ṣa phaṭa/ ces bzlas palodrag shul bsgrub bo/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ gzhan rnams bde mchog drag po chen po'i mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i hū zhes pa la/ snying ga'i hi zhes 'don pa spo/ gtor ma'i chog mdor bsdus pa'i tshe sdom 'byung dang 'dra ba las/ rgyas pa la spro na dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chen bya'o/ /ma rung 'joms shing sgrub po la/ /mtha' dag bde ba'i mchog ster bar/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di sgom pa las/ /lta stangs brgyad po 'grub ces thos/ /rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo'i sgrub thabs te bcu bzhi pa'o// //༈ oṃ su sti/ he yig rol pa ru brjod bral/ /ka yi byed pa shrī yig ni/ /zung 'ju ga ye shes skur gyur pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /da ni rgyud rtsa bshad kyi khog sdebs pa man ngag gtso bor gyur pa gsum las/ dang po rtsa rgyud las dngos su mi gsal yang / bshad rgyud sna tshogs khog sdebs pas rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs par 'gyur ba/ grub pa'i slob dpon dril bu pas dbang po dman pa la dgongs te mdzad pa'o/ /'dir lwa ba bcu gsum mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs bshad zin pa las 'don pa spos te/ dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga sgom par 'dod na/ nga de sems bsgom bzlas —172—

yan chad 'dra/ shrī he ru ko3 ha/ lko a ā: nas ha k+ṣa hū phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying gar ra las: nas/ dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo drug gis mchod par gyur/ o ā badz+ra a da rnye skyo/ bī ni ga rnye:rā se sparnye oṃ ā badz+ra dharme hu/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi bdud rtsi mchod par bsam la/ tse( ā hū/ zhes brjod/ tse( ā badz+ra ma hā su kha nas/ 'jig byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad gyi phyogs bzhir mi ro'i snying gar zla ba/ mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum thod/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i mu khyud la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol wo pa nas/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing kha/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ steng zhal ljang ba zhal rnam par 'gyur ba spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa 'dzin zhing rlud gis 'phyar ba/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭa ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje —173—

dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'byud cing / g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis yab la 'byud pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga'i brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma la hūX/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ snying gar oṃ/ ha dkar po: nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kwa'i ngo bo zhes pa'i bar spyi dang mthun/shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing / mi ma sto do shal can/g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ kha cig gtso 'khor rnams g.yas brkyang ba'i brkyang bskum stabs su 'dod pa ni mun sprul lo/ /lus rjes su dran pa nye bar ba 'ag pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni/ la ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa —174—
