nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dran sogs byang chub yan lag drug phag mo'o/ /yang dag spong ba dang /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang dad sogs bcu 'phags lam rnams ni bum pa bzhi'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ yum la mi bskyod pa/ lha mo bzhi la ni rim pas/ rtag pa/ don grub/ 'od dpag med/rin 'byung rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar lha mo drug dang / mahā su kha gyi bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru ka ā hu hu phaṭa swāhā nas/ ha ho hri rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /dril bu lwa ba 'bar 'dzin dang / /spyod pa ba dang dge ba'i mgon/ /ti li na ro pha thing pa/ /bha dan+ta pa mar do dang / /bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan zhabs/ /lho tshad dbang phyug brtson 'grus dang / /'phags pa lo mchog grags chen pa/ /'phags 'od bu ston khyung lhas pa/ /nor bzang ka bzhi rin rgyal dang / /mkhyen rab chos rje lha bo pa/ /mkhas pa kun dga' don grub dang / /bsod nams dpal 'byor byang gling pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ /o ā hū/ yang pu rangs lo chung nas brgyud pa ltar na/ bha dan+ta pa lo chung dang / /sa chen bsod rtse grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa pan bo dong rin po che/ /sems dpa' che dang yang rtse ba/ /bu ston rje dang khyung lhas pa/ /man chad gong bzhin/ rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lha rnams mchod/ gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i bar du sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dra ba las/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hū hu phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hu hū phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hū hu phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hū hū phaṭa/ ces pa ni 'khor gyi sngags so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/rang gi snying ga'i zhes sogs dang / gtor ma'i cho ga dang / lā ba bcu gsum ma bzhin du —175—

bya'o/ /dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs 'grel du/ lwa ba'i zhabs kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sgrub thabs gtsug gi nor bus mdzad par grags te/ yan lag phra mo 'ga' zhig smu/ gtogs/ cho ga'i sgros gcig pa yin pas/ 'dir yang bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la 'don pa spos pas/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dag cing gtsang bar 'gyung ngo / /mchog tu ngo mtshar gyi bskyed pa'i gzhung / mkhas pa kun la cher grags kyang / /gzhan 'gas ming yang ma thos pa/ /de don rtogs par bsla kyi ra sbyar/ /dril bu lha lnga'i sgrubs thabs ste bco lnga pa'o// //༈ gdul dka' 'dul ba gang gis mtshan tsam zhig /dran pa'i mod la phun tshogs kun thob pa/ /rdo rje khro rgyal tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /bdud bzhi g.yul ngo ma lus bzlog par mdzod/ /'dir 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rim pas/ khro bo rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod na/ thog mar dpal 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi mngon rtogs legs par byang bar bslab bo/ /de nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'di dag bslabs pas tshegs med par shes par 'gyur ro/ /de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ dag pa gsum/ tshogs bsag phung khams byin rlabs/ srung 'khor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ ye shes tshogs bsag bar srid sbyong byed/ 'byung bzhi ri rab/ gzhi dkyil gyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa'i bar du sgom tshul rnams 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi skabs bzhin no/ /de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ sa/zhal yas khang gzhi dkyil gyi dbus su/ slar yang gzhal med khang / gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs dang bral ba/ lhag ma mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ grwa bzhir thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa 'khor lo'i lte bar pa las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la/ pad+ma dang nyi ma/—176—

sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan/ gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam la mi ro'i gdan phyogs bzhir bzhi bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir re re/ sgo mtshams brgyad du yang ro gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyis bar du huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas sa/nyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/g.yon gnyis ka pā la dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ thod pa'i cod pan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can zhi zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis nam mkha'i nā da yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ skar mda' 'pho ba'i tshul gyis yum gyi mkha' nang du son pas/ yab yum byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu/ thig le las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ ho srid pa gsum gyi bde snyed gtso/ /a la la la ho/ rgyal po'i bde chen dgyes pa'i tshogs/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje rol/ /a la la la ho/ phyogs bcu bde gshegs snying po spros/ /kun gyi snying po bdag por mdzad/ /srid pa gsum po'i snying po ni/ /bde ba chen po rtogs par mdzod/ /a la la la ho/bdag po dgyes pa grol bar mdzod/ bde chen a la la la ho/ /zhes bskul/lha mo rnams thig le la thim/ de nyid hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan par gyur/ de'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las yongs su gyur pa ni/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang he ru ka sku —177—

mdog mthing kha/ nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis huX mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcag kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis ka pā la dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /oX bha dharma dh+wa tu swa bha wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ bsnyen pa'o/ /snying gar oṃ ha: sogs go cha gnyis dgod de/ nyer bsgrub bo/ /de nas gnas gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs pa dang ye shes dgug gzhug sgrub pa dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab bsgrub chen rnams bde chen rnams bde mchog ga po gyi cho ga bzhi du bya ste/ dpal rdo rje hūX mdzad bams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i he ru ka/ zhes mtshan brje ba tsam khyad par ro/ /yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ thugs kar huX sngon mo/ lte bar swa ser po/ gsang bar a dmar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ shes rab kyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ thabs kyi gsang ba huX las rdo rje sngon po rtse gcig pa/ gnyis po'i bu gar byāX dang sdiX gis mtshan pa/ oX āXhuX/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras bcas dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa lha gra das dang mnyam pa'i thig ler gyur/ de rnams hūX bcu gcig /maX taX baX laX/ lkoX swā āXhā/phuX rlu phroX phri/ he nyi shu rtsa bzhi dzaXhuX baX ho rnams su gyur/ de rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur/ oṃ nga sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa —178—

thams cad bcom/ sems can thams cad rdo rje'i 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te rang nyid la thim pas/ rang dpal bde mchog khro bo rdo rje sems dpa' khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i skur gyur pa ni/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa/ g.yas zhal gsum dkar sngo ser ba/ g.yon zhal gsum sngo dkar ser ba/ steng gis zhal dmar po/ phyag bcu drug gis dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin zhing thugs kar 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral par 'jog pa/ lhag ma g.yas pas thod pa ral gri/ 'khor lo tho ba/ cang te'u rnams dang / g.yon rnams kyis kha smo ga lcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rin po che/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo lhan cig tu 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis/ mi'i pags pa dang glang po che'i pags pa lhan cig tu sbyar ba stod g.yogs su bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan zhing / yum rdo rje phag mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhal gsum phyag drug pa snga ma lta bus 'khyud pa'o/ /hu lan bcu/ mkha' nang gi khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bcom/ stobs bcu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la bkod/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la 'khod pa ni/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser nag ljang ba/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba/ lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin dud kha dud ser ljang ba/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar ser ljang ba/ rlung du rdo rje stobs —179—

po che nag po nag ser ljang ba/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum ka mi g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyis cang te'u dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po dkar nag ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og nag po nag ser ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu 'dzin pa/khro bo bcu po rnams ni phyogs skyong bcu gnon zhing / rtsa phyag gnyis rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khu/da pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭa ga bsnams pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing mi bzad pa'i gad rgyang drag po sgrog pa/cher khros shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /ma ta pa la oṃ snya ā hā/mkha' nang gi rnal 'byor ma brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ 'byung ba bzhi dang chu bo bzhi sbyangs/ tshad med bzhi dang rnam thar bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te nang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'khod pa ni/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo mer sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar sngo/ bden bral du rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser ljang / rlung du pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser/ dbang ldan du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma khra mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi gri gug dang thod pa/—180—

ḍa ma ru kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ cher khros pa'o/ /phuX phre phroX phri/ nang gi sgo ma bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te sgo bzhir 'khod pa ni/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma rgyal dbang ma dkar mo lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo'i rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang du 'bar byed ma ser mo thal mo spyi bor bzhag pa/ nub tu 'jigs byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lho ru g.yon ldan ma sngon mo gtun shing dang sdigs mdzub can/ thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar po sil bur grol ba'o/ /he/ lan nyi shu rtsa bzhin brjod/ mkha' 'gro ma nyer bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ shes pa bcu dang rnam thar brgyad dang / mngon shes drug la bkod/ slar 'dus te/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha snam rim pa gnyis la 'khod/ de yang shar du/ rta gdong ma dang drag mo'i gdong / /rdo rje sna ma snyan grags ma/ byang du/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug ma de bzhin/ khro gnyer can ma sna tshogs gzugs/ /rdo rje ka ta'i bu mo'o/ /nub tu/ro langs ma dang rdo rje zla/ dri ldan ma dang 'jigs byed zhal/ lho sa rdo rje pho nya rdo rje sen/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma de bzhin/ rdo rje ka spro dza rnams so/ /mtshams rnams la me nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyi/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma dang / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul drag byed ma/ /rdo rje me ltar 'bar ma'o/ /phyi'i grwa bzhi la/ sna tshogs gzugs can gzugs bzang ma/ /rdo rje mchu dang 'od byed ma'o/ /dzaXhūX baX hoXrnal 'byor ma lhag ma bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la bkod/phyi'i sgo bzhir 'khod pa ni/ shar nas brtsams te/ g.yon bskor gyis rdo rje ser skya ma dang ni/ /rdo rje 'bar ma rdo rje 'khyil/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ma rnams —181—

so/ /de la shar phyogs pa rnams dkar ba/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang ba/ nub phyogs pa rnams dang dmar ba/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser ba/ mtshams ma rnams phyed kyi dbang phyugs ma ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol ba/shegs pa dang / lcags kyu dang / kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i zhal gsum pa/ gcer bu rus pa dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ drag mo chen mo dbu skra gyen du 'bar ba/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes kyi lha de rnams grub pa na/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang / ma mo brgyad dang / gza' chen po brgyad dang / zhing skyong bzhi bcu dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa rdo rje'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po tshogs mtha' dag kyang 'khod par gyur/ oṃ āXhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī: sogs/skad cig rnam pa'i sngags brjod pa nas/ dbang bskur ba'am mthar thug pa 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang 'dra ba las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa re res dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaṃ: nas shasta'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang / rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ 'di skabs brgyud pa ni drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa dang 'dra'o/ /a nu rā gas gsang mchod/ he ru ka yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa rnams phul/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ sngags bzla bar bya ste/ de la gtso bo'i sngags ni/ glu rna sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang / u zhi ṣa yang bzla bar bya ba yin la/snying po ni/ oṃ kha badz+ra dhika badz+ra huX ka rā badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /khro bo gsal/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra huX/ de bzhin du thog mar oṃ badz+ra zhes pa dang / mthar badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces pa khro bo —182—

bcu kun la sbyar/ dz+wa la a na lwarka/ urdzi lga kuṇ+ḍa li/ yak+ṣa/ kā lī/ mahā bā la/ bhi ṣa ṇa/ gi zhi ṣa tsa grwa warti rnams dang / oX badz+ra pā tā la badz+ra huX phaṭa kyi bar ro/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ oX shrī ḍā ki ni ḍaX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lwa me laX/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he khaX/ ru bi ni rū kho pa'o/ /de bzhi/ oṃ shrī bud+dhā ḍā ki nī hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ de ltar sbyar te/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ bi shā ḍā ki nī/ lkog so/ /mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi/ thog ma nyer bzhi la/ mtshan sngags kyi dang po oX dang / mthar mar hūX huX phaṭa sbyar ba kho na dang / tha ma bzhi po la mtshan gyi mthar sa bon yang sbyar ro/ /de yang / oX wa ḍa wa mu khri huX hūX phaṭa/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ sgo ri mu khi/ badz+ra gh+ra ṇi/ ya shi sri ni/ tsaṇ+ḍashi kha re/ hri ku ṭi/ bi shwarā pe/ badz+ra ka t+yā ya nī/ badz+ra be+e tā li/ badz+ra sa yi kibadz+ra bhan+ta li/ badz+ra bhi ma lwa da ni/ badz+ra ga ti/ badz+ra na gī badz+ra ko ma rī/ ka spro dzī/bā hu/ rū pe/ su du pe/ badz+ra tu ni/ pra bha ska ri zhes so/ /oX shrī badz+ra piX ka le dzaXhuX hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la huX huX huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kuṇ+ḍi baX hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhi ra we hoXhūX huX phaṭa/ ces rnams so/ /thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang / (dkyil 'khor bya ba dang /1dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu sogs spyi dang 'dra zhing / gtor ma'i cho ga ni 'khrul spong gi sgrub thabs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar las/ ye shes kyi lha la 'bul ba'i spyi sngags song ba'i rjes su lha so so'i snying po'i huX phaṭa gyi gong du/ i maX bā li gro hā gro hā sarba sidha pra ya:sko zhes pa bcug nas/ so sor 'bul bar bya ste/ rma kha badz+ra dhi ka badz+ra hūX ka ra badz+ra i maX bā li gro hā gro hā sarba sirnyi me pra ya : zhu hūX huX phaṭa/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /rgyas par byed na 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams la'ang / de bzhi du spyor ba las/ sarba sirnyi sogs kyi dod du/ ma mā shan+ti rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru huX phaṭa/ zhes pa lta bu rang 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa'i las sngags sbyar ro/ /'dod don —183—

gsol ba'i gzhug tu/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blang bar bya ste/ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis rab tu rmongs pas brten par bya'o/ /bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad ma'i bde/ /a la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mjodi/ /a yī a ā ra li ho/ rab dgyes mgon po'i rab bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba stsol/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsole/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ /'phrin las thams cad ston par mdzode/ /ces so/ /'di la dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang la lha gong bzhin 'god pa dang / khro bo bcu gcig kho na'i dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod na'ang / de dang de'i 'dor len shes par bya'o/ /'di ni mngon brjod bla ma'i le'u yar mar gyi khog don sdebs pa bla ma'i man ngag go/rab zab sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /drag shul sgrub la mchog tu bsngags/ khyud don shes pa rnams la ni/ /dga' bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas byed yin/ /dpal bde mchog khro bo rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs te bcu drug pa'o// //༈ bde chen rdo rje phag mo ni/ /spros bral dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /srid gsum sgyu —184—

ma'i gar mkhan ma/ /de la dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /'dir grub pa'i slob dpon bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'am/ zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brang nas/ rdo rje btsun mo'i sgrub thabs sbor/ par 'dod pas/ spro na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang / lag mchod dang gtor ma rnams sngon du 'gro bar byas te/ rnal 'byor gyi bya ba la 'jug pa yin la/ de tsam ma lcogs na nang mchod byin gyis rlabs te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis mos la/ o sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya waka tsit+ta pra ṇa me ṇa badz+ra ban+ta na ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya/ g.yon pa'i 'theb srin gyis me tog phul la/ tse( mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/dza hū ba spo rab tu grub par mdzod/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig home tog 'bul ba'i gzungs kyis me tog phul kyang rung ngo / /chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga 'bul/ skye rdzo ā badz+ra rdzu ka hū hū bhu a ji / kha hū/ tse( ā hu zhes bla ma la nang ma snar phul/ lha so so'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor pa la nang mchod phul/ cang ta'u la sogs pa'i sgra dang bcas te/yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags dang / ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams zhes sogs kyis sdom pa bzung / yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ tso( ā hu ྅/ zhes mi dmigs par bsam mo de dag ni bsod nams tshogs kyi rim pa'o/ /de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom ste/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /zhes sogs wa shudha dod rje'i sa rdo rdo kau/ bye// ༷/ ༷ ༷ ma dngos stong pa / re med/ lha re nga / pung rdo rgi ga bzu yig dang pho ༷ / lti/skyes spos rdong ba'i bye'i bsru lju —185—

'khor du gyur/ oX me dhi ni badz+ra bha bā: nas/ a na lwarka hūX/ gi bar sngags sno drug brjod/ de'i nang du bhuX las bka'i 'khor lo ser bo rtsibs bcu pa/ der hūX gi sa bon 'ba' zhig las byung ba'i lha rnams te/ 'khor lo'i lte bar khro bo chen po 'jig rten gsum rgyal/ zhal bzhi nag ljang dmar ser ba/ phyag dang po gnyis hūX mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje phag mo phyag gnyis ma la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang gshun shing / gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis kyis dgra stu dang rtse gsum/ drug pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su 'phyar pa dang lhan cig thod khrag dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ rtsibs bcu la shar du khwa gdong ma la gshin rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pas 'byud pa/byang du 'ug gdong ma la bgegs mthar byed ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ nub tu khyi gdong ma la pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ lto ru phag gdong ma la shes rab mthar byed ser po be con 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ lhor gzhin rje brtan ma la 'dod rgyal sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ bden bral du gshin rje pho nya mo dbyug sngon can nag po dbyug pa 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ rlung mtshams su gshin rje mche ba ma la stobs po che dud kha rtse gsum 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ byang shar du/ gshin rje 'joms ma la mi g.yo ba sngo sangs ral gri 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ steng du mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/—186—

'og tu sa spyod ma kha dog sna tshogs pa la gnod 'dzes rgyal po nag po gtun shing 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ khro bo thams cad phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i sprul zhag can/ 'khor rnams shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu rgyan can no/ /phyir bzlog byed na bar 'dir mdzo brjod las byung ba'i urdzi ṣa bzla zhing / phyir bzlog gi dmigs pa dgos pa yin no/ /de nas sum+bha lan gnyis brjod pas/ dur khrod ma brgyad kyis thugs ka nas dur khrod ma brgyad dmar mo/ tho ba phur bu lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa spro ba/ yang su lhas/bka' bsgos pa na bgegs rnams phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par bkug ste/ hūX las byung ba'i 'brub khang bcu'i nang du rdo rje mo'i sa gzhi la bzhag /oṃ gha gha sogs/ phur bus btab/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogs kyis/ tho bas brdung te/bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du thim/ zung ba'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ pho nya mo rnams slar bsdu/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis brtan par byas te/gnas zung ba'o/ /de ltar bsrung ba gsum ni tshul khrims kyi tsho gos so/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ āXni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ āXnī bhi sang ska ra dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ zhes brjod cing sngags don bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs gsag pa'o/ /de dag gis sngon 'gro rdzogs so// //snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang rdo rje phag mor gsal ba la thim/gnas gsum du oṃ āXhūṃ/ rang nyid oṃ la thim de āXl: de huX la: de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus/ nā da yang mi dmigs par bsam mo/ /de ni ཿ bdag byed —187—

do/ /stong pa'i ngang las nā da ho gnyis kyi mtha' brten par nam mkhar gnas/de ni bar do dag byed do/ /skad cig gis 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su sku'i 'khor lo ni dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi khor yug go /de'i nang du pad+ma'i nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa'i gzhi la gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dkar/ lho ser ba ni gsung gi 'khor le'o/ /dbus kyi gzhi dmar po la/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i mu khyud zlum po'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa ni/ thugs kyi 'khor le'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i gdan/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje'i gdan/ sgo mtshams brgyad du pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i gdan/ dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo dkar po dang ro'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du nam mkha'i nā da ho gnyis dang bcas pa zhugs/ de nyid ba ma ta pa la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha hū brgyad dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thams cad zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ dkyil 'khor ra pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo drag mo chen mo nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid 'bar ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po'am gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/—188—

zhabs g.yas bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yon brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ phrag pa g.yon gyi phyogs su nye bar brten pa'i kha ṭāX ga dkar po zung 'jug gi rang bzhin can 'chang ba/ drag mo chen mo mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing / dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba la me tog sil mas mdzes pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ mi snang ba'i thabs dang gnyis su med par 'dus shing / ma lus pa'i sprul pa spro ba dang bsdud ba'i lus can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i byang shar gyi grwar mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ nub byang gi grwar lā ma ljang khu/ lto nub kyi grwar dum skyes ma dkar mo/ shar lho'i grwar gzugs can ma ser mo rnams g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ zur gsum du dga' ba 'khyil ba gsum dang / gru chad gsum la bum pa rnams gnas par gyur/ shar sgor go rī ser mo/ byang sgor tso rī dmar mo/ nub sgor phra mo ha sngon mo/ lhor sgor ro lang ma dkar mo/ shar rdzo grwar puska si khra mo/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍali ljang khu/ nub byang du lha sma ri dud kha/ byang shar du he ru ka'i 'od ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang g.yas kha ṭaX ga 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi gdan rnams la/ shar du kha gdong ma/byang du lug gdong ma/ nub tu khyi gdong ma/ lhor phag gdong ma rnams g.yas ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu shin rje pho nya mo/ nub byang du gnin rje mche ba —189—

ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon mi'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ brgyad po thams cad sku mdog ljang khu'o/ /'khor rnams bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa las zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs can no/ /'dir lha'i rnam pa gdam nga ni/ gtso bo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dmar ljang nag ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag mtshan gzhan rnams lha dril gyis he ru ka dang 'dra ba la/ glang lpags kyi dod bdud kyi pags pa 'dzin pa/ he ru ka nag po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ glang lpags kyi dod du 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pas 'khyud pa'o/ /yang na gtso mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar ba/ zhabs g.yas brgyang gi gar stabs kyi 'jigs dus brtsegs pa mnan pa/ zhal g.yas gnyis sngon po dang ser po/ g.yon gnyis dkar po dang ljang khu ste zhal phag gdong dmar po/phyag dang po gnyis rdor dril pad+ma'i skor bas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dbu thog tu 'jog pa/ gsum pas mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs/ bzhi pas shā ma ru dang / kha ṭī ga lnga pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang thod khrag go /yang phyag mtshan de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ sku mdog phyed gzugs g.yon dkar g.yas dmar ba/ zhal bzhi/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa/ g.yon ljang / rgyab ser/ g.yas sngo ba'o/ /gtso mo zhal drug pa'i skabs/rnal 'byor ma bzhi yang / glang po la sogs pa'i gdong brnyan du bya la/ gtso mo phyed gzugs su byed pa'i tshe/ de dag kyang phyed gzugs su bya zhing / gtso mo phyag mang gi lugs gsum po 'di la sku la phyag drug gis brgyan pa dang / go rī la sogs pa lha mo brgyad kyang mngon brjod bla ma nas 'byung ba bzhin zhal gsum phyag drug par mdzad de rgya gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni skye ba'i srid pa las lus dag byed do/ /rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba la ba yig —190—

dmar po dag go /dam tshig sems dpa' phyag mang sgoms kyang / ye shes pa phyag gnyis par nges so/ /de nas lus dkyil skad cig gis gsal 'debs te/lte bar gzugs can ma dang dga' 'khyil gcig lhag ma 'kho ra lo gsum la/bum pa gsum dang rnal 'byor ma gsum/ gtsug tor tu he ru ka gsang ba'i 'khor lo phyi ma gnyis la dga' 'khyil gnyis/ ze'u 'bru'i 'khor lo la rdo rje phag mo/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la go rī la sogs pa lha mo brgyad/ bu ga brgyad la khwa gdong ma la sogs pa brgyad/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ bde mchog gi lus dkyil spyi dang mthun par 'god pa las/ 'dir shes rab ma rnams gtso bor gyur pa yin zhing / sku mdog kyang / thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma dkar mo la dpa' bo nag po'i 'byud pa/ gsung gi sngon mo la dmar pos 'byud pa dang sku'i dmar mo la ser skyas 'khrud pa/ phyag mtshan nag po dang 'dra ste lus dkyil rgyas pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha bzhi bcu zhe brgyad sgom pa ni 'bring po yin la/ rtsa 'khor lo brgyad kyi lte ba'i lha tsam 'god pa ni bsdus pa yin zhing / dang por snying gar he ru ka dang lte bar rdo rje phag mo bsgoms te/ slar lte bar zhal sbyor du bsam pa ni shin tu bsdus pa'o/ /de dag ni ngag dag par byed pa'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa dang skye mched byin rlabs dang / go cha dgod pa dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / ye shes spyan 'dren dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams phag mo lha so bdun ma'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ phyi dkyil 'khor la gtso mo la rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bo mo nyid kyis dbu rgyan/ lus dkyil la ni rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs mi dgos so/ /de dag ni yid dag —191—

par byed pa'o/ /bar 'dir dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa cung zad bsgom ste ye shes dag par byed pa'o/ /de nas gong bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ nang mchod la bod lugs ltar brgyud pa'i mawo brjod 'dod na/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob ye shes bshes gnyen grub chen zhi ba sbas pa/ slob dpon go pi pa/ slob dpon ni khyu ṇa shrī rnams so/ /de dag ni dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ man ngag spyi dang mtshungs pa las / bzla bya'i sngags kyis gtso bo ni rkang brgyad sngon du 'gro ba'i rtsa sngags nyid yin/ snying po ni yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /nye ba'i snying po ni/ oṃ badz+ra bā ra hi/ a ā/ i sī/ a mū/ e e/tse( skye(/ a a hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /'khor gyi sngags ni so so'i mtshan sngags dang sgo mtshams brgyad la/ kha sbyor nas gsungs pa'i 'phreng sngags bzla bar bshad cing / phyir bzlog ma'i tshe sgrub kyi sngags dang / ye shes 'bebs pa dang / bdud rtsi 'bebs pa'i sngags kyang bzla ste gzhung du blta'o/ /bzlas pa'i rjes su gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom zhing / de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang / thun mtshams la 'jug tshul ni/ spyi dang 'dra zhing /gtor ma'i cho ga yang 'khrul spong gis skabs su bshad pa bzhin 'don pa spos pa ste/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ 'jig rten 'das gtor skabs lha so so'i snying po'i sngags la/ i ma bā li grihā gro hā ma ma sarba ka rla tsho dha ya zhes pa spel nas 'bul lo/ /'di ni phag mo'i rtog pa nyung ngu gcig dang / rtsa bshad kyi khog sdebs nas grub chen zhi bas mdzad pa'i man ngag go /dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /spyo da dang grol ba'i 'bras rtsol ba/ khren tu rnyed dka' tshegs med pa/ /lag tu 'ong ba'ang skal pa bzang / /rdo rje phag mo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs te bcu rngog dun pa'o// //—192—

༈ oṃ na mo badz+ra sa twa ya/ dpal ldan lhan skyes bde ba yis/ /'od kyis zhing kun rab bkang nas/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /de yi sgrub thabs rmad byung ni/ kha spyor thig le las gsungs bzhin/ /'dus gsal go bder brjod bgyi bas/ /'di las dge mtshan ci yang spel/ /da ni 'dir dpal kha spyor thig le'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bde mchog zhi ba rdor sems sam/ rdo rje dbyings sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du btang / nang mchod byin gyis rlabs/ spro na gtor chog gis gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ de tsam ma lcogs na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / tso rna ā hu/ zhes brjod pa'i bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dran par byas la/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems par gyur/ snying gar a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hu gi 'od zer gyis/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza hū las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ o ldi ni badz+re ṇi hu hū phaṭa/ ces sogs brjod/ gang gi drin gyis: sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang sogs sh+lauka gnyisakyis phyag 'tshal/ bdag nyid kyi sdig pa thams cad 'chags shing slar mi bgyid do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa dang / so so skye bo thams cad kyi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag nyid dang 'gro ba'i dge ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ched du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi bar du sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i chos dkon mchog dang / phyir mi ldog pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi'o/ /e ma ma la —193—

bdag bla na med pa yang dag par byang chub par bgyi'o/ /de'i lam sgrub pas bde ba chen po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba/ nam mkha' ji srid bar rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur ba de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig pa la sems can rnams 'god par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pa'i bar rnams lan gsum brjod/ rang gi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru/ gsum oṃ āXl thim/ āXhūX la thim/huX nā da'i bar du bsdus/ de yang 'od gsal du thim/ oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las bar do'i rnam par shes pa nā da'i rnam pa nam mkhar bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma la gnas shing raX las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i steng du hūX/ de las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan par gyur/ huX las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ bar 'dir sgom par spro zhing nus na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor rgyas pa bsgom par bya ste/ de'i dbus su pad nyi la bhuX las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ lte bar bdag nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' shes rab dang bcas par gyur/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa khro bo bcus bskor ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas mtsho skyes su byon pa/ huX zhes mi bskyod pa spros nas rang la thim/ rang nyid khams gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po huX mdzad du gyur pa ni/ gong du lan gnyis bshad pa ltar ro/ /huX/ lan bcu/ khro bo bcu po pad+ma nas spros rtsibs bcur 'khod pa ni/shar du gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/—194—

g.yas gsum lcags kyu 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon zhags pa dril bu dgra sta'o/ /lhor gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas zhags pa rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum zhags pa dril bu dgra sta'o/ /nub tu rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum lcags sgrog pad+ma ral gri/g.yon gsum dril bu dgra sta zhags pa/ byang du bgegs dgra sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum dril bu sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum zhags pa gshun shing dgra sta/ byang shar du gtum po nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon gsum sdigs 'dzub sta re zhags pa'o/ khar lhor 'dod rgyal nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rang gi phyag rgya/ lhag ma g.yas lcags kyu ral gri/g.yon rdo rje zhags pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum dbyug pa ral gri 'khore lo/ g.yon gsum zhags pa pad+ma dgra sta/ nub byang du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal g.yas gsum rtse gsum ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum thegs pa pad+ma dgra sta/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo can ser po ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ dang po gnyis gtsug tor spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon sdigs 'dzub ral gri/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon gsum zhags pa pad+ma ral gri/thams cad rang 'dra'i yum dang sbyor ba phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de rjes—195—

phur gdab bya ste man ngag snye mar gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bsdu na/ bdag nyid khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal du gyur/ nga lan gnyis kyi pho nya spro/ bgegs rnams la phur bas btab par bsam te/ oṃ gha gha: sogs/ oṃ badz+ra na dha ra: sogs lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis chog go /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du hu su hu las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'o/ /khro bo chen po'i gzugs yongs su gyur pa las de'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa'i chos 'byung gi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ de'i lte bar bhu las 'khor lo bhu gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad de zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phub can/ nang gi lha snam gru bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ de'i nang du zlum skor ga bor los mtshan pa nang du lha mo'i gnas kyi sa gzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i yang nang du zlum skor pad+mas mtshan pa nang du ma mo'i sa gzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i nang du 'od kyi 'phreng ba dang / rdo rje'i gdung zlum po nang le tshe dgur gyur pa/ de'i —196—

dbus kyi gzhi sngon po/ lhag ma sa gzhi thams cad phyogs kyi mdog can no/ /lha snam gyi phyogs rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma la zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan so so dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / de'i phyi rol pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /'di zhi ba gtso che ba'i dkyil 'khor yin pas/ dur khrod ma sgoms kyang rung la/ rdo rje drag mo la sogs pa ma mo 'dus pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir sgoms kyang mi 'gal lo/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa khyab cing byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ger gyur pa khang brtsegs kyi nang na gnas pa'i nā da la yongs su bcug cing / slar yang dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ a ā nas a a phrag gnyis rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba dkar po/ o tsi ta pra ti be+e dha ka ro mi/ ka kha: nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa bha phrag gnyis rnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba dmar po/ o bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa dā ya mi/ de'i dbus su bar srid nā da yongs su zhugs te nā da las thig le dang / zla phyed dang / mgo bo dang / ha dang /'chi' rim pas rdzogs pa'i hū las rdo rje'i lte ba la hu gis mtshan par gyur/ o badz+ra at+pa ko3 ha/ de las spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'gro ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs su byas/ de thams cad tshur 'dus te thim/ o mahā su rdzu ḍā nyid rdo rdo gā ༵ nga ༵kā rdo/'a/ dzhai~X ༵gi sgras rtsegs rmi sa su bzugs / / ༵ra/ /de ༵ ༵ —197—

thā sarba thā ga ta ta thā a ha/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas lnga'i cod paṇa can 'dzum zhing sgeg pa/ dkar la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyu/da pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu/g.yon gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ pad+ma thod pa zla ba rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba dang dar gyi na bza' can gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje phag mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin mas 'khyud pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ /thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum phyag gnyis pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan can/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' zla ba la gnas pa'i hu nag po/ bar 'dir sems can rnams la snying rje'i dbang bskur ba byed na/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs nas bshad pa bzhin du bya la mdor bsdus pa'i tshe ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /mig tu oṃ dza las gti mug rdo rje dang gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar hū hūṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje dang sgra rdo rje ma/ sna bug tu tra ba las ser sna rdo rje dang dri rdo rje ma/ lcer u ho las 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ dpral par ha kha las phrag dog rdo rje dang reg bya rdo rje ma/ snying —198—

gar hūX raX las dbang phyug rdo rje dang chos khams rdo rje ma rnams dang / mgo bo d+ma las byams pa/ dbang shes kyi gnas thams cad du maX las 'jam dpal/ de gnyis dpa' bo kho na'o/ /lte bar spyan ma dang rnam snang / snying gar mā ma gī dang mi bskyod pa/ mgrin par gos dkar mo dang 'od dpag med/ spyi bor sgrol ma dang don yod grub pa/ gsang bar pad+ma drwa ba ma dang rdo rje sems dpa'/ spyi bor sku rdo rje/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje rnams su gyur/ lha de rnams rang gi phung khams skye mched dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūX dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyugaphrag pa gnyis su po ṣa ṭa he nag po las he ru ka mig gnyis su huX hūX hoXdamar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haX ljang khu las rta mchog gi ngo bo lte bar oṃ baX dmar po las rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX yoX sngon mo las gshin rje ma/ khar hri moX dkar mo las rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hre hri ser mo las bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūX hūX ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las tsaṇ+ḍi ka /yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ thugs kar hūX nag po/ lte bar swa ser po/ gsang bar āXdamar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis sku gang / yab kyi gsang gnas huX las byung ba'i rdo rje/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu huX dang oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' hriXlas byung ba'i pad+ma/ bhuX las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru hiXdang bhuX gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ta ga a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ snying ga nas 'phros pa'i —199—

'od zer gyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyi bor bzhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba shes rab kyi mkha' nang du byin te yongs su gyur pa las/hu bhu a hi kha/ bhu hu hri ta/ a ā/ i yī/ gi/ ྅/ a ā la grwa la dzha/ stu 1 gha ba lī dza : ba ho zhes pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams las mi bskyod pa sku mdog nag po rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun du gyur/ hu bhu a hru kha/ mkha' nang gi rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dug lnga rnam par sbyong / ye shes lnga la bkod/ slar 'dus te mi bskyod pa rang nyid la thim zhing / rigs lhag ma bzhi phyogs bzhir snyend pa ni/shar du rnam snang dkar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po phyag g.yas gnyis kyis rin po che dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis na mda' dang pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhugs pa 'dzin pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang thod—pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ rgyan dang bzhugs tshul gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /bhu hū hi ta/ yum bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi sbyangs/ tshad med bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te nang gi grwa bzhir 'khod pa ni/ byang shar du spyan ma dkar mo phyag g.yas bzhis 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri mda'/ g.yon bzhis thod pa dril bu zhags pa —200—

gzhu/ shar lhor mā ma gī sngon mo phyag g.yas drug mda' ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma/ g.yon drug gis gzhu lcags kyu dril bu zhags pa thod pa kha ṭāX ga /lho nub tu gos dkar mo dmar mo phyag g.yas bzhis mda' pad+ma rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon bzhis gzhu thod pa zhags pa dril bu/ nub byang du sgrol ma ljang khu phyag g.yas bzhis ut+na la dmar po ral gri lcags kyu mda'/ g.yon bzhisa'akhor lo zhags pa thod pa gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ de dag ni rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyi yongs su brgyan pa'o/ /aX āX yī yī uX āX aX āX rnal ga tsho' byar ma brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/sems can thams cad 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la bkod/ slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i 'phar ma la 'khod pa ni/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rol pa'i khro mo'i tshul can te/ shar du rdo rje drag mo dkar mo mda' lcags kyu gzhu byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/lhor rdo rje gzugs ma ser mo rdo rje mdung zhags pa rdul gyis gang ba'i thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo ral gri rdo rje dri chus gang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang khu phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul ba dan rtse gsum pa kha ṭāX ga thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod spyin ma dkar ser dbyug pa ut+pal thod pa cang te'u rnams 'dzin pa/shar lhor rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ser dmar pad+ma me long tshil gyis gang ba'i thod pa dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma dmar sngo shasti dung 'khor lo thod pa khrag gang rnams 'dzin pa/ nub byang du sa rdo rje ma ljang dkar bum pa rdo rje sha lnga —201—

bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /la ṛ/ la dzha kla gha ba kla/ lha mo brgyad dpag tu med pa spros 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi dri ma rnams sbyangs/ ye shes kyi snang ba la bkod/ slar yang 'dus te phyi rol du 'khod pa ni/ phyi rol gru chad kyi dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo/ me mtshams su pi wa ma ser mo/ bden bral du rnga mu kun+da ma dkar mo/rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can/ lha rnams kyi shar lho'i grwar/ me tog ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu bdug spos ma sngon mo rin po che dang spos snod 'dzin pa/ nub byang du mar me ma ser mo pad+ma dmar po dang mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dri chab ma dmar mo ral gri dang dri bzang gi dung chos 'dzin pa/ rnam snang la sogs pa de thams cad lha'i gos dang skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs can no/ /me k+ṣi dzi kha ga ma ska sa/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang po rnam par dag par byas/rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang po rnams la bkod/ slar 'dus te rim pa gsum pa'i 'phar ma la 'khod pa ni/ shar gyi g.yas su byams pa ser po nā ga ge sar dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du sa'i snying po dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lho'i g.yas su phyag rdor nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po ser po nor bu nga/nga dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub kyi g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can ral pa'i zur phud gsum pa ut+pal dang dril bu 'dzin pa/byang gi g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/—202—

g.yon du kun tu bzang po dkar po rdo rje dkar po dang dril bu 'dzin pa thams cad kyang phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba g.yas brkyang gi stabs can no/ /dza / ba ho sgo ma bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ bdud bzhi bcom/ stobs bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te sgo bzhir 'a rgod pa ni/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma sngo sangs sngo nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis lcags kyu ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum gyis zhags pa sdigs 'dzub dril bu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis zhags pa rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum gyis 'khor lo dril bu sdigs mdzub/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis lcags sgrog rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum gyis 'khor lo dril bu lcags kyu rnams 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis dril bu rdo rje ral gri/g.yon gsum gyis 'khor lo lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ de ltar sgo ma bzhi ni dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lha gzhan rnams thams cad pad+ma thod pa zla ba la gnas pa/ lha tshogs thams cad kyang gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /gal te lha nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la mos na/ lha snam gyi dbus su zlum skor gcig dang / de'i dbus su le tshe dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor byas la/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad bkod pa'i snam bu dor ba'o/ /de dag kyang rgyud phyi ma dang / rtsa rgyud so so'i dgongs pa yin la/ rtsa rgyud la rgyud gzhan —203—

gyis kha bskang ba lha mo bcu drug dgod par mdzad pa yang shin tu legs pa ste/de'i tshe rim pa gsum pa'i 'phar ma la phyogs bzhir sgeg mo sogs dang /mtshams bzhir pi wa ma la sogs pa dgod cing / lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir me long ma la sogs pa bzhi 'god pa ni khyad par ro/ /gang dag rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni sgo gsum sgra kho na'o zhes smra ba de dag ni rgyud la mngon sum du bsnyon par zad la/ rgyud las/ 'phar ma'i rim gsum mam bzhi par gsungs pa'i phyir na sgo rkyang kho na ste bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor 'phar ma gnyis par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de'i rjes su yan lag lhag ma rnams la bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dza.o badz+ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ pā du: hu/ o ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hu dza swāhā/ ba ho zhes pa dam ye bsres/ mig tu oṃ dza: nas dpa' bo kho na'o/ /spyi bor sku rdo rje: dang nas/ rnams su gyur/ gyi bar gong bzhi/ yang snying ga'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams badz+ra sa mā dza chu gnyis dang nyer spyod kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ zhes pa'i bar sdom 'byung gi skabs bzhin/rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang / mā ma gī/ sgra rdo rje ma/phyag na rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po rnams la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma drag mo sa rdo rje ma/ gling bu ma/ me tog ma/ byams pa/ sa'i snying po/ lcags kyu ma rnams la rnam snang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ gzugs ma/ bdug spos ma/ pi wa ma/ nam mkha'i snying po/ zhags pa ma rnams la rin 'byung / gos dkar mo/ 'dod —204—

chags ma/ mar me ma/ dri ma/ mu kun+da ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dpal lcags sgrog ma rnams la/ 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma/ zhi ba mo/ gnod spyin mo/ rdza rnga ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dril bu ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i 'dod yon rnams byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ shes rab kyi pad+ma ra mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa grangs med par gyur te/ lha mo'i ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir spros nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mchod par gyur/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā at+pa ko3 haX/ 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi rkang brgyad dang / spro na/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs kyis kyang bstod la/nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang / oX sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta su da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas smos nas nang mchod 'bul ba'i srol ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /nag po spyod pa pa dang dha ma pa/ /laṅga li pa ti slo nā ro dang / /a wa dhu tī pa dang so ri pa/ /'jigs med 'gyung gnas stobs bcu rdo rje dpal/ /dge mtshan dpal dang mi dbang dpal bzang po/ /rā wi mi tra ra ti gup+ta dang / shwarnyi gup+ta bi pu la gar+bha/ /gang ba'i rdo rje rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes bya la/ brgyud pa rnying pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ birba ḍom+bhi ngo mtshar rdo rje dang / /nags khrod garnya ri dang rgyal ba dpal/ /mi thub zla ba dpa' bo'i rdo rje dang / /'brog mi gsal snying skye cu sa chen dang / /rje btsun sku mched sa skya paṇa chen dang / /tshogs sgom snyeg ston zhad ston bkra shis dpal/ /spang khang grags dpal ma ti pan chen dang / /thig chen chos rje brag thog chos rje dang / /kun dga' rnam rgyal yangs pa can pa gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la zhes sam/ yang ngor lugs ltar na ma ti'i rjes su/—205—

gzhon blo ngor chen dpal ldan pa dang ni/ /bsod nams lhun grub rje btsun grol mchog dang / /byams pa'i mtshan can rnams la: zhes 'don/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas nas tsa mi sogs la brgyud pa'ang byung ngo / /bar 'dir dag pa dran par byed pa spro na man ngag snye mar gsungs pa ltar shes dgos la 'on kyang ngag tu mi brjod do/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i sgo nas las rgyal mchog dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang bsgom mo/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ glu rna badz+ra a sra ta mahā sdo/ kha ha swāhā/ skye( badz+ra bai ro tsa na nī ye bzhi ḍā ki nī ye swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ ā hū hū swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa spyi dang mtshungs so/ /thun 'jog par 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ stong pa la mnyam pa bzhag /slar yang lha sku sgyu ma lta bur langs te/ (〈zhi〉 zhwa bor sku rdo rje: sogs ) gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /'di'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'bring po ni/ tsan+dan dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal gru gsum gyi dbus su/ gur gum gyis zlum por bskor ba la/ le tshe dgur byas/ ma 'byor na rdul tshon nam/ nang mchod kyis de dang dbyibs mthun tsam bri/ gtor ma mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bshams/mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs 'khrul spong gi skabs dang 'dra/rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor khro bo chen po bcu phyogs skyong ba 'khor bcas srid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad phaṭa/ ces 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ tshod ku ra kyi sogs kyis spyan drangs/ sgo( —206—

shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam bzhi yi/ khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang / khyad par gdol pa'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po brtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang / /dga' ba las 'das bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u mas bstod/ /rgyal ma rnam par rgyal dbang mo/ /thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /nag po sdang ba lam pa ki /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen ma/ /thod 'phreng 'phreng can kha ṭāX ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu lag dang / /lha yi dbang phyug ma rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid dang / /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /gos med sbyor ba bskyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'dir spyon cig /oṃ ka ska ta na ba bhan+ta na/ rji da na/ sarba sdos rten/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya gha ta ya/ a mu ka phya i daX kwarla swaṅgā ya huX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaXswāhā/ dbus kyi re mig gi gnas la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing / re mig gzhan rnams la phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ lha mo bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa 'khod pa ni/ ha ri ke lar a ru ra drung shar/ /zhing skyong nag po —207—

drag po 'khor bcas bzhugs/ /kosko nar ni so ma bzhi byang / zhing skyong drag po chen po/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya ṇa ra a sho ka /zhing skyong lha byin mnyam brten lho phyogs rdul bral tsu ta'i shing gi drung / /zhing skyong nag mo'i ming can mer ni ka rañja te tsa ri tso/ /zhing skyong rtsigs byed wo po bde bral de bi ko ṭar bha ṭa ste/ /zhing skyong 'jigs byed mi sdug rlung mtshams 'bar ba 'dzin par gser shing te/ /zhing skyong dga' ba las 'das dbang ldan aṣ+ṭa ha sar ka da shing /zhing skyong bgegs kyi rgyal po 'khore bcas bzhugs/ zhes bya ste/ sa mū ṭar zhing brgyad bshad pa zhing skyong brgyad dang spyod brgyud kyi dgongs pa ra nges la/ phyogs mtshams ji ltar yin tshul ga ya dha ra dang / nā ro pa gnyis kyi man ngag ltar bkod pa'o/ /dbang po'i g.yas su tshangs pa dang zla ba dang nyi ma khyab 'jug rnams dang / nor bdag gi g.yon du tshogs kyi bdag po dang / chu lha'i g.yas su thabs bzang ris dang sa'i lha mo rnams rang rang gis 'khor tshogs dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ chu bzhi dang nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ o badz+ra ḍā ka i ma ba li gro hā gro hā hu phaṭa/tse( dza : ba hos ma ya sta khru khyi ho zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis dkyil 'khor la phul o kha kha ji hi ji hi nas/ pra ya:skyo hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mkha' 'gro skyi gtor gyis sngags bsdus pas 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad la lan gsum du phul/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /sogs kyi 'dod don gsol ba bto/ o u hipra wa ra sa t+pa ra hu añca ma na pra tismo swāhā/ o hasta pung tshi ye swāhā/ o ta bu la ye swāhā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya'i mthar/ hu phaṭa btags pa lan gsum bzla zhing dril bu dkrol/—208—

sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /sa rngas rgyas nyid du grub gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ tse( phun sum tshogs pa zhes sogs bsgyu ku shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ pad skor 'khyud rgya lag g.yas re mig gis sa la bzhag cing / g.yon khu tshur snying gar reg pa rnams bya ste/o at+pa tiṣ+ṭha hū swāhā/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbugs dang lhan cig rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyis mchod/ lko sarba du ni gro hā gro hā gwa tsā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams gshe/gas su gsol/ slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gzhan rnams ni/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i sgrub thabs nyams su len tshul yang 'di kho na ste/'khor lo'i bdag po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi bsgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /kun tu ngo mtshar rmad byung ba//dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab rdzogs nyung tshu) tshig gis bris/ /'di las rdo rje 'dzin thob shog kha spyor rdor sems kyi sgrub pa'i thabs te bco brgyad pa'o// //༈ de ltar na ze dag rnams la rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/snang ba thams cad sku gsung thugs su lhag par mos pas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya zhing / bza' btung bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs nas/ lte ba'i gtum mo rab tu 'bar ba'i me'i dbus/ snying gar ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang / lte bar phyogs skyong la sogs pa gsal bar dmigs te/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis longs spyod pa dang / gong bu bsdu ba'i rim pas 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas gnyid lam du 'byer ba dang slar yang ldang ba dang / khrus kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa nas brtsams te/ sgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sna tshogs bsam pa dang mtshungs cho ga sna tshogs tha dad pa/ /rgyud rgyal rnams —209—

su bstan pa de kun nam yang don med min/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chu klung lam rnams sna tshogs tha dad las/ /rgya mtshor ro gcig sa zhol bzhin thabs tshul kun kyang chos kyi dbyings su'o/ /nges par zab bo sbyang bya spyong byed legs par 'byongs pa'i bskyed rim mo/ /yid ches ldan no rgyud dang 'phags yul mkhas dang grub pa'i gsungs bzhin te/ /byin rlabs che'o rdzogs sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar du rgyun ma chad/ /skal ba bzang ngo dkon cing rnyed dka' 'bad med legs par thob 'di ko /de ltar sgrub thabs thabs tshul dpag yas rnams/ tshig tshogs ha cang ches na 'bri dka' zhing / /klog dka' 'dzin dka' 'don yang khong chud dka'/ /thun bzhir sgom pa sogs kyang lhag par dka'/ /bdag blo dman no skye bo phal cher yang / /blo dman nyid pas nyung pus phan par sems/ /bdag nyid sgom dang gzhan la mi phan na/ /tshigs tshogs che ba'i nga rgyal de yis ci/ /theg mchog nyams len man ngag rgya mtsho 'di/ /'bad brtsol grub chen zhugs pa de las kyang / /skal bzang don mthun skye bo bgrang yas rnams/ /zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du phyin par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /rgyud sde'i mthar thug 'khor lo sdom pa 'dir/ /gus pas cung zad brtsol ba'i dge ba las/ /bdag kyang 'khor lo'i mgon de thob par shog /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can ji snyed pa/ /ma lus bla na med pa'i byang chub la/ /myur ba nyid du 'god par byed gyur cig /de srid bdag kyang 'gro ba'i don byed shog /bde chen lam mchog zab yangs pad tshal du/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bung ba'i rgyal po ni/ /bye ba phrag brgyar lhan cig zab don gyis/ /sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston spyod pa nyid du gyur/ /bskyed rdim pho nyas rab tu bskul te rtags bral dbang po thams cad pa yi ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po gang / /'gyur med bde ba'i 'od brgya 'bar bas gzung 'dzin tshang tshing stug po bsregs nas phung po khams dang skye mched gzhan/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings rgyal ba rnams kyi snying po zung 'jug dpa' bo dpyid dang phag mo mnyam spyor zhes —210—

bya ba/ /bla med bla ma'i drin las dus 'di nyid du mngon du 'gyur zhing srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun gyi gzhir gyur cig /sgrub thabs nges par brjod pa'i tshig 'di yang rgyal gsungs yan lag rgya mtsho dang 'grogs te/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar dag tu/ /skye bo kun la phan bde'i rgyun byed shog /ces pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ yab bka'i dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi dang / yum bka'i dkyil 'khor bzhi'i sgrub thabs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa ste/ de yang dang por bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po'i 'grel pa'i lugs dang / de nas slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi lugs dang /mai tri bcu gsum ma dang / yum bka'i lha sum cu so bdun ma dang / sdom 'gyung lha bcu gsum ma dang / lwa ba bcu gsum mar grags pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang / 'jam rdor lha nyer lnga ma dang / drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa dang / bong bu'i zhal can lha so bdun ma dang / mchog gi rdo rje phag mo lha bcu gsum ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro drag po'i dkyil 'khor dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dang / rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / dril bu lha lnga dang / khro bo rdor sems dang / phag mo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / kha sbyor las 'byung ba zhi ba rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang bka' la/ /lha dril nag gsum grags che bas logs su gsal/ yi ge bdun pa sgrub thabs ni dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yin yang slob ma rjes 'dzin byin rlabs kyi cho ga tsam dang bcas pa yin pa gzhan du bshad zin no// //bod yul 'di na dngos su rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi khungs la ma rten pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ba yang mang du yod cing / 'ga' zhig thob mod kyang 'dir ma bkod la/ gong du smos pa de rnams las gzhan pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa —211—

gsungs pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhud bod du 'gyur pa'ang mang mod kyang / kho bos legs par thob pa ni 'di tsam yin la/ de yang kha ba can gyi phyogs de dag las gzhan zur bka' grags pa khungs rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i dbang bka' grags che ba cher med pa 'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor gcig nyid la 'dod tshul tha dad pa mang po 'byung ba ni su zhig gis bgrang bar spyod/ de la 'di'i sdom 'gyung gi sgrub thabs ni dge bzhas dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin gyis bskul nas thog mar sbyar ba yin la/ des spro ba 'phel nas sgrub thabs bdun tsam zhig de'i rjes thogs su bris nas bar skabs su lo 'ga' zhig le lo'i dbang gis 'phro bor ba las/ slar yang 'phros rnams bris pa ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud la mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so drug pa la nags rgyal gyis dben gnas dpal jo mo nang du tshang bar bsgrigs pa'o// //'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing sangs rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig gcig zhus ma ṅga la// //—212—

he ra co ka'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/oX na mo sam+bha rā ya/ 'khor lo bde mchog khro bo rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba rdo rje huX mdzad he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdo rje can 'di dus las rab grol mchog tu dul ba'i rang bzhin te/ /'gro rnams mun pa mthar byed rab tu che ba'i nang gi 'od zer ni/ /rtag tu 'char ba rang gi rig ma dang 'dus bdud bzhi 'joms dpa' bo/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal bde ba'i rol pa 'gro ba'i snying la 'jug par mdzod/ /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal dngos grub kyi/ /chu gter 'di ni chu gter bzhin/ /mchog tu rgya che gting yang zab/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag kyang / /rkyal bas sdogs min de bzhin rin chen 'byung gnas 'di'i/ /sbyor ba re re'ang tshu rol mthong ba'i blos mi spyod/ /'on kyang dkar po'i blo yis rnam 'byed rdo rje can/ /deng bdag snying la zhugs snyam 'di la blo mig thob/ /de ltar na gzu bor gnas pas mnyan pa'i rigs so/ /'dir dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa shrī he ru ka rdo rje khro bo huX mdzad kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa khro bo bcu'i bka'i 'khor los sdang ba dang ma rungs pa'i sems can phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid thogs pa med par 'joms pa'i spyor ba dang sngags dang rgyud 'di nyid kyis las grub par bya ba/dang po'i las can la sogs pa gang zag bzhis so sor bya ba ni/ ji snyed cig bshad pa las/ nye bar mkho ba cung zad cig brjod na/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bsrung zhing phyir zlog gi sbyor ba dang / khro bo rnams kyi bsnyen pa dang / phyir zlog gi 'khrul 'kho ra dang / zhal bzhi pa'i 'khrul 'kho(ra las snags —213—

dang / de rnam sa nyid kyis nges pa nang du bstan pa'o/ /bsrung ba bsnyen pa zlog 'khor dang / /lasatshogs dang ni rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bsrung zlog kyang / rgyas pa dang /bar ma dang / bsdus pa'i dbye bas rnam pa mang por 'gyur ba las/ re shig 'khor lo sdom pa la rnga tshi3 ba'i sngags pa las dang po pa rnams la nye bar mkho bar snang bas/ man ngag las kyang 'gyung ba/ rgyud don las kyang mi 'da' ba kho nar bsrung 'khor rgyas pa nyid tshig zor yang pa'i sgo nas thog mar brjod la/ rgyas bsdus kyi 'dor len ci rigs pa dag ni phyis bshad par bya'o/ /de yang / oX swa bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3 haX/ oX shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā ba at+pa ko3 haX/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing kha huX gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhuX las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas bskor du mgyogs par 'khor ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin phyogs bcur 'phro ba/de'i lte bar paX las sna tshogs chu skyes dang / raX las nyin mor byed pa'i gdan la/ thog tha med pa'i sems kyis rang snang huX dkar po las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpa' bo bde ba'i go 'phangs la bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus dag pa'i shel dang ston zla ltar dkar zhing zhi ba/ g.yas ser g.yon ljang ba'i zhal gnyis rnam par 'gyur ba/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhag/sa pa/ g.yon gnyis ka pā la dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ thod pa'i cod pan dang rgyan thams cad pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs can/ 'dod chags rdo rje'i 'od 'phrengs —214—

'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor na rol pa/ hū las byung ba'i thabs kyis rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang ā las shes rab kyi pad+ma/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ snying po'i bu gar byā dang du gyis mtshan pa/ o ā hū rdo rje pad mar bskyod pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang / thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i rnam par bkug ste/ zhal du zhugs lha mo'i pad+ma ra babs pa/ hū bcu gcig las zhe sdang rdo rje he ru ka khro bo bcu dang bcas par gyur/ mi bskyod pa thugs kar drangs hū zhes phyir phyung / snang ba'i sems can thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje khro bo'i sa la bkod/ rang la thim pas bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed hū mdzad he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag khro bo 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par mdzad pa/gdon bgegs thams cad za bar byed pa'i zhal gsum dbus mthing kha/g.yas ser/ g.yon ljang ba/ gsum ka'ang lhag par khros pa'i gad rgyangs can/me ltar 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ glog 'phreng lta bu'i smin rdzi g.yo ba'i khro gnyer bsdus pa/ thod pa'i dum bus 'og pag dang / phyag rgya drug dang / klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / mi mgo'i me tog gi do shal can/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rdo/ rje dang rdo rje dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pas rang snang gi rig ma la 'phyud pa/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa'o/ khro bo bcu rnams thugs kar drangs/ hu thugs ka nas phyir spros/—215—

phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi steng dang / steng 'og gi rtsibs brgyad kyi nang la cung zad ma reg pa rnams su pad nyi dang phyogs skyong ba bcu'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/byang du rdo rje nyi ma me ser po ser nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/ lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum/ mer rdo rje gnod spyin dud ka dud ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ rlung du rdo rje stobs po che nag po nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa mi g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis cang te'u dang rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po dkar nag ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og mig sman ltar gnag pa/nag ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo lta bu/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag drug gi lhag ma g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang snang gi shes rab la 'khyud pa/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /khro bo bcu ni sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam dang / zad pa dang / mi skye ba dang / kun rdzob dang / pha rol sems dang / chos dang / rjes su shes pa ste/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du'o/ /de thams cad kyi snying —216—

gar oX oX ha/ zhes pa nas/ tsaṇ+ḍa ki'i ngo bo/ zhes pa'i bar ram/ yang na sgrub thabs ltar zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i go cha bkod/ dpral par oX dkar po sogs rdo rje gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i huX gi 'od zer mu mtha' med pas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs h+pha dzaXhuX baX hoX ye shes kyi snyen ra lo sad/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshe/gas pa la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga 'bul/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpal bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bzhin chus dbang bskur bas/hūX mdzad la rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje gtum po la rnam snang / nyi ma la rin 'byung / gtsug tor la 'od dpag med/ 'khyil pa la don grub/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pa'am/ yang na/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan/gzhan rnams la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oX krodha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ pra du pur+sha/ nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod nas/phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad med par gyis shig ces khro bo rnams la bka' bgos pas/ khro bo re re las phur bu'i khro bo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis pa rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas ser po dud kha g.yon dmar po ljang khu/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi rig mar sbyor ba de 'og gnyis lha chen po'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis kha ṭāX ga lcags kyu/ tshangs mgo gri gug g.yon bzhis thod pa/ thegs pa/ cang te'u/ gri gug mi mgo'i cod pan dang do shal/ phyag rgya drug dang / klu mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal gyis brgyan pa/ rab tu khros pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa/ zhabs gcig pu —217—

mdung rtse lta bu'i phur bur gyur pa/ gang gis kyang bzod glags med pa'i me dpung 'ur 'ur 'bar ba can te/ steng zhal ni steng gi khro bo stag dang / 'og ni byi ba'i gdong / shar nas phyogs g.yon bskor dang / me nas mtshams g.yas bskor gyis rta gdong dkar po/ glang po/ byi ba/ seng ge khyi dang / 'ug pa/ phag dang / khra'i gdong can no/ /yang hū bzhi pa lan gnyis brjod cing / sdigs mdzub se gol phyogs khor gdab cing / shar dang steng du khā gdong ma sngo ba/ byang du lug gdong ma ljang ba/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar ba/ lhor phag gdong ma ser ba/shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma sngo ser phyed pa/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya mo ser dmar phyed pa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma dmar ljang phyed pa/ byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma ljang sngon phyed pa/ yang na thams cad dmar mor man ngag las 'byung ba'ang rung ngo / /thams cad kyang lang tsho gzhon nu dregs shing khros pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje tho ba/ g.yon sngar spros pa'i phur bu'i khro bo re re bzung ba las/ pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ bgegs kun tshar bcad/ o badz+ra a dru sha ya a kar+ṣa ya hu/ o badz+ra pā sha ban+ta hu/ o badz+ra ka li ta dzi ba hu/ o badz+ra mu spyi lha hā hu/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa la sogs pa mtsho ni cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i pho nya rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs ma lus pa 'dus pa phyogs skyong bcur gyur pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus snying gar btab/ rdo rje zhags pas bcings/ mtsho ni cha thams cad kyis bsdigs/ khu tshur gyis bzungs nas/'khor lo'i rtse mo dang nye ba'i phyi rol du hū las byung ba'i khron pa gru gsum pa zab mo/ phyogs mtshams brgyad dang / shar gyi shar dang / nub kyi nub na gnas —218—

pa ste bcu po rnams su bcug ma mo brgyad po rnams kyis lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi rim pas/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oX gha gha ghā tā ya ghā tā ya sarba du sbyin/ phaṭa/ ki lā ya ki lā ya sarba pā baX phaṭa/ huX huX huX badz+ra ki lā ya badz+ra dha ra ya dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bisni kā ya nywaspyi t+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ phur bu rnams lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi rim pas tho bas brdung / oX badz+ra the zhi ra badz+ra ki lā ya a ko ṭā ya sha huX phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang ba rkang pa rnams su phug ste rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sbrags pas bgegs rnams lus g.yo ba med/ dag rlung rgyu ba med pa sems rtog pa thams cad chad nas/ bde ba chen po de bzhin nyin dang ro gcig tu gyur/yang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas/ sngags rnams 'od zer 'phro ba/ gser gyi sa gzhi nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la thug pa'i lus che zhing 'bar ba'i 'od zer las/ skad cig gis grub pa ni/ rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa steng du rdo rje'i gur/ de gnyis kyi mtshams su bla bre/ phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga'i mde'u can gyi mda' dra srid rtse'i bar du khyab pa/ de thams cad kyi phyi nang kun rdo rje me ri sgra drag po dang bcas pa bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me dpung lta bu gnod byed thams cad kyis bltar yang mi bzod par gyur/ de dang dus mnyam du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i huX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la thug par sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oX me dhi ni badz+re bha ba badz+ra brnya skyoX/ oX badz+ra pra ka ra hūX baX hūX/ oX badz+ra pañca ra huX paX huX/ oX badz+ra bī tā na hūX khaX huX/ oX badz+ra sa ra dzā la traX saX traX/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la a na lwarka huX huX hūX/ slar yang pho nya mo rnams kyis ma rungs pa thams —219—

cad tshar bcad de/ rdo rje'i rwa ba la thim pas chu chu la brdabs pa'i zegs ma phyir 'phros pa ltar/ rdo rje dang pad+ma dang / 'khor lo'i rwa ba rnams su gyur/ oX badz+ra pra ka ra hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX pad+ma pra ka ra hūX huX phaṭa/ oX tsakra pra ka ra hūX hūX phaṭa/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i khro bo bzhi spros shing / khro bo rnams kyi bzlas pa bya ba'am/ yang na man ngag gi tshul las mngon brjod drug cu pa'i skabs las 'byung ba ltar 'dir blangs te/ 'di ltar/rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis huX zhes brjod pas skad cig gis rab khros huX mdzad zhal gsum pa las brgyad par gyur te/ drag shul can gyi gzugs rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dus sprin ltar gnag pa/ g.yas gsum dkar sngo ser ba/ g.yon gsum sngo dkar ser ba steng zhal dmar po/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bus thugs kar 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral par 'jog pa/ lhag ma g.yas pas thod pa/ral gri/ 'khor lo/ tho ba/ cang te'u rnams dang / g.yon rnams kyis kha ṭāX galcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rin po che/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mi'i pags pa steng du 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa thugs ka'i huX las khro bo bzhi dus gcig tu spros pa ni/ 'dod rgyal sngon po sngo ser ljang ba/g.yas gnyis pas tho ba/ dbyug sngon ljang khu ljang ser g.yas gnyis pas be con/ stobs chen dmar po dmar ser ljang / g.yas gnyis pas tri shu la/ mi g.yo mgon po dud kha dud ser ljang ba/ g.yas gnyis pas ral gri/ thams cad kyi dang po gnyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral par 'jog pa —220—

g.yon gnyis pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i thod pa/ tha ma gnyis rdo rje gyen du gsor zhing kha ṭaX ga bsnams pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon pa rnams spros/ sdang ba thams cad tshar bcad/ bar chad bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ yang zhal bzhi pa brjod/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ sngar bzhin las mdzad/ oX kha badz+ra dha ka badz+ra hūX ka ra badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra dzā lā na lwarka badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badzo khye ṣa badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra ya ka badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kwa li badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra mahā bā la badz+ra naX pa ṭa/ oX badz+ra bhi ṣa ṇa badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ zhes khro bo bcu gcig dang / gtso bo nyid kyi gsang sngags/ snyaX( ra ni nga hūX hūX phaṭa/ tseX( groṇ+ḍa rta gro hā hūX hūX phaṭa/ tseX( groṇ+ḍa pā ya gro hā pā ya huX huX phaṭa/ tseX( ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+re hūX hūX phaṭa/ zhes skad gsang mthon pos bzla bar bya'o/ /gal te phyir zlog bya bar 'dod na huX zhes brjod pas khro bo thams cad cher 'khrugs te zhal phyir gzigs/ 'khor lo g.yon du drag tu 'khor/khro bo thams cad las pho nya dpag tu med pa dang / khyad par rang gi snying ga'i hūX gi 'od kyis gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba bskul/ gnyis ka las khro mo bcu'am/ khro bo bzhi'i sprin dpag tu med pa spros/ gdug pa thams cad dang / sgrub bya bkug me rlud gi steng du bcing pa lngas bcings mgo mjug ljog der ba theg pa/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyis phye mar gtubs/ mes bsregs pa'i thal ba rlung gis gtor bar bsam/ gang yang skyes bu gzhan gyi phyir ni/ sgrub bya'i snying ga'i hūX gi nā da dam/'khor lo'i lte bar chud par bsgom mo/ /sngags 'di ni rang dang gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba gnyis pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams gnad 'di gcig pus rtogs nus pas 'dab bzhi'i rim pas rtsa lag bzhi/ bde ba chen po'i gnas na gnas/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis po 'di kho nas kyang / dus —221—

'khor sogs kyi rgyud sde mang po la nges pa ster ba 'di ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /man ngag gi gzhung bya ba/rgyud don gyi mdud pa 'khrol nus pa 'di lta bu dgos kyi/ man ngag dang rgyud bshad rgyab 'gal du 'gro ba dang / grub thob kyi gsung yin zer nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang 'gal ba mang po dag snang ste/ rtsod dus tha ma 'dir/ skal med rnams kyi snying la ni shin tu 'phrod kyang / zab don gyi skal ba can blo gros mchog rnams kyis ni/ mdzod phugs mi gtsang bas bkang ba dang 'dra bar mthong ngo / /gsum pa ni e wa sa bon blangs nas ni/ /pad+ma'i me tog kha bye bar/ /bung ba'i gzugs kyis rab dga' ba'i/ /dpa' bo sbrang rtsi mnom par byed/ /ces pa ste/ 'di la shung ke lo tsā ba grags rgyal gyis/ e wa yi ge'i sa bon len/ /chu skyes kyi ni me tog la/ /sbrang rtsir byed pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rab dga'i dbang po sbrang rtsi mnom/ /zhes 'don pa go bde zhing brjod sla ba tsam snang ngo / /'di'i don 'grel par/ e wa pha ma'i sa bon blangs pa dang / pad+ma mngal gnas dang /bung ba dri za dang / rab dga' dkar dmar gyi dbus su sems rgyal ba la 'chad kyang de gzhung gi don du mi snang ngo / /e wa ni gong du bshad pa ltar gyi/ sgra gcan dang dus me yin zhing / der yang skabs 'dir bde ba'i phyogs nas bstan pas/ nyi ma gcig gis bsang bar mdzod cig zhes sogs dmod tshig brjod la/ rang gi lag mthil sna tshogs rdo rjer bsam la thal mo brdabs pas/dgra bgegs skad cig gis thal bar brlag par bsam/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa dang / bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /'dul dka' 'dul byed sogs brjod gal te thun mtshams su 'di nyid ched kyi byas pa yin na/mchod bstod gtor ma dbul ba sogs bya'o/ /sngon gyi bod mkhas pa rnams phyir bzlog la/ steng dang dbus kyi khro bo brje bar bzhed de/ gzhan dang mthun pas legs mod/ 'on kyang 'di skor gyi —222—
