rgyud dang rgya gzhung khungs ma rnams las ma bshad cing / gsang 'dus dang / rdo rje gur sogs dang 'di cung mi 'dra'o/ /de ltar brjes na gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad/ bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad/ lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad/ sngags zla ba'i gnad ces bod snga ma rnams kyi brda chad du gnad lnga zhes gsungs pa de yang tshang bar mngon/ spyir de rnams kyi man ngag rgya gar gyi slob dpon tshad ldan gyis bshad pas/ tha snyad ni rgya gzhung las 'byung ngo zhes ngal bas sgrub ri dgos shing 'grub dka'o/ /rdo rje gur du ni khro bo bcu'i las tshogs kyi gtsug tor gyi su bang ri pe bar lo'i lte bar khro bo sgom nas phyir bzlog bya bar gsungs/ le'u bcu gnyis par dkyil 'khor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor gsungs pa rnams man ngag gi sdebs pa las/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshul 'byung la/'dir ni de ltar med pas/ gtso bo spo ba yang mi dgos so zhes rig par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rwa gur sngon du bsgom nas/ 'khor lo phur gdab sogs phyis byed pa yang lugs gzhan te/ dang po nag po lugs dang mthun la/ 'di ni ྅ yi pa dang mthun zhing 'di gnyis ka'ang shin tu rgyas pa'o/ /gnyis/ yang phur bu'i khro bo dang hu mdzad phyi ma khro bo bzhi dang bcas pa bor ba snga ma lta bu dang / gsum/ lwa ba'i zhal snga nas kyi 'grel par bstan pa ltar/ hū ཾ bzhi pas khro mo bcu spros/ phur gdab byas/ rwa gur sogs sngags tshan drug gis bkod/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' dang bcas pa bskyed/ rdor sems yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bcu gcig skad cig gis bskyed pa ni/ nag po pa'i zhabs dang 'brel la/ bzhi/ rwa gur sogs bskyed la/ 'khor lo khro bo bcu gcig dang bcas pa bsgoms/ hū bzhi pas khro mo spros nas/ phur gdab sogs byed pa ni nya lto ba'i zhabs dang mthun no/ /lnga/ mngon brjod du bstan pa yang 'di dang mthun te/ 'on kyang phur gdab ni hu bzhi pas bka' bsgos nas/ khro bo bcus byed pa yin te/ 'di gsum la rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hu las khro bo brgyad spros/ gtso bo hu mdzad du bsgyur/ de dang dus mnyam du steng —223—

'os bskyed pa ste/ mngon brjod dngos bstan du khro bo brgyad spro zhes pa las/ ji ltar spro mi gsal lo/ /drug /yang rdo rje sems dpa' hu mdzad du bsgyur nas khro bcu snying ga nas spro ba dang / bdun/mkha' nang nas sa bon las bskyed de spro ba dang / brgyad/ mkha' nang du mi bskyod pa khro bcu dang bcas pa bskyed/ mi bskyod pa spros te rang la bcug pas/ hu mdzad du bsgyur/ hū mdzad kyi rang snang gi rig ma'i mkha' las khro bo bcu spro ba rnams kyang sdo5gas gzhan dang gzhan no/ /dgu/ 'dir bsrung ba'i don tsam du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mi bsgo ma pa gtso bo dang / steng 'og gi khro bo zhal phyag gzhan du bshad pa yang yod de/ bcu/ de'i phyir rnam pa du ma yod do/ /'di rnams dang / 'di dang mthun pa rnams kyang rgyas pa'o rdzogs phreng nga/nga / man ngag snye ma'i/ snye ma nyer bdun par bshad pa'i khro bo'i zhal phyag rnams ni/ mngon brjod kyi lugs yin par snang na yang / da lta bod du 'gyur ba'i mngon brjod rnams dang mi mthun pa ni dpe gzhan zhig yod par mngon/ man ngag snye ma'i rdor sems sgrub thabs kyi bsrung 'kho1ra yang rgyas pa yin no/ /bcu gcig lha bcu gnyis nag gi bcu gsum/ sgrub thabs kyi srung 'khor dang / phag mo mngon 'byung dang / bcu bzhi/ snye ma nyer bdun pa'i srung 'khor dang / bco lnga/ de rnams dang mthun pa/ 'di ltar khro bo bcu kho na bsgom pa dang /bcu drug phur gdab dang rwa gur tsam byed pa ste/ rwa gur sngon ma dang / phur gdab phyis byed pa dang / bcu bdun/ phur gdab kyi rjes su rwa gur byed pa rnams ni 'bring po'o/ /bco brgyad/ sngags drug gis byin gyis rlabs pa'i rwa gur tsam byed pa dang / bcu dgu/ hu bzhi pas skad cig gis rwa gur grub pa dang / nyi shu/ de dang mthun pa rnams ni bsdus pa yin no/ /de la bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i skabs las gzhan du bya dgos pa'i gsal kha mi snang la/ phyir bzlog ni gtso bor gzhan gyi byad ma bzlog pa'i drag shul gyi sbyor ba yin pas/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'grub na ches legs mod/ ma 'grub kyang rung ngo / /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi —224—

zhal snga nas/ rdo rje phreng bar dkyil 'khor la chu rdol la sogs pa'i gnod pa bsrung ba la yang 'di gsungs so/ /de ltar shes pa na lhag pa'i skyon med cing / shin tu rgyas pa yang byar yod la/ skabs med pa'i tshe/ shin tu bsdus pa byas kyang dgos pa'i cho ga ma chad pa zhig 'ong ba yin no/ /pū nag gi lugs gnyis dang / dril bu lhar lngar gsungs pa'i don gtsug nor du bshad pa ste/ rtsa gcig /de gsum po grags che bas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa khro bo bsnyen pa ni/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor yan chad bsgoms te/ chos 'byung gi nang du/ 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang mngon byang lnga las rdo rje sems dpa' dang / de zhu ba glus bskul te khro bo hū mdzad zhal gsum par bskyed/ go cha bgo sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug bya/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgom/ dbang bskur te mi bskyod pa'i cod pan bya/ de rnams sbyor ba'o/ /yum gyi gnas lnga byin gyis rlabs/ khro bo bcu mkha' spro sngar srung 'khor du bstan pa bzhin byas te/ ye shes dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur bya/ mchod bstod bya ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /de nas bzlas pa bya ste rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o/ /'di ni nag po'i zhabs kyi man ngag sbyar ba yin la/ gcig /lha thams cad mngon byang lnga las bskyed la/ go cha/ ye shes dbang bskur rgyas btab bya ba lo i pa'i man ngag dang sbyar ba ste/ 'di gnyis nā ro ta pa'i man ngag las 'byung / gnyis/ mngon brjod kyi rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni bsrung 'khor dngos bstan de nyid bsgom nas bzlas pa byas la/ rjes kyi cho ga bya ba ste/ khro bo tsam gyi bsnyen pa ni de kho nas rung la/gsum/ snga ma ni bde mchog khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs yin pas/ thun mong gi cho ga ྅ nag gam/ de dang mthun pa rnams dang thun mong ste de'i phyir de gnyis su rig par bya'o/ /yang gzhan rnams dang po dang 'dra ba las/ rdor sems hu mdzad du bsgyur lugs mngon brjod kyi dngos —225—

bstan ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /bzhi/ yang 'khor lo'i lte bar hu mdzad gcig pu bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhis bskyed pa dang / khro bo gzhan bcu po la yang yan lag bzhis bskyed kyi sgrubs thabs bod 'ga' zhig gis mdzad la/ lnga/ 'di gzhan gyis rgyas bkab pa ste rung mod/ 'on kyang 'dir khro bo lhag ma rnams kyi las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa sgrub tshul mang po mi snang bas re zhig nye bar mkho ba chen po mi snang ngo / /de bzhin du hūṃ las phur bu'i khro bo sgom ste/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyang cho ga mngon byang lngas bskyed dang / gcig zhu ba glus bskul gyi tshul gyis sngar khro bo'i bsnyen pa ltar bskyed pa yin no/ /'di la lha snam gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyang// dbus su gtso bo/lho nub tu las byed kyi phur bu sgom pa yin la/ khra gdong la sogs pa sgo bzhin sgom la/ glang gdong sogs me la sogs pa gsum du 'god/ gtso bo zhal nub bstan no/ /zhes kha cig 'dod cing /'ga' zhig glang gdong sogs gtso bo'i gnas gsum du 'god mod/ lugs dang po ltar 'thad la/'on kyang sto nub kyi phur bu mi dgos so snyam mo/ /sngags ni/ o gha gha/ sogs dang / o ki lī ki lā ya hū zhes sogs/ hu mdzad zhal brgyad pa'i ni/ gtso rkyang kho na ste/ chos 'byung du/ pad+ma la sa bon las bskyed de/ 'grel pa ltar mthar/ yan lag bzhi bskyed bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su khro bo bzhi spro ba yin no/ /de yang khro bo hū mdzad kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa las tshogs sgrub pa la bde mchog nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub pas ni/ hu mdzad kyi sgos bsnyen mi dgos so/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum phrag bzhir sngon gyi bod rnams gsungs la/ dpal he ru ka'i bsnyen pa grub pas hū mdzad kyi bzlas pa khri byas nas las sgrub bo zhes dam pa snga ma rnams 'doms par mdzad do/ /'dir dpyad par bya ba ni 'di yod de/ gang la la hu mdzad kho na rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / yan lag bzhi sogs kyis mi sgrub na des sngags kyi grangs tsam rdzogs pas bsnyen —226—

par 'gyur ram/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa la sogs pa gzhan zhig gis bsnyen pa ni byas la/ rgyud 'dir ma yin pas hu mdzad kyi bzlas pa khri yis las sgrub bam/ 'on te ma yin zhe na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis ni/ rdza rnga bcings pa la sogs pa sngags de kho na'i las 'grub pa ni yod la/ gzhan ni ma yin zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi las mtha' dag la yang mi dbang la sems kyi dri ma sbyangs pa'ang stobs chung bas/ de ni 'bras bu che ba ma yin la/ gang bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas bsnyen pa grub pas ni/ de dag rgya chen po 'grub pas na/ dpal he ru ka'i bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa dang 'brel pa'i bsnyen pa ni gal che la/ de ltar ma yin na rgyud 'dir dbang bskur ba/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gzhan gyi bsnyen pa legs par grub pas kyang rung ste/ de la 'dir khro bo rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa sngar bstan pa ni/ bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'o na/ 'dir thig le'am phra mo sgom pa ni ji lta bu zhe na/ sngar bstan pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor gyi lha ma lus pa spro bsdu'i sbyor bas/ rmi lam lta bur bsam pa'i las rgyal po mchog sgom mo/ /de nas nye snying mgrin spyi'i mdud pa'i bu gar a hu o ha/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i rlung gis me bskul bas gtum mo'i rang bzhin a 'bar ba'i mes ha zhu/ des yi ge gsum gang /a dang dbyer med lhan skyes kyi thig ler gyur pa las/ 'od zer gyi re kha phra mo me lce gcig tu 'bar ba lta bu de'i mthus bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i thig les re kha bsil bar gyur pa/ sems brtan pa'i mtshan ma thob kyi bar du sgom mo/ /mtshan ma rnams kyi nye bar dmigs pas brtan par shes na/re kha'i 'od kyis thams cad gsal bar byas pa sgom ste/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /yang na snying ga'i sngags kyi/ 'od kyis 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas su byas nas/ nang du 'dus pa thig le'i rnam pa'i hū du gyur pa las yid bzhag go /dbugs 'byin pa na spro/ rngub pa na bsdud pa yang yang sgom mo/ /'dis bying rgod kyang sel lo/ /bsdu ba'i mthar thig le gcig pu dang / spro bsdu ji tsam du —227—

byas pa de tsam gyi dkyil 'khor yang bsam mo/ /de las g.yin yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od dhu tī nas song bas spyi bo'i ha zhu ba'i 'bar 'dzag la gtso bor snying gar yid 'jog pa de/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni sems brtan par byed pa'i thabs dam pa'o zhes pas a la sogs pa yi ge thams cad zhu ba'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam par dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa rdo rje nor bu'am/ de las 'phros pa'i pad+ma'i sna rtser bsam la brtan na dkyil 'khor spro'o/ /yang snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od kyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa zhal du zhugs zhu ba'i thig le pad+ma'i sna rtser bsgom pa yang ste phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas ni/ rdza rnga bcing pa'i nges don gyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang mthun pa bskyed rim rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /rnam pa 'di gsum ni yan lag gzhan gyi mthu las rdzogs pa'i rim par yang 'gyur te/ gang du phra thig dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa mi gsal ba'i rgyud thams cad du yang 'di sbyar ro/ /zhes pa ni mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs te/ rdo rje slob dpon ye shes zhabs la sogs pa'i man ngag go /de la 'dir/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa thams cad kyang blang du rung mod/'on kyang gtso bo ni mdo li'i bzlas pa yin te/ de skad du/ 'khor lo'i sbyor bdag nyid kyis zla/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bskyed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i sbyor ba ni mdo li'i bzlas par sngon gyi bla ma mkhas pa rnams 'chad pa ltar don la'ang gnas pa'o/ /gsum pa bris pa'i phyir zlog gi sbyor ba ni/ 'di ltar yin te/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la gnas pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ 'khor lo ni pad 'dab kyi phyi rol du rtse mo 'bur tsam thon pa'i re kha bri'o/ /rdo rje'i lte bar hū gi nang du ba/ ba gyi nang du o ā hu/ che ge mo/ raka ku ru o ā hu/ shar rwa dbus ma la/ ṛ ḍā de ṛ/ byang zhwa la de grwa/ nub tu lo kha de lo/ ltor swo ra de lo/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas lhor hū kha pra de hu hū ma tsa de hu hu ka pra de hū hū bi ma de hu/ me nas dbang ldan du/—228—

hū su bi/ de hu hū a kha de hu hū ba la de hu hū ba dru de hū/ de'i phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi bar du/ sngar gyi rim pas/ ka kha ga gha dang / nga rtsa oṃ rdza ngo / de'i phyi rol sna tshogs rdo rje rwa dbus ma rnams la shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ hū bzhi pa'i rkang pa re re bkod pa hū dang phaṭa kyi bar du ming bcug de'i phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi bar du shar nas g.yon skor gyis ā li bcu gnyis klad kor can bya/ de'i phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la shar nas g.yon skor gyi dbyangs bcu drug zla phyed thig le can/ phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi bar du g.yon bskor gyis he ru ka'i yig brgya bri/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drug la shar nas g.yon bskor gyis/ a blo/ba ma/ ma pā/ ba sdo// sdo/ shā/ ba su/ ma ha/ bi kha/ ma tsa/ ra kha/ ha 3| a tsa/ ho su/ pa ma/ be+e tsa/ba ma/ sa bon gnyis tshan gnyis tshan pa o dang hri spel ba ste/ o hi a blo do hi o la sogs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi dbus su g.yon skor phyi/ dzhai nya ṭa/ ṭha ṭa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha/ de'i phyi ru gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rkyang pa bya/ sgo mtshams su hū phaṭa ya ka ya de hu phaṭa/ de ba'i snen du hū phaṭa spel ba'i ra u ra/ la shwa la/ wa su wa/ sha ya sha ṣa ya lga sa ya sa/ ha ya ha rnams bkod/ de rnams ming la skor bar bya/ sgo'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga phyed zur gyi steng du zla nyi phyed pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa/ rdo rje brgyad po'i rwa dbus ma la sngar gyi rim pas rkang pa brgyad pa bri/ de'i phyi'i khor yug gnyis kyi bar du/ shar nas g.yon bskor gyi phyir bzlog gi sngags rings bri/ de'i phyi rol klas skor/ de'i phyir ṭhas skor/ de'i phyi rol ā lis skor/ de'i phyi rol kā lis skor/ 'di la kha cig phyir zlog yi ge re re lnga'i nang du bcug pa de yang ṭha'i nang du chud par bya zhes gsung ngo / /de'i phyi rol bde mchog gi rtsa sngags kyis skor/ de'i phyi rol rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gang rung gis skor nas 'od zer phreng ba bri/ 'di la nga ṭi ltar na gong gi hū bzhi pa la rkang pa bzhi pa la o med la/ hu hū swāhā zhes pa yod do/ /de yang rigs ngan nam bram ze mo'am/ rgyal —229—

po'i bu mo'i me tog glang po'i khram pa'i chang / snyoms 'jug las skyes pa'i khu ba/ gi wa/ zhun r+pā gyi snag tsha rnams rdo rje dang pad+ma'i chus bsdur te/ glang po che'i chang ma rnyed na sing po'o mi lpags sam gro ga'am ras la bri ste/ bde mchog zhi khro gang rung gi bdag mdun lha'i rnal 'byor/gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/ 'byung po'i gtor ma btang / kha shar du bltas la bri gzhi la gi wa gur gum tsan+dan la sogs pas byug go /gal te bsad zlog lta bu drag shul la ni/ dug dang khrag dang ke tshe dang / nim pa dang / lan tsha dang / dgra bo'i rjes kyi rdul dang / de'i rdo rje'i chu bsris pas byug go /las gzhan rnams la spyi dang mthun pa'i cho ga sbyor ro/ /de nas las dang mthun pa'i smyug gu'am/ pir gyis legs par bris nas/ kha nub tu bstan nas rab gnas bya'o/ /rab gnas ni bgeg bskrad/ khrus bya/ khro bo bcu gcig bskyed pa'am/ ji ltar bris pa bskyed/ sa bon rnams lha de dag dang / phyir zlog gi 'bru re re zhing 'khor los sgyur ba/ gzhan rnams kyang he ru ka'i ngo bor mos pa las/ 'khor lo ji lta bu'i ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ spyan dbye brtan bzhugs/mchod bstod byas la/ khro bo bcu gcig bskyed na/ spyan dbye byas ma thag de zhu ba 'khor lo snga ma lhar lta'o/ /de la gtor ma phul la tshogs mchod bya/ de nas sgrub pa na gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba la hu mdzad sgom/ de yongs su gyur pa las khang brtsegs dang 'khor lo rnam snang gi ngo bo/ bris pa'i yi ge sngar bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug ming yig rnams de yongs su gyur pa'i sgrub byar ltas la/ yid kyis 'khor lo sgrub byar bcas pa/ kha nas bcug ste zhu ba'i khu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas byung / lha mo'i pad mar sngar bzhin bskyed pa la/ nang dbang bskur/ de nas sgrub bya la ni/ khro bo rnams dang / khyad par bgegs mthar byed kyi tshogs spros pa rnams kyis bzung ba'i phyir/ phyi nas skor bar bsam/ bdud rtsi lnga dang byang sems kyi lus gang bde bas khyab/ sngags kyi 'od las byung ba'i/ lha dkar po bum pa bdud rtsi'i dkar pos gang ba —230—

thogs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing / mnyam par sbyar bas zhu ba'i khu bas kyang dbang bskur bzhin par bsam ste dpa' bo'i rtsa sngags dang / oṃ hi ha ha che ge mo la shin+ta rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru hū sarba pā pa phaṭa/ zhes pa dang / u spyi ṣa brgya rtsa zla zhing / de nas sngags 'don bzhin pas gru bzhir ltab der/ skud pa dkar pos 'khor los mi mngon par dum dkri/ de nyid mgrin pa'am dpung par gdags pas kyang / rdo rje lha mos byin gyis rlobe sa cing bgegs med par byed pa dang / g.yul du yang rgyal bar 'gyur zhes gsungs la/ 'on kyang gdon drag po dang byad ma bzlog pa la sgrub pa byed pa gal che ste/ kham phor dkar po'am/ dge ba'i thod par phyi nang gi bdud rtsi lnga/ mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o ma rnams shas che bas bgang / der 'khrul 'khor gzhug bkra shis kyi skud pa'i sna ring por bzhag la/ de srin lag gis bzung dgos pas/ snod kha spyor gyi bar nas bton dgos zhes bla ma rnams gsungs/ bdag bskyed khro bo bcu gcig mdun bskyed khro bo bcu bsgom pa nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar byas la 'khrul 'khor yang bdag bskyed kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar sgom par 'dod/ de nas gzungs thag nas bzungs la sngar gyi dmigs pas bzlas pa bya/ rtse gcig tu de ltar thun bzhi'am/ drug la sogs pas ji srid mtshan ma brtan po ma byung bar du bya ba yin la/ thun 'jog 'khor lo mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ gsol ba gdab pa sogs bya'o/ /nges pa'i rtags mthong na/'khor lo phyung la mchod bstod/ dngos grub blang / yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ gshegs su gsol te dri bzang gi chus bkru bar bya la/ yang na gshegs su ma gsol bar/ 'o sbrang dang mar dang bdud rtsi lnga bsres pa'i chus bkrus nas gang la gtor ba nad dang ldan pa'ang nad med byed/ ces 'byung /de ltar na/ las tshogs kyi mchog zhi ba'i dbang du byas pa'i phyir zlog 'di nye bar mkho bas bris so/ /las g.yin dag la yang spel tshig gi khyad par dang / las bzhi'i byed pa so so spyi'i rim pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs las 'byung ba ltar bya/ khyad par drag po la hu mdzad kyi rnal 'byor gyis kha —231—

sbyor 'byed pa'i sbyor ba dang / las sngags o phaṭa che ge bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa k+ṣa hū phaṭa/ zhes pa dang hū phaṭa/ra ra ra che ge mtshams med pa lnga byed pa ra ra ra hu phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa bzhi khri sogs sngon du song ba dgos so/ /'on kyang / de ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga yis/ /yang dag gsung pas gang gsungs pa'i/ /gsod pa de yang rmongs rnams kyi/ /phyin ci log tu brtags byas shing / /phyin ci log tu bzung ba 'di/ /sred dang zhe sdang mun sgribs pas/ /skye bo rnams ni bsad byas na/ kha ni thur bstan mnar med 'gro/ /zhes de'i sbyor ba mngon shes med pas mi sgrub par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa la/thun mong ma yin pa 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs dang thun mong ba bsam gtan gyi las/ dang po la 'khrul 'khor bzhi/ de re re la yang las gsum gsum ste/ las chen bcu gnyis sgrub tshul 'khor lo so so'i ming bod kha cig gis/ rdo rje rol pa rta'i 'gros/ /yi dwags srin po gdong gi 'gros/ /gshin rje ro langs gzugs dang / ma mo rigs ldan gyi 'gros zhes gsungs pa dang / yang gzhan dag rigs ldan dang rta 'gros gnyis las gshin rje/ yi dwags ro langs srin po gdong rnams gzhan du mi bzhed cing / rigs ldan rta 'gros gnyis la gnyis gnyis su mdzad/ rigs ldan gyi 'gros che bas rmongs rings yan lag nyams pa gsum der/ dur khrod kyi ras la khrag dang dug dang ske tshes bris la/ de yang dpa' bo'i thod rlon nam bram ze'i thod pa skam por/ snag tsha dang /de rnams bsres la bya rog gi sgro rtsa'am/ rkang gis bri/ dbus kyi le tshe stong pa la sgrub bya'i ming spel tshig dang bcas pa 'dri ste/ de yang rdo rje 'dzin pas bde mchog gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom la/hu mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sngon du 'gro bas bri'o/ /tshes bcu'am bcu bzhi la sha chen dang khyi dang phag dang khyim bya'i sha'i gtor ma dang sbyin bsreg bya/ gos sngon po gyon/ kha lhor ltas te/ thod pa kha sbyar dug khrag ske che'i mar khu/ nim pa rnams kyis bkang bar bcug 'khrul 'khor gyi dbus su sgrub bya bsam la spel tshig dang bcas pa sngags zlos shing / lag —232—

pas rdo rje bzungs nas brdegs pas 'jigs par byed par bsam/ rigs ldan 'gros shes bya ba ni/ klu rigs ldan gyi 'gros te klu rnams gya gyur 'gro ba lha bu zhes bha ba bha dras bshad cing de yang /sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu ste/ che ba 'di ni lto nub kyi zur phyi ma nas g.yas su skor ba tha ma dbus kyi lho'i re mig tu 'byung / chung ba la zur bzhi'i re mig dgu dgu la sngags tshar re re rang rang phyogs kyi zur rtse nas g.yas skor tha ma rang rang gi dkyil du 'gyung ba 'di ni bla ma bod pa rnams bzhed do/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas ni rigs ldan che ba mdun nas mgo rtsom par bzhed de tha ma dbus kyi byang du 'ong ba yin no/ /'khrul 'khor bzhi pos bcu gnyis su 'gro ba'ang / rdzas dang spel tshig srog gzugs sogs kyis phye ba yin la/ de la bzhi ka'ang / gzhal yas khang rtsig rkyang sgo bzhi pa'i nang du bri zhing / sna tshogs rdo rje mi byed pa'ang yod mod/ sngags btu ba'i gzhi la de ltar yin mod kyang / 'di la gzhal yas khang yod med gdam nga yin zhing / sna tshogs rdo rje nges par dgos pas lte ba gru bzhi pa la re mig zhe dgu bya/ sna tshogs rdo rje sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa/ phyi rol khor yug gsum gyis skor phaṭa yi sngon du ming spel 'dri bar 'phags yul gyi slob dpon man ngag rigs pa dag bzhed de/ de ltar na spros pas chog go /las gsum po de rnams kyi 'khor lo gang du sba ba ni dur khrod dam ro bsregs pa'i sar ro/ /rigs lngar chung ba ni dbang dgug rmugs pa'i las byed de/ dbang dgug gro ga la gur gul dang / gi wa dang / sdong ros kyis bri/ rmugs pa dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang ske tshe'i khu bas so/ /'di la hu gnyis kyi bar du gzir ba'i le tshe stong pa la sgrub bya'i ming dang spel tshig go /dbang dgug la bram ze'i thod par gzhug sba mi dgos rmugs pa la g.yul du bsad pa'i thod pa dur khrod du sba/ rta 'gros che ba ni/ zur gyi re mig dgu dgu la mgo rang rang gi bden bral nas brtsams mjug rlung du 'ong ba ni/ dbus kyi re mig sogs la 'gyog por 'phyong ba der/ srin dbang me dang chu gnod spyin/ skyon rje dang ni rlung du'o/ /re mig —233—

stong pa bcu bdun du ming spel bya/ 'di la snga ma rnams phaṭa mi dgod la/ hu gnyis te re mig gcig tu bri/ phaṭa kyang 'god ces lugs gzhan no/ /'dis bsad sgrad dbye gsum ro ras la dug khrag ske tshe rnams kyis bri/ bris gzhi srog gzugs ni bsad pa la yi dwags gshin rje dang ro langs gang rung snod thod pa rme tshan ngan/ skrad pa rnga mo'am ma he/ dbye ba la rta dang ma he/ snod kyang de dag gi thod pa dang / de nas dur khrod dam dgra'i sgor gnon/ rta 'gros chung ba ni/ re mig dgu dgu rang rang gi zur nas mgo rtsom/ re mig re re bor ba'i spel ma/ 'di la ming spel gyi gnas sum cu so gsu ma mo/ /'di'i las ni/ phur gdab/ ma ning / gzugs brje ba gsum ste/ ro ras la khrag sogs kyis bri/ lam gyi bzhi mdor sba'o/ /thog rma ra sngags ba yis te/ de nas bris gzhi la spo/ de nas lhar bskyed pa sogs kyi rab gnas bya/ de nas dkris te snod du sgrub pa dang sba ba sogs bya ste/thun mong ba rnams gshin rje gshed ltar bya'o/ /gzhal yas khang byed pa sogs 'di rnams rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltar yin zhing / sa bhu ṭi dang g.yin du rdza rnga'i dbyibs kyi 'khor lo bya bar gsungs/ de yang kha sbyor gyi lugs la ni/ 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang po gcig pu la/ so so rdzas dang spel tshig sogs kyis dbye ba ste/ snye ma nyer bdun par/ 'dir ni 'khor lo 'di ltar dgod pa kho nas/gnor/ rnga/ dang bcing pa zhes sogs bshad do/ /rgyud du 'khor lo gcig 'a sa ma bshad pas 'di legs pa yin te/ de khu rkya 'khor lo'i gtso bo yang rnam dag la sogs pa'i nges pa la sa na/ rigasaldan gyi 'gros che bar grags pa gtso bor snang la/ 'khor lo gcig nyid kyis las kun sgrub rngu ni/de nyid las/ 'khor lo rdza rnga'i dbyibs su gyur pa/ rdo rje dang pad+mas mtshan pa/ sku rdo rje la sogs pa bsdus nas phyi rol du ri mo gsum gyis bskor te las kyi rdo rje rab tu sgoms pas dgra thams cad nges par gnon zhing / las thams cad byed do zhes gsungs so/ /'dir ni sa bcad tsam smos kyi rgyas par rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rab byed dgu pa las shes so/ khyud der sngags btu ba na/ ṛ grwa '-i zhwa —234—

bor pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis la/ 'phel ba/ gti mug /bzang po/ khyu mchog rus sbal/ chu srin/yugs sa mo/ rme ba/ 'bugs pa/ 'phyo ba/ rmi lam/ sa yi dbang phyug zhes ming ni brda sbyar bar go bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi las ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ ā li kā li'i don gyi las tshogs ji snyed pa de dag ste/ rtsa rgyud du sngags btu ba'i gzhi ā li kā li'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i don 'chad pa ste/ phal cher sngags kyi byed las bshad pa yin zhing /dkyil 'khor mi 'dra yang yi ge 'dra ba'i phyir sngags btu rnams kyi thun mong yin par rig go /'di dag bshad rgyud de gnyis 'grel pa dang bcas par blta'o/ /'dir ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas bzhag/ go / lnga pa la rdza rnga'i bcings pa'i nges don/ bsrung bzlog gi sbyor ba'i nges don/ skabs 'dir 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim sil bu sna tshog ba5 pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni skabs kyi don du snang bas 'ji/ra 'chad la/ phyi ma ni ā li kā li'i las tshogs kyi bar bar na yi ge'i nang gi bshad pa rdzogs rim mang du yod pa de dag yin pas bshad rgyud de dag tu rtogs par bya'o/ /dang po la/ sngags kyi nges don dang / las kyi nges don te/ sngags btus zin pa'i nang bshad gnyis dang / rdzarnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi nges don nam/ sngags btu bar bya ba dang / 'thu bzhin pa'i nang bshad de gsum las/dang po ni hu bzhi pa'i hu gi mtshon don mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin te/ bde stong nam mkha'i mthasaklas pa'i brtan g.yo kun la mnyam pa nyid kyis khyab pa ni/ gnas te 'dod sred med pa'i shes rab kyi cha nā das mtsho ni la/ cha gzugs kun zhes pa la cha thig le ste/ thig le dang bcas pa'i hu yig gis ni thig le 'pho med kyi ngo bo rang rig bde ba dang / phyi nang gi hu de gnyis lha thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po kun tu 'byung ba'am/ gyur pa'i sa bon te grub pa'i slob dpon karma li'i zhal snga nas/ kun tu gyur pa'i sa bon ni/ /yi ge hu gi cha gzugs can/ /mi 'gyur ba ni bde ba ste/ /nam —235—

mkha' dang mnyam gnas med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni go cha bcings pa ste/ de yang phyogs bcing pa la sogs pa'i bsrung ba'o/ /'di la shes rab dang thabs kyi cha gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba yang yin la/ brten te rdul phra rab med pa'i lha sku'i dkyil 'khor yang yin pa/ des gnyis snang dang gnyis 'dzin thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i tshul gyis bsrung ba'o/ /de yang de nyid kyis/ de nas go cha bcing byas nas/ /thams cad stong pa rten med pa/ /zhesaso/ /gnyis pa thabs kyi cha ni rgyud gzhan gdan bzhi la sogs pa dang / mngon spyod bzhi pa las/ cibyams pa'i go cha bgos pa ste/ /snying rje yi ni go cha bgos/ khres rab mtshon cha bsgom ldan pas/ /nyon mongs bdud las nges rgyal 'gyur/ /'dir shes rab ni stong nyid rtogs pa yin la/mtshon cha ni rdo rje'i ra ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud sum cu pa las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ tshen tu rnyed dka' dgod pa ste/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub sgrub byed pa/ /sa yi cha mnyam yid 'ong bar/ /tsan+dan gyis ni nye bar bku/ /dri bzang dri ldan sa la ni/ /me tog sil ma bcal bkram zhing / /spos kyi dri yis nyams dga' bar/ /bdag gi bya ba byas nas ni/ /phyogs bcing pa yang byas nas su/ /de nas rdza rnga bcing byas te/ /ri mo dgu yis legs par bskor/ /yi ge phyi mo mnyam bris la/ lken tu mnyam gzhag dgod par bya/ /der gnas pa las dpa' bo ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa/ /rim bzhin 'byung dang rim min pas/ /dbyangs dang yi ge sgrub pa pos/ /grangs de dag gi nang chud pa/ /dge ba thub par byas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nges don te/ 'di la gnyis/ sa gzhi yi nges don dang / re mig gi nges don no/ /dang po ni/ dngos grub sgrub byed zhes pa la/ las dang dngos grub sngar bstan pa ltar/ 'khrul 'khor dang bsam gto gyis sgrub ces gsungs/ 'dir ni man ngag gi rim pa phyir zlog brgyad kyis mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub ces bya'o/ /sa yi chu mnyam pa dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 'bar 'bur —236—

med pa'i nges don/ chos thams cad bden gnyis yul sems rang gzhan don gnyis/ spang blang/phan gnod/ 'khor 'das rnams rang bzhin mnyam nyid yin pa ma rtogs par byis pas sdug bsngal ba thob la/ rnal 'byor pas man ngag las 'byung ba ltar mnyam pa nyid bsgom pas/ rang bzhin de mngon du 'gyur bas/ de'i tshe zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /tsan+dan ni tshul khrims te/ de yang sems gnyisasnang 'dzag bcas kyi tshe rang bzhin stong par rtogs pa'i 'dzag med kyi tshul khrims te/ bsil bar byed pas tsan+dan dang mtshungs pa yin la/ de yang / tshus khrims tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyis ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /dri zhim po'i dris byugs pa'i sa ni zhu bde'i byang chub kyi sems 'pho med du bcings pa'i bde ba stong par sbyor bas rlan pa'i sems te rgyud gzhan las/ bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ zhes te/ nam mkha' ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang /sad pa ni gyen du bcings pa'i ming ngo / /me tog bdun ni/ pad+ma/ ut+na la/ dzā ti/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ma li kayu thi ka kā ra bī ra te/ de yang byang chub yan lag bdun mtshone pa yin te/ 'phags lam yan lag 'bras bu dang mtshungs pa/ de dngos su 'byin pas na me tog lta bu zhes pa thun mong ngo / /thun mong ma yin pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyis mthong ba'i lam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ byang chub yan lag bdun te/ me tog bsil ma'o/ /g.yin yang / yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis/ /rdo rje nyi ma pad+ma ra phyung / /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog /ces gsungs te/ zhu bde'i lhan skyes kyi dga' ba rdo rje nor bur mngon du gyur pa ni/ gsal zhing mdzes pas yang dag dga' ba'i me tog ces bya la/ nyi ma ni shes rab ma'i me tog ste/ khrag gi dwangs ma pad+ma'i lte bar phyung ba/ bdag nyid kyis dhu his btung bar bya ste/ 'di las gang zhig thob na/ khu khrag rlung gsum dag pas dwangs ma'i 'ja' lus sems dang dbyer med pa mngon du 'gyur te/ de —237—

ltar na sems de bzhin nyid la 'jug pa 'dod chags chen pos sgrub pa mthar phyin pas rig pa'i skyes bu mngon du byed tshul dang / phyag rgya'i lam la dang por slob pas kyang / 'di'i lam dang mthun pa zhig dgos shing / nus mthu de lta bu tshang pa'i bud med kyi rang byung ni 'dir me tog go /de ltar me tog gi nges don gsum ga la'ang ji bzhin ma yin pa'i sgra ste/ rim pas spyi don dang / mthar thug dang / sbas don rnams gtso che'o/ /spos kyi dri ni/ de skad du/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing /lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni/ /nges par bsregs pa de yis spos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rnam rtog gi rtsol ba la ma ltos pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi mes phung po sogs bsregs pa'i bde ba ste/ 'di yang mthong ba'i lam yan chad du mngon du 'gyur la drod thob pa na yang rjes mthun pa ni mngon du byed nus so/ /gzhan yang spyi don gyi nges don 'di dag ste/ mngon brjod bzhi par/ mnyam pa'i sems ni dri yin te/ khri/ bzhi pa ni byug pa yin/ /lus dang te'u dang tsan+dan ni/ /mnyam par gnas pa nyid yin no/ /me tog bzod pa rnal 'byor pa/ /'bad pas gtor ba yin par bshad/ /rang bzhin dag pa mar me ste/ /mnyam nyid bsgom pa gdug pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mnyam pa'i sems kyi dri/ dngos po thams cad la byug pa zhes sbyar te/ byams pa dang sdang ba rang bzhin med pas mnyam par bsgom pa dang / bzod pa yang bde sdug dang yangs dog sogs rang bzhin med pas bzod pa ste/ gang rang bzhin med par shes pas snang ba thams cad mnyam par bzod do/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa snang ba dang stong pa res 'jog ma yin par rtogs pa ni mar me dang / de'i phyir 'khor ba rang bzhin mnyam par bsgom pa bdug spos zhes brdar brtags pa ste/ 'di dag ni man ngag dam pa rigs pas rtsa bshad sbyar ba'o/ /bdag gi bya ba hū yig dang phyogs bcing ba go cha ste/ gong du zugad pa de'o/ /gzhan yang 'di yod de/ mar me dang / bsgos kyi nges don thabs kyi rgyud las 'di ltar 'byung ba yang 'di'i don yin te/ yi ge hūṃ las yang dag sgro238—

byung / /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /sngags kyi 'od zer ni rlud bcu po rnams te/ 'od zer gyi rnam par snang ba dang / sngags kyi de nyid du/ rang bzhin gyisaganas pa'i phyir/ de ni 'gyur med hu ste snying ga'i thig le dang / mi shigs pa'i sems las 'byung la/ khams kyi sgrod pa der zad pa na/ yang dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba ni bdag gi bya ba ste/ snying ga'i thig le'am/ rnam par shes pa ni bdag ces bya'o/ /'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thus/sa rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /yul dang dbang po thams cad rang bzhin med pa/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong pa'i dkyil 'khor yul dus chad pa med par longs spyod pa'i dbang po thams cad pa ste/ dbang po thams cad rang gar gnas kyang g.yo ba med pa'i man ngag gi ye shes dam pa zhes bya'o/ /'ga' zhig ltar las dang po pa kho nas tshogs drug lhug par 'jog pa ltar ni ma yin te khyad par chen po shes dgos so/ /'di gnyis ni rtsa rgyud kyis gzhung 'di'i don 'chad pa ste/ skabs 'dir mar me sogs kyi ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ ming gi don mu ra dze yi ge sa/sum gyi sku gsum mtshon zhing chosalongs sprul pha/sum rim pas thugs gsung sku yin la/ de ltar mu ra rje'i sngags ni thugs gsung sku'i sngags te 'bru gsum mo/ /de yang gnyug ma'i sngags te ldang 'jug gnas gsum de gsum gyi gdangs su rang bcas su yod pa de la gnad du bsnun na/ sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i nus pa can yin la/ 'di dngos ni ngag gi chos yi na kyang / lus ngag sems gsum dbyer med pa'i nges pas/ngag nyid la'ang sgo gsum gyis rab tu phye ba dang / rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin nye bar len pas gnas pa yin te/ de yang lwa ba'i zhabs kyis/ rdza rnga zhes bya ba la yi ge gsum ni sku gsung thugasakyi dbye bas sku gsum mo zhes so/ /gnyis pa re mig gi nges don ni/ de la ri mo brgyad dang dbus—239—

kyi ri mo ste dgu'o/ /dbus kyi ri mo ni ri mo brgyad kyi gzhi yin pa bzhin/ snang ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang rlud gi dwangs ma mi shigs pa nyid yin la/ de yang dbus kyi ri mos mtshon no/ /de yang rdza rnga'i rnam pa dbus su bkod pas rlud sngags dbyer med par ston pa yin te/ lwa ba pas/ rlud gi shin tu skor ba yi/ /ri mo brgyad pa yang dag brten/ ri mo dgu pa dbus su'o/ /zhes so/ /yi ge phyi mo mnyam pa'i don/ /slob dpon de nyid kyis/ /stong pa'i rnam pa dri med dgod/ /ā li kā li mnyam rgyas bya/ /ba byangs gsal zhe brgyad ste bcu drug tshan gsum ni mnyam pa'i don yin la/ 'og tu dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin zhes 'byung ba dang / stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pa ni stong pa bcu drug gi gzugs sam mtshon byed dri ma med pa ni/ rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi don no/ /des na stong nyid bcu drug dang / dga' ba bcu drug sbyar ba'i bde stong gi ye shes 'di rnams re re la snying rje gsum gsum du dbye bas bcu drug tshan gsum ste dmigs pa med pa bcu drug dbyangs dang / lhag ma gsal byed de/ bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can zhes pa'i nges pa'o/ /de nas dbus kyi yi ge 'chad pa na/ rnga'i don slar yang bshad de/ dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /chos kyi rnga chen mi shigs pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rnga dang / lus kyi dbus snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i rnga'o/ /dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin can ni dga' ba bzhi 'byung ba can no/ /re mig stong pa'i rnam pa can la/ yi ge re re mnyam par bkang ba ni/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis pa'i/chos kyi yi ge yongs rdzogs pa/ chos kyi rnga dbyangs gsal gyi bdag nyid gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi chos rdzogs par ston pa mtshon la/ ngag gi bya ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni mi shigs pa'i rlung yin zhing / de ni yi ge zhe brgyad po'i rten klas mazhi no/ /gong du rnga'i ming dang / 'dir don spund do/ /grangs de dag gi nang chud dang / /zhes pa'i don/ grangs de dag gi nang son par/ /chos bdag med la yang dag brten/ /dbyangs gsal las sngags mthu ba ni/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis —240—

kyi/ /dbyangs gsal gyi snying po bdag med pa'i ye shes mthu ba'o/ /zhal bzhi par ni rnam grags pa/bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa po/ de ltar btus zin pa'i sngags kyis bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i don dga' bzhi'i bde stong gi ye shes kyis bdud bzhi 'joms pa'o/ /rlung la zhon nas spro byed cing / khams gsum po ni yang dag bsdud/ rlung gi de nyid yang dag rig /su lha'i sngags zla ba'i tshe spro bsdu byed pa ni/ khams gsum pa'i rtsa ba rlung gi de nyid rig nas/ rlung la rdor bzlas byed pa ste/ yi ge dang rlung dbyer med pa sngar bstan pa ltar ro/ /de dag ni/ 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa/ /zhes pa'i don te/ rim bzhin 'byung dang rim min pa'i/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /brjod dang rjod bya'i yi ge ste/ /sgra snyan lta bu'i rnam par rtogs/ /'di la gnyis/ brjod bya la sbyar na ā li kā li rim dang rim min gyis mthu ba'i don dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog go /ā li kā lis ni khams dkar dmar gnyis mtshon la/ des na bde ba ni dkar dmar 'dus pa las byung ba'o/ /rjod byed la sbyar ba ni/ 'dir bkod pa ni yi ge min gyi yi ge'i brda'i gzugs yin pa ltar des ni ngag thams cad brag cha lta bu'o/ /zhes bstan zhing nang gi spyor bas rlung thams cad mi shigs pa dang / stong pa la thim pas sgra nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gang yin pa ste/ de ltar na/ mi shigs pa'i rdor zlas kyis drangs pa'i dga' ba bzhi'i lhan skyes kyi bde chen dang / bdag med kyi don sbyar zhing bsgom pa 'di ni rdza rnga'i re mig la dbyangs gsal bkod nas sngags thu ba'i nges don no/ /gnyis pa bsrung zlog gi sbyor ba'i nges don la/ bsrung ba dang phyir zlog gnyis kyi dang po la/rtsa rgyud le'u gnyis pa las/ rwa ba rnams ni phyogs su dgod/ /'og tu yang ni mtshon cha dgod/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid mtshon cha mnyam/ /steng du mda'i drwa ba bya/ /de ltar bdag nyid mkha' spyod du/ /gur byas 'di ni go char 'gyur/ /zhes pa la rgyud gzhan nas gsal bar gsungs pa'i nges pa ni sbyin pa'i rwa ba byin par bya/ steng du tshul khrims drwa ba'o/ /bzod pa'i phur bu 'og tu —241—

gdab ces pas/ gzung 'dzin las grol ba'i gnyis med ye shes dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dang / ngo bo thams cad rtsa bzhin gtor ba/ zang zing dang / 'gro ba la gnod pa med pa mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa 'i rwa ba dang / g.yin la gnon pa 'gog rnga 'i tshul khrims gsum ni/ gur dang mda' dra/ bzod pa gsum ni phur bu'i sa sa/zhi ste sna tshogs rngo rje'i sa gzhi'o/ /'di ni spyi don yang yin la nges don yang yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bde ba'i dkyil 'khor bzung don du/ gdug pa thams cad khyad par gyi/ /'di ni rnyed pa tsam gyis kyang / /rtag mi dgos par 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i sbyor bdag nyid kyis zla/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bskyed pa'o/ /gdug pa ni kun rtog go /rig rgyal 'khor lo bsgyur ba ste/ rnam par mi rtog pas mtshan 'dzin 'khor los gcod pa ltar gcod pas rtag pa ste/ the tshom med par 'chi ba der 'od gsal du 'gyur la/ dngos grub kun kyang 'dis thob bo/ /mngon brjod las/ phyir zlog chen mo bsrung ba dang / rdo rje kha bzhis rnam par rme tshan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yi/ /rim pa gsum pa rdo rjes mtshan/ /thams cad mchoge gi bsrung ba che/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu gsol/ /bdud dang bdud min pa yang min/ /rang gi sems ni bcing bar bya/ /rang gi sem sa ni bcings pa la/ /bdud kyi 'ju ga pa sa/ 'a yod/ /ces pa la/ phyir zlog gi 'khor lo'i rdo rje rtse bzhi pa ni dbang phyug brgyad rdo rje bzhis phye ba dang / khor yug gsum ni sku gsum dang rdo rje gsum mo/ /'dir tham rā cad mchog gi bsrung ba ni/ dngos po thamasacad stong par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis gnyis 'dzin gyi bdud thams cad bcing ba la phyi rol bdud kyi 'jug pa med de/ rang ba'i 'a de la bdung dang / bdud min te bar du gcod pa dang mi gcod pa ngo bos grub pa med cing / mnyam pa nyid kyis phyir ro/ /de ltar 'dir phyi'i bar chad sngags dang rnal 'byor gyis phyir zlog pa dang / 'khrul 'khor gyis phyir zlog pa dang / nang gi bar chad rlung gis dang /mnyam pa nyid kyis dang / ye shes 'khor los zlog pa dang / gnyis ka'i la snying rje chen po'i phyir —242—

zlog pa dang / rig pa'i skad cig gis phyir zlog pa dang / 'bras bu la bar chod srid zhi mnyam nyid kyis zlog pa'o/ /de ltar 'di ni zhal gyi gdams pa ste/ man ngag dang ldan pa dag 'doms par mdzad pa gang yin pa de bshad zin to/ /'di dag gi 'thad pa rgyas par rgyud 'grel rnams dang / bla ma'i zhabs la brten zhing rtogs par bya la 'dir ni re shig chog go /mchog tu 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal rdo rje khro bo'i sprin spro ba/ /de yi rnal 'byor gsal bar byas pa'i phun tshogs las 'dis 'gro rnams kyi/ /bdud kyi dra ba bcad nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'du bar shog /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal shin tu rgya che'i bsrung ba'i sbyor ba rnam mang po/ /mtha' dag nyung ngu'i tshig gis gsal bar bya'o gzur gnas pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo rnal 'byor 'dir gnas rnams kyis rol rtsed mdzod/ /bla mar bsnyen bkur byas gang man ngag rnams kyi rin chen mtsho/ /phal cher rgyud sde rgya chen ma mthong mthong na yang / /rgya che bsdu bar mi nus g.yin dag ma 'khru/la med/ /'ga' zhig man ngag bral te phal cher 'di na nyams/ /ma nor man ngag ldan pas bshad de 'dis kyang blo/ /zab dang rgya che dpog pa min nam rdo rje khro bo yi/ /sgrub thabs yan lag btus 'dis rgyud don dpag med gsal bar gyur/ /bsam gtan rdzun smra rnams la 'di ni shin tu rtsub pa'i sgra/ /gang yang rgyud rig mchog tu dga' bskyed rna ba'i bdud rtsi yin/ /spyor ba 'di yi yi ge ni/ /gsal po sngon chad ma mthong nas/ /rgyud gzhud 'grel bcas gzhan yang ni/ /phyogs 'di'i rdo rje can mang po/ /kun gyi rim pa'ang mthong ba dang / /man ngag ldan phyir phan blos bshad/ khri/ba pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang / /'phags pa rnams kyis 'di nyid mkhyen/ /mang thos mkhas smra mkhas pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rang phyogs rtag par rtag tu 'dzin 'dod pas/ /gya gyu'i blo gros blo ldan 'di dag rnams/ /'di la ci 'dod ci dga' spyod cing rung / zhes pa ni bde mchog khro bo rnam par rol pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag —243—
tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gnyis pa smin drug gi nya ba la grub pa'i gnas bsam gtan sdings su sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel/ shu bha mā stu sarba dzā ga snya/ /ma sgo lo/ /gnyis zhus/

dga' bde rgya mthe mo sa bya ba bzhu/gas/oX swā sti/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro rma sgyu ma bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dga' bde rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/khyab bdag rigs kun 'khor los bsgyur/ /dpal ldan bde chen phyag 'tshal nas/ /drwa ba sdom pa las 'byung ba'i/ /rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs bshad/ /de ltar yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi rim pa yis/ /de yi lam la rab tu sbyor/ /zhes rnal 'byor bzhi ldan du bsgom par gsungs la/ bdag nyid che ba'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag la bdag gis rab tu mchod/ /ces gtso bo bskyed pa rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor thams cad bde ba yi/ /rjes su spyor bas mchod byed cing / /zhes rig ma sgrub cing rjes chags brtsam pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor dang / rgyud la myang bar byed pas ni/ khren tu spyor bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes mngal gnas nas/ dkyil 'khor spro ba shin tu rnal 'byor dang / /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /ra sā ya ṇa'i bde ba 'di/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dpal dang / /nad med lang tsho bde mchog 'grub/ /ces skye mched byin sas dbang bskur mchod bstod la sogs pa ni/ rnal 'byor r+ṣa po'o/ /de la dang por 'di nyid kyi mchod chog gtor 'bul la sogs pa sngon du song na shin tu legs/ yang phyogs 'dir bar skabs su byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabasatsam byed pa'ang mi 'gal zhing legs pa'i yan lag yin la/ sgrub thabs tsam nyams su len pa la de dag ma bsgrubs kyang 'gal ba med pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams bla med spyi —245—

dang 'dra bar byas nas/ nad mchod/ su lha'am/ oX badz+ra kro dha a spo ta kuṇ+ḍali hūX rdo rdo hūX phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i zhe shil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX las byung ba'i thod pa nang 'od gsal chags thogs med pa la gnas pa'i dri chen dri chu rak+ta rkang dang byang sems te bdud rtsi lnga dang ba glang khyi rta glang po sha chen te sgron ma lnga/ huX oṃ hriXtraX haX/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i huX las byung ba'i rdo rje/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas dang yi ge rnams zhu/ huX oX hriXhriXhūṃ haX/ oX āXhuX sarba pañca a mraX ta huX hiXthā/zhes brjod/ rigs drug gi sa bon las phyag mtshan dang de las skur gyur pa'i 'phro 'dus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas rdo rje la bzhugs/ rdo rje dang zla ba snod du lhung ba las zhu ste 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dang dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/oX āXhūX ha ho hiX rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i lag pa g.yas par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drug gi dbus su/ huX oX snyaXhiXtraX haX rnams las/ rdor sems rnam snang khrag 'thung dang / /gar dbang nyi ma rta mchog go /lag pa g.yon par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor drug gi steng du/ a yig dkar po drug las/ kun tu bzang mo sangs rgyas spyan/ /kro dhī shwa rī gos dkar mo/ /mā ma gī dang sgrol ma'o/ /lce la/ na ma sna sarba budhe khyuXzhes pas mtshan pa/ oX āXhūX bdud rtsi myang / bdag nyid sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gyur/ dpral par oX/—246—

mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ mdzod skru nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis srid pa gsum po sbyangs/ rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ rang gi tshangs bug tu zhugs shing thim/ snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te zla ba'i gdan la bzhus/sa/dzaXhuX baX ho/ oX badz+ra sa mā dza huX/ oX e hre hi bha ga wān/ ma hwas kā ru ṇi ka dra khyo ho/ sa ma ya stuX/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes spyan drangs/ mahā sa ma stuX/ lan ku/nyis kyis chu sa/nyis phul/ oX za ni zo ni hūX/ bgegs thams cad bshig cing bsrung ba'i 'khor los mchams bcad/ tseX( āXhuX/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/na mo gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa me naX badz+ra ban+ta naX ka ro mi/ oX a ti bhu ho/ /zhes phyag la'i lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ /rdo rje rin wo bla na med/ /rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pa/ /rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa mu khe khyuXsarba tha khaX ud ga te spa raṇa i maX sa/ ga na khaX snya hā/ oX badz+ra khyu oX/ oX badz+ra dhu pe hūX/ oX badz+ra ā lo ke hiX.oX badz+ra ga rnye hūX/ oX badz+ra nai bi r+ya t+yāX/ oX badz+ra ā haX ra twoX na maXsarba ta thā ga te sbyo a laX rka/ ra pa na bai huX phi hā/ bo : ༷ rat+na me gha spa ra ṇa huX/ zhes phyi ma sgo da rnga / oX na maXs rba pañca rā sa ya ṇa a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ nang ra/chod dang / oX bo rnyi po rma hā su kha huX/ zhes gsang mchod phul/ 'grub na khyad par gyi bshags pa yang bya/ bla rme sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /rnam kun bstud de skyabs mchi zhing / /mchod 'os gzhan la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa las ni bzlog bgyi zhing / /bsod nams thams cad yongs su bzung / /lus can —247—

rnams kyi bsod nams dag /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag ni lus btud thal sbyar nas/ /gsang ba'i theg chen bshad pa dang / /'gro gnas bar du bzhugs slad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams gang / /bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis gang / /des ni sems can thams cad kyang / /bla med byang chub gnas thob shog ces rgyun bshags bya/ 'di ni slob dpon ku ku rā dza'i cho ga lnga pa las 'byung ba yin/ gtam bya rin chen 'phreng ba'i tshig gi zur cung zad bsgyur bar snang la/ gsang don rnam par bkod pa dang / hūX mdzad grags pa'i yan lag bzhi pa las 'byung ba sogs ni/ ha cang mang grags pas ma bkod do/ /mthar/ oX badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha dri dho me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra sto me bha wa/ su po khyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ya smo sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taX shri yaXku ru huX ha ha ha ha hoX bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñca badzi bha wa mahā sa ma yā sa twa āX oX āXhūX/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa'i mthe bong bsgrengs nas g.yob/ rdo rje thal mo'i rmad lan gsum brdab/ eX( badz+ra ga tsā mu/ oX badz+ra tu rtsi hoX zhes gshegs su gsol/ de dag ni yul dman pa dang mchog la tshogs bsags pa'o/ /oX su bhā wa shudha sarba dharma spyo bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la huX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re phye rol bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ de'i dbus su bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /dpung pa gnyis pa snol zhing se gol gtogs pa'i sgra dang / badz+ra sa mā dzaX sangs rgyas thams cad bka' bgro ba mdzad de gcig —248—

tu 'dus pa/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' la thim pa huX du gyur/ ñcaX ring po gsum sna bug nas brjod/ rang nyid khro bo thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po rab tu khros pa'i rtsa zhal mthing nag 'bar ba r+ṣa po'i 'od zer can g.yas dkar g.yon ser rgyab dmar ba ste zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭāX ga dril bu gsil pa dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang thegs pa/ gsum pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang thod pa/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs shing / yum chen kro dhi shwa ris 'byud pa/ de'i thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs tshogs thams cad bkug ste/ hūX las byung ba'i khron pa rnams su bsgyur/ oX nga ni nga hūX/ gro hā gro hā huX/gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān du rā dza huX phaṭa/ oX in+t+ra ya dzaXya ma ya dzaX wa ru ṇa ya dzaX ku be+e ra ya dzaX 'a ye dzaX nai ri kyi dzaX bhe ra ma hā ya dzaX sī shā na ya dzaX tsan+t+ra ya dzaX sur+ya ya dzaX su ra tā ya dzaX a ra pa ta ya dzaXrang gi snying ga nas khro bo bcu spros/ oX badz+ra krodha ya bi dza a huX ha na ha na huX phaṭa/oX badz+ra krodha ya mun+ta ka huX pa tsa pa tsa huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra krodha ha ya/ hṝ ba huX phya hu lu hu lu hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra krodha a rlu ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ huX tshin+ta tshin+ta huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra krodha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūX da ha da ha hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra krodha ār+ya a tsa la huX ban+ta ban+ta huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra krodha a pa ra dzi ta hāX tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kro dha tri lo kya bi dza ya hūX dhin+ta da hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kro dha huX ka ra hūX ga rdzagardza hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kro dha mahā ba la huX h+pho ṭa h+pho ṭa hūX phaṭa/ khro bo thams cad sku mdog nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i —249—

zhal gsum/ g.yas rdo rje ral gri tho ba/ g.yon thod khrag zha gas pa lcags kyu/smad phur pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de nas khro bo bdud rtsi la byil ba tho ba bsnams pa sprul te/ khro bo rnams phyogs bcu'i bgegs la phur bu'i tshul du btab par gyur/ tseX( gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba sdo ྅ phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX huX hūX badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bighān kā ya wa kā tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa / lan gsum brjod/ 'od zer rnon po 'khrug cing 'bar bas kyang/bgegs thams cad bsregs/ rdo rje gur gyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa grub ste/ khro bo bcu rnams de la bzhugs shing sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs kyis bgegs bsrung ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ oX dharma dh+wa tu su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oX shu n+ya tā dz+nyā myo/ badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de dag ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i srung 'khor te sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams so/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid stong gsum gyi yang thog tu gnas pas/ oX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra sa/ ya mi rma rnal hūX bhūX/ skad cig tsam gyis e las nam mkha'i rang bzhi myo/ chos 'byung dkar po kun tu bzang mo'o/ /de/'i nang du yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rdo rje khye / dri pa rdo pre dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa sgrol ma'o/ /de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba dkar po rtse mang pos mtshan pe gos dkar mo'o/ /de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum nga sa mtshan nga mā ma gī la'o/ /de'i steng du 'aX las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa spyan ma'o/ /der khaX las byung ba 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ suX/ las byung ba'i —250—

ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ rol mtsho ri dang bcas pas brgyan pa'o/ /de dag ni gzhi'i kho nge 'dzin no/ /de'i steng du pa las pad+ma la gser gyi 'khor lo/ de'i lte bar hu las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i dbus su hu las gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar mthing dmar ser ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa las/ rang byung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od zer 'phro pa'o/ /pha gu dang dra phyed dang shar bu dang mda' yab dang 'dod yon gyi snam bu la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'byams kyi phyi rim la/ 'jig rten pa'i lha snam dkar pos bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol pad+ma dang 'khor lo dang / rdo rje'i ra ba me dpung 'bar bas bskor ba/ phyi rol phyogs mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sa gzhi la dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba la/ phyogs skyong dang /zhing skyong dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / mchod rten dang /mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / grub pa thob pa dag gnas shing / ro dang / dum bu dang / 'thor ba dang / keng rus dang / bya dang / gcan gzan sna tshogs pas khyab pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snam bu ser po/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i ra ba sngon pos bskor ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po de'i nang gi steng 'og rnams shar dkar lho sngo nub dmar byang ser dbus ljang khu'o/ /de'i dbus su nang gi gzhal yas khang rnams so/ /skabs 'dir dbus su gdung bzhi'i re mig dgu pa byas nas/—251—

mtshams bzhi la rta mchog gi dkyil 'khore bzhi dang / dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lhag ma lnga dgod do/ /de shar du dkyil 'khor dgu byed pa ni rgyas pa yin la/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor gcig ni byas te/ dkyil du yang dag byed pa ni 'bring por 'gyur la/ lha dgu dgu'i nang gi dkyil 'khor kho na drug bkod nas mchod lha dang / bcas pa dkyil 'khor chen po kho na la bkod nas bsdus pa yin no/ dkyil 'khor dgu'am drug la bsrung 'khor tshun chod dang dur khrod dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs byed pa dang / gzhal yas khang rta babs dang bcas pa byed pa dang / rta babs med pa ste gsum po yang de dang de nyid la bltos pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mo/ /mchog gi 'khor gyi lha 'god tshul la/ dkyil 'khor dgu pa ltar na/ shar lho shar dang mtshungs pa sogs phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs par mi 'dra ba bzhi yin no/ /yang dkyil 'khor drug pa ltar gyis dbus dang phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor lnga dang / dbang ldan du rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor thob thang yin yang / bri cha la mi mdzes pas/ bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis shar gyi dkyil 'khore shar dbang ldan dang / lho'i dkyil 'khor lto me mtshams la nye ba dang / nub kyi dkyil 'khor nub bden bral la nye ba dang / byang gi dkyil 'khor yang rlud mtshams la nye ba'i nub dang / byang shar kyi dkyil 'khor dbang ldan la nye ba'i byang phyogs su 'god pa ste/ bde mchog 'khor lo bsgyur drug bzhin byed do/ /phyogs rnams su ji ltar 'god pa la/ kha cig shar du rnam snang / ltor rdo rje nyi ma/ nub tu gar dbang / byang du rta mgrin 'god pa sogs 'dug kyang / yan lag bzhi pa las/ gnyis gong bzhin/ltor he ru ka byang du nyi ma/ mtshams su rta rgyal/ dbus su rdor sems 'god pa nyid shin tu legasapar mthong ste/ 'on kyang rang rang gi mos pa'i dbang dang / gang zhig gtso bor sgrub pa'i dbang las/dkyil 'khor gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshul gyis 'god na ni/ rnam pa drug gar yang 'byung ste/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus bzhin no/ /spyi ldog nas rgyud 'di rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bor 'gyur pa yin pas/ he —252—

ru ka dkyil du bldan rdor sems mthar bton nas/ rigs bsdus la mnyam sbyor khro bo dang /rdor sems rigs rkyang la mnyam spyor zhi ba'i tha snyad byed pa ni mi legs par mthong ngo / /des na re zhig la dkyil 'khor drug pa'i dbang du byas te brjod na/dbus kyi gzhi ljang khu la/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa drug ste/ rtsig pa dang lha snam gyi phyogs mdog ni/ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga ni/ rdor sems khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor la'o/ /sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba shar/ /dkar ser nag ljang dmar ba nub/ /dkar nag dmar ljang ser ba dbus/ /mtsharmas kyi dkyil 'khe(ra gzhi dkyil 'dra/ / yang lugasagacig ltar na dkyil 'khor phyi nang thams cad mtshungs par rtsig pa dang lha snam kyi phyogs mdog dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim par byas kyang rung ngo / /pho brang dbus ma rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su zlum po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ pho brang shar ma'i dbus su zlum po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ lho ma'i dbus su zla gam chen po kha dog dmar po sgo gcig shar du bstan pa/ thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor zhing /zhing gi 'phan gdugs sogs 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su zlum po re mig dgu pa la khro bo'i rdo rje 'phreng bas bskor ba/ dbus su pad+ma dregs byed nyi zla brtsigs pa'i gdan re mig brgyad la bam chen re re'o/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs can/ ka ba dang mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /byang ma'i dbus su rin po che zur brgyad pa'i dbyibs can gyi dkyil 'khor la rin po che'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba'o/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rgya gram gyi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang sna —253—

tshogs rdo rje nyis rim lha'i gnas thams cad du pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad kyang nang le tshe dgu dgu dang ldan pa/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor ma gtogs dbus kyi le tshe la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan re re pad+ma thams cad kyi mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thod pas kha brgyan pa re re dang / rta mchog la sna tshogs rdo rje nang ma'i mtshams bzhir bum pa dang bcas par gyur/ dkyil 'khor thams cad la mtshungs par sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir pad+ma'i gdan no/ /de dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor drug po thams cad gyi gtso bo'i gnas pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan rnams la/ rang gi sems nyid dpal mchog dang po bzhugs par mdzad de/ yod pa ma yin med pa min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ khres rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa'o/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de'i tshe bde mchog ma la sogs pa bzhis/ rnam pa mang po'i 'dod chags rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ te na te te hu/ rnam pa mang po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu sprul rol rnam par sprul/ /rnam pa mang po khro bo'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas rab —254—

tu rnam par 'phrul/ ru lu ru lu hūX spyo hūX/ rnam pa mang po srog gi rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ /hūX shiñca bi sha huX/zhes bskul bas stong pa'i ngang las/ a ā i yī u ā ṛ grwa lo lī e i o au aX aX las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ skom pi phi nga ro dang rnam bcad rnams las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed kyis mtshan pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las huX du gyur/ de las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od dmar po 'phro ba'i lte bar hūX gis mashaṃ pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od 'phros rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor sprul/sems can thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rgo 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pas shin tu 'od zer 'bar bar gyur pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /badzo3haX/de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor drug kar gyi dbus su rdo rje sems dpa'i sku re re yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /oX ma hā su kha badz+ra sa twa a/ dzaXhuX baX ho su ra ta stuX/ gangs ri rdul bral me shel 'od/ /dkar mthing dmar dang ser pa'i zhal/ /rdo rje kha ṭāX mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /kun tu bzang mo rang 'dras 'byud/ /de ltar bdag nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin par gyur pa drug po rnams kyi sku la rigs drug gi lha'i rdul phra rab kyis khyab par gyur/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya rigs bdag bzhugs sa'i gnas lngar —255—

gdu gas te/ oX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ rdo rje thal mo las mthe bong bsnol/ gung mdzub rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas pa/ mkha' dbyings dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgyas/ spyi mgrin snying ste yan lag thams cad la reg ste/ oX dharma dha tu swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas huX las rdo rje 'bar ba nor bu'i rtse mo can phaṭa kyis mtshan pa'o/ /shes rab ma rnams kyi bha ga āXlas pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa phyi rol chos 'byung gi dbyibs can/ ze 'bru la as mtshan pa'o/ /sa ma ya ho sa ma ya stuX/ dzaXhūX baX ho/ oX pra be sha khu/ phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ zhes yab yum bcu gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen po'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes shing bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs/ slar 'dus te so so'i sku la thim/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab ma rnams kyi pad+ma ra spros/ yab yum bcu gnyis ka so so'i gnas su byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu bar gyur/ bde mchog ma la sogs pa rang rang gi lha mo bzhi bzhis so sor bskul ba ni/ stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthus/ /nam mkha'i nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag ces bskul bas/ byang chub sems kyi thig le drug po rnams/ hūX oX hiXsdiXhāX haX rnams su gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te tshur 'dus thim pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams su bzhengs par gyur pa ni/ de yang dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i —256—

gtso bo'i gnas su huX las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang dung dang kun da dang zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba la yid tsam dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum la rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bzhi rtsa zhal dkar ba g.yas sngo g.yon dmar rgyab ser ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dpyangs pa'i kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pas rab tu snyems pa dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ stod g.yogs dar dkar gser gyi ngang ris can dang smad g.yogs tshig gu'i na bza' gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum kun tu bzang mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor shar ma'i dbus su/ khaX ngam oX las sangs rgyas rgyal ba rtag pa rnam par snang mdzad dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba g.yas ser g.yon dmar rgyab ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis stod g.yogs chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba'i grwa dang lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mkhar gsil dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pas rab tu 'byud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lho ma'i dbus su huX ngam sdiXlas dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po rab tu khros pa'i rtsa zhal mthing nag 'bar ba chen po'i zer can/—257—

g.yas dkar g.yon ser rgyab dmar ba ste zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭāX ga dril bu dpyangs pa dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa rlung gis bskyod pa'i tshul can/ gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang /snying chen pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs pa/ spyan gsum gdangs mig dmar po las me stag 'phro ba/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma ser nag gyen du 'khyil zhing / rdo rje'i ba sbu g.yas su 'khyil ba/ zhal gdangs pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ rkan sgra gdab pa/ 6ṣi/sa g.yas cung zad bskum pa yum gyi brla la 'byud cing / g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa gshe ba 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba dang / /gar da/gu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /gu lang dang / dbang chen dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / gnyen rje dang /tshangs pa la sogs pa dregs pa thams cad zhabs 'og tu gnon pa/ yum kro dhī shwa rī sngo skya thod khrag dang ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya can gyis yang dag par 'byud pa'o/ /yang na he ru ka phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dung khragagayon gnyis bgor thod zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lha chen po'i g.yang gzhi stod g.yogs su bsnams pa'o/ /bsdu na he ru ka phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ kha ṭāX ga ser ral khar byas pa/ yum la yang kha ṭāX ga rgyab kyi phyogs su ser ral kha la brten pa khyad par gzhan rnams sngar dang mtshungs par bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /stod g.yogs gnyis dang smad g.yogs dang / /thod —258—

'phreng gsum dang sprul rgyan brgyad/ khrag zhag thal ba phyag rgya drug /de dag dpal gyi mas brgyad do/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i dbus su/ hi las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal bco lnga nyams dang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ chags pa'i nyams ldan no/ /phyag g.yas lnga bcu'i rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dbyug pa ral gri la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin zhing / g.yon lnga bcu kha dog ma nges pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa/ zhabs nyi shu rtsa bzhi g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mtshan dpe rdzogs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /yang na zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyis pad sdong gnyis 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ zhabs rgyal po rol ba'i tshul du bsgoms na'ang legs so/ /dkyil 'khor byang ma'i dbus su tra las rdo rje nyi ma/ gser gyi mdog can zhal bzhi ser ba/ res 'ga' dmar zhing yid tsam khro ba/ phal cher lhag par 'dzum pas bzhad pa/ phyag dang po gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri 'phyar zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan zhing sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum mā ma gī sngon mo rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin pas shin tu 'phyud pa'o/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ hū ⑩pa ha las rdo rje rta mchog rol ba'i sangs rgyas sku lus ljang khu/ rtsa zhal dmar ba g.yas sngo g.yon dkar/ steng zhal rta gdong ljang khu mgrin pa gtod de sgra 'byin —259—

pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang rgya gram dang ral gri dang mda' rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon bzhis sna tshogs pad+ma dang shaka ti dang be con dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang ba'i dang pos dus mtshan ma dang dpal mo/ gnyis pas zhi ba ma dang dga' ba ma/ g.yon bskum pa'i dang pos drag po dang khyab 'jug /gnyis pas 'dod lha dang tshangs pa mnan pa/ zhabs kyi mthil nas rdo rje'i rmig pa 'byin pas de rnams 'tshir bar mdzad pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ drag po chen po gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ gru mo phan chad kyi phyag rnams dmar zhing /pus mo man chad kyi zhabs rnams nag po/ rang 'od kyi yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang skya/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas nges par 'byud pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bzhugs pa'o/ /yang na rta mchog ljang khu phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang / sna tshogs pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gsum pa dang / ral gri 'dzin par byas kyang rung ngo / /de ltar na 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa drug po thams cad kyi dpral par oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' rnams dang / de rnams kyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ huX oX hiXhiXbhāX haX rnams su gyur/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs h+pha/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis/bdud rtsi'i bum pas khrus gsol zhing dbang bskur/ dzaXhūX baX hoX spyi bo nas zhugs te 'dres pas dam tshig pa rnams dang gnyis su med par thim/ dbang rtags su de bzhin gshegs pa lnga lngas dbu la brgyan/ mkha' dbyings dbang —260—

phyug ma'i phyag rgya rigs bdag gi gnas lngar gtugs la/ tseX( a bhi ski ñca maX/lan lnga/ sor mo thams cad nang du bsnol/ /rtse mo'i ngos rnams kun sprad la/ /mthe bos rdo rjes mnan pa ni/ /sna dang mig phugs lta bu ste/ /zhes pa'i thod skam gyi phyag rgya yang gnas lngar gtugs la/ huX badz+ra a bhi khiñca maX/ rin po che'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs la/ e rat+na mā la a bhi khiñca t+yāX/ rdo rje khu tshur dpral mgrin sogs gnas lngar reg oX ṭāX lan mang du brjod pa'i mthar/oX pa ṭa laX ba a bhi tiñca hūX/ oX badz+ra tu nyu ho/ zhes dar dpyangs bcing ngo / /skabs 'di dag tu/ gsang don rnam par bkod pa drug las/ rdo rje sems dpa' la rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba med de/gnas lnga byin rlabs kyi rjes thogs nyid la dbang bskur sogs mdzad cing / rigs lhag ma lnga la de'i rjes thogs su/ skad cig tsam gyis 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bsgyur bar mdzad do/ /slob dpon huX ka ras drug ka la rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbye ba dang zhu ba glus bskul mdzad do/ /de ni 'bras bur bzhengs lugs bla med spyi dang mthun pas shin tu legs par mngon la/ spyir yang rdor sems dang rigs gzhan lnga la rgyu 'bras rdor 'dzin byed mi byed kyi dbye ba yang med do/ /yang rgyud gcig gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa mnyam po la/ spyi ldog nas zhu ba glus bskul yod med gnyis ka 'gyung ba 'khor lo sdom pa sogs dang 'dra bas/ rgyu rdor sems sngon du ma btang bar yang mngon byang lnga las he ru ka sogs skyed par rung ni rung ngo / / rigs rkyang la de ltar yin pa bzhin du rigs bsdus la yang go bar bya'o/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ /rjes su chags pa rnam mang bde ba'i pad+mo rnams/ /dga' ba mchod pas gsal bar rjes su mchod byas pas/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas bde sgrub mdzod/ /e ma ho mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i rnal 'byor skal bzang mchog dgyes pa/ /rang gi dam tshig rtag la rol cig —261—

rol cig ho/ /zhes pa'i glus bskul/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi dbye bas/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas huX oX hiXhi hāX haX rnams las/ rdo rje 'bar ba: nas/thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs par gyur/ rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rigs drug gi gsung gi yi ger gyur nga rnams so so'i ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'dus te byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig par gyur pa/ 'khor lo bzhi nas brgyud rang rang gi brta ka ste rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor phyin/ yang rjes chags kyi 'od zer kyis 'gro ba thams cad sbyangs/ rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pa shes rab ma drug po rnams kyi dbang gi gnas so sor gzhal yas khang so so lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ lha so so'i gnas su rang mdog dang mthun pa'i thig le re re/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi snying po'i yi ge ste sa bon rnams su gyur/ dbus kyi rnams gtso bo drug po rnams su gyur/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo drug po so so'i mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ oX ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa āXdza huX baX ho su ra ta ghaX/ oX bhu khaX/ oX he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hiXsarba sdo yan sa ma ya mu dra pra pañja ka hūX phaṭa/ oX swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharma ni rte shwa ra hiXdza/ oX sidhaXn+tuXs ma yaXju mahā badz+ra rat+na ba ba ṭa ṭa traX/ oX ra ni nga huX/ sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa khyad par can thams cad mdzad/ sems can thams cad rgyal ba rigs drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ so so re rer gcig tu 'dus nas/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi thugs/ kar thim/—262—

'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyang rgyas par na/ rang sngags kyis 'byin pa yin yang / mdo tsam na sa bon gyis phyung bas chog ste/ dzaXbade mchog ma dkar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa dang / huX e ma ho bde ma gser mdog ling ga rdo rjes mtshan pa dang bha ga rin po ches mtshan pa 'dzin pa dang baX snang mdzad ma dmar mo sna tshogs rdo rje dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin zhing kha ṭāX ga gru mor brten pa dang / hoXslob pa mo ljang khu ga khu sa mda' 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i tshul dang g.yon sangs rgyas kyi sku gzus/sa kyis mtshan pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi la shar sogs g.yas skor gyis gnas pa'o/ /āX sangs rgyas byang chub ma dkar dmar tshangs pa'i mgo bos mtshan pa'i mda' bzhi dus gcig tu 'then pa'i tshul dang gzhu 'dzin pa / bhuX chos kyi /sde ngor lo ma dkar ser g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo dmar po dang sngon ngo/ gnyis bskor zhing g.yon dkur bsten pa/ / haXkham sa gsum rnam rgya slos ma dmar skya ga rngu ri sa mdung rtse gsum 'phyar zhing g.yon rdo rje thugs kar bsten nga / khaX 'dod pa'i dbang mo ljang khu dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma rlung gis bskyod pa 'dzin zhing gar mdzad pa rnams re mig brgyad kyi shar sogs phyogs bzhir ga phya sa skor gyis 'khod/ oX gling bu ma sngon mo/ haX/ pi wang ma ser mo/ waX/ rnga chen ma dam ra mo/ saX/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu rnams re mig gi shar lho nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ oṃ me tog ma dmar ser/ āXspos me ma dkar mo/ aX mar me ma dmar mo/ aX dri myong ma ljang khu rnams phyi'i mtshams kyi grwa bzhi la me nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ gling bu ma la sogs pa brgyad rang —263—

rang kai ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ bde mchog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug po de rnams dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg mdzes chags pa'i nyams can/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba/ 'gying bag gi tshul dang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag ni rdor sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lha tshogs so/ dza rta mgrin 'phangs mtho ma dkar mo rta gdong can lcags kyu dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ hu phag gdong ma sngon mo mche ba dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ ba/ snang ba ma dmar mo khyi gdong can nyi zlas mtshan pa'i lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ ho thal bar 'jigs byed ro langs ma ljang khu ser ge'i gdong can dril bu dang / 'od dpag med pa'i skus mtshan pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa rnams gnyis gnyis spros te/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma dang phyi rol gzhi dkyil gyi shar sogs sgo bzhi la g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi phyag mtshan la rdo rjes mtshan pa ste gtum zhing khros la/ dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa g.yas pa brkyang zhing gnas pa me dpung 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag ni rdor sems dang gzhi dkyil gyi sgo ma rnams so/ /ha sangs rgyas kun brjod ma dkar mo ljags kyis mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/ hū shin tu rgyal ma ser mo phyag gnyis thal mo rdeb pa/ tru/ kun nas bzang mo dmar mo rdo rje rtse lnga dang rin po che'i za ma tog 'dzin pa/ dha/ mi zad pa'i snod ma sna tshogs mdog nor bus gang ba'i snro~X je cho/ ༵ rngo sdo~X rdo /na lda /ma~X rdo ༵ gser rgyal ba snro dhi ༵༵ dho sku —264—

thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bruX/ zhal bzang ma dkar mo me long gi mdog can me long dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ ha/ sprin chen ma sngon mo ser ba 'bebs pa'i rdo rje'i sprin 'dzin pa/ khaX/ nam mkha'i spyan ma ser skya pad+ma mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ re mig brgyad kyi shar sogs phyogs bzhir g.yas skor gyis 'khod/oX/ gling bu ma zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i bar mchod lha brgyad dang / sgo ma bzhi po sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa rnams spros te sgo bzhi la g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ ces 'don pa spo/ phyag mtshan la rdo rjes mtshan pa zhes pa'i gnas su/ 'khor los mtshan pa ste/ de dag ni rtag pa ste rnam snang gi lha tshogs so/ /hiX go rī dkar ser cung zad zhi ba'i mdangs can zhal bzhi pa phyag brgyad kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pas tshangs pa'i mgo bzhi 'bigs pa/ sni/ tso ri dmar ser drag mo'i nyams can g.yas gung mos 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gtod pa/ g.yon thugs kar lcags kyu 'dzin pa kha ṭāX ga la 'khyud pa/ rdzoX pra mo ha dmar nag rmongs byed kyi tshul can steng zhal phag gdong can phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo dang khu tshur bcings pa/g.yas brkyang gi stabs/ dziX be+e tā li dkar mo shi ba slong ba'i tshul can/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang / ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa rnams phyogs bzhi'i re mig la 'khod/ hūX/ puska si sna tshogs pa'i mdog dang gar gyi stabs can/ rdo rje rtse lnga dang dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma 'dzin pa/ 'di'i sku mdog gi khyad par ni/ bol bzhi brla dpung dkar ba la/ lus sgrol nya bzhi dmar ba ste/ /phyag mchog lo ma sngon po 'dra/ /zhes gsungs shing / zhal ras sngon por don gyis —265—

thob brla ser skyar spund pa yang yod do/ /phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍa li sngo nag dgugs skyod pa'i tshul can rlung ras rdo rjes mtshan pa dang tri shu la 'dzin pa/ huX/ lha sma ri ser nag mi ro za ba'i tshul can ral gri dang me thab 'dzin pa/ phaṭa/ sme sha ma mthing nag rnam par g.yeng ba'i tshul can g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang dung dmar/ g.yon gnyis ba lha / ra thod dang zhags pa/ kha ṭāX ga se ral khar thogs pa rnams mtshams kyi re mig bzhi la 'khod/ de ltar khro mo brgyad po rnams ni/ zhing lpags dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ sbrul dang thod 'phreng dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad nyi ro'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /me mda' 'dzin ma dkar mo mda' gzhu thogs pa/ waX/ kha ṭāX 'dzin ma ser mo kha ṭāX ga dril bur bcas pa thogs pa/ yaX/ 'khor lo 'dzin ma dmar ser 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dzin pa/ raX/ sna tshogs ba dan 'dzin pa ljang khu ba dan la dril bu dpyangs pa 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod/ me tog ma sogs lhag ma sngar dang 'dra ba las/ khro bo'i nyams dang ldan zhing / phyag mtshan gyi skabs/ khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag ni he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams so/ /dzaX rnam gzigs ma dmar mo phyag g.yas pas pad+ma dmar po snyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ huX/ sgrol ma ljang khu pad+ma sngon po'i sdong bu dkur bsten zhing g.yas pas de nyid 'dren pa/ baX/ sa 'dzin ma sngon mo snyen ra lo dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ hoX khro gnyer ma dkar mo mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gar byed cing ut+pal mthing ga 'dzin pa rnams 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod/ huX/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje —266—

gtod cing / g.yon pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ he/ sna tshogs pad+mo ma sngo ljang 'khor lo gyen du gtod pa dang sna tshogs pad+mo 'dzin pa/ āX pad+ma'i na bza' ma gser mdog chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang pad+ma ser po 'dzin pa/ hoX pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma dmar mo rdo rje rtse lnga dang pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ re mig brgyad kyi sogs 'gre/ gling bu ma sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ chags pa'i nyams can pad+ma'i 'phreng bas klubs pa'o/ /de dag ni pad+ma gar dbang gi lha tshogs so/ /oX dbang bskur ma dmar mo rdo rjes masno pa'i rin po che'i cod pan 'dzin pa/ hruX gter ldan ma ser mo rin po ches gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ hoXrgyal mtshan mchog ldan ma dkar dmar rgyal mtshan nor bu'i tog can 'dzin pa/haX/ mchod chen ma ljang khu rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa rnams/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod/ dzaX mda' gzhu ma dmar ser mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ huX/ ral gri sngon mo ral gri dang khra ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ baX/ nyi ma dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ hoX me 'bar ma ljang dmar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab 'dzin pa rnams re mig gi phyogs bzhir 'khod/ gling bu ma sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ phyag mtshan gyi skabs/nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa sku la nor bu dmar po'i mdangs 'od 'phro ba'o/ /de dag ni rdo rje nyi ma'i lha tshogs so/ /rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor la ni/dzīX rta mchog gi g.yas su lha mo sna tshogs pad+ma ma ljang ser/ rnyaX rta mchog gi g.yon du lha mo sna tshogs rdo rje ma ljang khu/ gnyis ka'ang g.yas rang ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs—267—

pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gcig pa'i skabs/ rigs bzhi ji ltar sbyar kyang rung ba las/ las dang rin chen phyogs mtshungs rgyud sde spyi lugs kyi phyir nges par rdo rje nyi ma dang mtshungs pa yin pas zhi dkyil du byed na de ltar bya la/ yang rnam snang dang mtshungs par 'dod pa'ang yod do/ khro dkyil du byed na he ru ka'i lugs bzhin no/ /de la rta mchog khro bo gtso che bas/ hru go rī dkar ser zhes sogs la/ phyag rgya mdzad pa rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar la sogs pa'i dbus kyi rwa bzhi la 'khod/ ces pa dang / se ral khar thogs pa rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa bar/ mtshams bzhi la 'khorwa da/ ces 'dod pa spo/ /ma mda' 'dzin ma nas 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod kyi bar mi dgos/ a me tog ma sogs/ gong du bshad pa ltar las/ lha mo thams cad kyi phyag mtshan la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de ltar ye shes kyi lha tshogs mngon du bzhengs pa na/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tshul du shar du lha chen brgyad dang phyogs skyong / lhor gzhin rje dang ma mo'i tshogs/ nub tu pho nya dang klu chen brgyad/ byang du gnod spyin brgyad dang 'gyung po'i tshogs/ gzhan yang bka' sdod dam can srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po dkyil 'khor la mngon par dad pa mtha' yas pa'i tshogs rnams phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i snam bu la 'khod par gyur/ rigs bsdus kyi skabs 'dir lha mo thams cad rang snang gi yab dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i skabs kyang yod mod kyi/ mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ thams cad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rig mar byas na bsgo ma pa bde'o/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor drug ltar la 'khor gyi lha mo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma la sgo ba bzhi/ de steng gtso bo yab yum bcu gnyis te/ brgya dang so brgyad do/ /gtso bo yab yum gnyis med dang / rdor sems dkyil —268—
