'khor dang gzhi dkyil gyi sgo ba rnams rigs mthun sdom pas/ brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad du'ang bshad pa yin no/ /spyir dkyil 'khor dgu pa'i dbang du byas nas/ nyis brgya dang drug gam/ zhe gnyis sam/ drug cu'i bar gyi rnam gzhag kyang yod do/ /bla ma gong ma rnams dkyil 'khor drug tshoms la gtso bor mdzad pa rkyang par 'dug pa dang / cung zad bsdus pa nye bar 'kho ba'i phyir 'dir dkyus la drug pa'i dbang du byas te bshad pa yin no/ /'on kyang bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni dkyil 'khor dgu pa nyid bzang zhing / rta mchog la pad 'dab kyi lha mo rnams kyi dod sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje ma gnyis nyid yin pas/ dkyil 'khor so so'i 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams spangs pa nyid yin par nges so snyam mo/ /yang rdor sems dang rnam snang gi lha rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung /he ru ka'i rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs/ gar dbang gi rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung/ rta mchog gi rnams khro bo'i skyil krung ste/ brkyang bskum mo zhes kyang 'ga' zhig las 'byung ngo / /de dag ni shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mig dang gzugs phung la rnam par snang mdzad/ rna ba dang tshor ba la rdo rje nyi ma/ lce dang 'du shes la pad+ma gar dbang / sna dang 'du byed la rta mchog yid dang rnam shes la he ru ka lus dang ye shes la rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaX badz+ra puspro pu/ si pe dhu/ ā lo ki hri/ ga rnye gaX sarba pū dza spa ra ṇa huX/thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis bdud rtsi'i bum pas khrus byas shing gnas gsum du dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dang bral bar byas/ lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim/ dzaXhūX baX hoX oX budha a bhi 'khri lto oX / oX badz+ra a bhi tañca hūX/ oX rat+na a bhi khri lto traX/ oX pad+ma a bhi 'khri ñca hriX oX karma a bhi khri stsa a/ oX —269—

rat+na mā la a bhi khiñca t+yāX/ pa ṭa laX ba hūX/ oX baX badz+ra ru shu heX khaX a bhi khiñca maX/zhes rnam snang gi lha tshogs dang / hi a bhi khiñca maX/ he ru ka'i dang / khyiX.a bhi khiñca maX/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dang / bhāX a bhi khiñca maX// zhes rdo rje nyi ma'i dang / haX a bhi khiñca maX// zhes rdo rje rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ro/ /rnal 'byor gyi yan lag la/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/bzlas pa/ thig le phra mo ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ oX āXhuX a ti bhu ho/ ban+ta naX ka ro mi/gu ru pa ti a la la ho/ go phyag bya/ oX 'byung ba chen po thams cad 'byung / stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /me tog bdug pa mar me ma/ /dri mchog kun gyis mchod par bya/ /oX pa na po nu pur ra ti pu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma yo gi sirnyi huX/ zhesamachod pa sprul/ oX badz+ra put+pa badz+ra dhu pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra ga rnye/ pra tismo ho/ shrī bhaX ga wān/ kha kha ji hi/ zhes phul/ g.yin yang / tseX( badz+ra pu spre/ āXhūX/ sogs/shasta'i bar du sbyar ro/ /de nas huX zhes skad gsangs mthon pos glur blang ste/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i glu'i phyag rgya bcings/ 'di la chos kyi snying po'i gsal kha gzhung rnams na med/ kun tu bzang mo la sngags logs pa'ang med mod/ yab yum gnyis su med pa nyid kyi phyir gtso bo'i snying po brjod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen skal bzang dpal khyod bdag cag bsgrubs la rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ kyai/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag nyid bde ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i tshogs rnams bde ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul mchog grub pa bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs gar rnams bstan du gsol/ /dzaXhuX baX hoX kyi ma bde mchog bde bas bzung la rnam par sprul huX —270—

snang bar mdzad du gsol/ /a la la la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu mas slob ma bzung du gsol/ /rab tu dga' ba rjes su chags pa'i mda' gzhu rab tu phra bas rgyas btab pa'i/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sbyor ba'i bde bas myos pa'i bde bas thams cad bdag la grub par mdzod/ /rab tu bde mchog rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i longs spyod dang / /rab tu dga' ba'i dbang phyug che mchog grub pa de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu sna tshogs bde mchog rol cig hoX zhes pa ni dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i glu'o//rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu'i phyag rgya ཿngas la/ oX ru ru sgru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ne/sarba arba sidha ni snya hā/ zhes chos kyi snying po lha mo rnams kyi lce la bkod de/ oX rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ sogs dang / oX āXhūX/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ /rtag pa'i glu'o/ /dpal he ru ka'i glu'i phyag rgya dang / su bha ga sta ma hā na de bo/ ha ri mi ri/shri ye/ zhes bkod la/ huX rdo rje las kyi mda' gzhu la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje chags pa'i dam tshig dpal khyod 'dud/ /rdo rje kha ṭāX rab tu 'jigs la 'dud/ /rdo rje dril bu rab tu 'khrol ba'i dpal/ /gzigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i rgyas thob la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'o byed 'byud pas rmongs mdzad de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog brtan kun stsol ma/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog ngo —271—

mtshar brtan du gsol/ he ru ka'i glu'o/ /gar dbang gi phyag rgya dang / oX tā re tu stu re tu re snya hā/ zhes bkod la/ la lar rab tu drag cing skye bo dag la drag pa'i bud med sku ltar snang / /'gro ba mtha' dag 'dul phyir la lar rab tu snang ba'i 'khor lo phyag na bsnams pa'i sku/ /la lar nges shing zhi bar mi 'gyur sbyin pa tshangs pa'i skur yang ston par mdzad/ /la lar rab tu 'bar ba'i chags pa pas dam tshig bdag la grub par mdzod/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gi glu'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i phyag rgya dang / traX ba ba ṭa ṭa ṭa tra ṭa/ zhes bkod la/ thams cad dbang bskur dbang phyug dam pa mi zad pa yi gter mchog bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sku mchog rgyal mtshan rgyal ba bsgreng rdo rje/ /rin chen shin tu che ba bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i glu'o/ /rta'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang / hriXpad+ma ba ṭa su kha yo gī shwa ra/ hi hi hi hi hi/ zhes bkod la/ la lar mkhas pa'i gzugs kyang 'dzin/ /la lar dus mtha'i dus ltar drag /la lar rgyal ba'i dbang bzhin zhi/ /la lar rta mchog sbyor bas 'grub/ /myos byed spyad las lhag par bde ba 'dod pa'i gzugs ston pa/ 'dul ba'i dbang gis gshin rje stong las lhag par rab tu 'jigs/ zhi ba'i sku ni tshangs pa stong las lhag par rab tu mdzes/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog 'gyur de bzhin gshegs kun grub par mdzod/ /ces pa ni rta mchog gi glu'o/ /'dzub mo skyil krung du bsnol mthe bos bkab ste mdzub mo'i rtse mig 'bras ltar ston pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i glu'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo khong stong mas mo'i rtse mo bkug ste mthe bo'i rtse dang sbyar ba ni rtag pa'i 'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du 'phye mdzub mo bkug mthe bong mche ba ltar phyir brkyang ba ni he ru ka'i 'o/ /rdo rje thal mo las gung mo rtse sbyar/ mthe bong mthe chung 'dab ma —272—

bzhir byas pa ni pad+ma gar dbang gi'o/ /rdo rje thal mo las mdzub mo phyir bkug ste de'i rtse mo mthe bos mnan pa ni rdo rje nyi ma'i 'o/ /rdo rje thal mo la tra/ mthe chung srin lag mnyam par brkyang mdzum mo bkug ste rtse sprad pa ni rta'i rgyal po'i 'o/ /o 'byung ba thams cad lnga las byung / /rang las ma byung gang yang med/ /gtsang sme'i dri rtog kun bral ba'i/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems chen po/ /bdag sogs gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol/ /o na ma sarba pañca a mṛ ta ā hū rdza hā/ byin rlabs mtshan dang rgyan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol/ /o mahā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta a la la ho/ /gnyis pa ni/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /des ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / khams gsum dag la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin —273—

tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs la sogs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong ba'i mod la 'tsho ba dang / /gzigs mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi /'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams kun snang ba dang / /lus dang sems dang tshe ni rdo rje rab brtan te/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /gsum pa ni/ oX badz+ra satwa ma hā sa ma ya āXhuX spru hā/ zhes pa dang / gong du bshad pa'i 'byin sngags drug po rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla la/ bzlas pa'i man ngag ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ steng 'og gi sna rtse la bslab pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs dang phal cher 'dra la/ lnga pa snying gar dbyangs gsal bcu drug po tshan gsum bskor ba'i dbus su/ a yig zla phyed thig ler ldan pa'am/ phyag mtshan bsgom par bshad la/ mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad mnyam nyid bde ba chen po bzung 'dzin dang bral ba la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi rjes la dag pa dran pa ni/ rten ni dge ba bcu yin te/ khri/ bzhi bden pa bzhi ru brjod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rdo rje'i rwa/ /yon tan sna tshogs kun rgyas shing / /tshangs pa'i gnas —274—

bzhi khyab mdzad zur/ /chos rdzogs sum cu rtsa bdun las/ /ting 'dzin bzhi po 'jug pa'i sgo/ /rang bzhin ye shes drug dag las/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs rnams/ /rnam thar brgyad po ka bar bcas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i tshul nyid mdzes/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor chen por brjod/ /thugs rje chen po'i char phab bo/ /nyon mongs drug rnams rnam dag pa/ /de las ye shes drug 'dzin pa/ /rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gcig pu'i ngang / /rtog pas ma gos thugs rje'i bdag /zla 'dra dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams dgod bya ba/ /nyon mongs nyi shu dag par mdzad/ /ces pa'o/ /rjes thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnam grangs du ma yod kyang / gtor ma'i cho ga kun la nye bar mkho ba yin la/ de la yang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba du ma snang zhing /skabs 'dir gtor chog rgyas pa ni/ ha cang ma nges par 'gyur bas/ sa bsdus pa' tshul gyis bshad par bya'o/ /de la gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa 'dus byas/ maṇ+ḍal/ zla gam dmar po dbus su thig le lnga dang bcas pa bshams/ mchod rdzas rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/o mahā tsakra maṇ+ḍal hū/ hu o hihi hrī ha/ o ā hū/ zhes dpa' bo 'bru dgu dang / o mahā kro tī shwa ri/ sarba dra bya sho dha ya ā hu/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'am 'bru gsum gyis kha gso/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su rdo rje rta mchog ha las 'khrungs pa/ de'i mdun du lha chen po g.yas su tshangs pa/ rgyab tu brgya byin/ g.yon tu khyab 'jug /de'i phyi rol shar phyogs su phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong / lho phyogs su ma mo'i tshogs/ nub phyogs su lha chen po rnams dang klu chen brgyad/ byang du 'byung po sna tshogs pa dang 'gro ba rigs —275—

drug gi gtso bo 'khor bcas gnas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor mgron gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oX badz+ra ṭā ki nī spyo/ e a ra snyi hring hring dza dza/ zhes spyan drangs/ oX badz+ra gu hra dṛ shu ho/ sa ma ya stuX/ oX badz+ra gu rgya dṛ shu sa ma ya hoX oX badz+ra gu phya dro khyo sa ma ya phaṭa/ ces dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan/ oX i dam dhū pa/ pus/ dī pa/ ga rje pū dza spa ra ṇa ar+ghaX ba ling kha kha/ zhes mchod/ gong du nang mchod byin rlabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa las/ oX āXhuX te dzo ba ling ta ba la ba te/ gu phya sirnyi sa ma ya huX hri tha/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi sngags kyi mthar/ i dam ba ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes pa btas nas 'jig rten 'das pa la phul/ de dang spel nas/ oX 'jig rten kun gtso mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs byed drag byed stobs ldan pa/ /bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ldan snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas/ /lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang / /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo gsus 'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs bcas dang / /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang / /'gro ba drug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs sogs sbyangs byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyan dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can/ /las la brtson pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo 'khor —276—

bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /las mdzad rdo rje bran bcas pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las sgrub cing / /theg chen gsang sngags srung ba dang / /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang / /tshe dbang bkra shis spel ba dang / /bde legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ /oX āXhūṃ/ pad+ma ba ḍa ba mu kha hūX hri/ oX hri badz+ra ḍā ki ni naX/ ba ling ta pra ru huX khā hi/ oX āXhri ji hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis mgron spyi la phul nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oX thugs rje chen pos gzigs nas kyang / /sna tshogs rgyud rnams sprul mdzad pa'i/ /gar mkhan 'khor lo'i rgyud mnga' ba/ /drag po zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs gar gyi rnam par sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshon chas rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus lha yi lha mchog skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo rtsal rdzogs stobs bcu'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti bhu ho/ a la la la la ho/yig brgya lan gsum/ oX phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas par/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub pa/ /ji ltar thugs kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /de nyid spyod par bdag gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /oX khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ru mu/ zhes ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag la thim/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'am/ nyal ba na/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid dam tshig sems —277—

dpa' la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de yang huX la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du thim/ nyal ba las langs pa'am/ spyod lam la 'jug na/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag sa nyis pa'i skur gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas bzhin/ kaX haX aX tuX/ zhes go cha dged/ rat+na mā la a dzhai ṣañca huX phaṭa a ba la spa a bhi ṇi3 huX/ zhes rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar mos/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /'di'i sngags 'phreng rgyas pa bzla bar mos na/gtso bo drug smos zin/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni/ dzalaX tshu sprisno sa ma ke ma ṭa/ huX badz+ra ke lī gī lī huX/ baX badz+re ṇi sa ma ra na ṭa/ ho badz+ra kā me shwa ri traX/ oX aX ma du badz+re jiX ghuX/ oX badz+ra me ghi gu lu gu lu bruX/ oX ha shaX rang badz+re aX aX/ oX khaX badz+ra she shi ri huX huX/ oX aX ra ti badz+ra bi lā si ni tra ṭa/ he ra te badz+ra gī te te te te/ ho ra ti badz+ra ha phya ha ha baX/ oX he ra ti badz+ra khru tu be sa badz+raX/ oX badz+ra wo ā badz+ra dhu pe/ oX badz+ra ā lo ke aXbadz+ra ga rnye/ oX badz+raX ku shi dzaX oX badz+ra pā she huX/ oX badz+ra shri kha le paX/ oX badz+ra dhiṇ+ḍi hoX rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams so/ /oX badz+ra satwa shaX /oX badz+ra rat+na raX/ oX badz+ra 'a saX/ oX badz+ra 'a thaX/ haX satwa ba lbo/ dzo badz+ra ra hre sa ta/traX badz+ra pad+me dhaX/ bi shwa badz+re/ lhag ma/ oX aX ra ti badz+ra sogs la/ badz+ra gyi dod du tsakra sbyar ro/ /rnam snang gi lha tshogs so/ /huX badz+ra gu phya sirnyi pa ra ma yo gī shī ri hiX huX hūX badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri kha ṭāX gi mahā badz+ra ka pā la mā lā ma ku ṭa ru lu ru lu hā/ huX badz+ra nā rā yo ni rdzoX huX badz+ra pa twa re dziX huX badz+ra pra ha ra ma ṭa/ huX badz+ra shu la gri bhin+da ma ṭa/ hūX badz+ra ko she tshin+ta ma ṭa/ hūX badz+ra bi ma la pā she ma ṭa/ he badz+ra ra ti maX/ baX mahā ra ta badz+re hoX oX badz+ra lo tsa ne yaX/ raX mahā shrī badz+re twoX a badz+ra pulge sogs—278—

brgyad ni rdo rje sems dpa'i skabs bzhin no/ /he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams so/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta pad+mā rdzoX huX badz+ra pad+me he pad+me pad+me baX/ hoXpad+ma ma ṇi rā dzi/ huX pad+ma sne shwa ri hūX phaṭa/ he mahā bi shwa pad+ma myu rnye sijuX huX phaṭa/ hiXpad+me pad+ma huX āX/ hoXpad+me bi shwa kra mā kra mā hāX rdzoX zhes so/ /he ra ti pad+me bi la si ni thog/ he ra ti pad+ma gi te te te/ he ra ti pad+ma hā su hā sa baX/ he ra ti pad+ma dra t+ya bi pa ba dzaX/ lhag ma brgyad ni sngar dang mtshungasapa las/ badz+ra gyi gnas su pad+ma 'o/ /pad+ma gar dbang gi lha tshogs so/ /badz+ra satwa dzaX badz+ra rat+na huX/ badz+ra dharmā baX/ badz+ra karmā hoX oX pra ti badzi ni phaṭa/ oX badz+re sdi ti hiX oX dzi ra mi ni hoX oX mahā ma ho hāX/ lhag ma bcu gnyis ni rdo rje sems dpa'i skabs bzhin las/badz+ra gyi gnas su rat+na sbyar ba'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i lha phis so/ oX bi shā badz+ra dharmā gri/ oX bi shwa badz+ra satwa haX lhag ma gzhan dang mtshungs te/ rta mchog gi lnga tshogs so/ /lugs 'di'i gtor chog rgyas pa ni/ yan lag bzhi pa'i gzhung dang bla ma gong ma'i yi ge rnams las shes par bya zhing /mchod pa'i spros pa rgyas pa rnams kyang gzhung dag las shes par bya'o/ /yang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu 'gyur na ni/ gtor chog rgyas pa sogs su 'bri bar yang spro'o/ /rim pa 'di nyid kyi rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor rigs rkyang gi sgrub thabs rnams kyang rtogs par 'gyur la/ ci ste zhu ba glus bskul dang / rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbye ba mi byed pa'i lugs la mos na/ dpal mchog dang po'i sems nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dod yin la/ mngon byang lnga las 'bras bu'i lha so so bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs bsdus kyi skabs 'dir/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dbus su gang bkod pa gtso bo des/dkyil 'khor mtha' dag spro bar byas kyang rung ba yin mod rigs rkyang so so'i cho ga zhor la shes par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pas dkyus nyid legs so/ khren tu rmad byung bla med chos 'di ni/ /dus mtha'i sngags las ming yang thos par dkon/ /skye bo blo dman 'di la gtsor byed —279—

slad zab cing rgya che'i rgyud sde la/ /'jug par 'gyur snyam 'di bris dge ba yis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun bde chen gnas thob shog /ces pa dpal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dga' bde rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nye bar sbyar ba'o// //mthi laX// gcig zhus dag /

oX swa sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po ni/ /rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sku/ /mtha' yas dkyil 'khor bcas btud nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga cung zad 'bri/ /mkha' 'gro skyu ma bde mchog gi /rgyud don rtogs dka' mkhas rnams kyis/ /phyogs 'dir rgya cher bshad min yang / /rang dang rjes mthun 'gal ba med/ /'di la sa chog ni/ gzhung rnying ma gnyis las spyi dang mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang gnad phal cher gcig pas gsang ba spyi'i cho ga rnams dang 'dra bar shes dgos la/ des na/ tseX( bhu khaX/ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ snyaX( bhuX ga ga ṇa khaX āXspruX/ zhes sbyar ba dang / srung ba dang / phur btab sgrub thabs kyi srung 'khor bzhin sbyar bas 'grub pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang /mchod pa sogs 'dus byas/ tseX( nga ni nga hūX/ zhes pa rta mchog gi snying po'am/ tseX( badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa/ li hūX/ tshin+ta tshin+ta huX phaṭa kyis bsangs/ tseXrgo sā bhā wa shurnyaXsarba dharmaXsla bhā wa skyo3haX/ gis sbyangs/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po rnams dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams h+pha/ zhes spyan drangs/ tseX( kha kha ji hi sku hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta bi shā tsa/ ut+pa da a pa sma ra ḍa ka ḍa ki n+ya da ya/ i maX ba li groṇ+ḍa skye sa ma ya rak+ta stu/ ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra ya :sko swāhā/ zhes lan gsum lnga bdun gyi bar du phul/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pur+sha āXskyoX/ nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ zhes/ sogs las la gzhol zhing mtshams bcad pa'i bar spyi dang 'dra/ bsangs —281—

sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ gnas khang bhuX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang pa/ rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang bum pa bzang po dang gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes pa phyi rol tu dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba/ de'i nang du a dang bhuX las byung ba'i thod pa mtshan ldan la sogs pa snod kyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i nang du/oX āXhuX rnams las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri ro/ reg bya/chos khams kyi khyad par mtha' yas pa/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung / byed las dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed par gyur/ oX mahā kro khyu shwa ri sarba dra bya bi sho dha ni āXhūX/lan gsum/ tseX( badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā nas/ shasta āXhuX gis bar/ tseX( āXru pa badz+ra skyoX/ shag/gan+dha/ ra sa/ spa ri sha /dharma ra tu/ sogs sbyar/ oX badz+ra lha rjer ṇi ta sogs rol mo byin dbab/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin dang / rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu ba nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur go pa'i bar brjod/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ ḍak+ki ni hūX dza/ oX haX/haX gi sgra dang / huX gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung / tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i —282—

bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kyi rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi las ci dgos pa bka' stsal du gsol/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ eX( pri thi lī de wi khyuX.ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ mtshan sngags de sngon du 'gro ba'i/pa duX/ pu po dh+wa pe/ ā lo ke lha rje/ nai wi te/ shasta huX/ lha rjer ṇi ta/ sogs/bsangs sbyangs/ sting pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oX āXhuX ha ho hriX pri thi lī de ldi khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba tha khaX ud ga te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX gro ste daX ba dzi ta ye swāhā/ oX tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod gtor 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /kyai rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod cig /oX pri thi bi de lī khyo ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ sa chog gi skabs nam mkhar btegs pa'i rigs yin na'ang / sa 'og nas spyan drangs pa la yid kyis dbyer med bcug nas/ mchod gtor 'bul ba man chad byas pas 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / —283—

lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dri bzang dang dam rdzas kyis byugs/ lhag gnas mi 'tshol ba'i phyir skya thig tsam btab la/ lha'i gnas su dri bzang gis thig le dang tshom bu bkod/ sa chog sngon du 'gro na/ nam mkha'i lha phab pa tsam gyis chog kyang / lag len la dam tshig pa'ang bskyed par mdzad pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dwangs shing thogs pa med pa la/ tshom bu rnams lha so sor rang rang gi gdan ji lta ba bzhi du grub par gyur/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i gnas su hū ཾ ༷ las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nas bzang po dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor shar ma'i sa'i dbus su/ oX las sangs rgyas rgyal ba rnam par nas rab tu 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lho ma'i sa'i dbus su hiXlas dpal he ru ka nas yang dag par 'byud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i sa'i dbus su hiXlas pad+ma nas rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor byang ma'i sa'i dbus su traX las rdo rje nas shin tu 'byud pa'o/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su haX las rdo rje rta mchog nas nges par 'khyud pa'o/ /dzaXbade mchog ma nas bum pa 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa'i phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor gyis gnas pa'o/ /aX sangs rgyas nas gar mdzad pa rnams de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir 'khod/ oX gling bu nas ljang khu rnams me nas brtsams te/ sogs/ dzaXrta mgrin nas 'dzin pa rnams shar sogs phyogs bzhi la g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ de rnams nas zhugs pa'o/ /haX sangs rgyas kun spyod ma nas me dpung 'bar ba'o'i bar yang dkyil 'khor snga mas rigs 'gres te/ dkyil 'khor gyi pad 'dab bzhi zhes sogs kyi tshig bor bas 'grub bo/ /hiXlas go rī dkar ser nas gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o'i bar la/ re —284—

mig la zhes pa nas bor ba'o/ /ma mda' 'dzin ma nas dpyangs pa 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi la 'khord/ ma sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gre/ dza rnam gzigs ma dmar mo nas pad+ma'i 'phreng bas klubs pa ca'i bar la 'dor len sngar bzhi bya/ o dbang bskur ma dmar mo nas sku la nor bu dmar po'i mdangs 'od 'phro ba'i bar la'ang 'dor len sngar bzhin bya/ dzigatso bo'i g.yas su nas khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /hi go rī dkar ser sogs ra bar gyi mtshams la 'khod/ de ltar khro mo nas gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /ma mda' 'dzin ma sogs mi dgos me tog sngar bzhin/ de thams cad kyi dpral par tse(/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ o badz+ra sa mā dza / dza / ba ho/ lan mang du brjod/ o badz+ra a ku sha dza/ la sogs pa brjod kyang rung / mchod pa rgya cher bshams nas/ gong gi gnas khang byin rlabs kyi tshig dor nas/ lhag ma sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ tse( ā hu a dhi bhu ho zhes pa nas/ dam tshig mchog gzhung dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol gyi bar/rnal 'byor chen po'i yan lag gi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ mchod pas mnyes par bya/ spros pa la dga' na dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar mchod pa cung zad rgyas par sbyar kyang legs so/ /de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas/ /stobs mchog rgyal chen rnams la bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mgon gyur las rnams sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsang ba bdag gis bri/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang /—285—

khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don rgal stsal/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'gyung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ /bde mchog 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pas nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyangs phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar byon par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ 'grub na skabs 'dir sbyin bsreg 'bul lo/ /slob ma sta gon ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang /zhes sogs/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang nang dbang bskur ba dang / dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa dang / bu tshur shog shig theg chen pos/ zhes sogs spro ba bskyed pa rnams spyi dang 'dra/bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams dang / /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /sems bskyed —286—

mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i lam rnams kyis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni sangs rgyas shog /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /zhes rgyun bshags dang /'gro ba'i mgon po bdag la dgongs/ /ma lus phyogs bzhugs bde gshegs rnams/ /dus 'di nas bzung sangs rgyas bar/ /bla med bdag la dgongs par mdzode/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams nas sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la zhes pa nas/ de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par/ /bdag gi sdom pa legs par bzung gi bar yang spro na bya/ nges par dgos pa ni min zhing / spros pa la dga' na rdo rje rtse mo rnams gsungs pa ltar gyi/ sdom bzung rgyas pa byas nas sdom pa bzung na shin tu legs/ 'di'i dkyil chog rnying ma las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs/ slob dpon gyi bka' stsal ba'i tshul du byas pa ni/ don la 'gal ba med mod kyang / 'dra min du bcos pa zhig yin pa 'dra'o/ /de nas gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / mchod pa bzhi 'bul ba dang / so shing / khyor chu/ srung skud rnams spyi dang 'dra/ ku sha la/ huX a oX/ a hi a/khyiX.a traX a haX a/ sarba su pa na ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas sbyin/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /sogs/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang / rmi lam brtag cing ngan na srung ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bum pa lhag gnas ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa mchog yin yang 'grub —287—

dkasnye spru bas/ 'khor lo drug la bum pa re re dang / las bum ste drug gam/ de'i steng du bkra shis gyi bum pa brgyad bsnan pa ste/ bum pa bcu bzhi 'grub na'ang legs/ shin tu bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las bum gyis chog ste/ spyi dang mthun par bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pa las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhu las rin po che'i bum pa/ lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ bum pa gnyis yod na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su/ 'khor lo drug zhi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gdan yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su hū las rdo rje sems dpa' zhes sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi zhes pa'i gnas su/cha shas dbus ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas dang / cha shas shar ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas zhes sogs 'don pa spos nas/ gong lha sta gon ltar/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ o sarba budha sa ma yo ga ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ra/ maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa re khyo badz+ra ar+gha pra rte swāhā/ de bzhin du/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod thung gis bstod/ me tog 'phreng ba'i gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi snying po rnams ci nus su bzla/ las bum du rta mchog bskyed na/ cha shas byang ma'i dbus dang las bum du zhes lhan cig tu bskyed pas chog /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed na/ las bum du hū las byung ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag po/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum sogs srung 'khor skabs bzhin las/ smad phur pa'i dbyibs su mi byed/ lhag ma 'dra/ sngags kyang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nyid bzla/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / bzod gsol spyi dang mthun par byas/—288—

me tog dang bcas pa'i mchod yon phul bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i/ bum chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ las bum gyi lha ni bzhu mi dgos so/ /sta gon gyi lha la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yig brgya bzod gsol/eX( badz+ra u sta zhes nam mkhar btegs/ slar yang mchod pa dkyus ma dang bstod thung gis bstod/ nangs par dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ oX las byung ba'i thig tshon dkar po/ hiXlas byung ba'i thig tshon sngon po/ hriXlas byung ba'i thig tshon dmar po/ traX las byung ba'i thig tshon ser po/ haX las byung ba'i thig tshon ljang khu rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oX dī pa ta sgi rje ang ku shi rdzoX nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs dang / phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon spyan drangs te gnyis su med par 'dres/ pañca ku la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX/ nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ thig skud sgril zhing / rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po sngon du 'gro bas/ oX badz+ra sa mā ya su traX mā ti kra ma hūX/ oX āXhūX/ zhes bzlas/ oX āXhuX tho tho spyo zhes btang nas/ oX bo dhi tsit+ta sarba satwa huX/ zhes thig skud drangs/ tseX( badz+ra sa mā ya ma ti kra ma hūX/ gi sngags kyis ye thig rnams gdab par bya ste/ dkyil chog rnam gsum las/ kha lta phyogs sogs mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang yang / rtsom pa po so so'i 'dod pa yin gyi/ rgyud sde 'di'i khyad chos ma yin pas spyi dang mthun par btab bo/ /sngar las thig rdzogs par ma btab na/ de nas las thig gi cha dbye bar bya la/ sngar btab na der zad do/ /thig gdab tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /thig gi bya ba zin pa na/ ye —289—

thig la mchod bstod byas nas/ la muX zhes ye shes pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor kyi thugs kar thim/ oX badz+ra be kra a kra ma huX/ zhes ri mo bteg nas nang du 'ongs/ hi hi/zhes sgo'i rtsa thig dbye/ rdul tshon la/ oX badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya huX/ mang du bzlas/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan rgyal po rdo rje sems/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /yang dag bde ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams shes par mdzod/ /ces dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas 'bri zhing / tshon bkra brtag pa sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas rgyan dgram zhing mchod pa bshams pa ni/ me tog dkar po sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang la kha dog dkar/ /ser po mkha' las byung ba la/ /tsan dan bdug pa sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la du ru ka /spyan ras gags la ka pi ta/ /gu gul rdo rje nyi ma la/ /mar me'i 'phreng ba sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la mar me bdun/ /spyan ras gzigs la mar me brgya/ /stong ni rdo rje nyi ma la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tsan dan dri/ /rdo rje can la gur gum yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la tsan dan dmar/ /ga bur rdo rje nyi ma la/ /me tog 'phreng ba bdug pa kun/ /de bzhin mar me thams cad dang / /spos rnams thams cad ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs shing /rdo rje can he ru ka dang / rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /'di dang phyogs rma rtsis rdo rje gur nas kyang gsungs shing / khyad par kha zas la/ kha ba tsha ba rdo rjer 'bul/ /mngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lañca 'jig rten rjer/ /rta yi rgyal por thams cad dam/ /bska ba rab tu rtag par bya/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / rgyud 'di las slob dpon mchod pa'i yon du gsungs pa/ bu mo shin tu brgyan pa'am/ /de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /phul nas rin gyis bslu ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi yon/ /mi chen dag ni phul nas su/ /slar yang rin gyis bslu ba —290—

ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal sbyor ba/ /yon ni mchog gi yon yin no/ /mu tig bzangs dang nor bu dang / khren tu dkar dang ras zung dang / /de bzhin rta ni dkar po dag /pad+ma can gyi yon yin no/ /rgyal srid rin chen ltar rnams dang / /gos dang rgyan gyi tshogs rnams dang / /de bzhin mchod pa thams cad dag /rdo rje nyi ma'i yon yin no/ /rta mchog shin tu brgyan pa dang / 'ang rta rin chen bkang ba dag /rta yi rgyal po'i ye ni yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu/ dngos dang / bris pa dang /yid kyis bsams pas kyang ngo / /de'i rjes su/ lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te yig brgya mang du bzlas/ bum pa rnams phyogs phyogs su spyan drangs/ dkyil 'khor la bgegs sbyang ba/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba/ khrus gsol rnams bod snga ma'i lag len ltar spro na bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / sgrub thabs kyi 'jug tu bshad pa'i gtor chog dang 'dra ba las/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi sngags bor ba'o/ /o nga ni nga ni hū/ bdag nyid rdo rje rta mchog tu gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas rdo rje khro bo mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spros/ bgegs bskrad cing mtshams bcad par gyur/ hu bzhi pa drag tu bzla'o/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ gsang ba'i dam can so so nas/ /'du ba'i las ni ma gtogos pa/ /gsang ba nyan par mi dbang ba'i/ /bgegs dang 'gyung po thams cad kun/ /da lta nyid du so sor dengs/ /ci ste bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /rdo rje mtshon chen 'bar ba yis/ /rtag tu brlag cing phung bar 'gyur/ /hū badz+ra dz+wa la ra ya kha tsakra bi shwa hu phaṭa/ khro bo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas mtshams bcad/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas mkha' dbyingasagang ba la dmigs te/ de dag la gsol ba 'debs bzhin tu/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la —291—

bab/ /ces sogs byin phab/ de rjes nang mchod dang / sarba da bya gyi sngags kyis rdzas gzhan mtha' dag dang / nang gis gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlabs/ rigs rkyang he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor dang / rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang rigs bsdus kyi skabs 'dir/ rak+ta yang pon mas la/ o mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hū hi tha/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs rigs rkyang gzhan bzhi la/ rak+ta mi dgos/ de nas gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bshags pa 'bul ba ni/ hu gsang ldan rdo rje che ge mos/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod 'gal zhing / /lha spangs mchod la 'bus pa dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya spangs pa dang / /snod min gsang ba bsgrags la sogs/ /gnyis gsum nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /yan lag cha shas nyams dang 'das/ /'gra(da sems nges par bshags par bgyi/ /o na ma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba pā pa shurnya shurnya swāhā/ gzhan yang bshags pa'i khyad par ji ltar 'os pa sbyar bas rung ngo / /de nas lag pa byin rlabs/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' skur nas brtsams te/ las mdzad par gyur gyi bar song ba na/ mdun skyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ dbus su dpal ldan kun bzang yab yum dang / /bde mchog ngo mtshar bde ma snang mdzad ma/ /slob ma sangs rgyas byang chub chos 'khor ma/khams gsum rnam rgyal 'dod pa'i dbang mo bzhugs/ khar du rgyal ba rtag pa yab yum dang / /sangs rgyas kun brjod shin tu rgyal ma dang / /kun bzang mi bzad snod ma kun ldan ma/ /zhal bzang sprin chen nam mkha'i spyan ma —292—

bzhugs/ /lha mo'i dbus su khrag 'thung yab yum rol/ /nub tu pad+ma gar dbang yab yum dang / /rnam gzigs sgrol ma sa 'dzin khro gnyer can/ /gtum pa'i dbang phyug sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /pad+ma na bza' pad+ma'i dbang mo bzhugs/ /byang du rdo rje nyi ma yab yum dang / /dbang bskur gter ldan rgyal mtshan mchog ma dang / /mchod chen ma dang mda' gzhu ral gri ma/ /nyi ma ma dang me 'bar ba ma rnams bzhugs/ de dag kun la phyi nang grwa rnams su/ gling bu pi waX rnga chen rdza rnga ma/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri chab ma/ /mtshams kyi dbus su rta mchog yab yum dang / /sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje ma/ /phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /sgo bzhir rta gdong ma dang phag gdong ma/ /snang ba mo dang ro langs ma rnams bzhugs/ /lho dang mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /go ri tso rī rab rmongs be+e ta lī/ /puska sī dang ga tshu mo lha sma ri/ /rme sha ma ste khro mo brgyad po bzhugs/ /rim gnyis grwa bzhir 'da' 'dzin kha ṭāX ma/ /'khor lo 'dzin ma sna tshogs ba dan 'dzin/ /me tog ma sogs mchod lha bzhi dang bcas/ /de ltar gdod nas rnam dag dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad oX badz+ra sa mā dzaXhuX/ zhes sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ rta mchog gi snying po dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsangs gtor bya zhing bgegs bskrad/ huX bzhi pa'i sngags cig rdo rje gsor pa dang bcas pas/ srung 'khor gyi sgo phye la/ mahā sa ma ya stum/ lag gnyis kyis mchod yon 'bul ba nas/ mahā su kha hūX/ gi bar tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa phul/ 'khor los bsgyur ba —293—

drug gi snying po'i mthar/ a be shwa ya a/ dzaXhuX baX ho/ btanas pa dang / rgyas par spro na/'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar yang de bzhin du bya la/ mdor bsdu na/ dzaXhuX baX ho aX bhuX haXkhuX/ aX taX baX saX a ā aX aX dzaXhuX baX ho/ haX oṃ traX dhaX aX bhuX ha khaX/ tseX( taX nas baX ho gong bzhin no/ /sdiXsni ni rdzoXdziXhuX phaṭa huX phaṭa/ maX baX yaX raX a ā aX aXdzaXhuX baX ho/ dzaXhūX baX ho huX he āXhoX oX taX sogs gong bzhi no/ /oX hiXhoXhaX dzaXhuX baX ho/ oX taX sogs gong bzhi no/ /dziXtshiXhriXnyu sogs te/ sa bon sde 3 de rnams kyi mthar/ a be sha ya a dzaXhuX baX ho/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi lha rnams gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang bsre bar bya'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu slob dpon huX mdzad kyis brda' sgo dbye ba dang / brda' phyag 'tshal ba bshad pa ltar byed pa legs pa yin te/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya stuX/dzaXhuX baX ho/ oX pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ zhes phyogs bzhi nas sgo phye/ spro na/oX hūX/ zhes dbus nas sa mnan te/ oX huX phaṭa/ shar du ro/ /oX hūX a phaṭa/ lho bu(/ /oX huX a a a phaṭa/ nub tu'o/ /tseX( ha ma ra du spyin/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a a a hūX khyiXphaṭa/ byang du'o/ /'di dag bgegs bsgrad pa yang yin te/ sgo dbye ba dang 'brel lo/ /brda' sgo dbye ba'o/ /oX stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbus rnams kyi/ /skye 'gro rdul snyed gnas pa kun/ /bde gshegs lha yi dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /phyogs dus kun nas tshogs pa'i lha/ /gnyis su med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oX āXhuX a ti bhu ho/ sarba ta thā ga tā nāX ka ro mi/ a la la la ho/ oX ā ti bhu huX/ pra ti o ti bhu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya yo ga sirnyi āXhuX/ zhes pa la sogs pa sngags bdun gyis phyag 'tshal ba yin no/ /oX āXhuX rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' mdun bskyed dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ oX badz+ra ut+pa —294spo

ko3haX/ oX su bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ oX sarba sa ma yo3haX/ oX āXhuX/ mang du bzlas/ oX dharma dha tu/ oX shu n+ya tā/ stong pa'i ngang las/ stong gsum gyi yang thog tu spyo pa nas/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin du byas la/ de nas cho ga mdor bsdus tsam la dga' na/ tseX( āXhuX a ti bhu ho/ zhes pa nas/tseX( badz+ra satwa mahā sa ma ya āXhuX swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa byed pa'i bar sgrub thabs kho na bzhin byas pas cho ga ma tshang ba med la/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /nam mkha' mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oX shrī sarba bud+dhā sa ma yo ga ḍā ki ni dza la sam+bha ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang / pā duX/oX lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ zhes sogs dang / badz+ra purdze āXhuX/ de bzhi du nai wi te'i bar du sbyar ro/ /me tog la sogs pa'i tshigs bod 'di rnams/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las 'byung bas/ rgyud tshig la bcos ma byas pa nyid legs so/ /phyogs 'di'i gzhung gnyis las sbyin sreg gi skabs su 'byung ba la/ rgyud tshigs la cung zad bcos par mngon no/ /oX dpag bsam shing sogs rgyu las byung / lha yi na bza' khyad par 'phags/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog mtshungs dang / /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan sogs 'bul/ /badz+ra sa ma ye swāhā/ gzhan yang mchod pa rol mo'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs rnam pa du ma dang / /dga' ba'i glu dang dbyangs kyi mchog /bkra shis sgra kun gyis kyang mchod/ /badz+ra sha p+ta āXhūX/ shin tu rgyas pa la mos na/rdor sems lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi glu dang phyag rgyas mchod de/ 'grub na shin tu gal che la/ de bzhin du rigs drug gi glu dbyangs rgyas pas kyang mchod par bya'o/ /rdor sems lha nyer gcig dang / rigs drug gi glu —295—

dbyangs rgyas pa ni/ logs su rtogs par bya'o/ /nang mchod kyi sngon du/ tseX( āXhuX sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūX hiXtha/ zhes lan mang du bzlas nas/ spros pa la mos na/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /ces sogs gyer/ mdor bsdus na mi dgos te/ oX 'byung ba thams cad sogs/āXhuX grwahwa'i bar 'don/ oX āXhuX/ hūX oX twoXhiXdraX haX/ he pañca a mṛ ta ra sa ya na sirnyi sarba pañca sirnyi huX oX hi hri tha/ zhes mang du bzlas la/ oX ba hu bi bhi dha dzi ban san+ta ki e she sha ni she sha sa dha bi na ya/ sarba ta tha ga ta dza le pra dza le gu rba bi ga rba sarba shasba re huX/ biṣ+ṭi bi sha huX/ de bzhin tu dzi ban gyi sar/ rā ga dang / su ra ta dang / ro tra sbyar ba'am/ yang na/ rnam pa mang pos srog gi rgyud/ sogs bod skad du rdo rje'i glu blangs nas/shan ting ku sa pa khyoX ku sa na ni ku sa mahā ra ya/ baX huX swāhā phaṭa/ ces glu blang ngo / /chos sku kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /phyag na rdo rje dri ma med pa dang / /rgyal po dza dang u pa ra dza dang / /ku ku ra dza mu ti ta dang ni/ /ba hu mu ste sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / /dri med bshes gnyen rma lo rin chen mchog /gye re phyogs skyong rin chen gzhon nu dang / /go'o tshul byang de sras rnam gsum ste/ /co ro rgyal yon la gsum gzhon nu mchog /stag tsher 'jam pa'i dpal zhes grags pa yin/ /byang chub 'od dang blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / /rong ban tshul rin rong zom chos bzang dang / /yaX zhud blo chen mgo yi rigs byung lnga/ /de yang zla ba 'bar dang 'bum grags dang / /dngos grub rgyal mtshan dge slong chos rdor dang / /mgo ston dngos grub 'bum zhes rim pas so/ /dbus pa sangs 'bum kun mkhyen chos 'od dang / /mi bskyod rdo rje byang chen bsod nams 'phel/ /bag ston pa dang tshul rgyal yon po ba/ /bla chen —296—

bsod rgyal grub chen kun blo pa/ /rtsa ba rgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi snying po dang / /spro na lha thams cad kyi sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas 'bul/ yang na/ sarba pañca a rlu ta la 'a hi/ zhes btags pas kyang rung / byin rlabs mtshan dang nas dam pa bdag la stsole gyi bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /che ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa'i ma gos shing / /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i sku/ /zla ba ltar dkar rtsa dmar 'gying / /rdor sems bde ba che la 'dud/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu ma'i lam la rab 'jog pa/ /gti mug rgya mtsho zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba rtag pa la phyag 'tshal/ skyon na tu gdul dka' drag po la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyu/ra bas/ /de bzhin gshe/gas kun khro bor gyur// khrag 'thung lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal/ /chags chen rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /lta ba ngan rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sgyu ma sna tshogs tshul ston pa/ /pad+ma gar dbang la phyag 'tshal/ /yid bzhin nor bu spre sbyin pa pa/ /ser snas zil gnon 'gro ba sgrol/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdo rje nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje las ni brtson 'grus che/ /khro dang nga rgyal le lo 'joms/ /pha rol gnon pa shin tu stobs/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba che/ /snying po'i ye shes kun tu ston/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba chen po'i dbyings/ /'khor los bsgyur ma rnams la 'dud/ /'gro kun sgyu ma bde mchog la/ /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin sbyor/ /lha mo lhan cig —297—

spyod rnams la/ /rab tu dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can tshogs rnams yongs sbyangs phyir/ /rjes su 'brang ba lha mo'i sku/ /bde ba'i gar gyis rol mdzad pa/ /lha mo de rnams la yang 'dud/ /mi zad rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /bla med mchod pas rnam 'phrul ba/ /mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad la/ /tshogs gnyis sgrub phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgug gzhug la sogs las mdzad cing / /'phrin las thams cad sgrub pa po/ /sgo skyong gnas pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi rol gnas pa'i dam can tshogs/ /sgrub la rtag tu phan par brtson/ /gzhan yang dur khrod gnas rnams la/ /rab dang sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes las grub gzhal med khang / /bdud bzhi'i stobs ni 'phrog byed pa/ /srung pa'i 'khor lo bcas rnams la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /o ā hu/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dam pa grub par mdzod/ dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/mchod pa chen po thams cad grub pa mdzod/ /a la la ste mchod par 'bul a la la ste dam tshig skongs/ a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ a la la ste dngos grub stsol/ dgyes mnyam longs spyod mchog la rol/ o shrī rā ga hu/ dza / ba ho/ ru ṭa ma ṭa/ sma ra ta ti/ ru lu ru lu/ pra skyo di dza/ ṭak+ki hū dza/ hu lu hu lu/ a shu khri sdo sa dha/ da sha ya sarba/ ka ni gu ni hū hū ta gha na ghi ta bhe ghi ṭa ṭa ghi bhe ghi/ ta ghi ta bhe/ ghi ghi/ ta ta/ ta ghi ta bhe/ hen don ṭak+ki hu dza/ bhe ta/ ghi don ṭak+ki hū dzatra na a la la la la ho/ zhes thal mo brdab pa sogs la rol mo'i mchod pa'o/ /ta ghi bhe/—298—

ta lhan ta lhan/ lhan lhan/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rol mo'o/ /aX aX aX haX haX haX/ baX baX baX dhaX dhaX dhaX/ dam tshig gsum gyis brdung ba ste rtag pa'i 'o/ /khyu kong kong kong / khyu badz+ra badz+ra nur ne/༷kongaX koXng kongaX koXng /༷ hūX sbyoXhūX spyoXhūX rtso/ ru lu ru lu huX spyoX po kong kong kong / ko ko ko bhe ko ko ko he ru ka'i 'o/ /pad ma pad+ma sgruX sgo gsum gar dbang gi'o/ /traX traX traX/ ba ba ba ba ba ba ba/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ kren tra na tra na/ kren tra te/ ṭa tu ste ṭa tu ste/ tut+ta t+ta/ rgyal po ste rdo rje nyi ma'i rol tsho 'o/ /'a ṭa ska hūX dza/ lan gsum snyem pa'i 'gros so/ /tra tra tra tra tra tra tra/ 'gyur ba li 'o/ /ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba/hūX ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba huX/ rta mchog gi'o/ /ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba/ ṭa ṭa ba ṭa ṭa ba ṭa ṭa ba/ ṭa ta shin tu myur ba'i rol mo'i 'o/ /yang na/ oX ko ko pad+ma pad+ma traX traX ṭak+ki huX/ zhes rigs lnga char gyis brdung ba'o/ /bdag cag dam tshig sogs brjod/ bzlas pa yang sngags mchod kyi tshul tu bya/ dag dran 'dir byed kyi gsal kha med kyang / skabs 'di kho nar byas na legs pa yin no/ /bar 'dir sbyin sreg la sogs pa spro zhing nus na 'bul/ de nas gtor ma'i cho ga ni nang gtor sngar bzhin phul la/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma ni/ 'di skor gyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i gtor chog rgyas pa'am/ 'bring por na phyogs bzhir gtor ma gtong ba'am/ yang na ma rgyud spyi 'gros la 'gyung ba'i phyogs gtor bzhin du 'bul/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol gtor ma bzhi bsham/ sgrubs thabs las bshad pa'i gtor chog kho nas sngos te phyogs bzhir gtong / gtor ma dang sbyin sreg dang rab gnas la sogs pa'i skabs sam/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i tha mar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod de/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu zhi byed dang —299—

po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ don rnams thams cad grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi legs dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lusba'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bstan par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis:grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge sgrub bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: /dge shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon phyung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis —300—

des ni /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /be+e ḍūr+ya ltar sngon po'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni: /chu bo'i 'gram na tsar ka'i 'phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ khren tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu'i rgyal po'i phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des na: khreng rgyal drung gshegs byams pas stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni:sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni5 /grong khyer wa ra na sir drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni: /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni: mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhoms pa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag nye bar ston pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni: /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man —301—

da ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni: /lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de nas bar 'dir slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa bya/ rjes su dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang bar bya ste/ shrī su kha badz+ra satwa su bha ga twa a ha/ tse( nam mkha' skye ba mtsho ni don phyir/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de'i rjes su slob ma la dbang bskur ba bya ste/ 'dir re zhig slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam gyis chog pas/ bdag 'jug gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas brjod par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar las thams cad pa'i bum pas bsangs/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa/ bzhis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa/ sogasakyis gsol ba btab/ ā kha swe ra hu/ lan gnyis kyis mig dar dang me tog gtad/ kyai khyod ci la dga'/ bskal ba bzang la bdag dga'o/ /thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog du/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /dkyil 'khom ra chen po nyams dga' ba/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi //ba don dam dra ༵༵ gā/ma/sa ༵ sngu kau zlo/ ༵/ sarba~X / rdo / / rdo /༵ —302—

mi/ yang sngags de nyid kyis slob ma'i lag nas 'jus te nang du khrid par mos/ pad skor lan gsum/ g.yon pa'i thal mo kha phub pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa'i thal mo skan/ mthe chung mthe bong sbrel bas rin chen 'phreng ba bzung nas yol ba'i nang du 'jug par 'dod do/ /bar 'dir rgyun bshags bya ste/ dkyil 'khor rnying ma gnyis las/ thog ma med dus 'khor ba nas/ sogs yod kyang / sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas na legs par mngon la/mdor bsdu na gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags nyid byas pas/ don tshang zhing legs la zor yang ba yin no/ /gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad par yang ma yin no/ /o su ra te sa ma ya stu ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su kha/ o rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshe/gas/ /de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ /tse( mahā sa ma ya u ta ka ṭha/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par bya/ /dam tshig srungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /o ā hū/sarba pañca a mṛ ta hū/ badz+ra u ta ka hi sto/ de ring phyin chad khyod nyid kyi/ rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin gyi/ /gang zhig bsgo ba'i las rnams byos/ /nga la brnyas par ma phyed cig /gal te cung zad brnyas na yang / /dus min 'chi zhing dmyal bar lhung / /ye shes dbab pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /sku dang gsung 'phrul las mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ /de ring bdag la —303—

dbab tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ rang gi rkang mthil du yaX/ snying gar raX/ ger rnamagrin kepar laX/ spyi bor khaX/ tseX( nga ni nga hūX/ zhes rta mchog gi sngags drag tu bzlas pas srungs la/ bdud rtsi lnga dpa' bo 'bru dgus lce thog tu bzhag /snying ga'i dbus su dpal rdo ji sems dpa' yab yum mam/ gsal bar nus na/ rigs drug gi 'khore los bsgyur ba'i yab yum rnams rjes su chags pa'i bde ba'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgya ji/ dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ snying gar thim par gyur/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyi dud pas bdugs/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'brol ba dang / rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra sbyar te/ oX dz+nyā na a be sha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya huX āXhaXdzhai/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs rtag tu brjod la/ des ye shes phebs na ye shes pa bskul ba dang / ma phebs na dbab pa'i don tu/ rnam pa mang pos 'dod chags rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ /te na te te spruX/ zhes glu blangs nas/ a la la la la ho/ sarba ta thā ga ta bi tsaX tra ḍā ki ni dzā le/ zhes rtag tu bzlas sngar bzhin dbab/ rnam pa mang pos rab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /sgyu mas thams cad rab tu sprul rol rnam par sprul/ /huX huX hūX hūX/ zhes dbab/ rnam pa mang po khro bo'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /sgyu mas rab sprul rnam par 'phrul/ ru lu ru lu hūX spyo hūX zhes sngar bzhin dbab/ rnam pa mang pos srog gi rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ rnam par 'phrul hūX shiñca bi sha skyoX/ zhes kyang dab pa ste/ sku —304—

dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes 'bebs pa'i cho ga yin no/ /zhes spund do/ /skabs 'dir slob ma dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ nam mkha'i kha dog dri zhing lung ston/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa ste/ /bsod nams rim pa de bzhin shog /o pra ca badz+ra ho/stobs dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' khyod/ /'di ni rab tu bzung bar bgyi/ /o rat+na mā la asni khri do ni tru/ o gyi sngags pa'i mig thur pra yig gis mtshan pas rab rib bsal/o rdo rje sems dpa' deng nyid kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /o badz+ra tsak+ṣu dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭa/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang dag lhungs gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi rigs kyi lha/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ slob ma la skabs 'dir lha ngo ston/dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ / da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i rigs mchog 'dzin/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig ting 'dzin rjes chags dang / /gsang sngags snying po 'dzin par gyis/ /dngos gzhi slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dbang bskur ba/ 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /—305—

bdag ni rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /bdag nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du gnas shing / mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ oX huX ḍa ṭi ta phaṭa/ ces dri bzang gi chu dang / oX sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra swāhā/ zhes pas nyung kar me nang du dor/ oX sarba saX sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas ku sha dang bcas pa'i chus gtor zhing bya ba/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad shin+taX ku ru swāhā/ las bum mam nang mchod kyis bsangs gtor byas la/ rta mchog gi sngags lan gsum gyi srungs/ dpral par tseX(/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ oX phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ sogs tshigs su bcad pa gsum dang / spro na gong du smos pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs kyi shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis kyi bum pa blangs la/ til gyi gong bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /'ji/ nyid du ni blugs mdzad pas/ /bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /ces phyi bum gyi khrus so/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor khro bo bcu dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX mahā sa ma ya stuX/ lan gnyis kyis chu gnyis/ oX rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ /zhes pa nas/spa ra ṇa huX/ zhes pa'i bar tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod do/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga la/ cho ga spyi 'gros dang mthun par/ slob ma dbang rdzas gnyis ka'am/ gang rung rigs lnga phyag gnyis par bsgom kyang legs par ni 'gyur la/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rkyang gi dbang la slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bskyed cing / rigs rkyang gzhan rnams la'ang / rnam snang dang he ru ka sogs gang du dbang bskur ba'i gtso bo de kar bskyed nas/ dbang rdzas rnams he ru ka —306—

la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs lngar bskyed pa dang / dbu rgyan la rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba yod pa bzhin du/ gzhan rnams la yang dbang rdzas cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang / sngags kyi mgo 'dren mi 'dra ba dang / dbang gi las byed pa'i lha mo rnams la yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod la/ rigs bsdus yin yang dbang so sor bskur na de dag dgos mod kyi/chabs cig tu dbang bskur ba la/ la lar rigs kun gyi khyab bdag yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin dang / kha cig tu drug ka sdom pa bzhin du byas na 'dir de'i dbang du byas nas bshad par bya'o/ /bum chu rnams gtso bo'i bum pa'am/ dung chos la sogs par bsdus/ snyen ra losabasgyur ba drug gi sngags brjod/oX swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ khyoX las dpal he ru ka phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang dung khrag g.yon gnyis shor thod dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ yum kro dhī shwa ri sngo skya thod khrag dang ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya can gyis yang dag par 'khyud par gyur/ dbang rdzas kyi lha'i dpral par oX/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaXhuX baX ho/ dbang rdzas kyi lha dang gnyis su med par thim/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te de zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang / dbang lha yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dang 'dres/ bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhag cing dbang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sprul pa'i kun tu bzang mo la sogs pa 'khor lo'i bdag mo —307—

rnams dang / bde mchog ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi po rnams kyis phyogs bzhi nas khrid cing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi/ sogs dbyangs dang bos dang / o lha yi chu ni rnam dag pas/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung / /rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs ldan pas/ rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa yin/ /o badz+ra a bhi ṇi3 mi/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dam/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gam/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying po'i dpa' bo 'bru dgu'i mthar/ a bhi khiñca/ zhes btanas la chu dbang bskur/ de ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin he ru kar mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dpal he ru kar rtogs par bya'o/ /dbu rgyan gyi dbang la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs la dbu rgyan/ rtse mo lnga pa rin po che'i khang bu sgo can gyi dbus na sangs rgyas lnga bzhugs pa/dar dkar dmar gyi lag dang bcas pa/ rgyu rin po che sogs khams srog rtsa ba gang yang rung ba dang / brgyud thag sangs rgyas drug mtshon pa'i thod pa drug gi 'phreng ba can/ gtsug gi nor bu rdo rje'o/ /rnam snang la rtse mo gcig pa/ rgyu rin po che khog gcig pa/ khang bu dang / sangs kyi rgyas sku dang thod pa yang gcig pa/ rgyun thag 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba dang / dar dpyangs can no/ /he ru ka'i ni rgyu rin po che sna tshogs pa/ rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ khang pa sgo can du rang nyid zhugs pa/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba can no/ /pad+ma gar dbang gi yang de dang 'dra ba las/ nor bu dmar pos brgyan pa pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can dang / rdo rje nyi ma la dbu rgyan rtse mo brgyad pa/ thor tshugs kyi rtse rmo la rin po che 'bar bas mtshan pa la rang nyid bzhugs shing / rin po che'i 'phreng ba can no/ /rta'i rgyal po la de dag las ji ltar rigs pa'o/ /yang na rigs lhag ma rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen phyed/ /rdo rje rigs la rdo rje yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas sku/ /nor bu 'dzin gyi nor bu yin/ /zhes —308—

kyang ༅da do/ /oX spyo bhā wa: dbang rdzas cod pan mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ traX las byung ba'i rdo rje nyi ma/ zhal bzhi ser ba/ phyag dang po gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri 'phyar zhing / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ dpral par oX/ sogs 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong gi rigs 'gre/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan rgyal ba rigs lnga khang bu dang bcas pa dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang dar dpyangs dang chibacas par gyur/ oX sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen las byung dbu rgyan che/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oX badz+ra ba ra ta ka badz+ra a ra li ho/ a bhi tiñca traX/ thod pa'i ma tshan ma drug dang bcas pa'i dar dpyangs yang bcings te/ hūX badz+ra ka pā la a bhi tiñca mi/ des ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje nyi mar mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rdo rje nyi mar rtogs par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni/ spyo bhā wa:rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hruX las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyis pad+ma'i sdong bu gnyis dang / 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ dpral par oX/sogs gong bzhin las 'don pa bsgyur te/ rdo rjer gyur/ oX 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i don/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir bzung bar gyis/ /oX badz+ra satwa stuX/ a bhi khri mi spyi/ lan gsum du gsor —309—

te snying gar gto/ o thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod do/ /de ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang den pad+ma gar dbang du mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin pad+ma gar dbang du rtogs par bya'o/ /dril bu'i dbang ni/ o su bhā wa sogs/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ ha las rdo rje rta mchog ljang khu/ zhal gsum steng zhal rta gdong ljang khu/ phyag dang po gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang / sna tshogs pad ma/ 'og ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa rang ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang skya gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ khro bo khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral par o/ sogs gong bzhi la 'don pa spos te dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /o a dhi pa ti stum a bhi rdzi myu mi/ dril bu bkrol bzhi du/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyu/ra/ /zhes dril bu'i de kho na nyid bzung / de ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin rta mchog dpal tu mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rta mchog dpal tu rtogs par bya'o/ /dkyil chog rnying ma gnyis nas po gad pa ltar gyi dbang du byas pa ni de ltar yin la/ yongs nas slob dpon gyi dbang la sogs pa/ 'og tu byed pa 'di rigs la/ rdo rje dril bu'i dam tshig bzung ba yang 'dir mi byed par de skabs byas na legs pa yin no/ /ming gi dbang ni/ o su bhā wa/ sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dril bu/ o las rnam par snang —310—

mdzad dkar po/ dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos gos dang lhung bzed/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mkhar sil dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ dpral par/ sogs 'don pa bsgyur te/ rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ thabs shes sbyor ba ste 'phyud rgyas rdor dril spyi bor bzung la/ gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ /dbang po'i spyod yul gang dang gang / /bde mchog sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /o kye dpal che ge mo/a bhi 'khri ñca mi/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta ho/ gsang ming dran par bya/ de ni chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rnam par snang mdzad du mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dpal rnam par snang mdzad du rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas phan yon dang nyes dmigs sgrags pa ni/sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog kyang / /rgyas mi thebs shing mi rmongs te/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /sdom pa nyams par khyed byed na/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /de dag la ni snying ring nas/ /snying las khrag chen 'thung bar 'gyu par/ /sems can khams rnams ma lus don/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /bdag gi ngo bo rnams spangs shing / /dka' thub kyis ni gzir mi bya/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar spyad/ /'di ni phyi dus —311—

sangs rgyas yin/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /grub pa gcig pu gcig la spyod/ /lhan cig spyod dang rjes spyod sdug /sangs rgyas byang chub bla med yin/ /yan dag nyid kyis rtag tu bsten/ spro na de nas/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du ma rdza phul/ spyir gong du thun mong du maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gnyis song bas 'dir ma byas kyang chog go /bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu mnga' gsol ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus/ dbang stegs kyi steng du gnas shing mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po nas rnam par brgyan par gyur/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/hūX dang a las kun tu bzang po dkar po/ dkar sngo dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dar dang kha ṭāX ga 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rang dang 'dra ba'i sku can gyis 'khyud par gyur/ dpral par oX/ sogs gong bzhin 'don pa spos pa las/ zhu ba las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya che/ /zung cig yang dag bzung bar bgyi/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon che/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes go du brjod nas/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /tseX( mahā badz+ra huX/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya sta e ṣa stuX dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi huX/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khres —312—

rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oX badz+ra lha rnye aX bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po'i pang du gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum kun tu bzang mo lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i na tshod can du gyur pa la 'khu/da pa tsum pa dang mnyam par sbyar ba las/ yang dag pa'i bde ba dam pa thob par gyur/ yid kyi lus rten de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/tseX( mahā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya huX/ gzhung rnying ma gnyis nas spyod pa'i brtul zhugasam bshad kyang / slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes bshad pa ltar bya ste/ rgyas pa byed na'ang ma rgyud spyis rigs 'gre ba gzhan du shes par bya shing / bsdus pa ni/zi rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭāX cang te'u lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' kha ṭāX ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭāX rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭāX ga da rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /zhes so/ /rin r+sā rdo rje'i lugs la slob dpon gyi dbang ni sngon du 'byung yang / 'di cho ga rnying ma'i nang du 'jug par 'dod na skabs 'dir bya ste/ dam tshig gsum po rdo rje brtul zhugs su byed pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi rjes su spyod pa'i brtul zhugs 'byung ba ni thams cad kyi spyi 'gros yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs byed pa ni nges par legs te/ rgyud 'dir bskyed rim gyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs dang / spros bcas kyi spyod pa rtsal 'don du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas gzhung rnying —313—

ma gnyis nas mi gsal yang / spyi dang mthun par chu dbang bskur na spyi ldog nas legs par mngon zhing / gzhung rting gnyis kyi lugs la/ cod pan dang 'di'i bar lnga po 'di/ chu dbang gi rjes 'gro'i dbang zhes btags nas/ 'dir chu dbang mi byed pa nyid de'i rang lugs su ni snang ngo / /gang ltar yang bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs sngon du 'gro ba'i rol mo'i sgra dang cas te/ oX su pra tiṣ+ṭha brje swāhā/ zhes me tog dor zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang / khres rab thabs bcas snyems can gyi/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /oX badz+ra la gya huX/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /'phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oX badz+ra mā le huX/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /oX badz+ra gī te huX/ de nyid thal mo gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyis/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /oX badz+ra nirti huX/ sangs rgyas rnams la sbos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /oX badz+ra ga pe huX/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs ༄gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /oX badz+ra stso | huX/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me snang bar gyis/ /oX badz+ra āXlo ke huX/ khyod kyis —314—

rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /o badz+ra ga rnye hū/ de dag ni slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /o badz+ra ni tre a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hru/ zhes mig thur dang /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /zhes me long dang / thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /lko dril bu dang / o rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /dzabadz+ra pre sna sa ma ke ma ṭa/ zhes mda' gzhu sbyin/ o badz+ra he tu ma/ o badz+ra bha ga ra/ o badz+ra lha ṇ+ḍi.a.a deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo kun tu ni/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngar bshad tshul gyis cho ga yis/ /skye bo kun la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na rgyal ba la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces chos shad dang /—315—

mdor na 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bde gshegs/khro bo/ pad+ma/ rin chen/ las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes te rigs lnga'i sprul bshad do/ /mdor bsdu na/ me long nas 'di'i bar ma byas kyang rung la/ rigs drug gi sprul bshad kho na byas kyang legs so/ /bdag gzhan don grub las kyi tshogs/ /thun mong 'bring po mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag dgug pa dang / /sdang gnod rengs pa'i las kun dang / /dbye rmongs skrad pa'i cho ga rnams/ /thog pa med par sgrub par gyis/ /rnam shes sgrub dang ye shes sgrub/ /phyag rgya shes pa'i dngos grub dang / /thams cad grub cing grol ba yis/ /don gnyis yang dag sbyor bar gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gnas 'jug cing / /sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan rgyan/ /'phrin las bdag gzhan gnas sbyar ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dngos grub bsgrubs/ /zhesalas dang dngos grub kyi sgo nas rjes su gnang ngo / /'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las grol/ /kyai/ che ge mo/ zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bha rgyu wa su 'dod chags bral ba lta bur sdig khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /mahā sa ma ya hū phaṭa/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho —316—

ga bzhin du bri/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /lung bstan zhing gzengs bstod pa'o/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong bas kyang / /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'ching ba yongs med de/ /tshugs med thub par mi 'gyur bas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las 'das so/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tsom med/ /byang chub sems ni yongs mi spangs/dam pa'i chos la mi smad cing / /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon dag la gus par bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs te/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde ba zung / /'di ni ma byin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ khamasagasum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang / /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /der ni sangs rgyas rigs thob par/6/khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon to bdag por 'gyur/ slob dpon nyid kyang bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /de kho na nyid ston par spro na/ rgyas par g.yi rnying ma las shes par bya'o/ /mdo tsam mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing / slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid ni/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las la spyor/ /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa'o/ /de ltar de kho na nyid bcu ni —317—
