slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas par mos/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dpal ldan mgon po bde ba che/ /bde chen bde ba'i gnas na bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde stsol mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis/ /mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar mjodi/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /mi shes pa yi rab rib sel/ /gang gi byang chub bla med pa/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ bu khyod ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bde chen sbyin/ /zhes gnang ba rtsal/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur/ rjes su chags pa rnam mang / nas thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs par gyur/ gyi bar rjes su rnal 'byor bzhin/ de lta bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i rten du gyur pa/ kun da byang chub kyi sems mthe bong dang / ming med kyis blangs nas lce thog tu bzhag /ji ltar rgyal ba bde gshegs kyis/ / rang gi sras mchog dbang bskur bzhin/ /byang chub sems te dag pa'i chos/ / rtog pa'i dri ma dag par bya/ /oX mahā bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya a bhi tiñca huX/ a ho mahā su kha/ r+sā du brjod pa brjod/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sgyu ma chu zla lta bu bdag byin rlabs pa'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas so/ /yang sher dbang gi don du mkha phul nas/ gsol btab gsang dbang bzhin nam/ bcom ldan 'das zhi ba chen po sogs dgyes —318—

rdor ltar ram/ skyob pa skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs/ /sgyu ma bde mchog bdag skyob mdzod/ /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag kyang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying pa bdag la skyabs su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /bzung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /thabs g.yin gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum du dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /dngos grub mchog kyang yongs med do/ /lha mo des gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas te/ rmad byung gsang ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu rim bzhin spyod byed na/ /de nyid bde chen 'bral mi 'gyur/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rab sgrol byed/ /nang gi rtsa yi sde bor lo la/ /pad+ma zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /bha ga'i mkha' dbyings nam mkha' bzhin/ /'byung ba bzhi po dag gis brgyan/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa ni/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bde chen gzugs/ /bhañja mo k+ṣa hoyang dag pa'i rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba las/ dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas par gyur/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen por rtogs pa'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas/ bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag —319—

kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum/ de ltar yang / sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyis dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /zhes pa dang / thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rnam gsum phyag rgya gang rung las/ /gnyis med bde ba'i ye re/sa stong / /mngon sum mnyam myong rgyud la skye/ /zhes pa ltar cung zad mnyam par bzhag gokhyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bar bya/ /'dod pas log par g.yem par bya/ /rdo rje ma dang byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang btang mi bya/ /dran pa gsal bas bzung byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha bzhin rin chen tog /dbang bzhi pa thob pas shin tu rnam par dag pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang /gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang dge ba bsngo/rjes chog ni mchod pa bshams/ gong bzhin byin rlabs bya/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis phul nas/ bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo mas bstod/ spro na bar 'di bskang ba dang / bshags pa dang / dkyil 'khor lha'i bkra shis dang / spyin sreg dang / rdo rje'i glu dbyangs la sogs pa bya/ ma 'grub na mos pa tsam du byas nas/ gsol btab dang / yig brgya dang /bzod gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par byas/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs byas la/ bdag srung ba dang / smon lam bkra sdos rnams bya'o/ /rdul tshon gyi cho ga zhag sbrel mar byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol bar byed na/ o badz+ra u tiṭizhes lan mang pos ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg la/ sngags tsam gyi sgo nas mchod pa —320—

phul/ bstod thung glo ka gcig gis bstod/ oX khyod kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oX badz+ra ga tsā muX zhes gshegs su gsol ba dang / tseX( āXhuX/ zhes bdag nyid la bsdu ba lan gsum byas nas gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bsdu/ yang phur bu'i khro bo la mchod bstod dkyus mar byas nas phur bu phyung tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am/ ma grub na gtor ma btang /smon lam dang shis brjod bya ste/ de dag thams cad ni chos spyi 'gros dang 'dra'o/ /dpal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la/ slob dpon bram ze rin chen rdo rje cho ga'i rim pa sgrig lugs legs shing / zhal gsal ba slob ma dbang bskur gyi thad rnams/ bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng ngam/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang chog dang mthun shas che ba'i dkyil chog khyad par can bde ba skyed mar grags pa zhig mdzad yod na'ang / deng sang gi dbang rgyun 'di rnying ma yin pas/ gtso cher dkyil chog rnying ma gnyis dang mthun par byas la/ 'gyur khyad rnams 'gyur bde ba'i phyogs dang mthun par byas/ rgyud sde g.yin gyi rgyud tshig la bcos slad ltar snang ba 'ga' re 'dug pa/ so so'i rgyud tshig bzhin du bcos/ dkyil chog rnying ma 'di gnyis/ gsang sngags snying ma dngos yin yang / chog sgrigs rnams rnying ma bka' gter zhes phyogs 'di na grags pa rnams dang /mi 'dra bar/ gsar ma'i cho ga rnams dang khyad par mi snang ba'i phyir/ cho ga'i rim pa mi bde ba 'ga' re yod pa rnams/ dkyil chog spyi dang mthun par yang sbyar ro/ /de la slob dpon ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa drug dang / cho ga lnga pa dang / dbang mchog rnams sdom pa rang gzhan gyi don nyams su blang ba'i lag len cha tshang ba gcig yin la/ slob dpon huX ka ras mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i sgrub thabs dang / yan lag bzhi'i snang ba dang / dbang chog ste gsum sdom pas kyang cha tshang gcig tho( /de gnyis nang sel mi 'dra ba 'phran bu ma gtogs/ rkang pa gcig par snang zhing rgyud dang 'grel pa rnams dang rin chen rdo rje'i dkyil chog sogs las/ de dag dang mi —321—

'dra ba mang du snang gzhan sgrub thabs thor bu pa 'ga' re yang ni snang ngo / /ku kur ra dza dang / hū mdzad kyi gzhung rnams dang / brgya byin sdong po'i 'grel wo rnams tshig legs shing don gyi dbyings bzang ba/ mkhas grub khyad par can gyis mdzad par ni the tshom med la/ slob dpon de dang de dag gis mdzad nges pa'am/ bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā ba chen po 'ga' zhig gis de dang de'i man ngag zin bris kyi tshul du bkod pa yin brtag par bya ba'i gnas te/ tshig zur dang brjod tshul mang po zhig la/ rgya gzhung kho na min nam snyam pa yang snang ngo / /yang slob dpon de dang des mdzad pa dngos yin du chug kyang / bar bar du go bde ba'i phyir tshig sna bsrings pa yang srid de/ gang ltar yang gzhung bzang por ni snang ngo / /'di la bod kyi mkhas pas lag len gsal por sbyar ba'i yi ge gzhan nyung bar snang zhing / phyis byon gyi mkhas grub 'ga' zhig gis mdzad pa mthong yang / rgyas ches pa dang go dka' bar gyur pas dus mtha'i 'gro ba la phan chung bar snang ngo / /des na 'di/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas tshig zor yang zhing / don tshang la ngag 'don lhan thabs sogs la ma ltos par bklags chog tu sbyar ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud thams cad kyi/ /rtsa bar grags pa'i chos mchog 'di/ khren tu dar bar gyur cig snyam/ /lhag bsam dag pas 'di bris te/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba ni/ /ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar pos/ /'gro ba'i mi shes mun bsal nas/ /bde chen lam bzang mthong bar shog/ // ma ṅga la/ zhus dag /—322—

rgya ma cen zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/oX su sti/ bde legs su gyur cig /dpal ldan phyogs kun dge legs spyin mdzad pa/ /mkha' dbyings rab gang rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ khren tu dges pa'i spyan ni rab phye nas/ kha cig me tog char 'bebs rnga chen brdung / /gzhan dag bkra shis glu len mchod pa byed/ khro bo lha mor bcas pas bar chad bsrung / khyed la gnas 'dir rtag tu dge legs stso'i// /dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang mchog gis 'gro ba smin zhing grol bar mdzad pa rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'khor lo'i mgon po dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams la dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des/ skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye ci/ tha/mas cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur rgyal ba dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'khor lo sdom/ rnal 'byor ma dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dang / /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub shā bā ri/ /lha yi pa dang da ri khe ṅge pa/ /rdo rje dril bu pa dang rus sbal zhabs/ /dzā lan+ta ra nag po spyod pa dang / /gu phya rnam rgyal zhabs dang ti snyi pa/ /nā ro pa sogs bla ma dam pa la/ /byin rlabs dge legs mtshan ma ci mnga' bas/ /bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar —323—

ji lta ba/ /'dzin zhing rim gnyis lam gyis mchog grub nas/ /gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /thar pa chen po gzhal yas khang gi snying po'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa la/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan la/ mchog tu mdzes pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu 'bar ba in+d+ra nī li'i lhun po la nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer 'bum gyis 'khrud pa lta bu dbang phyug brgyad dang yon tan brgyad dang yan lag bdun dang ro myang brgyad la sogs pa yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i ston pa phun sum tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i//he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+ma ra rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bde ba'i mchog gyur he ru ka dpal dang / /bde ster shes rab ma mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bde stong dpyid thig zung 'jug sbyor ba'i mchog /bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byore rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /thub pa wo po'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snying po rab dang mchog tu gyur pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug gi gtso bo grub pa'i rtog pa rmad du byung ba/ dpa' bo chen po bklags pas 'grub pa/—324—

thams cad du gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdod nas grub brgyud thams cad kyi bla ma/ dpal he ru ka rnal 'o byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / zugad pa'i rgyud dang / yan lag gi rgyud dang bcas pa la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des/skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'bod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig /bde ba che mchog rab 'byams rtogs pa dang / /dbang dang rim gnyis mtha' yas rab ston pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi snying po ni/ /dpal ldan 'khore lo sdom pa'i rgyud sde la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byore rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrub pa po la dngos sgrub rtsol zhing gtso bo nyid dang thugs kyi ye shes mi gnyis pa/ dpa' bo chen po gzugs rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po tshor ba rdo rje dang /dpa' bo r+ṣa po 'du shes rdo rje dang / dpa' bo wo po 'du byed rdo rje dang / dpa' bo wo po rnam shes rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po mig rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po rna ba rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po sna rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po lce rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po lus rdo rje dang / dpa' bo chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug rdo rje dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo lhung byed ma dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo gsod byed ma dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'gugs byed ma dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang / rnal 'byor ma chen po pad+ma dra ba can dang / gzhan yang rab —325—

'byams zhing kun gyi rdul snyed dang mnyam pa'i yum bzhi dang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang / ma mo rnams dang / go cha'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su gnas pa thams cad kyang hu dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa mdzes pa'i gar sna tshogs pa byed cing / rang gi dam tshig dang 'gyud pa dang tsum pa sogs snying rje chen po'i nyams yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang / rtsa dang / khams dang / rlud byin gyis rlabs nas/ lam gyi grogs mdzad pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyis dpal la gnas pa'i lhag par skyong bar gyur cigaphung khams skye mched byin gyis rlobs pa'i lha/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs lha rnams dang / /bgegs kun 'joms shing ting 'dzin dam pa las/ /g.yo ba med mdzad go che'i lha rnams la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo'i phyogs bzhi'i zhal la gzigs/ /pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /dam tshig can 'dus brtse ba'i rjes bzung nas/ /yon tan ma lus skyed pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /bsam pa tsam gyis bde ster yul bzhi la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba —326—

des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /byang chub sems dang tsan dan dri chen gur gum chus/ /gang ba'i snod bzhis dpa' bo'i zhal la reg par spyod/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /ye shes bdud rtsi lnga yis rnam gang ba/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dam tshig snod/ /rab tu bsten na ye shes lus su 'gyur/ /byang sems 'phel ba'i dngos grub spyin rnams la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'khyams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng / /gnas la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /thugs kyi rigs gyur pho nya gsum 'dus las/ /'od gsal dga' ston spyin mdzad nam mkha' spyod/ /gnas dang nye gnas dpa' bo lha mo la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa steng gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+ma'i 'phreng / /zhing la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mor gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra —327—

shis shog /gsung gi rigs gyur pho nya gsum 'dus las/ /'od gsal dga' ston sbyin mdzad sa steng spyod/ /zhing dang 'dun rtog nye bar bcas pa yi/ /dpa' bo lha mor dge legs ci mnga' bas/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa 'og gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i 'phreng / /'du la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /sku'i ris sa gyur pho nya gsum 'dus las/ /'od gsal dga' ston spyin mdzad sa 'og spyod/ /'du dang dur khrod nye bar bcas pa yi/ /dpa' bo lha mor dge legs ci mnga' bas/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshams rnams su/ ji gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'phrog gzugs gnyis ldan/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rta yi rgyal po'i rigs mchog las kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub/ /lam gyi bar gcod gdug pa thams cad 'dul/ /rab song gnas brgyad pho nyas bde ster ma/ /rdo rje ma mor dge legs ci mnga' bas/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /—328—

de ltar dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi bzhugs pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi la gnas pa'i ri'i rgyal po lhun po rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i steng na rdo rje rin po che'i gzhal yas khang rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i dpag tshad bye bar khyab pa/ dril bu dpyangs pa'i sgra las yan lag dgu dang ldan pa/rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gzhom du med pa'i dbyangs la 'jug pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ srung ba'i 'khor los bskor ba'i phyir rol sna tshogs pa'i lha dang / klu dang / phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / 'byung po rnams dang mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro h+pha zhes pa dang / a la la'i sgra sgrogs pa/dril bu dang / cang te'u'i sgra dang mchod rdzas rnams kyis gang ba'i mchog tu rmad du byung ba chen po dang bcas pa la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des/skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang / yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dbang po sogs/ byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i steng / /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas ni rab tu brgyan gyur cig /mu tig nyi zla rin chen gser gyi dril bu dpyangs/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs/ /ri dwags dang bcas mdzes pa'i ba dan bcu drug 'phyar/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bcu gnyis sa yi rang —329—

bzhin 'khor lo lnga/ /rab yangs pho brang dam pa gzhal med khang / /rin chen rgyan rnams kun ldan snang byed gtso/ /bcom ldan rtag pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la/ /dge legs man ni ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig yongs bskor dur khrod brgyan rnams su/ phyogs skyong brgyad dang shing chen brgyad ni gnas pa la/ /gdong brnyan dang ldan zhing skyong brgyad ni gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad rab 'bar zhing / /byang chub sems kyi sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus gyur la/ /dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i chu chen brgyad 'bab cing / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gang / /sha za srin po 'byung po'i tshogs kyi nyer bsten pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur/ /bla res kun nas bris shing mda' yi dra bar ldan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i kun nas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rnam shes brgyad kyi srid pa spangs pa las/ /dur khrod brgyad po nyer spyod yongs rdzogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun mchod cing las kun sgrub/ /sgrub la zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las/ /spyin mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag yas kyis/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor —330—

rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi yi bdag nyid can/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ye shes me lcer bcas/ /rdo rje bsrung 'khor rab tu brtan pa la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byore rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis rtse(ga /'di la spro na rdzogs pa 'di byas la/ de nas gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' las byung ba'i bkra shis zhig gi thog drangs te ci rigs shig bya'o/ /mi spro na tshig lhug rnams bor te tshigs bcad kho nas kyang rung ngo / /zhes bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i bkra shis dang spel mar sbyar ba 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di yang / tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum la snron gyi zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi la sbyar ba'o// //zhus dag bkra shis//—331—

rgya ma skrun zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oX swa sti/ oX ra bas bsangs/ oX swa bhas sbyadas/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yaX las rlung / raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhūX ha hoXsdiX na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa/ ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga na tsa kra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūX/ na mo thabs dang : nas 'di nyid dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams: 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong bsrung ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams: dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje'i sbun grogs rnams/ oX mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang / /mos gus gzhom med pho brang na/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thibs/ /'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ /tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /mchog dang thun —332—

mong dngos grub stsol/ /gu ru de ba/ sogs/ stug po'i zhing khams 'jig pa med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i 'bum sde'i dbus/ /'khor lo sdom pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'dod chags rdo rje 'od dpag med/ rnam 'phrul: mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing / /dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod gnas/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i bde bskyed yum/ /rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /rnam 'phrul: sogs/ sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas/ /rab song gnas gyi bdag po mchog /dpa' bo chen po yab yum yang / /rnam 'phrul: bdud tshogs kun 'dul sogs bya/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'du ba'i zhing / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang / /rnam 'phrul: sogs bya/ bdud tshogs kun 'dul 'phrin las zhing / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa'i/ /chos skyong bsrung ma 'khor bcas kyang / /rnam 'phrul sogs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rigs kyi cod pan ldem se ldems/ /dar gyi cod paṇa pu ru sa /rgyan cha mang po khrol lo lo/ /rol mo mang po dir ri ri/ /glu len gar byed khyugs se khyugs/ /'khor tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rig pa gsal la la/ /brjod med dbyings su tha la la/ /bde ba chen po khril li li/ /byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di la byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /bgegs dang logs 'dren bar chad sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres/ /gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dz+nyā na a be sha ya a ā/'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram —333—

ze khyi dang gdol ba gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /a ho mahā su khaX/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a ho mahā su khaX/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang / gtso bo yab yum la snying po'i mthar/ a kā ros gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ lha gzhan thams cad la/ tseX( badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye huX huX phaṭa/ nas/ ya ma ma thaX nī ye hūX huX phaṭa/ a kā ros 'bul/ sha sa na'i sngags kyis chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ o aXhuX ha ho hruX n+d+ra badz+ra a ra li sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gtong / dman pa'i yul las rab 'das/ sogs bya/ de nas tshogs la longs spyod do/ /rjes tshogs lhag bsdus/ lam sgron btsugs/ bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhuX ha hoXhiX a kā ro lan gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i ཿnga po 'chol ba'i tshogs/ dam tshig gi cho ga blta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no/ /rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oX u tsiṇ+ḍa ba li ta bha k+ṣa se swāhā/sum bhas bsangs/ rdo rje glu dang / smon lam bkra shis sogs bya'o zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //bkra shis/ zhus dag/ //—334—

oX su sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lag mchod byed par 'dod pas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga nang mchod me tog phud phor zan ḍā ma ru rnams nges par tshogs par byas pas/bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ lag pa g.yon pa/swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lag mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan/ sor mo'i tshigs dbus ma rnams dang / sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la pad zla'i gdan re re/ de nas nang mchod nas g.yas kyi srin lag gis blang ste/ lag mthil dang / sor mo'i tshigs dang / sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la thig le bya zhing / tseX( tseX( ha/ nas/ tseX( phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar tshar gcig brjod/ lag mthil gyi pad+ma'i lte bar/ oX baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo mdun nas g.yon skor gyi 'dab ma lnga la rim pas/ haX yoX sngon mo nas/ tshwa ka'i ngo bo/mthe bong la oX oX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'dzub mo la oX na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ gung mo la oX swāhā huX dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /srin lag la oX bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mthe'u chung la oX huX hūX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngos la oX phaṭa phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lag pa'i sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu khams mā ma ki me khams gos dkar mo/ rlud khams sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can no/ /slar yang de thams cad kyi gnas su nang mchod gtor zhing / oX —335—

āXhūX/ lan bcu gnyis brjod/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs lag mthil gyi rgyab ngos dang bcas par skad cig tsam gyis 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor grub par gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rim pa bzhi/ lha'i gdan dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog /zhes pa nas/thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i bar mkha' nang gi dkyil 'khor bzhin bskyed/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs/ thog mar me tog nas g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul bar mos te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang / 'khor rnams la sngags phreng bzhin tshar gcig brjod nas/ tseX( badz+ra pukhre/ āXhuX/ zhes lag mthil du sbungs/ yang blangs te/ tseX( tseX( ha nas/ phaṭa phaṭa/ kyi bar brjod cing / so so'i gnas su reg la/ lag mthil du sbungs/ zan yang de bzhin du 'bul ba las/ pu zhe/ āXhuX gi tshab tu/ tseXrgo āXhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin chang la sogs pa khu ba'i rdzas yod na'ang cho ga de khas 'bul/ de nas/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /zhes pa nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag rgya rnams lag pa g.yas pas byed/ nang mchod 'bul tshul/ me tog dang zan 'bul ba dang 'dra/ a nu rā ga na'i sngags kyis gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ lag pa g.yas kyis ḍā ma ru bkrol zhing / rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub mtha' dag stsal du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byorwa ra pa dang / sogs brjod/ lag mthil gyi rdzas rnams snod gcig tu sbungs la/ lag pa la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams phan tshun du mnyes shing / tseX( a kā ro sogs brjod pas/ lha rnams rang gnas su thim par gyur/ oX yo ga shu khro sogs la 'byud rgya/—336—

lag mchod kho na byed na/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ zhes pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar rjes chog ltar bya'o/ /lag mchod kyi ngag 'don mdor bsdus pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag bkra shis// //

snye ma zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oX su sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i spyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ bla ma dang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gya gyus mngon par bsgrod mkhas gzung 'dzin mgron/ /dhu ti'i lam du nam yang bcom las slar/ /phung khams tshogs rnams 'od gsal 'bar ba'i spras/ /dga' ston mchog tu rol la ya mtshan dgyes/ /'di slad bcom pa'i rim pa las/ /ye shes 'khor lo bsreg blug gis/ /tshim byed rim pa 'dir spel te/ /las rnams thams cad mthar 'byin pa'o/ /de la 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sgrub par 'dod pas/ cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas dang mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ sbyin sregs gang du bya ba'i sa gzhir dkyil chog ltar sa'i lha mo sta gon bya/ de nas sum bha brjod cing nang gtor lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas dri bzang gis sa gzhi la byug cing /༷oX ha na ha na kro dha hūX phaṭa/ nyer gcig yang dbus su rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa bzhag /o bhu khaX sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ phur gdab byed na/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du huX las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub ma thob gyi bar du bar rbad bsrung bar gyur/ zhesamangon rtogs bzhin no/ /der tshangs thig dang / zur thig btab la/ lte ba nas g.yas g.yon du mtho gang gang gzhal ba'i sar zlum thig bskor ba'i/ khru gang zlum por 'gyur/ yang thab chung ngur —338—

byed na/ khru gang bskor ba'i/ bskum gru'i tshad du 'gyur ba dang / sor brgyad bskor te thabs kyi phyi'i tshad la gru gang du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phyi'i tshad las gzhan pa'i thig med pa spyi dang mthun pa'ang rung ngo / /de nas de'i phyir slar yang khru phye bskor te/ de la bskor thig rim pa gnyis kyis gsum gtubs su btang bas/ nang nas rim pa bzhin kha khyer dang / mu ran dang las kyi kha khyer dang gsum du 'gyur ro/ /thig phyi ma de nyid la reg par stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i thig btab ste/ 'di'i bya rjes zur thig gi steng nas lag len bzhin btsal bar bya'o/ /thabs kyis nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi thig btab/ de nas tshon 'gyed cing mtshan ma 'god par bya ste/ thams cad kyang kha dog dkar po la ji ltar 'os pa'i bcad kyi ri mo bya'o/ /pad+ma'i lte ba la rdo rje dang gri gug sngon po bris/ 'dab ma bzhi la kha ṭā ga re re bris te/ shar du 'khor lo/ ltor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / mtshams su bum thod bris/ ma grub na tsho mi bu bkod kyang rung / kha khyer la pad+ma dkar po'i 'phreng ba/ mu ran la gri gug sngon po'i phreng ba/ las kyi kha khyer la rdo rje sngon po'i 'phreng ba stegs bu ser po grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rnams bri'o/ /bris thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'di las 'di ni bsdus pa'o/ /thab kyi zlum bskor dang mthun par 'o ma can gyi shing ngam/ nags kyi ba glang gi lci ba'i mtho gang tsam gyi dpangs zlum por brtsigs par bya'o/ /thab kyi shar lho me tshang dang /phye mar ting lo gcig bca'/ nang bud shing gis khengs par bya/ mthar mda' dra dang me long phur bu tshone skud rnams bca' ba'i lag len mdzad/ de rnams ma 'grub kyang mi 'gal/ dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba ltar phyogs mtshams brgyad du ku sha bkram/ sha chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma gsum dang /lced lde dang / bsangs chu'i dung chos ku sha'i 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa dang / rdor dril/ cang ṣeganang mchod/ dung chos gnyis/ sgrub pa po 'jig rten pa'i shar du bltas pa'i thab kyi g.yas su mchod pa dang / g.yon du bsregs rdzas rnams mdun nas 'go brtsams te rim pas bsham/ yam shing 'o ma can gyi shing las byugs pa/ sbom su mthe'u chung tsam srid du sor brgyad nas gru gang gi —339—

bar gang yang rung ba/ sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis byug pa/ yal ga dang bcas pas kyang rung ste/ yam shing dang / rtsi bcud kyi mar khu yang legs par 'du bya la/ bum pa bca' zhing sgrub pa 'grub na nges par bya ba yin mod kyi/ bsdus pa la ma grub kyang 'gal ba med par shes par bya'o/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas dang yo byad byin gyis sas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom/ dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdus te/ bdag nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod yon gnyis/su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX dang shaX las dung dkar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du huX huX las byung ba'i bsangs/ chu dang me lha dga' bar byed pa'i ma chod yon nus pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur/bsangs chu la dmigs nas sum+bha gang mang dang / mchod yon la yi ge bdun pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa bya/ gnyis pa ni/ thab dang yod byad/ thams cad la bsangs chus gtor te/ sum bha/sogs dang / oX grwahwa'i bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang ba/ zab su khru phyed pa kha khyer la pad+ma dkar po'i 'phreng ba/ mu ran la gri gug gi 'phreng ba dang / las kyi kha khyer la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ las kyi kha khyer dang bcas pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gi gang bar gyur/ mchod rdzas dang / bsregs rdzas rnams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oX āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang bsregs rdzas rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che —340—

ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu/ las so so sgrub pa'i nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX/ nas/ a khaX swa he'i bar brjod la rol r+ṣa bya/ oX a swāhā/ gsum gyis mar/ lan gsum gyis yam shing dang / tseX( shrī sruhwas mar dang gsum gyis/'bru dang / oX dzi raX grwahwas 'bru rnams dang / gsum gyis rdzas gzhan rnams dang / oX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas rdzas gzhan rnams bsangs shing byin gyis rlabs par bya'o/ /de nas lced lde la me sbar te thal mo sbyar ba'i bzung / sum bha bzla zhing / thab la g.yon bskor gyis bskor ba lan gsum bya ste me tshangs du gzhug oX he ru ka mahā badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūX hūX/ zhes brjod bzhin pas/ mar khu blugs gzar chung ngur gsum blugs la me gsos so/ /de nas ku shas bsangs chu gtor la su lha'i mthar/ oX swāhā btags pa'i bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raX las ye shes kyi me'i phung po rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po'i gdan la/ raX las dbyug gu rtse gsum pa raX gyis mtshan pa las me lha pā pa ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ g.yas gnyis kyis dbyug gu dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ g.yon gnyis na bgrang phreng dang / spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'bab cing / 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ de'i thugs kar paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po grub pa'i mdun gyi zur la/ gzugs med khams dang sa bla dag pa huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa/ g.yas kyi zur du gzugs khams dang —341—

sa steng dag pa āXlas pad+ma āXmatshan pa/ g.yon gyi zur du/ 'dod khams dang sa 'og dag pa oX las 'khor lo oX gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su baX dang raX las dbyug gu rtse gsum pa raX gyis mtshan pa/ de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ khams gsum gyi bdag po dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar: nas/ 'phro ba/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhi no/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad dang steng 'og tu/ oX e rgyu ye/ asna ye/ ya mā ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya we/ ku be+e ra ye/ i shwa na ye/ ut+taXrte bra h+ma/ a khyo pri thi wi/ zhes brjod pas skad cig gis shar tu brgya byin dkar po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor tshon rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sprul zhag 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa lcags sgrogs rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang mchod spyin g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa dang ril bu spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa gaṇ+ḍi 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa lha ser po phag pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs kyi mdzes pa'o/ /phyi nang gi lha de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oX dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/thugs kar huX sngon po/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ snying khar oX oX ha dkar po/ nas/ tsa'i ka'i ngo bo'i bar sgrub thabs bzhi/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lhor nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs dang —342—

bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaXs bkug par gyur/ dbyug gu rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oX tshung byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oX e phya hi mahā bhuX ta de wa ri khri di dza sa t+ta mahā kṛ stuX a hu ri ma he ri a 〉 na sa ni hi to bha wa/ o he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka asna ye ma ma shin+taX ku ru swāhā/ lko5pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma kā ma la ya stuX/ zhes pas gdan phul/ tseX( he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka asna ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ nas/shaga'i bar gyi mchod/ oX asna ya swāhā/ lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ shrī he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka /tseX( asna ye/ a di bya/ a di bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha shrī ye ha bya ka bya wa ha na ya swāhā/bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul ba ni byon zan no/ /dzaXhuX bo ho/ slar gnas gsum byin rlabs dang /go cha 'god pa sngar bzhin no/ /yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor h+pha/ oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX nyer spyod lngas mar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ wo gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul te/ dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad he ru ka'i yig brgya'i mthar gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i snying po brjod la/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri huX/ yang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags kyi mthar/ oX badz+re bha wa a bhi khri nyu hūX/ zhes gsung shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhis dbu rgyan/ oX pa dra laX pa a bhi khiñca badz+ra tu7 oX rat+na mā la adhi khiñca traX/—343—

sngar bzhi bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ༷rtse ma nyams pa/ srung ba dang gtsang byed dam pa nus pa phul du phyin par gyur/ o badz+ra sa twa a/ lan brgyad brjod la ku sha bkrams par bsam la/ oX ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /sa la skyes pa'i snying po mchog /ces pa'i ku sha phul/ 'dis bdag cag 'khor bcas la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā/ sum bha lan brgyad brjod cing / mda'i dra bas mdzes shing / me long gi phreng ba la sogs pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ mda' dra sogs bcings par bsam/ me lha'i zhal dang dgang blugs kyi rtse mor/ oX oX oX ḍā ki ni dzi na dzi ka swāhā/ lko lan ga brjod/ gong gi byon zan tsol ba'i skabs ltar/ tseX( asna/ dgang gzar lan gsum gyis bkang la/ oX he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka asna ye stuX/ zhes laXn gsum phul/ skabs 'dir me bkra brtag ngan na bgegs skrad/mchod yon gyis snod bzung ste/ o he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka asna ye pra bar sa rka ra pra tismo swāhā/ zhes mchod yon dang po dang / oX i maX ar+ghaX ma ya dad taX/ gro hā sid dhi sme pra ya tsā ye swāhā/ gnyis pa dang / oX i maX pa duX mas ya dad taX/ gro hā sid dhi sme pra ya tsā ye swāhā/ zhabs bsil/ oX he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka agha ye sa pa ri wa ra pu po nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX āXhūX/ nang mchod 'bul/rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud —344—

rtsi bcud ldan ga rnye bsnams/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhas rab chen po bdag med thugs chud cing / /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol yang / /thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs 'dzin/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba/ /rang gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bstod/ bsreg rdzas thams cad la bsangs chu gtor te/ oX swāhā/ lan mang du brjod/ de nas yam shing 'bul zhing / oX he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka asna ye/ zhes pa ni lha sngags/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la ye swāhā/ yam shing gi rdzas sngags/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sarba pa paX shin+taX ku ru swāhā/ las sngags te/ dal ba'i tshe gsum char sgrags pa nyer gcig la sogs pa'i phul/ bsdu na lha sngags dang / las sngags lan gcig gis bar du/rdzas sngags kyi mthar swāhā sbyar ba/ bdun nam nyer gcig phul/ rdzas sngags so so'i khyad par ma btogs 'og ma rnams la 'di'i rigs 'gre bar byas te/ so so'i rdzas sngags ni/ oX asna ye grwahwas mar khu'o/ /oX sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra ye grwahwas til/ oX he ru ka mahā badz+ra asna ye grwahwas 'bras pha/ oX sarba sa po te grwahwas zas mchog oX badz+ra ā yu ṣe grwahwas dur ba/ oX mi hā be ga ye grwahwas nas/ oX badz+ra snasmi ri ye sruhwas gro/ oX badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ so ba la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs/ oX badz+ra pukhye ye sruhwas 'bras/ oX mahā ba la ye grwahwas sran ma/ oX mahā shri pha la dha ni grwahwas 'dza' ti la sogs pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ oX a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye sruhwas ku sha rnams 'bul mar khu blugs gzar dang /gzhan rnams lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis kha gyen du bstan pas 'bul/ nyer gcig sogs —345—

mang nyung long skabs dang sbyar/ de nas gong bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod/ shes rab chen po bdag med thugs chud cing / sogs dang / gzi brdzid chen po me ye lha/ zhes pa yan chad kyis bstod/ oX he ru ka dz+wa la dz+wa la huX huX zhes brjod/ mar khu dgang blugs rkyang ba gang phul nas/ me lha thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas/ bsregs rdzas rnams kha gsos la me dang bcas pa thams cad gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ mchod pa dang bsregs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags rnams gong bzhin brjod/stong pa'i ngang las me nang du srung ba'i 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oX me dhi ni badz+ra bha wa bhan+da geX/ oX badz+ra pra ka ra hūX laX huX/༷oX badz+ra pañca ra huX paX hūX/ o badz+ra bi ta na huX khaX huX/ o badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la dri saX draX/ o badz+ra dz+wa la a na arka huX huX hūX/ zhes sngags drug po lan gsum brjod/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las: zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po nas/ rdo rje'i phreng ba'i mtshan pa'o'i bar mngal dkyil bzhin bskyed/ dur khrod chen por shar du tshangs pa/ byang du gzhon nu karnya ka nub tu khyab 'jug lhor dbang phyug chen po 'khor dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga: zhes pa nas/ de nas tshu zhes pa'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin/ tseX( badz+ra he ru ka e phya hi/ bha ga wan i ha wa kya sa ma ye na tsa pañca a mṛ ta ar+ghaX pra titsā stuX pu dza pra wa ra ya mi/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ltar phyi mchod 'bul/oX sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saX bha ra maṇ+ḍa la la tsakra sarba bi ra yo gi ni/ oX 'a ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyis bkang la/ a di bya/ sogs kyis sngags sbyar nas gong ltar byon zan —346—

'bul/ dzaXhūX baX hoX o yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shuzlo ྅ haX/ gtso bo yab yum kyi gnas rnams su snying gar oX oX ha nas brlar ha ljang khu nas don yod grub pa'i ngo bo'i bar/ 'khor rnams kyi spyi bor oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ slar yang / nas/ dbang lha spyan 'dren: nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ zhes pas bar dbang bskur yang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin byas la/ dar dpyangs dang / rin po che'i phreng ba'i sngags gong bzhin/ tseX( pa tra laX pa a bhi ṣañca badz+ra tug oX rat+na ma la a bhi 'khri spya draX/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha thams cad sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gyur/ gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i thig le'i nang du dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba zhi ba'i thugs can du gyur/ de nas spro na mdun bskyed bzhi nam/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin mchod bstod rdzogs par bya/ de nas sreg rdzas 'bul tshul/ lha sngags rgyas pa ni lha rang rang gi rtsa sngags brjod pa dang / 'bring la gtso bo yab yum la rang sngags gzhan rnams la sa bon/ bsdus pa la/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saX bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ sogs sbyor tshul mang du gsungs kyang phyag len la dang po yam shing la/ rang sngags rdzogs pa'i lha sngags kyis rjes su/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la ye swāhā/ nyer gcig gis phul nas/ las sngags ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sarba pā paX shin+taX ku ru swāhā/ sarba bik+ta na/ sarba ro lga sarba nga na/ sarba byā he/ sarba dz+wa ra/sarba gra he/ sarba dur mi ti/ sarba dur stso/ sarba a ka la mṛ byur shin+taX kus de nas gong bzhin sreg rdzas tshar re la lha sngags gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'am/ nye snying gang rung gi mthar/ rdzas sngags kyi grangs nyer gcig sogs ji tsam 'os pa'i 'bul la/ mjug tu las sngags gong bzhin lan re re brjod/ de nas slar yang grangs kyi ngo bo til sngags 'ba' zhig la grangs —347—

'dzin pa yin no/ /yang na grangs 'dzin pa'i skabs 'dir/ o shrī he ru ka bi ma he bi du rā dza dhi ma ye bi ra pra tso tha ya āXhuX swāhā/ zhes pa dbyangs skyong gi sngags kyis phul yang rung ngo / /bsreg rdzas 'bul ba rdzogs pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ltar mchod bstod byas la/ sgrub thabs nas 'gyung ba ltar yi dam/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gtor ma 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan bdun tsam bzlas nas/ lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ yig brgya'i mthar/ tseX( he ru ka mu/ zhes pas ye shes pa gshe/gas/ sbyin sreg gi thal ba cung zad blangs/ rang gi gnas gsum du byugs la/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ de dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /gsum pa mjug ni/ slar yang mar blug gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis/ me lha thugs dkyil dang bcas pa sngar bzhin grub par gyur/ gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar/ sreg rdzas rnams tshar gcig rdzogs par phul la/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ slar yang sngags bdun gyis dgang blugs gang phul/ me lha'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oX āXhuX ha hoXhiX oX he ru ka mahā badz+ra pā pa ka asna ye sa pa ri wā ra na maXsarba ta thā ga ta khyu sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oX asna ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyis sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭaklis dbang bskur ba/ khres rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /me lha drang srong 'khor daXng bcas/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyi 'dod don gsol 'debs/ o in+t+ra ye nas/ bṛ thi wi de wi khyuX oX a kā ro sogs kyis phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma phul/ oX da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ oX āXhuX gi nang mchod/ he ru ka dpal ye shes ni/ /gang —348—

la gang 'dul thabs sprul pa/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas rnams/ /thogs med las kun mdzad la bstod/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma: sogs kyi 'phrin las gzhol/ slar yang gshegs skyems kyi tshul du/ tseX( asna ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ tseX( he ru ka sogs gong gi sngags dang bcas pa'i mar dgang blugs lan gsum phul la yig brgya lan gsum bzlas/ ma 'byor ba sogs/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du phyir bskyed la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyi/ /mgu zhing tshim par gyur nas kyang / /rang gnas bde bar gshegs su gsol/ /oX asna ye ya hi badz+ra muXsngar phur gdab dngos su phur bu bcu dang lnga la brten nas byas pa yin na/ rang rang gi phur pa 'byin sngags dang phyag rgyas dbyung / yid kyis btab pa tsam la ni phur ba dbyung bar bsams pa tsam las sngags dang phyag rgya mi dgos so/ /de nas bdag nyid go cha gsum gyis bsrungs nas/smon lam dang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /me ma shi bar mi dkrug cing / rang shi la song ba na bum par blug la chu bor spyan 'dren pa/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa dang 'dra'o/ /de dag gi lag len dang mthar gcod pa ni gzhan dang gzhan la blta bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sdom ni/ sa chog thab khung bca' ba dang / /yo byad bsags shing bum pa sgrub/ /gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs dang / /bdag bskyed chu gnyis sgrub pa dang / /rdzas byin rlabs shing me sbar zhing / /thab khung me lha phyi nang bskyed/ /byin rlabs spyan 'dren gdan phul mchod/ /byon zan phul stim go cha dgod/ /dbang bskur ku sha mda' drang bcings/ /me bkra brtag cing mchod bstod bya/ /bsreg rdzas mchod bstod dgang blugs phul/ /bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs srung 'khor dang / /gzhal med khang dang lha tshogs bskyed/ /spyan 'dren mchod bstod byon zan 'bul/ /go cha bcings nas dbang bskur bya/ /semasadapa' sum brtsegs zhi ba'i gzugs/ /mchod bstod bsregs rdzas mchod bstod 'bul/ khres —349—

brjod yig brgya bzod par gsol/ /gshegs gsol dam tshig nye bar bsdu/ /dgang blugs bsregs rdzas mchod bstod dang / /dgang blugs me lha phyogs skyong gi /gtor 'bul gshegs skyems kha skong dang / /bzod gsol gshegs gsol phur bu dbyung / /nyer bsdu smon lam bkra shis bya/ /thal ba chu bor spyan 'dren te/ /sbyin sregs las kyi spyi sdom yin/ /de ltar mchog dang thun mong dngos grub don/ /mtha' dag 'phrin las nye bar sgrub pa'i gzhi/ /bsregs blugs cho ga ma nor skyon bral ba/ /mdo tsam go bde'i ngag gis 'dir gsal byas/ /'di bris dge ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /sngags rgyud sbyor ba mthar phyin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa grub nas/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs par shog/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba/ don gnyer mang po'i bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la chos 'khor sdings su nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag /ma ṅga la// //dge'o dge'o dge'o// //—350—

oX su sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa rnams kyis mkha' 'gro thams cad pa'i gtor ma chen po byed par 'dod pas/ rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las 'byung ba'i lugs 'di bya ste/ lha dril nag gsum sogs kun dang / khyad par du yang nag po spyod pa pa'i lugs dang shin tu 'brel ba yin no/ /de yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'am rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis chos 'byung gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rim pa gsum/ zlum skor rim pa gsum le tshe nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa byas kyang rung / zlum skor nang ma'i dbus su re mig dgur bya/ dbus su dri bzang dang khrag gis zlum por bya/ re mig brgyad la lha'i mdog dang mthun pa'am/ sngon po lta bu ji ltar 'os pa'i tshom bu lnga lnga bkod/ re mig nyi shu rtsa bzhi la yang tshom bu gnyis gnyis 'god do/ /rdul mtshon gyis bri ba ma lcogs na khrag gam tsan+dan dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal lam/ chos 'byung gi dbus su maṇ+ḍal phal pa tsho mi bu tsam bkod pas kyang rung ngo / /rgyun gyi nyams len la shin tu bsdu na ting nge 'dzin kho nas kyang rung bas/ gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi phyi ru 'dus byas pa med kyang chog go /gtor ma gcig kho na yin na maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun dang / gnyis yod na 'das gtor maṇ+ḍal gyi byang shar dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma shar lhor 'god/ bzhi yod na phyogs bzhi dang / brgyad yod na phyogs mtshams dang / lha grangs dang mnyam pa yod na de'i rim pas 'god do/ /mchod yon mdun dang mchod pa gzhan rnams g.yas g.yon du bshams/ sgrub thabs las 'gyung ba'i mchod pa byin rlabs dang / gtor ma byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa rnams byas la/ 6༷( badz+ra ḍā ka i maX ba —351—

li gra hā spo hā hū phaṭa/ o dza : ba ho sa ma stu khru khyo ho zhes lan lnga dang / o ka ra ka ra: sogs lan gsum gyis phul/rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos bstan la/ ri ri/ dang por byas pa'i sngags de yod kyang / rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor la sbyor ba'i tshe dkyus bzhin mdzad do/ /ar+gha/la sogs pa dang / nang mchod dang / o bī ni badz+ra ṇi hū hu phaṭa/ sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyud kyi bstod pa dang / srid dang zhi ba/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ hu rnams las byung ba'i 'jig rten skyong ba/ slo tra pā la brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa dang / k+ṣ-i rnams las byung ba'i gnas bsrung zhing skyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams 'khor dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa phe/ o shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang / /khyad par chu la gnas pa yi/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lhas spyin mnyam du brten pa dang / /nag po gtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang / /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed lha mo u mas bstod/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma ste rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo/ /bcu gsum dbang phyug ma dang ni/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs can gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod can —352

ma/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭāX ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra stu can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid che/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po che/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gnegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oX ka ska dha na/ ba bhan+ta na/ dzi da na/ sarba du snaXstenaX ha na ha na/ gha gha gha ta na/ che ge mo/ shin+taX ku ru skyoXhuX phaṭa phaṭa dzaXswāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbang ldan du nag po drag po sku mdog dkar ba/ rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgan byad ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ shar du drag po chen po ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ rdo rje dang gdan la gnon pa/ rgyal ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ mer lhas sbyin dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ hom gzar dang / dbyug gu gsum pa dang / ba dan dang / spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ nag mo bzang mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lhor nag po sngon po ma he la zhon pa/dbyug pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ zla ba mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lho nub gtsigs byed sngo nag mi ro la zhon pa/ ral gri dang phub chung 'dzin pa/ mar me la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ nub tu mi sdug pa dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/zhags pa thogs pa/ drag mo'i gzugs la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ rlud du dga' ba las 'das pa nag po ri dwags la zhon pa/ ba dan thogs pa/ thod phreng ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang du log 'dren ser po gnod sbyin mi'i gzugs can la zhon pa/ lcags kyu dang rin po che'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/—353—

ral gri ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ gtso bo brgyad po rnams ni rang mtshungs kyi yum gyis 'byud pa/ phyag bzhi'i 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ 'khor rnams thams cad rang rang gi gtso bo dang 'dra ba las/ ral gri ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / kha ṭāX ma ni ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan can dang / gzhu can ma snying gar 'khyud rgya mdzad pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo khor yug gsum la phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis gnas pa ni/ drag tu rgod par shing mchog ka dam pa/ zhing 〈'gos 'gyur du/ yum zhi gdong dang / yab dril r+pā du'ang spund/〉 skyong zhi gdong dril bu chen mor bcas/ /rdo rje 'dzin zhing 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas/ /kol+la gi rir ri rtse la brten pa'i/ /zhing skyong me zhal dpal chen mo dang bcas/ /mi mgo 'dzin zhing mi ro'i gdan la gnas/ /bha ra ṇa yul tā la'i shing la brten/ gtsigs po de byed ma dang sgra byen zer/〉pa chen po skra gyen 'bar mar bcas/ rtse gsum 〈g.yas pa'i mtshon cha zer/〉 'dzin zhing sirnyi/ si sba zhi thadangul chu'i gang ba'i snod/〉/de wi ko ṭi ra shing mchog bā ṭa la/ /lus shrī can yang zer/ye'i/ po ni rna ba chen mor bcas/ /mdung thung 'dzin zhing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs/ /bi ra dza ra ni a mra la brten pa'i/ /ha har dzad dod a bhi yod zer/〉bzhad pa yum ni me 'bar ma/ /ba dan 'dzin zhing shing leb la gnas pa'o/ /e ruX ḍa ru kaXrja'i shing gi drung / /dril bu'i sgra can me yi gdong ma gnyis/ /rdo rje shaka po phang mdung zer/〉ti 'dzin zhing phag la zhon/ /ser gro ta phur/༅skya'i gnas su shing mchog dza ṭi waṃ zer/dza)na pa chen po dmar ser ma dang bcas/ /gtun shing 'dzin —354

zhing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs/ /e la'i grong du a pa ra dzi ti'i shing / /glang po'i rna ba stobs chen ma dang bcas/ /zhags pa thogs pas bong bu'i steng du bzhugs/ kha che'i yul du ri bo la brten pa'i/ /'jigs 〈sbu gu'i byin pa tso zer rtsa ba'i byin ho yang zer/〉byed chen po ba lang rna ba ma/ /lag na lcags sgrogs nor sbyin gdan la bzhugs/ /ma rung mya ngam thang la brten pa yi/ /gtsigs 〈rim pa mo yang zer/〉 pa'i zhal can 'jigs zhal 〈skad dod ga ta la zer ba yod zer/〉ma lhan cigalcags kyu zhags pa thogs shing ma he zhon/ /spa shing ldum ra la brten na ga rar/ /mche 〈'i byin pa/〉 gtsigs chen po ro langs can mar bcas/ /thong gshe/la 'dzin zhing mi mgo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /puṇ+ḍa we rnar a shwad tha yi drung / /bum pa'i 'bras bu can dang tsa 〈ra khri zer/〉muṇ+ḍi kha ṭāX ga 'dzin mi ro'i gdan la 'gying / /dza yan+ti ru khang pa brtsegs pa la/ /ral pha༅ gdong ma 〉pa gsum pa bzhin mdzes thabazhi dngas ma zer/〉 ma dang bcas/ /lug rgyud 'dzin zhing keng rus la gnas pa/ pre ta pu pra ni pu nga zer ba'ang yod/ ri ra u dūX ba ra la/ /'jigs par byed pa glog gi tshol bu'i sgra zer a gdong yang zer/〉 gdong mar bcas/ /gzhal yas khang gnas dbyug pa mdung thung 'dzin/ /su ba rar ni shal ma li yi nags/ /kun mdzes dang ni me lce'i gdong ma gnyis/ sha chen phung por gri gug mdung thung 'dzin/ /tsā ri tra ru ka rañja shing la/ /dril bu chen po ka ra ljin gnas ma/ /mdung thung 'dzin zhing 'jam 'bras sdong por gnas/ /o byun rdzo tre yang zer/〉yul du mya ga med pa'i shing / /zhing skyong rbag po stobs ho/〉sgra can yum ni lha chen mo/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin zhing 'dre bdud mnan/ /dza —355—

lan dha rar gser shing la brten pa'i/ /zhing skyong bskyed skrug skyes yang zer/〉 pa zhes bya gtum mor bcas/ /gri gug 'dzin zhing mi pre du da mnan par byas kyang rdzo〉ro zhabs kyis mnan/ /spu ra ka ru spyo la'i shing sdong la/ /ri rab chen po 'jig rten ma mor bcas/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing me dpung la gnas pa/ /mā ya pu rir shā kho ṭa shing drung / /zhing skyong 'jigs pa 'dod pa mo dang bcas/ /mi ro'i phung por rdo rje shaka ti 'dzin/ /a smyu ka yul de ba dza dri zer/〉 da ru la/ /brtul zhugs chen po srul mo dang lhan cig /thong gshe/la ga ya sa da'i stug pa zer thor ba dang stug pa'ang zer/〉 'dzin zhing seng ge zhon/ /rgyal po'i khab tu ne lin li ka zer lha rten gyi shing snyag yin zer phro ke shing la/ rga ba chen po mi sdug ma dang bcas/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin zhing 'khordo ra lor gnas/ /bod yul brag gi phug la brten pa yi/ /zhing skyong longs spyod lhan cig skyes mar bcas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing yi dwags mnan/ /mā la bar ni sbrang rtsi'i shing gi drung / /sna tshwas pa'i zer zi tshogs dbang phyug dbang bskur ma dang bcas/ /ro gdan la bzhugs rdo rje tho ba 'dzin/ /kun kyang las dang mthun pa'i nyams 'gyur dang / /rgyan dang na bza' kha dog 'od zer 'bar/ /yang na phyogs dang mthun pa'i kha dog bcas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun gyis bskor bar 'gyur/ /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid 'khor lo'i rtsibs sam re mig so so la bzhugs pa'o/ /ar+ghaX/ nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ su lha'i mthar/ tseX( sarba spyo tra pā la sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ya stuX/ zhes dam la bzhag zhing skyong thams cad la lhan cig tu gtor ma 'bul te/ lag pa g.yon gtor snod snying gar 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas sdigs mdzub gtor ma la bstan te/ tseX( —356

bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa sarba sku1 ga sku( gi shwa rī huX huX dzaXswāhā/ zhes pa bdun la sogs pas 'bul/man rnye las 'di ye shes dbang phyug ma kho nas gtor sngags su bshad pa ni saX pu ṭa dang rang rkang gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /tseX( badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa dzaXswāhā/ zhes pas kyang lha grangs dang mnyam pa sogs lan mang du 'bul zhing / mthar/ tseX( kha kha/ nas/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūX hūX phaṭa sruhwa re bar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum nas bdun gyi bar du phul/ ar+ghaX/ nas/shabha'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum/ gyi nang mchod phul/ spro na zhabs bsil phyag phyis so rtsi sogs mchod pa gzhan yang mang du bstabs/ gang ltar yang mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ snyaX( shing gcig dang ni/ nas/ gos med sbyor ba skyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang mo snyen ra dang bcas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing rnams la/ /rab dgas zhing skyong rig mar bcas/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung po yi/ /tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang / /lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'khru/ba lha(ga /ces pa'i bar brjod/ las so so'i dmigs bsal yod na las la bskul ba yang byas te gtor ma phyir btang ngo / /yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs bzod par gsol/ oX khyod kyis sems can/ sogs kyi mthar/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhugagayas sa la reg ste/ oX at+pa tiṣ+ṭha huX swāhā/ zhes brjod/ oX yo ga shudha sarba dharmaXyo ga shurnyo ྅haX/ rnam lnga 'dod skor bya/ oX sarba du ni groṇ+ḍa gro sna ga tsā huX phaṭa/ badz+ra muXzhes 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs/ dkyil 'khor pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /de nas bdag bsrung ba dang / mtshams rngam dang bstod pa rnams bya zhing / smon lam gdab/ bkra shis kyang bya'o/ /yang nag po drag po la sogs pa kho na bkod na/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtor ma zhes bya zhing / zhing skyong nyer bzhi kho na bkod na gnas srung gis gtor ma zhes bya la/ de gnyis sdom pa ni/ mkha' 'gro spyi —357—

gtor rgyas pa'am/ zhing skyong gi gtor chog chen mo zhes bya'o/ /yang hūṃ mdzad 'byung po 'dul ba gtso bor byas pa'i gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen por grags pa gzhan yang yod pa/ re zhig 'dir ma bris te logs su 'bri bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga'i yan lag tu mkho ba 'di ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/gtor chog mdo tsam smos pa ste/ 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //'dir sngar gyi gtor dpe dang ngag sgros tsam la ma bzhag par/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rtsa 'grel 'gyur mi gcig pa gsum dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'di skor gyi rtsa 'grel dang / man rnye sogs la zhib tu brtags te zhus dag kyang byas pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// //—358

thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo bzhugs/na mthaX he ru ka maṇ+ḍa le khyuX'adir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa dag gis/dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'di nyid sgrub par bya'o//de las ni las dang dngos grub la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khyad par shin tu mang po dag 'grub par 'gyur zhing /skye bo mang po dag la'ang mchog tu phan pa yin no//de la dus ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel na/thun so so'i 'jug gi cha'am/lhag par mchog tu bsngags pa nam phyed kyi thun mtshams la yin zhing /khyad par gyi dus ni/dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/tshes brgyad dang ni khyad par du//bco lnga dang ni tshes bcu bzhir/khrub 'dod rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni//'bad pa'i gtor ma sbyin par bya//zhes gsungs shing /de dag la yar ngo dang mar ngo'i dbye bas drug dang /spyir gtor chog 'di tshes bcu mchod pa'i yan lag yin pa'i/tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis te/zla ba gcig gi nang du nyi ma brgyad po de dag sngags la/lo dus kyi dbang ltar na dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu la lhag par bsngags so//de yang rtsa ba'i sngags bzla bzhin du/rdo rje dang bcas pa' ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas nang mchod blangs te sa gzhi la byugs pa'i steng du/thig btab nasachos 'byung bzung 'khor dang bcas pa sgom don bzhin/rdul tshon gyi 'bri ba'am/ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs yod na'ang legs la/yang na chos 'byung gi dbus su zlum bskor gsum/lte ba le tshe dgu dang bcas pa 'bri ba'am/de yang rdo /ba na chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas

pa tsam mo/ /yang na thig btab nas tshom bu bkod kyang rung la/ yang ras bris med cing rdul tshon gyis bri ba mi lcogs na/ maṇ+ḍal la nang mchod kyis chos 'gyung bris pa'i dbus su/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung ngo / /de nas gtor ma gcig gam gnyis sam/ 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i lnga'am/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa sogs sha khrag gnyis sha chang dang sgog tsong la sogs pa'i brgyan pa zas bzang rgus sbags pa bzhug /chu gnyis nyer spyod ri/ sogs spyi dang mthun par bshams/ nang mchod byin rlabs dang / gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba zhig sgom nas/ gtor ma chang chu nang mchod kyis bran/ so so'i sgrub thabs nas ji skad 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi la/ baX las chu khams kyi dkyil 'khor dkar po de'i nang du yaX las rlung khams kyi dkyil 'khor nag po/ de'i nang du raX las me khams kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po de'i nang du laX las sa khams kyi dkyil 'khor ser po'o/ /de rnams gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bral ba/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i dbus su paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ mu 'byud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma dang mi ro'i gdan la/ huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi'i 〈mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ltar na/〉dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga /'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 〈yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltar na/〉 phyag dang po gnyis g.yas ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas —360—

'dzin wo gsor pa'i rdo rje dang / g.yon bshor gyi rnam pa'i thod khrag 'og ma gnyis kyi mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ drag po chen po/ sum bcu rtsa gsum pa thams cad kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i rgyan dang cha byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la shar du phruX las mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang ma dkar mo thal mo'i rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang du rlu las 'bar byed ma ser mo thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa/ nub tu phroX las 'jib byed ma dmar mo/ snyim pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lhor phri las g.yo ldan ma'am ngag 'phrog ma sngon mo/ phyag gnyis gshun shing dang sdigs mdzub can/ bzhi kar yang skra dmar po grol zhing / mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa/ gcer bu sbrul dang rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi'o/ /sa khams 'khor lo'i sgo bzhir hriXrlu hi hoX mtshams bzhir oX gaX bi i rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can/ /rab khros mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin/ /lho sgor zhi ba ma ni dmar mo ste/ /thod pa lcags kyu kha ṭāX cang te'u 'dzin/ /nub sgor gzhon nu ma ni ser mo ste/ tri shā la ba dan gsum pa gzhu dang mda'/ /byang sgor tsa muṇ+ḍi ni sku mdog nag kha ṭāX thod pa rnge chung chang snod 'dzin/ /byang shar zur du tshangs pa kha dog dkar/ /'khor lo'i dang ni thod pa mda' gzhu bsnams/ khar lhor tshogs kyi dbang mo ljang khu ste/ /rtse gsum thod pa bgrang phreng la du 'dzin/ /lho nub khyab 'jug ma ni nam mkha'i mdog /'khor lo thod pa zhags pa ral gri 'dzin/ /nub byang mtshams su dbang mo 361—

mdangs 'od ser/ shaka ti thod pa sdigs mdzub zhugs pa 'dzin/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyi na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i byang shar nas brtsams te/ g.yas bskor gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad la/ yī i a a no pā ba ku rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'byung por dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog chings/ /phyag na mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa bsnams/ shar du sa srung bu la dbang po ser/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa phyag gis 'dzin/ shar lhor me lha lug la zhon/ /dmar po phyag na me thab 'dzin/ /lho phyogs gshin rje nag po ste/ /ma he'i gdan steng dbyug tho 'dzin/ /lho nub srin po sngo skya ste/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing khyi la chibs/ /chu srin la gnas chu lha dkar/ /zhugs pa thogs pa nub phyogs su'o/ /rlud lha dung mdog ba dan 'dzin/ /nub byang ri dwags steng na gnas/ /gter bum steng na lus ngan ser/ /rin po che 'dzin byang du gnas/ /de thams cad phyag bzhi'i g.yon gyi dang po thod pa bcud kyis gang ba dang / 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyor bas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i shar nas g.yas bskor gyi/chisu rtsa ma bu byo sho sha ra ko rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du nyi ma dmar ser rta mchog dkar po chibs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshan pad+ma phyag na bsnams/ /zla ba dkar po zla dkyil phyed pa'i mtshan pa yi/ /ku mud 'dzin pa ngang pa la gnas shar lhor bzhugs/ /lha sgor mig dmar dmar por skyes la gnas shing / /g.yas pa gri thung g.yon pas mi mgo bzungs te za/ /pad gdan —362—

la gnas gza' lhag ser po bden bral na/ /mda' gzhu 'gengs shing zhi ba'i lta bas gnas pa'o/ /nub sgor phur bu ser skya rlung du pa sangs dkar/ /gnyis ka'ang pad+ma la gnas bgrang phreng spyi blugs 'dzin/ /spen pa sngo nag rus sbal la chibs rab tu khros/ /dbyug pa phyar zhing khu tshur dkur bsten byang sgor bzhugs/ /dbang ldan zur du sgra can dmar nag srin po'i lus/ /sprin gyi gseb nas lus stong phyung ste nyi zla 'dzin/ /de dang lhan cig mjug rings sngon po sbrul mjug can/ /klu gzugs rab tu khros pa ral gri zhags pa 'dzin/ /de dag kun kyang rang gi khang pa'i steng na bzhugs/ /rgyu skar la sogs gdon gyi tshogs kyis rab tu bskor/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs ldan rang gi dam tshig spyod/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i phyogs bzhir g.yon bskor gyis/ /bra bi tu ka mtshams bzhir ma ra ba ya rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang po tshangs pa dkar po ni/ /zhal bzhi thod pa zlas 'phreng dang / /spyi blugs pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nor spyin phyogs su khyab 'jug nag /phyag bzhi ral gri 'khor lo dang / /thod pa ga de'i dbyug pa 'dzin/ /gshin rjer drag po du ba'i mdog /mdung rtse gsum pa thod khrag dang / /zhags pa bzlas 'phreng phyag na bsnams/ /chu bdag phyogs su gzhon nu ser/ /gdong ba drug ldan mdung thung dang //dbyug to thod pa bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /dbang ldan sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /pad ma la gnas nor 'dzin ma/ /ser mo gos dkar bum pa dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can/ /byin zer me yi dkyil 'khor la/ /me lce 'bar ba'i steng du ni/ /me yis lha mo me lha mtshungs/ /srin por chu'i dkyil 'khor steng / /char sprin la gnas chu lha 363—

mo/ /mdog dbyibs phyag mtshan chu lha bzhin/ /g.yo ba'i phyogs su rlung dkyil la/ /'tshubs ma rlung ras g.yo bas mtshan/ /der gnas rlung gi lha mo ni/ /phyogs skyong rlung lha nyid dang mtshungs/ /de'i phyi rol gzhal yas khang gi sgo g.yas g.yon la/ yi ge phu yig brgyad las klu chen po brgyad/ sgo'i phyi rol gyi khyams la lha ma yin dang / lus srul po la sogs pa'i tshogs dang / phyi rol dur khrod kyi gnas la/ zhing skyong chen po rnams srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/de thams cad kyi dpral par o/ mgrin par a thugs kar hū/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang / srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa ñcha // / / / snye /hūṃ // // / /snyo /// ga po 1 spre'u ( 〈 pe / / / / //snye/ / /stu/ / / / —364—

tha ga ta shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa re khyoX badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ de bzhin du pā juX/ pur+sha ā huX nas shaga'i bar gyis mar/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/de la'ang mkha' 'gro lnga'i ming sbyor/ spros pa la dga' na lha so so'i bstod pa sbyar na yang legs/bsdu na mi dgos/ rang gi lag pa g.yon par ā li las zla ba/ g.yas par kā li las nyi ma/ snyim pa kha spyor gyi dbus su huX sngon po/ oX a no n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharma huX/ oX pa ra spa ra a nu pra pri ni sarba dharma huX/ oX a t+yā nā a nu pra bri gi sarba dharma huX/ lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ pad bskor bya ṣ+ka / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gi /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mgron rnams kyi ljags hūX dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oX a ra smi hoX dzaXhuX baX hoX badz+ra ḍa ki n+ya ya sa ma ya stuX dri tho hoXzhes pa lan lnga'am bdun la sogs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul bar 365—

'dir spro na/ oX ḍā ki ni phruXphu swāhā/ oX dī pi ni phre phuXswāhā/ oX tsi ṣi ṇi phre phuXswāhā/oX kaX po dza rlu phuXswāhā/ sngags de bzhi pho mthar/ oX bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sogs sbyor/'jig rten pa'i lha rnams la so so'i mtshan sngags sam/yang na/oX āXhiXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ la/ a 'a btags pa'am/oX bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo ge shwa ri huX huX dzaXswāhā/ btags pa'i phag mo la phul/ des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /oX āXrlu huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXhiXhūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXho hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āX.oX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXgaX hūX phaṭa swāhā/oṃ āXpe hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āX.i huX phaṭa swāhā/ ma mo ga༈ bdun gyi sngags so/ /oX āX.i huX phaṭa swāhā/ rtsoX( āX.i huX phaṭa swāhā/ tsho( āX.aX huX phaṭa swāhā/ tseX( āXyaX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXn+ya huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXpāX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXpaX huX phaṭa swāhā/oX āXkuX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi'o/ /oX āXsuX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXrtsa hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXmaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXbuX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXbri huX phaṭa swāhā/oX āXshuX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXshaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXraX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXlka hūX phaṭa swāhā/ gza' dgu po rnams kyi'o/ /oX āḥbraX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXbi hūX phaṭa swāhā/oX āXchuX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXkaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXlaX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXraX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXbaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX āXyaX swāhā/ zhes pa rnams la sngar bzhin sbyar ro/ /re re kha 'a gsum mam bsdu na lan rnyag gis phul la/ thams cad la thun mong du/oX kha kha sku hi 'a hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ bi shā tsa/ gi ā ta/ a pa sma ra/ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i mi ba li gro hā tu sam ya rak+ta skye ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra ya smos/ ya thi baX/ ya the niX/ buñja tha/ bi ba tha/ dzi gha tha/ mā ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba ka tho yaX/ sad su khaX bi shudha/ ma ma sa ha yi ka bha wastu huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ni —366—

gsum la sogs pas phul/ g.yas thod pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon ba dan gsum gdengs pa'i phyag rgyas btab cing / tse( he ho hri swāhā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas nang mchod byin rlabs kha gsos/ tse( ā hu lan mang pos g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs thor 'bul/ bla ma dang dkyil gyi lha tshogs mgron thams cad mnyes par bsam/ dpal he ru ka'i rkang brgyad gnyis dang /de nyid lnga pa la sogs pas bstod/lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang /gnod sbyin: srin po'i: ཿnga po'i: yi dwags: sha za'i: spyo byed: brjed byed: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma mo'i ma lus par ni thams cad dag /'di gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal bar bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung / /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cing / /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med 367—

par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'khru rnams 'phel dang chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gis bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/ las so so dang 'brel na de dang de'i las la bskul ba drag tu bya/ de nas rdo rje glu 'di blang bar bya ste/ 'gro ba kun gyi mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas kyis/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ sham du/ /sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol par byos/ a re/ gang gi don dam la ni ma sgoms pas/ de yi sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin te/a re/ nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ zhes bya ba dang / hu khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yin/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /rab tu rmongs pa bsten par byed/ a la la la la ho/ a i ā a ra slo ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i a a ra slo ho/ rab rgyas mgon po khyed bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyi gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ a i a a ra slo ho/ bde ba spang bas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde —368—
