med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyed ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan zhing 'a rjebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blang bas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi: sogs bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /lha mo tshad ma/ sogs/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzigs kyang / /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje chu rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad gegs med par stsal ba dang / /myur du dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ spyo sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / bzod gsol spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can: sogs kyi mthar/ 'theb mdzub gnyis bkug ste zlum por byas la/ sor mo gzhan rkyang pa mig gis phyag rgya bstan rjes/ pad skor dang lte bar 'phyud rgya byas la/ mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogos te/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la mu ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag gis dpral par thim pa dang / oṃ yo ga shurnya/ sogs/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnasasu gshegs par mos/ rol mo'i sgra dang bos te 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma lam gyi bzhi mdo 369—

sogs su bskyal/ thams cad kyis sum bha drag tu bzlas/ nang du 'ongs nas gtor skyel ba la bsangs chu'am nang mchod kyis gtor/ yon bdag la sogs pa gzhan gyi don du gtor ma btang ba yin na/mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang / dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang btung ba khyod kyi drangs/ khyed la rtag tu bsrung dang mchog gi 'byor pa dang / /yang na yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro bar 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod/ rang gas gyi don gang yin kyang thun mong du/ smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing / dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni/ /sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'grub par shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur te/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs gnas bcu gnyis/ /dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol pa yi/ /bu bzhin dgongs pas bdag sgrib dag gyur cig /bde ba mchog gis sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing / /rdo rje'i dbang mo'i zhabs dran gyur nas kyang / /btsun mo'i shu kra'i tshogs la rtag spyod cing / /gsang ba'i pa khror rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i/ /zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te/ /'gro ba bde ba dam pas 'phong rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang / /bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms —370—

pa/ /'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yi/ /bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yi yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang / /yun ring 'gro ba'i don bsgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang / /gtso bor sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro bas dbang bskur ba/ /srid gsum rdo rje rol bar lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog /rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong / /sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'dir ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog /ces sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rnams nges par gal che'o/ /de ltar na gtor ma'i chog 'di la/ dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin byed pa ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa yin zhing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsung ba ltar na/ dkyil 'khor rim pa gsum yin pa'i 'byung ba bzhi dang mi spyor la/ rgyud de nyid nas mdor bstan gyi skabs su/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha rnams la gza' brgyad dang / sgo 'gyud bzhin lha chen bzhi/ zur bzhir 'byung bzhi'i lha mo rnams zhal phyag can du mi mdzad par/ pad+ma dang char sprin la sogs pa'i gzugs su mdzad/ rgyas bshad kyi skabasadakyil 'khor nang ma'i lha rnams la ma mo brgyad/ de'i sgo 'byud bzhir tshangs pa sogs lha chen bzhir 'god par dngos su bshad cing / des zur bzhir 'byung bzhi'i lha mo yang 'god par don 371—

gyis thob/ de gnyis 'dam kha yin pas gang ltar byas kyang 'dra/ gzhal yas khang kun la lha rnamasarim pa gcig kho na yin pas/ phyi nang gang la 'god kyang lha brgyad pa rim pa gnyis 'god dgos pa de la/ lha snam zlum por bskor/ sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi rtsig pa la ma reg tsam bya/ de la lha brgyad dang / sgo bzhi la lha bzhi/ gru chad bzhi la 'byung bzhi'i lha mo bkod pas legs par 'ong de yang dkyil 'khor nang ma la bkod na lag len bde zhing / yang dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi don la/ zlum bskor le tshe dgu pa phyogs mdog can byas kyang legs par 'ong ngo / /de ltar 'dir dkyus su bshad pa ni/ phyi gtor gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ nang gtor gyi dbang du byas na/pad+ma'i lte bar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus sam/ le tshe dgu'i re mig dbus ma/ shin tu yangs par gyur pa'i gnas su/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gi grub par mos/ skad cig rnam pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod cing / zhal phyag rnams rim gyis gsal btab/ de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa man chad byed cing / 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi skabs/mngon rtogs dkyus dang 'dra kha cig lha sum cu so bdun po 'di bskyed pa la/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor chen mo'i dkyil 'khor la 'byung po thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bring po yin zhes 'chad pa ni/ lha grangs gcig shos mang zhing / bskyed chog rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par yang med pas/ rgyas 'bring gi dbye ba de 'dra ni mi 'thad la/ cig shos zhing skyong nyid gtso bo dang / 'di 'byung po spyi'i dkyil 'khor yin pas/ yul dang dgos pa gnyisakar cung zad mi 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhi nas tha dad yin pas/ phyir yang rgyas bsdus su 'jog rgyu ma yin no/ /'on kyang dkyil 'khor gnyis po so so dus gcig tu bzhengs nas/ cho ga'i khyad par mi 'dra ba rnams so sor skabs de nyid du lhag por sbyar/ cho ga byings 'di tshar gcig gis 'gro bar byas na ni shin tu rung la/ yang kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa rgya gar mkhas pa zhig ni/ dbus su —372—

gtso bo mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i mtha' zlum bskor gsum la zhing skyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi/lhag ma dkyil 'khor bzhi la gong du bshad pa bzhin byas nas/ phyi'i dur khrod la nag po drag po sogs zhing skyong brgyad/ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa sgom zhes bka' stsol bar mdzad do/ /'on kyang re zhig dkyil 'khor gnyis su byed pa nyid mi legs shing / bla ma dam pa de'i lugs la/ gtor ma'i bshe/dzoms kyi khyad par/ bum pa rbang gis bkang pa'i steng du/ kha zas dang dmar gyis gang ba'i gtor snod bzhag pa phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re dang / 'das gtor de ka 'dra ba gcig /brgyad po'i phyi rol lho phyogs stegs bu mtho ba la 'jog cing / thams cad ba dan gyis brgyan pa/ so sor dgos mchod re re dang bcas pa phyag len du mdzad kyin 'dug pa ni/'dir yang lag len du btab na legs so/ /yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtor chog dza na se nas mdzad pa sogs las/ ye shes pa spyan drangs ma thag tu/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'od gsal du bcug/ nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam pa can du bzhengs gsungs par 'dug lar yang 'phags yul dang bal po phyi rabs pa rnams gtor chog phal cher la lha rnams bsgyur ba 'di ka dar bar 'dug pa'i rtsa ba'i khungs slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi gtor ma chen po'i cho ga de yin 'dug cing /de'i lugs la'ang nang gtor la yin gyi phyi rol pa dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs la mi bzhed la/nang gtor la thun mong ma yin pa nang chog gis bskyed pa dang / thun mong ba'i/ nang tshan zhi ba'i phyogs la/ 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byed pa dang / drag po'i phyogs la phur pas btab nas gser 'gyur rtsi ltar bsgyur bar byed/ 'di dag la ye shes lha'i rnam par bsgyur ba yin kyang / phyag mtshan dang phyibs pa sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad 'byung ngo / /'on kyang 'di slob dpon de las brgyud pa min pas/ gong du bshad pa nyid kyis cho ga la/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'gro ba thams cad lhag pa'i lhar shes pa rtag tu dgos la/ khyad par du yang gtor mgron thams cad he ru 373—

ka'i ngo bor mos pa brtan po ni nges par dgos pa gzhir bzhag tu snang / lha'i rnam pa bsgyur ba ni med mi rung kho na yang min pas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lugs gsal bar mdzad pa'i chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos las ma bshad cing / man ngag gi rgyun la med phyin mi dgos so/ /de bzhin du dza ya se nas 'das gtor phul ma thag de dang / yig brgya bzla ba'i bar du cho ga lhag ma mang du bcug pa yang 'gal ba med mod kyi lhag po yin no/ /gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su/ sgo phrag bzhi po dngos su 'bri ba yang ma grub/ thig yongs rdzogs yang gdab par ma nus na/ sgo phrag gsum mam bzhi'i rtsa thig dang phyi'i chos 'byung dang nang gi zlum thig dang bcas ba tsam btab kyang legs par 'gyur zhing / rdul mtshon gyis 'bri ba'i phyogs la ni/ gdan dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan 'bri nus na mchog yin la/ phyag mtshan 'bri ba ma nus na gdan 'bri zhing / de yang ma nus na rdul tsho ni gyis tshom bu'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa bha wa bha dras mdzad pa na/ nyi ma spen pa sgra gcan mjug rings rnams la nyi gdan dang / gza' gzhan rnams la zla gdan zhes bshad kyang /'dir ni de lta bu mi dgos so/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud da lta yod pa 'di'i 'gyur dang dpe la/'bar byed ma dang / ngag 'phrog ma lto byang go spos par yod kyang / dpe'am 'gyur gyi skyon yin te/mkha' 'gro bzhi po de'i bzhugs gnas kyi phyogs ni rnam pa kun tu gong bzhin yin la rgyud de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos la/ da ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang gtan nas med cing / 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang gdan bzhi dpang por bzhag pa'o// //de ltar na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor chen mo dang 'gyung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma chen po 'di gnyis/ bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re yang yin na'ang / deng sang phal cher gyi ming yang ma thos 'dug pas kun la phan pa'i phyir/ tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ bkra shis//—374—

bde ba bzhugs/oṃ swa sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir bzlog ni 'di yin te/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ oṃ khyu bhā wa dang / shu n+ya tasastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng / /sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la/ /bhuX las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ser/ khong stong g.yas su drag tu 'khor/ /rtse mor rab rno lte ba dang / /rtsibs bcur pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /kun gyi steng du huX yig ni/ /lha rnams so so'i rang mdog can/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ /gdug can thams cad tshar bcad nas/ /tshur 'dus so sor thim pa las/ /rang nyid huX mdzad he ru ka /mthing ka sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ /rtsa phyag huX mdzad phyag rgya yi/ /rdo rje dril bu thugs kar 'dzin/ /tha mas glang lpags stod g.yogs bsnams/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /g.yas rkyang zhabs kyis mnan te bzhugs/ khro mo'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor ma/ /rang dang mtshungs pas 'byud par gyur/ khar du rdo rje gtum po ni/ /nag po nag ser ljang ba'i zhal/ /byang du rdo rje nyi ma ni/ /ser po zhal sum ser nag ljang / /nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar/ /brgyu sprin nag dur ba'i mdog /lho phyogs rdo rje 'khyil ba ljang / /mar gad zla ba gser gyi mdog shar ltor rdo rje gnod spyin ni/ /dud kha zhal gsum dud ser ljang / /lho nub rdo rje dus dmar —375—

po/ /dmar dang ser dang ljang khu'o/ /rlung du stobs chen sku mdog nag /nag ser pa la sha yi mdog /dbang ldan rdo rje 'jigs rung sngo/ /nag ser ljang la mig kyang yo/ /brgyad po de rnams rtsa phyag gnyis/ /cang te'u dang ni dril bu bsnams/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur/ /dkar po dkar nag ljang pa'i zhal/ /rtsa phyag 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /sgyur ga tu rdo rje sa 'og nag /dkar min ser dang ljang khu'o/ /rtsa phyag rtse sum dril bu 'dzin/ /kun kyang rang mtshungs yum gyis 'byud/ /phyogs skyong bcu po chung mar bcas/ /so so'i zhabs kyi 'og tu brdzis/ khro bo'i rgyal po bcu gcig rnams/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis thod khrag kha ṭaX ga /rab khros spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs/ khro gnyer g.yo zhing ljags kyang 'gril/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra 'bar/ /stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris shing / /phyag rgya drug dang klu chen brgyad/ /mi mgo'i do shal cod paṇa can/ /gnod byed thams cad zhal du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /lha dang 'byung po kun la sdig /'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oX oX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ huX huX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oX oX bam dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX oṃ haX yoX sngon mo gzhan rje ma/ khar oX hri mom dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par oṃ hre —376—

tri ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ huX hūX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dza o a/ go ra de ma/ ka au tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri so su/ na si ma ku/oṃ spyi bor sku yi rdo rje dkar/ /āXmagrin par gsung gi rdo rje dmar/ /huX thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje mthing / thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i bsrung 'khor ni/ khro bo'i tshogs bcas mdun du byon/ /h+pha/ dzaXhūX baX ho/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga sko rdzo3haX/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX pukhye la sogs pa lngas mchod/ khyed rnams kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam: nas sa ma ya shri huX/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/gtum po la rnam snang / nyi ma la rin 'byung / gtsug tor la snang mtha'/ 'byil ba la don grub/ g.yin rnams la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaX: la sogs pasamachod/ huX 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa'i rdo rje ni/ /drag gtum mi bzad ma rung thams cad 'joms/ /he ru ka dpal mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje khro tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spro zhing nus na yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ oṃ kha badz+ra rnyig badz+ra hūX ka badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lwa na lwarka badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oṃ brje nyi ṣa badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra huX phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā li badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra mahā ba le badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sgyi ṣa ṇa badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra urdzi ṣa tsakra warti badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra pā ta la badz+ra huX phaṭa/ hūX nga ni che hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā —377—

pā ya gro hā pā ya huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūX hūX phaṭa/ de ltar na sngags bcu gcig po ci rigs pa dang / sum bha mang du bzla/rang gi thugs ka'i huX las sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ khā gdong ma lasasteng du khwa gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma las 'og tu khyi gdong ma rnams dmar mo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/ yang na sku mdog so sor byas kyang rung ngo / /sum bha sogs lan gnyis/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces bka' sgos pas/ pho nya rnams kyis bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ nag po'i rigs can kha cig ni bsgral te bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas spar/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug ste 'ongs pa phyogs bcur mkhod/ huX las phur bu/ bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag par btad/ bgegasakyi spyi bor btsugs/ oṃ gha gha ghā tā ya ghā ta ya sarba ྅niX phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX hūX huX/ badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bi gha na kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ yang hūX las tho ba bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad/ phur bus spyi bor brdung / oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra gī la a ko ṭa ya huX phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyis bar thal byung nas/ de dag gi lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlud rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog pa thams cad bcom nas 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur wo / smon lam gyi mthu las rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje las 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/—378—

oṃ me dhi na badz+re bha wa ban+ta huX/ de las phyogs mtshams su 'phros pa las rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa'i ra ba dang / rdo rje 'phreng la song ba'i dra ba/ huX badz+ra pra ka ra huX paX hūX/ steng du 'phros pa las rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba'i gur/oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūX baX hūX/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na huX khaX hūX/ de'i phyi rol du 'obs dang bcas pa'i mda'i dra ba mde'u rno ba srid pa'i rtse mo la thug par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la traX saX traX/ de thams cad kyi phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i/ me ri 'bar ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka huX huX huX/ pho nya rnams las rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros/ rdo rje'i dra mig nas phar ro stod thon te/ sgrub pa pos ji srid byang chub ma thob kyis bar du gcod pa thams cad bgrung bar mdzad/ bzlog pa byed na slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod cig byas/ huX zhes khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs nas gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/na maXs man+ta kwa ya wā3khā+e badz+ra he ru ka naX/ oṃ oṃ huX badz+ra he ru ka tsakra brnyi/ sarba lo ki ta lo ko rta ra ni/ yan tra man tra ran tra tsuṇ+ḍa pra yo ga rī ne/ ye na ke na ci 〉 tā naX/ sa rbun/ ā ka dbye ā ka dbye/ tas+thā ya tas+thā ya/ gro hā grihā/ ༷bha ༷k+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya/ bhā sa ya bhā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ rwaX riX rnyo dzhai/ ma tha ma tha/ bi snye rgyu ya/ bi rma nu ya/ sha ta sa ha sra/ tsu tshe ya tsu nā ya/ oṃ badz+ra he ru boṣ+ṭi ṣa tsakra brnyi/ ta phya ba mu kha tsak+ṣu ban+da ban+da huX huX/ a mu ka phya 〈ma ma zhes pa 'don pa spo ma rman〉 shwan ti ku ru huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes drag tu bzla'o/ /dmigs pa'i gnad rnams man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /de'i mthar bden stobs brjod cing smod pa gdab pa ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang: zhes pa nas/—379—

ma rung pa rnams tshar bcod shog gi bar/ spros ṣa rwa lugs kyi ngag 'don yig wo du bshad pa bzhin bya/ 'od gsal du bsdu'am mi bsdu skabs dang sbyar/ bkra shis dang smon lam gang 'grub bya'o/ /yang rdo rje phag mo'i rnal 'byor la bsten pa'i phyir bzlog byed na/ skyabs sems nas tshur 'dus sor sor thim pa las/dbus su rang nyid khro bo che/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ni/ /ser po steng du gdugs dkar can/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'bar ba bskor/ /g.yon pa sbrul zhags sdigs mdzub can/ shar du sngo skya khwa gdong ma/ /byang du ljang skya lug gdong ma/ /nub tu dmar skya khyi gdong ma/ /lho phyogs ser skya phag gdong ma/ khar lhor gshin rje brtan ma dang / /lho nub gshin rje pho nya ma/ /nub byang gshin rje che ba ma/ /byang shar gshin rje 'joms ma rnams/ /phyogs mdog dbang gis phyed gzugs can/ /steng dang 'og tu khwa gdong dang / khyi gdong ma yang rnam par gnas/ /de ltar de rnams thams cad kyang / /rab khros spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs nas/ 'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba yi/ /thugs ka rab tu yangs pa'i nang / /e las chos 'byung gru gsum dbus/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs drug la/ /rdo rje phag mo gzhin rje ma/ /rmongs byed ma dang skyod byed ma/ /skrag byed ma dang rta ka /'khor lo'i lte ba zlum po la/ /rang sems ba yig gyur pa las/zhes pa'i rjes su/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo lko pa nas/ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /ces pa'i bar brjod/ desamatshon nas rdo rje phag mo'i rigs gang la sbyar kyang 'dra/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ oṃ —380—

ha/ zhes pa nas/ gsungs shing dbang bskur/ zhes pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ khro bo'i zhes pa la lha tshogs zhes pa mdun du byon zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ gtso mo dang rnal 'byor ma drug la mi bskyod pa/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba la rnam snang /'khor gzhan rnams la don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ ar+gha: la sogs pa'i mchod/yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ hru 'jigs byed: sogs la/ he ru ka dpal zhes pa rnal gam 'byar ma dpal zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba gong bzhin gyis kyang bstod do/ /de nas oṃ gsum ma lta bu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sngags snying po skabs su gang babs de dang / sum bha: mang du bzlas/ bhu zhes bya ba'ang mang du brjod nas/ o usti ṣa tsakra bā sgro badz+ra hū phaṭa/ ces pa dang / ka ka phya la sogs pa yang mang du bzlas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hu las sgo man los ma brgyad sprul/ ces pa nas/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad/ de nas spro na gong bzhin mchod bstod tshar gcig bya/ usti khri'i sngags la/ badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa'i gnas gsum du/ badz+ra bā ra hi/ zhes pa bcug ste drag tu bzla'o/ /phag mo las bcu'i gzhung na gsang 'dus usti— ṣa'i sngags la/ usti ṣa tsakra bā rnyi/ zhes pa'i sngon du/ badz+ra bā ra hi/ zhes 'don pa dang / steng 'og gi khro mo mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma yin par mdzad pas/ spyir ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du byas pas chog kyang / skabs su babs pa ni 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi bshad rgyud las byung ba yin pas/ gong du smos pa'i sngags la 'don pa spo bar bya'o/ /yang rdo rje phag mo'i phyir bzlog 'di la/ khro bo gtsug tor gong du smos pa'i dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par sgom na'ang legs la gtsug tor 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i tshab tu 'chi med rdo rje lha mo sgom na'ang shin tu legs pa dang / rdo rje lha mo kho na la brten te phyir bzlog byas kyang rung ba yin no/ /de dag gi don rgyas par bde mchog khro bo rnam rol tu 4gad zin pa ltar yang legs par rtogs na 'phrin —381—
/ thas smras pa'o

oṃ swā sti/ oṃ swa bha ba shurnya khyu bhā dharma swabha ba shurnyo rdo3haX/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung dang bcas par gyur/ rtsa gsum rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i ra ba gsum yang grub/ bhuX bhuX bhuX dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i rang nyid bde mchog khro bo reg tshig nag po/ g.yas rdo rje'i rtse la me'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang /g.yon rtse gsum gyi rtse la rlung gi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pas bskor ba/ zhabs g.yon bskum/ g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa/ 'khe/ra lo dang sna tshogs rdo rje brtsegs pas spyi bo rus brgyan dang dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang tri shu la 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral par bhuX dkar po/ snying gar huX sngon po/ lte bar a ser po/ bol du taX ljang khu/ mig la traX dkar po/ rna bar huX ser po/ sna la tri dud kha/ lce la āXdamar po/ lus la kha ljang khu/ yid la tuX mthing kha'o/ /rtsibs bcu la rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo khro mo spros/ ar+ghaX nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo reg tshig stobs po che/ /mun pa lta bu'i sku 'dzin zhing / /phaṭa kyi sgra 'byin me dpung 'bar/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ bha ya nā shā ni/ tra sa ni/ sarba mā ra/ pra tu zhi ra bi nā sha ya/ ye ke tsit+ta/ du tsho/ twa ma ma bi rū pa ki/ ṭa an+ti ta ni/ sarba mā ra/ pra dra sko ri/ ni ba ta hūX phaṭa/ me rlud steng du dgra bgegs byad ma bkug /'khor lo 'khor bas rtsibs —383—

kyis gtubs par bsam mo ci nus bzla zhes thal mo gdeng zhing / dkon mchog gsum gyis bden pa'i stobs kyis su gang dag bdag la sdang ba'i sems can dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kyi lus bcing par bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing par bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig /stobs brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i sngags kyi de nyid brlag par cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dre de nyid kyi sha la za bar gyur cigades byas pa'i sbyor ba thams cad de nyid la bzlog par gyur cig sna tshogs rdo rje dang nyi zla'i bar du ba khas par bsam la/ thal mo brdab/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs/rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/gdul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rung pa rnams tshar gcod shog /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hū hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhesapa'ang sa skyong mi'i dbang po gzhon nu kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i thugs dam du tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ ma ṅga la// //—384—
